901.t: raag raamakalee mahalaa panjavaa ghar doojaa dhupadhe
901.e: Raag Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla, Second House, Dho-Padhay:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Sing the songs of Praise of the Lord.

901.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
901.t: naam japat param sukh paieeaai aavaa gaun miTai mere meet ||1|| rahaau ||
901.e: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, total peace is obtained; coming and going is ended, my friend. ||1||Pause||
Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, one is enlightened,
and comes to dwell in His lotus feet. ||1||
In the Society of the Saints, one is saved.
O Nanak, he crosses over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||1||57||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:
My Guru is perfect, my Guru is perfect.

901.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਰੋਗ ਕੂਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
901.t: raam naam jap sadhaa suhele sagal binaase rog kooraa ||1|| rahaau ||
901.e: Chanting the Lord's Name, I am always at peace; all my illness and fraud is dispelled. ||1||Pause||
Worship and adore that One Lord alone.

901.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
901.t: jaa kee saran sadhaa sukh hoi ||1||
901.e: In His Sanctuary, eternal peace is obtained. ||1||

901.g: ਨੀਦ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਲਾਗੀ ਭੂਖ ॥
901.t: needh suhelee naam kee laagee bhookh ||
901.e: One who feels hunger for the Naam sleeps in peace.
Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, all pains are dispelled. ||2||
Enjoy celestial bliss, O my Siblings of Destiny.
The Perfect Guru has eradicated all anxiety. ||3||

901.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
901.t: aaTh pahar prabh kaa jap jaap ||
901.e: Twenty-four hours a day, chant God's Chant.
O Nanak, He Himself shall save you. ||4||2||58||

901.t: raag raamakalee mahalaa panjavaa paRataal ghar teejaa
901.e: Raag Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla, Partaal, Third House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
I humbly bow to the Lord, the Supreme Being.

901.g: ਜਲਨ ਥਲਨ ਬਸੁਧ ਗਗਨ ਏਕ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
901.t: jalan thalan basudh gagan ek eka(n)kaara(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
901.e: The One, the One and Only Creator Lord permeates the water, the land, the earth and the sky. ||1||Pause||
Over and over again, the Creator Lord destroys, sustains and creates.
He has no home; He needs no nourishment. ||1||

901.g: ਗੰਭੀਰ ਧੀਰ ਨਾਮ ਹੀਰ ਊਚ ਮੂਚ ਅਪਾਰੰ ॥
901.t: ga(n)bheer dheer naam heer uooch mooch apaara(n) ||
901.e: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is deep and profound, strong, poised, lofty, exalted and infinite.

901.g: ਕਰਨ ਕੇਲ ਗੁਣ ਅਮੋਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੰ ॥੨॥੧॥੫੯॥
901.t: karan kel gun amol naanak balihaara(n) ||2||1||59||
901.e: He stages His plays; His Virtues are priceless. Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||2||1||59||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:

901.g: ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਭੋਗ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਚਲੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਛਲੇ ਕਨਿਕ ਕਾਮਿਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
901.t: roop ra(n)g suga(n)dh bhog tiaag chale maiaa chhale kanik kaaminee ||1|| rahaau ||
901.e: You must abandon your beauty, pleasures, fragrances and enjoyments; beguiled by gold and sexual desire, you must still leave Maya behind. ||1||Pause||

901.g: ਭੰਡਾਰ ਦਰਬ ਅਰਬ ਖਰਬ ਪੇਖਿ ਲੀਲਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਧਾਰੈ ॥
901.t: bha(n)ddaar dharab arab kharab pekh leelaa man sadhaarai ||
901.e: You gaze upon billions and trillions of treasures and riches, which delight and comfort your mind,
but these will not go along with you. ||1||

901.g: ਸੁਤ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਮੀਤ ਉਰਝਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਭਰਮਿ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਇਹ ਬਿਰਖ ਛਾਮਨੀ ॥
901.t: sut kalatr bhraat meet urajh pario bharam mohio ieh birakh chhaamanee ||
901.e: Entangled with children, spouse, siblings and friends, you are enticed and fooled; these pass like the shadow of a tree.

901.g: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਸੰਤ ਭਾਵਨੀ ॥੨॥੨॥੬੦॥
901.t: charan kamal saran naanak sukh sa(n)t bhaavanee ||2||2||60||
901.e: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of His lotus feet; He has found peace in the faith of the Saints. ||2||2||60||
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Raag Raamkalee, Ninth Mehla, Thi-Padhay:

901.g: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਓਟ ਲੇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
901.t: re man oT leh har naamaa ||
901.e: O mind, take the sheltering support of the Lord's Name.

901.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਸੈ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
901.t: jaa kai simaran dhuramat naasai paaveh padh nirabaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
901.e: Remembering Him in meditation, evil-mindedness is dispelled, and the state of Nirvaanaa is obtained. ||1||Pause||

901.g: ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ਤਿਹ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
901.t: baddabhaagee teh jan kau jaanahu jo har ke gun gaavai ||
901.e: Know that one who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord is very fortunate.

901.g: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਖੋਇ ਕੈ ਫੁਨਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
901.t: janam janam ke paap khoi kai fun baiku(n)Th sidhaavai ||1||
901.e: The sins of countless incarnations are washed off, and he attains the heavenly realm. ||1||

902.g: ਅਜਾਮਲ ਕਉ ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਸੁਧਿ ਆਈ ॥
902.t: ajaamal kau a(n)t kaal meh naarain sudh aaiee ||
902.e: At the very last moment, Ajaamal became aware of the Lord;

902.g: ਜਾਂ ਗਤਿ ਕਉ ਜੋਗੀਸੁਰ ਬਾਛਤ ਸੋ ਗਤਿ ਛਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
902.t: jaa(n) gat kau jogeesur baachhat so gat chhin meh paiee ||2||
902.e: that state which even the supreme Yogis desire - he attained that state in an instant. ||2||

902.g: ਨਾਹਿਨ ਗੁਨੁ ਨਾਹਿਨ ਕਛੁ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਗਜਿ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
902.t: naahin gun naahin kachh bidhiaa dharam kaun gaj keenaa ||
902.e: The elephant had no virtue and no knowledge; what religious rituals has he performed?

902.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਰਾਮ ਕਾ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਅਭੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਤਿਹ ਦੀਨਾ ॥੩॥੧॥
902.t: naanak biradh raam kaa dhekhahu abhai dhaan teh dheenaa ||3||1||
902.e: O Nanak, behold the way of the Lord, who bestowed the gift of fearlessness. ||3||1||

902.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
902.t: raamakalee mahalaa nauvaa ||
902.e: Raamkalee, Ninth Mehla:

902.g: ਸਾਧੋ ਕਉਨ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਅਬ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
902.t: saadho kaun jugat ab keejai ||
902.e: Holy people: what way should I now adopt,

902.g: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
902.t: jaa te dhuramat sagal binaasai raam bhagat man bheejai ||1|| rahaau ||
902.e: by which all evil-mindedness may be dispelled, and the mind may vibrate in devotional worship to the Lord? ||1||Pause||

902.g: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਿ ਉਰਝਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਹੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਨਹ ਕਛੁ ਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
902.t: man maiaa meh urajh rahio hai boojhai neh kachh giaanaa ||
902.e: My mind is entangled in Maya; it knows nothing at all of spiritual wisdom.

902.g: ਕਉਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਗੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
902.t: kaun naam jag jaa kai simarai paavai padh nirabaanaa ||1||
902.e: What is that Name, by which the world, contemplating it, might attain the state of Nirvaanaa? ||1||

902.g: ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਤਬ ਇਹ ਬਾਤ ਬਤਾਈ ॥
902.t: bhe dhiaal kirapaal sa(n)t jan tab ieh baat bataiee ||
902.e: When the Saints became kind and compassionate, they told me this.

902.g: ਸਰਬ ਧਰਮ ਮਾਨੋ ਤਿਹ ਕੀਏ ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗਾਈ ॥੨॥
902.t: sarab dharam maano teh ke'ee jeh prabh keerat gaiee ||2||
902.e: Understand, that whoever sings the Kirtan of God's Praises, has performed all religious rituals. ||2||

902.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਰੁ ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਮਹਿ ਨਿਮਖ ਏਕ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
902.t: raam naam nar nis baasur meh nimakh ek ur dhaarai ||
902.e: One who enshrines the Lord's Name in his heart night and day - even for an instant

902.g: ਜਮ ਕੋ ਤ੍ਰਾਸੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਹ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰੈ ॥੩॥੨॥
902.t: jam ko traas miTai naanak teh apuno janam savaarai ||3||2||
902.e: - has his fear of Death eradicated. O Nanak, his life is approved and fulfilled. ||3||2||

902.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
902.t: raamakalee mahalaa nauvaa ||
902.e: Raamkalee, Ninth Mehla:

902.g: ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਸੁਧਿ ਲੇਹਿ ॥
902.t: praanee naarain sudh leh ||
902.e: O mortal, focus your thoughts on the Lord.

902.g: ਛਿਨੁ ਛਿਨੁ ਅਉਧ ਘਟੈ ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਜਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਦੇਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
902.t: chhin chhin aaudh ghaTai nis baasur birathaa jaat hai dheh ||1|| rahaau ||
902.e: Moment by moment, your life is running out; night and day, your body is passing away in vain. ||1||Pause||

902.g: ਤਰਨਾਪੋ ਬਿਖਿਅਨ ਸਿਉ ਖੋਇਓ ਬਾਲਪਨੁ ਅਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
902.t: taranaapo bikhian siau khoio baalapan agiaanaa ||
902.e: You have wasted your youth in corrupt pleasures, and your childhood in ignorance.

902.g: ਬਿਰਧਿ ਭਇਓ ਅਜਹੂ ਨਹੀ ਸਮਝੈ ਕਉਨ ਕੁਮਤਿ ਉਰਝਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
902.t: biradh bhio ajahoo nahee samajhai kaun kumat urajhaanaa ||1||
902.e: You have grown old, and even now, you do not understand, the evil-mindedness in which you are entangled. ||1||

902.g: ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੀਓ ਜਿਹ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਸੋ ਤੈ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰਾਇਓ ॥
902.t: maanas janam dheeo jeh Thaakur so tai kiau bisaraio ||
902.e: Why have you forgotten your Lord and Master, who blessed you with this human life?

902.g: ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹੋਤ ਨਰ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਗਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
902.t: mukat hot nar jaa kai simarai nimakh na taa kau gaio ||2||
902.e: Remembering Him in meditation, one is liberated. And yet, you do not sing His Praises, even for an instant. ||2||

902.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਕੋ ਮਦੁ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਜਾਈ ॥
902.t: maiaa ko madh kahaa karat hai sa(n)g na kaahoo jaiee ||
902.e: Why are you intoxicated with Maya? It will not go along with you.

902.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹਤੁ ਚੇਤਿ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਹੈ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੩॥੩॥੮੧॥
902.t: naanak kahat chet chi(n)taaman hoi hai a(n)t sahaiee ||3||3||81||
902.e: Says Nanak, think of Him, remember Him in your mind. He is the Fulfiller of desires, who will be your help and support in the end. ||3||3||81||

902.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ
902.t: raamakalee mahalaa pehilaa asaTapadheeaa
902.e: Raamkalee, First Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa:

902.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
902.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
902.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

902.g: ਸੋਈ ਚੰਦੁ ਚੜਹਿ ਸੇ ਤਾਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਦਿਨੀਅਰੁ ਤਪਤ ਰਹੈ ॥
902.t: soiee cha(n)dh chaReh se taare soiee dhineear tapat rahai ||
902.e: The same moon rises, and the same stars; the same sun shines in the sky.

902.g: ਸਾ ਧਰਤੀ ਸੋ ਪਉਣੁ ਝੁਲਾਰੇ ਜੁਗ ਜੀਅ ਖੇਲੇ ਥਾਵ ਕੈਸੇ ॥੧॥
902.t: saa dharatee so paun jhulaare jug jeea khele thaav kaise ||1||
902.e: The earth is the same, and the same wind blows. The age in which we dwell affects living beings, but not these places. ||1||

902.g: ਜੀਵਨ ਤਲਬ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥
902.t: jeevan talab nivaar ||
902.e: Give up your attachment to life.

902.g: ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਧਿਙਾਣਾ ਕਲਿ ਲਖਣ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
902.t: hovai paravaanaa kareh dhin(g)aanaa kal lakhan veechaar ||1|| rahaau ||
902.e: Those who act like tyrants are accepted and approved - recognize that this is the sign of the Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||1||Pause||

902.g: ਕਿਤੈ ਦੇਸਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਤੀਰਥ ਪਾਸਿ ਨ ਬੈਠਾ ॥
902.t: kitai dhes na aaiaa suneeaai teerath paas na baiThaa ||
902.e: Kali Yuga has not been heard to have come to any country, or to be sitting at any sacred shrine.

902.g: ਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਹਲ ਉਸਾਰਿ ਨ ਬੈਠਾ ॥੨॥
902.t: dhaataa dhaan kare teh naahee mahal usaar na baiThaa ||2||
902.e: It is not where the generous person gives to charities, nor seated in the mansion he has built. ||2||

902.g: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਸਤੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਛੀਜੈ ਤਪ ਘਰਿ ਤਪੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
902.t: je ko sat kare so chheejai tap ghar tap na hoiee ||
902.e: If someone practices Truth, he is frustrated; prosperity does not come to the home of the sincere.

902.g: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ਲਏ ਬਦਨਾਵੀ ਕਲਿ ਕੇ ਲਖਣ ਏਈ ॥੩॥
902.t: je ko naau le badhanaavee kal ke lakhan eiee ||3||
902.e: If someone chants the Lord's Name, he is scorned. These are the signs of Kali Yuga. ||3||

902.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਕਦਾਰੀ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਖੁਆਰੀ ਚਾਕਰ ਕੇਹੇ ਡਰਣਾ ॥
902.t: jis sikadhaaree tiseh khuaaree chaakar kehe ddaranaa ||
902.e: Whoever is in charge, is humiliated. Why should the servant be afraid,

902.g: ਜਾ ਸਿਕਦਾਰੈ ਪਵੈ ਜੰਜੀਰੀ ਤਾ ਚਾਕਰ ਹਥਹੁ ਮਰਣਾ ॥੪॥
902.t: jaa sikadhaarai pavai ja(n)jeeree taa chaakar hathahu maranaa ||4||
902.e: when the master is put in chains? He dies at the hands of his servant. ||4||

903.e: Chant the Praises of the Lord; Kali Yuga has come.

903.g: ਤਿਹੁ ਜੁਗ ਕੇਰਾ ਰਹਿਆ ਤਪਾਵਸੁ ਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਦੇਹਿ ਤ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
903.t: tih jug keraa rahiaa tapaavas je gun dheh ta paieeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
903.e: The justice of the previous three ages is gone. One obtains virtue, only if the Lord bestows it. ||1||Pause||

903.g: ਕਲਿ ਕਲਵਾਲੀ ਸਰਾ ਨਿਬੇੜੀ ਕਾਜੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਹੋਆ ॥
903.t: kal kalavaalee saraa nibeRee kaajee kirasanaa hoaa ||
903.e: In this turbulent age of Kali Yuga, Muslim law decides the cases, and the blue-robed Qazi is the judge.

903.g: ਬਾਣੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬੇਦੁ ਅਥਰਬਣੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਲਹਿਆ ॥੫॥
903.t: baanee brahamaa bedh atharaban karanee keerat lahiaa ||5||
903.e: The Guru's Bani has taken the place of Brahma's Veda, and the singing of the Lord's Praises are good deeds. ||5||

903.g: ਪਤਿ ਵਿਣੁ ਪੂਜਾ ਸਤ ਵਿਣੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਜਤ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਾਹੇ ਜਨੇਊ ॥
903.t: pat vin poojaa sat vin sa(n)jam jat vin kaahe janeuoo ||
903.e: Worship without faith; self-discipline without truthfulness; the ritual of the sacred thread without chastity - what good are these?

903.g: ਨਾਵਹੁ ਧੋਵਹੁ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਚੜਾਵਹੁ ਸੁਚ ਵਿਣੁ ਸੋਚ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥
903.t: naavahu dhovahu tilak chaRaavahu such vin soch na hoiee ||6||
903.e: You may bathe and wash, and apply a ritualistic tilak mark to your forehead, but without inner purity, there is no understanding. ||6||
In Kali Yuga, the Koran and the Bible have become famous.
The Pandit's scriptures and the Puraanas are not respected.
O Nanak, the Lord's Name now is Rehmaan, the Merciful.
Know that there is only One Creator of the creation. ||7||

903.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਏਦੂ ਉਪਰਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਨਹੀ ॥
903.t: naanak naam milai vaddiaaiee edhoo upar karam nahee ||
903.e: Nanak has obtained the glorious greatness of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. There is no action higher than this.

903.g: ਜੇ ਘਰਿ ਹੋਦੈ ਮੰਗਣਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਫਿਰਿ ਓਲਾਮਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਹੀ ॥੮॥੧॥
903.t: je ghar hodhai ma(n)gan jaieeaai fir olaamaa milai tahee ||8||1||
903.e: If someone goes out to beg for what is already in his own home, then he should be chastised. ||8||1||
Raamkalee, First Mehla:
You preach to the world, and set up your house.
Abandoning your Yogic postures, how will you find the True Lord?
You are attached to possessiveness and the love of sexual pleasure.
You are not a renunciate, nor a man of the world. ||1||

903.g: ਜੋਗੀ ਬੈਸਿ ਰਹਹੁ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
903.t: jogee bais rahahu dhubidhaa dhukh bhaagai ||
903.e: Yogi, remain seated, and the pain of duality will run away from you.

903.g: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮਾਗਤ ਲਾਜ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
903.t: ghar ghar maagat laaj na laagai ||1|| rahaau ||
903.e: You beg from door to door, and you don't feel ashamed. ||1||Pause||
You sing the songs, but you do not understand your own self.
How will the burning pain within be relieved?

903.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਚੈ ਮਨ ਭਾਇ ॥
903.t: gur kai sabadh rachai man bhai ||
903.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, let your mind be absorbed in the Lord's Love,
and you will intuitively experience the charity of contemplation. ||2||
You apply ashes to your body, while acting in hypocrisy.
Attached to Maya, you will be beaten by Death's heavy club.
Your begging bowl is broken; it will not hold the charity of the Lord's Love.
Bound in bondage, you come and go. ||3||
You do not control your seed and semen, and yet you claim to practice abstinence.
You beg from Maya, lured by the three qualities.
You have no compassion; the Lord's Light does not shine in you.
You are drowned, drowned in worldly entanglements. ||4||
You wear religious robes, and your patched coat assumes many disguises.
You play all sorts of false tricks, like a juggler.
The fire of anxiety burns brightly within you.
Without the karma of good actions, how can you cross over? ||5||
You make ear-rings of glass to wear in your ears.
But liberation does not come from learning without understanding.
You are lured by the tastes of the tongue and sex organs.
You have become a beast; this sign cannot be erased. ||6||
The people of the world are entangled in the three modes; the Yogis are entangled in the three modes.
Contemplating the Word of the Shabad, sorrows are dispelled.
Through the Shabad, one becomes radiant, pure and truthful.
One who contemplates the true lifestyle is a Yogi. ||7||

903.g: ਤੁਝ ਪਹਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਤੂ ਕਰਣੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
903.t: tujh peh nau nidh too karanai jog ||
903.e: The nine treasures are with You, Lord; You are potent, the Cause of causes.
You establish and disestablish; whatever You do, happens.
One who practices celibacy, chastity, self-control, truth and pure consciousness
- O Nanak, that Yogi is the friend of the three worlds. ||8||2||
Raamkalee, First Mehla:
Above the six chakras of the body dwells the detached mind.
Awareness of the vibration of the Word of the Shabad has been awakened deep within.
The unstruck melody of the sound current resonates and resounds within; my mind is attuned to it.
Through the Guru's Teachings, my faith is confirmed in the True Name. ||1||
O mortal, through devotion to the Lord, peace is obtained.

903.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
903.t: gurmukh har har meeThaa laagai har har naam samaieeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
903.e: The Lord, Har, Har, seems sweet to the Gurmukh, who merges in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

904.e: Eradicating attachment to Maya, one merges into the Lord.
Meeting with the True Guru, we unite in His Union.
The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is a priceless jewel, a diamond.
Attuned to it, the mind is comforted and encouraged. ||2||
The diseases of egotism and possessiveness do not afflict

904.g: ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
904.t: raam bhagat jam kaa bhau bhaagai ||
904.e: one who worships the Lord. Fear of the Messenger of Death runs away.
The Messenger of Death, the enemy of the soul, does not touch me at all.
The Immaculate Name of the Lord illuminates my heart. ||3||
Contemplating the Shabad, we become Nirankaari - we come to belong to the Formless Lord God.
Awakening to the Guru's Teachings, evil-mindedness is taken away.
Remaining awake and aware night and day, lovingly focused on the Lord,
one becomes Jivan Mukta - liberated while yet alive. He finds this state deep within himself. ||4||
In the secluded cave, I remain unattached.
With the Word of the Shabad, I have killed the five thieves.

904.g: ਪਰ ਘਰ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਮਨੁ ਡੋਲਾਏ ॥
904.t: par ghar jai na man ddolaae ||
904.e: My mind does not waver or go to the home of any other.
I remain intuitively absorbed deep within. ||5||
As Gurmukh, I remain awake and aware, unattached.
Forever detached, I am woven into the essence of reality.
The world is asleep; it dies, and comes and goes in reincarnation.

904.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਨ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੬॥
904.t: bin gur sabadh na sojhee pai ||6||
904.e: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it does not understand. ||6||
The unstruck sound current of the Shabad vibrates day and night.
The Gurmukh knows the state of the eternal, unchanging Lord God.
When someone realizes the Shabad, then he truly knows.
The One Lord is permeating and pervading everywhere in Nirvaanaa. ||7||
My mind is intuitively absorbed in the state of deepest Samaadhi;
renouncing egotism and greed, I have come to know the One Lord.
When the disciple's mind accepts the Guru,
O Nanak, duality is eradicated, and he merges in the Lord. ||8||3||
Raamkalee, First Mehla:
You calculate the auspicious days, but you do not understand
that the One Creator Lord is above these auspicious days.

904.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋਈ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
904.t: jis gur milai soiee bidh jaanai ||
904.e: He alone knows the way, who meets the Guru.
When one follows the Guru's Teachings, then he realizes the Hukam of God's Command. ||1||

904.g: ਝੂਠੁ ਨ ਬੋਲਿ ਪਾਡੇ ਸਚੁ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
904.t: jhooTh na bol paadde sach kaheeaai ||
904.e: Do not tell lies, O Pandit; O religious scholar, speak the Truth.

904.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ਸਬਦਿ ਘਰੁ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
904.t: haumai jai sabadh ghar laheeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
904.e: When egotism is eradicated through the Word of the Shabad, then one finds His home. ||1||Pause||
Calculating and counting, the astrologer draws the horoscope.
He studies it and announces it, but he does not understand reality.
Understand, that the Word of the Guru's Shabad is above all.

904.g: ਹੋਰ ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਉ ਨ ਸਗਲੀ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
904.t: hor kathanee badhau na sagalee chhaar ||2||
904.e: Do not speak of anything else; it is all just ashes. ||2||
You bathe, wash, and worship stones.
But without being imbued with the Lord, you are the filthiest of the filthy.
Subduing your pride, you shall receive the supreme wealth of God.
The mortal is liberated and emancipated, meditating on the Lord. ||3||
You study the arguments, but do not contemplate the Vedas.
You drown yourself - how will you save your ancestors?

904.g: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਚੀਨੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
904.t: ghaT ghaT braham cheenai jan koi ||
904.e: How rare is that person who realizes that God is in each and every heart.
When one meets the True Guru, then he understands. ||4||
Making his calculations, cynicism and suffering afflict his soul.

904.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਵੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਥੀਐ ॥
904.t: gur kee saran pavai sukh theeaai ||
904.e: Seeking the Sanctuary of the Guru, peace is found.
I sinned and made mistakes, but now I seek Your Sanctuary.
The Guru led me to meet the Lord, according to my past actions. ||5||

904.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਨ ਆਈਐ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
904.t: gur saran na aaieeaai braham na paieeaai ||
904.e: If one does not enter the Guru's Sanctuary, God cannot be found.
Deluded by doubt, one is born, only to die, and come back again.
Dying in corruption, he is bound and gagged at Death's door.

904.g: ਨਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਚਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
904.t: naa ridhai naam na sabadh achaar ||6||
904.e: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is not in his heart, and he does not act according to the Shabad. ||6||
Some call themselves Pandits, religious scholars and spiritual teachers.
Tinged with double-mindedness, they do not find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

905.e: One who takes the Support of the Naam, by Guru's Grace,
is a rare person, one among millions, incomparable. ||7||
One is bad, and another good, but the One True Lord is contained in all.
Understand this, O spiritual teacher, through the support of the True Guru:
rare indeed is that Gurmukh, who realizes the One Lord.
His comings and goings cease, and he merges in the Lord. ||8||
Those who have the One Universal Creator Lord within their hearts,
possess all virtues; they contemplate the True Lord.
One who acts in harmony with the Guru's Will,
O Nanak, is absorbed in the Truest of the True. ||9||4||
Raamkalee, First Mehla:
Practicing restraint by Hatha Yoga, the body wears away.

905.g: ਵਰਤੁ ਤਪਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
905.t: varat tapan kar man nahee bheejai ||
905.e: The mind is not softened by fasting or austerities.

905.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਪੂਜੈ ॥੧॥
905.t: raam naam sar avar na poojai ||1||
905.e: Nothing else is equal to worship of the Lord's Name. ||1||

905.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਮਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸੰਗੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
905.t: gur sev manaa har jan sa(n)g keejai ||
905.e: Serve the Guru, O mind, and associate with the humble servants of the Lord.

905.g: ਜਮੁ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨਹੀ ਸਾਕੈ ਸਰਪਨਿ ਡਸਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
905.t: jam ja(n)dhaar joh nahee saakai sarapan ddas na sakai har kaa ras peejai ||1|| rahaau ||
905.e: The tyrannical Messenger of Death cannot touch you, and the serpent of Maya cannot sting you, when you drink in the sublime essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
The world reads the arguments, and is softened only by music.
In the three modes and corruption, they are born and die.
Without the Lord's Name, they endure suffering and pain. ||2||
The Yogi draws the breath upwards, and opens the Tenth Gate.
He practices inner cleansing and the six rituals of purification.

905.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਸਾਸੁ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੩॥
905.t: raam naam bin birathaa saas leejai ||3||
905.e: But without the Lord's Name, the breath he draws is useless. ||3||

905.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪੰਚ ਅਗਨਿ ਕਿਉ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਧੀਜੈ ॥
905.t: a(n)tar pa(n)ch agan kiau dheeraj dheejai ||
905.e: The fire of the five passions burns within him; how can he be calm?
The thief is within him; how can he taste the taste?
One who becomes Gurmukh conquers the body-fortress. ||4||
With filth within, he wanders around at places of pilgrimage.

905.g: ਮਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਸੂਚਾ ਕਿਆ ਸੋਚ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
905.t: man nahee soochaa kiaa soch kareejai ||
905.e: His mind is not pure, so what is the use of performing ritual cleansings?

905.g: ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ ਦੋਸੁ ਕਾ ਕਉ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੫॥
905.t: kirat piaa dhos kaa kau dheejai ||5||
905.e: He carries the karma of his own past actions; who else can he blame? ||5||

905.g: ਅੰਨੁ ਨ ਖਾਹਿ ਦੇਹੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
905.t: a(n)n na khaeh dhehee dhukh dheejai ||
905.e: He does not eat food; he tortures his body.

905.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਥੀਜੈ ॥
905.t: bin gur giaan tirapat nahee theejai ||
905.e: Without the Guru's wisdom, he is not satisfied.
The self-willed manmukh is born only to die, and be born again. ||6||
Go, and ask the True Guru, and associate with the Lord's humble servants.

905.g: ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਚੈ ਨਹੀ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੀਜੈ ॥
905.t: man har raachai nahee janam mareejai ||
905.e: Your mind shall merge into the Lord, and you shall not be reincarnated to die again.

905.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਮੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੭॥
905.t: raam naam bin kiaa karam keejai ||7||
905.e: Without the Lord's Name, what can anyone do? ||7||
Silence the mouse scurrying around within you.
Serve the Primal Lord, by chanting the Lord's Name.

905.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੮॥੫॥
905.t: naanak naam milai kirapaa prabh keejai ||8||5||
905.e: O Nanak, God blesses us with His Name, when He grants His Grace. ||8||5||
Raamkalee, First Mehla:
The created Universe emanated from within You; there is no other at all.

905.g: ਜੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ॥
905.t: jo kaheeaai so prabh te hoiee ||
905.e: Whatever is said to be, is from You, O God.
He is the True Lord and Master, throughout the ages.
Creation and destruction do not come from anyone else. ||1||
Such is my Lord and Master, profound and unfathomable.

905.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਜਮ ਤੀਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
905.t: jin japiaa tin hee sukh paiaa har kai naam na lagai jam teer ||1|| rahaau ||
905.e: Whoever meditates on Him, finds peace. The arrow of the Messenger of Death does not strike one who has the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is a priceless jewel, a diamond.
The True Lord Master is immortal and immeasurable.
That tongue which chants the True Name is pure.
The True Lord is in the home of the self; there is no doubt about it. ||2||

905.g: ਇਕਿ ਬਨ ਮਹਿ ਬੈਸਹਿ ਡੂਗਰਿ ਅਸਥਾਨੁ ॥
905.t: eik ban meh baiseh ddoogar asathaan ||
905.e: Some sit in the forests, and some make their home in the mountains.
Forgetting the Naam, they rot away in egotistical pride.
Without the Naam, what is the use of spiritual wisdom and meditation?
The Gurmukhs are honored in the Court of the Lord. ||3||
Acting stubbornly in egotism, one does not find the Lord.
Studying the scriptures, reading them to other people,

906.g: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਭਰਮਸਿ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
906.t: teerath bharamas biaadh na jaavai ||
906.e: and wandering around at places of pilgrimage, the disease is not taken away.

906.g: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੪॥
906.t: naam binaa kaise sukh paavai ||4||
906.e: Without the Naam, how can one find peace? ||4||

906.g: ਜਤਨ ਕਰੈ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਕਿਵੈ ਨ ਰਹਾਈ ॥
906.t: jatan karai bi(n)dh kivai na rahaiee ||
906.e: No matter how much he tries, he cannot control his semen and seed.

906.g: ਮਨੂਆ ਡੋਲੈ ਨਰਕੇ ਪਾਈ ॥
906.t: manooaa ddolai narake paiee ||
906.e: His mind wavers, and he falls into hell.

906.g: ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਾਧੋ ਲਹੈ ਸਜਾਈ ॥
906.t: jam pur baadho lahai sajaiee ||
906.e: Bound and gagged in the City of Death, he is tortured.

906.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ ਜਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੫॥
906.t: bin naavai jeeau jal bal jaiee ||5||
906.e: Without the Name, his soul cries out in agony. ||5||

906.g: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਕੇਤੇ ਮੁਨਿ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
906.t: sidh saadhik kete mun dhevaa ||
906.e: The many Siddhas and seekers, silent sages and demi-gods

906.g: ਹਠਿ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵਹਿ ਭੇਵਾ ॥
906.t: haTh nigreh na tirapataaveh bhevaa ||
906.e: cannot satisfy themselves by practicing restraint through Hatha Yoga.

906.g: ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਗਹਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
906.t: sabadh veechaar gaheh gur sevaa ||
906.e: One who contemplates the Word of the Shabad, and serves the Guru

906.g: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥੬॥
906.t: man tan niramal abhimaan abhevaa ||6||
906.e: - his mind and body become immaculate, and his egotistical pride is obliterated. ||6||

906.g: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਾਵੈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
906.t: karam milai paavai sach naau ||
906.e: Blessed with Your Grace, I obtain the True Name.

906.g: ਤੁਮ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਰਹਉ ਸੁਭਾਉ ॥
906.t: tum saranaagat rahau subhaau ||
906.e: I remain in Your Sanctuary, in loving devotion.

906.g: ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਭਗਤੀ ਭਾਉ ॥
906.t: tum te upajio bhagatee bhaau ||
906.e: Love for Your devotional worship has welled up within me.

906.g: ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਉ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੭॥
906.t: jap jaapau gurmukh har naau ||7||
906.e: As Gurmukh, I chant and meditate on the Lord's Name. ||7||

906.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਜਾਇ ਮਨ ਭੀਨੈ ॥
906.t: haumai garab jai man bheenai ||
906.e: When one is rid of egotism and pride, his mind is drenched in the Lord's Love.

906.g: ਝੂਠਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਸਿ ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਕੀਨੈ ॥
906.t: jhooTh na paavas paakha(n)dd keenai ||
906.e: Practicing fraud and hypocrisy, he does not find God.

906.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਨਹੀ ਘਰੁ ਬਾਰੁ ॥
906.t: bin gur sabadh nahee ghar baar ||
906.e: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he cannot find the Lord's Door.

906.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੮॥੬॥
906.t: naanak gurmukh tat beechaar ||8||6||
906.e: O Nanak, the Gurmukh contemplates the essence of reality. ||8||6||

906.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
906.t: raamakalee mahalaa pehilaa ||
906.e: Raamkalee, First Mehla:

906.g: ਜਿਉ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਉ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਬਉਰੇ ਜਿਉ ਜਨਮੇ ਤਿਉ ਮਰਣੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
906.t: jiau aaiaa tiau jaaveh baure jiau janame tiau maran bhiaa ||
906.e: As you come, so will you leave, you fool; as you were born, so will you die.

906.g: ਜਿਉ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਕੀਏ ਤੇਤਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਭਵਜਲਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੧॥
906.t: jiau ras bhog ke'ee tetaa dhukh laagai naam visaar bhavajal piaa ||1||
906.e: As you enjoy pleasures, so will you suffer pain. Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, you will fall into the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

906.g: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਦੇਖਤ ਗਰਬਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
906.t: tan dhan dhekhat garab giaa ||
906.e: Gazing upon your body and wealth, you are so proud.

906.g: ਕਨਿਕ ਕਾਮਨੀ ਸਿਉ ਹੇਤੁ ਵਧਾਇਹਿ ਕੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਹਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਗਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
906.t: kanik kaamanee siau het vadhaieh kee naam visaareh bharam giaa ||1|| rahaau ||
906.e: Your love for gold and sexual pleasures increases; why have you forgotten the Naam, and why do you wander in doubt? ||1||Pause||

906.g: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸੀਲੁ ਨ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਪਿੰਜਰ ਮਹਿ ਕਾਸਟੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
906.t: jat sat sa(n)jam seel na raakhiaa pret pi(n)jar meh kaasaT bhiaa ||
906.e: You do not practice truth, abstinence, self-discipline or humility; the ghost within your skeleton has turned to dry wood.

906.g: ਪੁੰਨੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਨ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਾਦਿ ਜਇਆ ॥੨॥
906.t: pu(n)n dhaan isanaan na sa(n)jam saadhasa(n)gat bin baadh jiaa ||2||
906.e: You have not practiced charity, donations, cleansing baths or austerities. Without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, your life has gone in vain. ||2||

906.g: ਲਾਲਚਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ ਆਵਤ ਜਾਵਤ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਇਆ ॥
906.t: laalach laagai naam bisaario aavat jaavat janam giaa ||
906.e: Attached to greed, you have forgotten the Naam. Coming and going, your life has been ruined.

906.g: ਜਾ ਜਮੁ ਧਾਇ ਕੇਸ ਗਹਿ ਮਾਰੈ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਲ ਗਇਆ ॥੩॥
906.t: jaa jam dhai kes geh maarai surat nahee mukh kaal giaa ||3||
906.e: When the Messenger of Death grabs you by your hair, you will be punished. You are unconscious, and have fallen into Death's mouth. ||3||

906.g: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਤਾਤਿ ਪਰਾਈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਸਰਬ ਦਇਆ ॥
906.t: ahinis ni(n)dhaa taat paraiee hiradhai naam na sarab dhiaa ||
906.e: Day and night, you jealously slander others; in your heart, you have neither the Naam, nor compassion for all.

906.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਨ ਗਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਰਕਿ ਗਇਆ ॥੪॥
906.t: bin gur sabadh na gat pat paaveh raam naam bin narak giaa ||4||
906.e: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, you will not find salvation or honor. Without the Lord's Name, you shall go to hell. ||4||

906.g: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਵੇਸ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਟੂਆ ਜਿਉ ਮੋਹ ਪਾਪ ਮਹਿ ਗਲਤੁ ਗਇਆ ॥
906.t: khin meh ves kareh naTooaa jiau moh paap meh galat giaa ||
906.e: In an instant, you change into various costumes, like a juggler; you are entangled in emotional attachment and sin.

906.g: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਸਾਰੀ ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਮਗਨੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੫॥
906.t: eit ut maiaa dhekh pasaaree moh maiaa kai magan bhiaa ||5||
906.e: You gaze here and there upon the expanse of Maya; you are intoxicated with attachment to Maya. ||5||

906.g: ਕਰਹਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਵਿਥਾਰ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਪਇਆ ॥
906.t: kareh bikaar vithaar ghanere surat sabadh bin bharam piaa ||
906.e: You act in corruption, and put on ostentatious shows, but without awareness of the Shabad, you have fallen into confusion.

906.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ ॥੬॥
906.t: haumai rog mahaa dhukh laagaa gurmat levahu rog giaa ||6||
906.e: You suffer great pain from the disease of egotism. Following the Guru's Teachings, you shall be rid of this disease. ||6||

906.g: ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਕਉ ਆਵਤ ਦੇਖੈ ਸਾਕਤ ਮਨਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
906.t: sukh sa(n)pat kau aavat dhekhai saakat man abhimaan bhiaa ||
906.e: Seeing peace and wealth come to him, the faithless cynic become proud in his mind.

906.g: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੋ ਫਿਰਿ ਲੇਵੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਪਇਆ ॥੭॥
906.t: jis kaa ih tan dhan so fir levai a(n)tar sahasaa dhookh piaa ||7||
906.e: But He who owns this body and wealth, takes them back again, and then the mortal feels anxiety and pain deep within. ||7||

906.g: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਮਇਆ ॥
906.t: a(n)t kaal kichh saath na chaalai jo dheesai sabh tiseh miaa ||
906.e: At the very last instant, nothing goes along with you; all is visible only by His Mercy.

906.g: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਲੈ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੮॥
906.t: aadh purakh apara(n)par so prabh har naam ridhai lai paar piaa ||8||
906.e: God is our Primal and Infinite Lord; enshrining the Lord's Name in the heart, one crosses over. ||8||

906.g: ਮੂਏ ਕਉ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਕਿਸਹਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਹਿ ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰ ਅਸਰਾਲਿ ਪਇਆ ॥
906.t: mooe kau roveh kiseh sunaaveh bhai saagar asaraal piaa ||
906.e: You weep for the dead, but who hears you weeping? The dead have fallen to the serpent in the terrifying world-ocean.

906.g: ਦੇਖਿ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਸਾਕਤੁ ਜੰਜਾਲਿ ਪਰਾਲਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੯॥
906.t: dhekh kuTa(n)b maiaa gireh ma(n)dhar saakat ja(n)jaal paraal piaa ||9||
906.e: Gazing upon his family, wealth, household and mansions, the faithless cynic is entangled in worthless worldly affairs. ||9||

907.g: ਜਾ ਆਏ ਤਾ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਪਠਾਏ ਚਾਲੇ ਤਿਨੈ ਬੁਲਾਇ ਲਇਆ ॥
907.t: jaa aae taa tineh paThaae chaale tinai bulai liaa ||
907.e: He comes when the Lord sends him; when the Lord calls him back, he goes.

907.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੋ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੈ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
907.t: jo kichh karanaa so kar rahiaa bakhasanahaarai bakhas liaa ||10||
907.e: Whatever he does, the Lord is doing. The Forgiving Lord forgives him. ||10||

907.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਖੋਜੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
907.t: jin eh chaakhiaa raam rasain tin kee sa(n)gat khoj bhiaa ||
907.e: I seek to be with those who have tasted this sublime essence of the Lord.

907.g: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
907.t: ridh sidh budh giaan guroo te paiaa mukat padhaarath saran piaa ||11||
907.e: Wealth, miraculous spiritual powers, wisdom and spiritual knowledge, are obtained from the Guru. The treasure of liberation is obtained in His Sanctuary. ||11||

907.g: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣਾ ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਤੇ ਬਿਰਕਤੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
907.t: dhukh sukh gurmukh sam kar jaanaa harakh sog te birakat bhiaa ||
907.e: The Gurmukh looks upon pain and pleasure as one and the same; he remains untouched by joy and sorrow.

907.g: ਆਪੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਲਇਆ ॥੧੨॥੭॥
907.t: aap maar gurmukh har paae naanak sahaj samai liaa ||12||7||
907.e: Conquering his self-conceit, the Gurmukh finds the Lord; O Nanak, he intuitively merges into the Lord. ||12||7||

907.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਦਖਣੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
907.t: raamakalee dhakhanee mahalaa pehilaa ||
907.e: Raamkalee, Dakhanee, First Mehla:

907.g: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਸਿ ਲੀਣਾ ॥੧॥
907.t: jat sat sa(n)jam saach dhiraRaiaa saach sabadh ras leenaa ||1||
907.e: Abstinence, chastity, self-control and truthfulness have been implanted within me; I am imbued with the sublime essence of the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||

907.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਲੀਣਾ ॥
907.t: meraa gur dhiaal sadhaa ra(n)g leenaa ||
907.e: My Merciful Guru remains forever imbued with the Lord's Love.

907.g: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਰਹੈ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਤੀਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
907.t: ahinis rahai ek liv laagee saache dhekh pateenaa ||1|| rahaau ||
907.e: Day and night, He remains lovingly focused on the One Lord; gazing upon the True Lord, He is pleased. ||1||Pause||

907.g: ਰਹੈ ਗਗਨ ਪੁਰਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਮੈਸਰਿ ਅਨਹਤ ਸਬਦਿ ਰੰਗੀਣਾ ॥੨॥
907.t: rahai gagan pur dhirasaT samaisar anahat sabadh ra(n)geenaa ||2||
907.e: He abides in the Tenth Gate, and looks equally upon all; He is imbued with the unstruck sound current of the Shabad. ||2||

907.g: ਸਤੁ ਬੰਧਿ ਕੁਪੀਨ ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਲੀਣਾ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਸੀਣਾ ॥੩॥
907.t: sat ba(n)dh kupeen bharipur leenaa jihavaa ra(n)g raseenaa ||3||
907.e: Wearing the loin-cloth of chastity, He remains absorbed in the all-pervading Lord; His tongue enjoys the taste of God's Love. ||3||

907.g: ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਚੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚੁ ਰਾਚੇ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਪਤੀਣਾ ॥੪॥
907.t: milai gur saache jin rach raache kirat veechaar pateenaa ||4||
907.e: The One who created the creation has met the True Guru; contemplating the Guru's lifestyle, He is pleased. ||4||

907.g: ਏਕ ਮਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਸਰਬ ਮਹਿ ਏਕਾ ਏਹ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੫॥
907.t: ek meh sarab sarab meh ekaa eh satigur dhekh dhikhaiee ||5||
907.e: All are in the One, and the One is in all. This is what the True Guru has shown me. ||5||

907.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਏ ਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡਾ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਖਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੬॥
907.t: jin ke'ee kha(n)dd ma(n)ddal brahama(n)ddaa so prabh lakhan na jaiee ||6||
907.e: He who created the worlds, solar systems and galaxies - that God cannot be known. ||6||

907.g: ਦੀਪਕ ਤੇ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਜੋਤਿ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੭॥
907.t: dheepak te dheepak paragaasiaa tirabhavan jot dhikhaiee ||7||
907.e: From the lamp of God, the lamp within is lit; the Divine Light illuminates the three worlds. ||7||

907.g: ਸਚੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਸਚ ਮਹਲੀ ਬੈਠੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ॥੮॥
907.t: sachai takhat sach mahalee baiThe nirabhau taaRee laiee ||8||
907.e: The Guru sits on the true throne in the true mansion; He is attuned, absorbed in the Fearless Lord. ||8||

907.g: ਮੋਹਿ ਗਇਆ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਜੋਗੀ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਵਾਈ ॥੯॥
907.t: moh giaa bairaagee jogee ghaT ghaT ki(n)guree vaiee ||9||
907.e: The Guru, the detached Yogi, has enticed the hearts of all; He plays His harp in each and every heart. ||9||

907.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕੀ ਛੂਟੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਚੁ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੧੦॥੮॥
907.t: naanak saran prabhoo kee chhooTe satigur sach sakhaiee ||10||8||
907.e: O Nanak, in God's Sanctuary, one is emancipated; the True Guru becomes our true help and support. ||10||8||

907.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
907.t: raamakalee mahalaa pehilaa ||
907.e: Raamkalee, First Mehla:

907.g: ਅਉਹਠਿ ਹਸਤ ਮੜੀ ਘਰੁ ਛਾਇਆ ਧਰਣਿ ਗਗਨ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
907.t: aauhaTh hasat maRee ghar chhaiaa dharan gagan kal dhaaree ||1||
907.e: He has made His home in the monastery of the heart; He has infused His power into the earth and the sky. ||1||

907.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੇਤੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਉਧਾਰੀ ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
907.t: gurmukh ketee sabadh udhaaree sa(n)tahu ||1|| rahaau ||
907.e: Through the Word of the Shabad, the Gurmukhs have saved so very many, O Saints. ||1||Pause||

907.g: ਮਮਤਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਸੋਖੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
907.t: mamataa maar haumai sokhai tirabhavan jot tumaaree ||2||
907.e: He conquers attachment, and eradicates egotism, and sees Your Divine Light pervading the three worlds, Lord. ||2||

907.g: ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨੈ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
907.t: manasaa maar manai meh raakhai satigur sabadh veechaaree ||3||
907.e: He conquers desire, and enshrines the Lord within his mind; he contemplates the Word of the True Guru's Shabad. ||3||

907.g: ਸਿੰਙੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਅਨਾਹਦਿ ਵਾਜੈ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
907.t: si(n)n(g)ee surat anaahadh vaajai ghaT ghaT jot tumaaree ||4||
907.e: The horn of consciousness vibrates the unstruck sound current; Your Light illuminates each and every heart, Lord. ||4||

907.g: ਪਰਪੰਚ ਬੇਣੁ ਤਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਗਨਿ ਪਰਜਾਰੀ ॥੫॥
907.t: parapa(n)ch ben tahee man raakhiaa braham agan parajaaree ||5||
907.e: He plays the flute of the universe in his mind, and lights the fire of God. ||5||

907.g: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
907.t: pa(n)ch tat mil ahinis dheepak niramal jot apaaree ||6||
907.e: Bringing together the five elements, day and night, the Lord's lamp shines with the Immaculate Light of the Infinite. ||6||

907.g: ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਲਉਕੇ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਵਾਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ॥੭॥
907.t: rav sas lauke ih tan ki(n)guree vaajai sabadh niraaree ||7||
907.e: The right and left nostrils, the sun and the moon channels, are the strings of the body-harp; they vibrate the wondrous melody of the Shabad. ||7||

907.g: ਸਿਵ ਨਗਰੀ ਮਹਿ ਆਸਣੁ ਅਉਧੂ ਅਲਖੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੀ ॥੮॥
907.t: siv nagaree meh aasan aaudhoo alakh aga(n)m apaaree ||8||
907.e: The true hermit obtains a seat in the City of God, the invisible, inaccessible, infinite. ||8||

907.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਪੰਚ ਵਸਹਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੯॥
907.t: kaiaa nagaree ih man raajaa pa(n)ch vaseh veechaaree ||9||
907.e: The mind is the king of the city of the body; the five sources of knowledge dwell within it. ||9||

907.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਵੈ ਆਸਣਿ ਘਰਿ ਰਾਜਾ ਅਦਲੁ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ॥੧੦॥
907.t: sabadh ravai aasan ghar raajaa adhal kare gunakaaree ||10||
907.e: Seated in his home, this king chants the Shabad; he administers justice and virtue. ||10||

907.g: ਕਾਲੁ ਬਿਕਾਲੁ ਕਹੇ ਕਹਿ ਬਪੁਰੇ ਜੀਵਤ ਮੂਆ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੧੧॥
907.t: kaal bikaal kahe keh bapure jeevat mooaa man maaree ||11||
907.e: What can poor death or birth say to him? Conquering his mind, he remains dead while yet alive. ||11||

908.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸ ਇਕ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਾਰੀ ॥੧੨॥
908.t: brahamaa bisan mahes ik moorat aape karataa kaaree ||12||
908.e: Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva are manifestations of the One God. He Himself is the Doer of deeds. ||12||

908.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਸੋਧਿ ਤਰੈ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਆਤਮ ਤਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੧੩॥
908.t: kaiaa sodh tarai bhav saagar aatam tat veechaaree ||13||
908.e: One who purifies his body, crosses over the terrifying world-ocean; he contemplates the essence of his own soul. ||13||

908.g: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ॥੧੪॥
908.t: gur sevaa te sadhaa sukh paiaa a(n)tar sabadh raviaa gunakaaree ||14||
908.e: Serving the Guru, he finds everlasting peace; deep within, the Shabad permeates him, coloring him with virtue. ||14||

908.g: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੧੫॥
908.t: aape mel le gunadhaataa haumai tirasanaa maaree ||15||
908.e: The Giver of virtue unites with Himself, one who conquers egotism and desire. ||15||

908.g: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮੇਟੇ ਚਉਥੈ ਵਰਤੈ ਏਹਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ॥੧੬॥
908.t: trai gun meTe chauthai varatai ehaa bhagat niraaree ||16||
908.e: Eradicating the three qualities, dwell in the fourth state. This is the unparalleled devotional worship. ||16||

908.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋਗ ਸਬਦਿ ਆਤਮੁ ਚੀਨੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਏਕੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੧੭॥
908.t: gurmukh jog sabadh aatam cheenai hiradhai ek muraaree ||17||
908.e: This is the Yoga of the Gurmukh: Through the Shabad, he understands his own soul, and he enshrines within his heart the One Lord. ||17||

908.g: ਮਨੂਆ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਰਾਤਾ ਏਹਾ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੧੮॥
908.t: manooaa asathir sabadhe raataa ehaa karanee saaree ||18||
908.e: Imbued with the Shabad, his mind becomes steady and stable; this is the most excellent action. ||18||

908.g: ਬੇਦੁ ਬਾਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਅਉਧੂ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੧੯॥
908.t: bedh baadh na paakha(n)dd aaudhoo gurmukh sabadh beechaaree ||19||
908.e: This true hermit does not enter into religious debates or hypocrisy; the Gurmukh contemplates the Shabad. ||19||

908.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਅਉਧੂ ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨੦॥
908.t: gurmukh jog kamaavai aaudhoo jat sat sabadh veechaaree ||20||
908.e: The Gurmukh practices Yoga - he is the true hermit; he practices abstinence and truth, and contemplates the Shabad. ||20||

908.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਅਉਧੂ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨੧॥
908.t: sabadh marai man maare aaudhoo jog jugat veechaaree ||21||
908.e: One who dies in the Shabad and conquers his mind is the true hermit; he understands the Way of Yoga. ||21||

908.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਹੈ ਅਵਧੂ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਰੈ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੀ ॥੨੨॥
908.t: maiaa moh bhavajal hai avadhoo sabadh tarai kul taaree ||22||
908.e: Attachment to Maya is the terrifying world-ocean; through the Shabad, the true hermit saves himself, and his ancestors as well. ||22||

908.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਸੂਰ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਅਉਧੂ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨੩॥
908.t: sabadh soor jug chaare aaudhoo baanee bhagat veechaaree ||23||
908.e: Contemplating the Shabad, you shall be a hero throughout the four ages, O hermit; contemplate the Word of the Guru's Bani in devotion. ||23||

908.g: ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਅਉਧੂ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨੪॥
908.t: eh man maiaa mohiaa aaudhoo nikasai sabadh veechaaree ||24||
908.e: This mind is enticed by Maya, O hermit; contemplating the Shabad, you shall find release. ||24||

908.g: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੨੫॥੯॥
908.t: aape bakhase mel milaae naanak saran tumaaree ||25||9||
908.e: He Himself forgives, and unites in His Union; Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary, Lord. ||25||9||

908.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ
908.t: raamakalee mahalaa teejaa asaTapadheeaa
908.e: Raamkalee, Third Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa:

908.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
908.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
908.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

908.g: ਸਰਮੈ ਦੀਆ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਕੰਨੀ ਪਾਇ ਜੋਗੀ ਖਿੰਥਾ ਕਰਿ ਤੂ ਦਇਆ ॥
908.t: saramai dheeaa mu(n)dhraa ka(n)nee pai jogee khi(n)thaa kar too dhiaa ||
908.e: Make humility your ear-rings, Yogi, and compassion your patched coat.

908.g: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਬਿਭੂਤਿ ਲਾਇ ਜੋਗੀ ਤਾ ਤੀਨਿ ਭਵਣ ਜਿਣਿ ਲਇਆ ॥੧॥
908.t: aavan jaan bibhoot lai jogee taa teen bhavan jin liaa ||1||
908.e: Let coming and going be the ashes you apply to your body, Yogi, and then you shall conquer the three worlds. ||1||

908.g: ਐਸੀ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਵਜਾਇ ਜੋਗੀ ॥
908.t: aaisee ki(n)guree vajai jogee ||
908.e: Play that harp, Yogi,

908.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਅਨਹਦੁ ਵਾਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
908.t: jit ki(n)guree anahadh vaajai har siau rahai liv lai ||1|| rahaau ||
908.e: which vibrates the unstruck sound current, and remain lovingly absorbed in the Lord. ||1||Pause||

908.g: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਪਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਝੋਲੀ ਜੋਗੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
908.t: sat sa(n)tokh pat kar jholee jogee a(n)mirat naam bhugat paiee ||
908.e: Make truth and contentment your plate and pouch, Yogi; take the Ambrosial Naam as your food.

908.g: ਧਿਆਨ ਕਾ ਕਰਿ ਡੰਡਾ ਜੋਗੀ ਸਿੰਙੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਵਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
908.t: dhiaan kaa kar dda(n)ddaa jogee si(n)n(g)ee surat vajaiee ||2||
908.e: Make meditation your walking stick, Yogi, and make higher consciousness the horn you blow. ||2||

908.g: ਮਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਆਸਣਿ ਬੈਸੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਤਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਲਪਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
908.t: man dhiraR kar aasan bais jogee taa teree kalapanaa jaiee ||
908.e: Make your stable mind the Yogic posture you sit in, Yogi, and then you shall be rid of your tormenting desires.

908.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰੀ ਮਹਿ ਮੰਗਣਿ ਚੜਹਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
908.t: kaiaa nagaree meh ma(n)gan chaReh jogee taa naam palai paiee ||3||
908.e: Go begging in the village of the body, Yogi, and then, you shall obtain the Naam in your lap. ||3||

908.g: ਇਤੁ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਜੋਗੀ ਨਾ ਸਚੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
908.t: eit ki(n)guree dhiaan na laagai jogee naa sach palai pai ||
908.e: This harp does not center you in meditation, Yogi, nor does it bring the True Name into your lap.

908.g: ਇਤੁ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜੋਗੀ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥
908.t: eit ki(n)guree saa(n)t na aavai jogee abhimaan na vichahu jai ||4||
908.e: This harp does not bring you peace, Yogi, nor eliminate egotism from within you. ||4||

908.g: ਭਉ ਭਾਉ ਦੁਇ ਪਤ ਲਾਇ ਜੋਗੀ ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਡੰਡੀ ॥
908.t: bhau bhaau dhui pat lai jogee ih sareer kar dda(n)ddee ||
908.e: Make the Fear of God, and the Love of God, the two gourds of your lute, Yogi, and make this body its neck.

908.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਤੰਤੀ ਵਾਜੈ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਖੰਡੀ ॥੫॥
908.t: gurmukh hoveh taa ta(n)tee vaajai in bidh tirasanaa kha(n)ddee ||5||
908.e: Become Gurmukh, and then vibrate the strings; in this way, your desires shall depart. ||5||

908.g: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੁਝੈ ਸੋ ਜੋਗੀ ਕਹੀਐ ਏਕਸ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
908.t: hukam bujhai so jogee kaheeaai ekas siau chit laae ||
908.e: One who understands the Hukam of the Lord's Command is called a Yogi; he links his consciousness to the One Lord.

908.g: ਸਹਸਾ ਤੂਟੈ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਇਵ ਪਾਏ ॥੬॥
908.t: sahasaa tooTai niramal hovai jog jugat iv paae ||6||
908.e: His cynicism is dispelled, and he becomes immaculately pure; this is how he finds the Way of Yoga. ||6||

908.g: ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵਦਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
908.t: nadharee aavadhaa sabh kichh binasai har setee chit lai ||
908.e: Everything that comes into view shall be destroyed; focus your consciousness on the Lord.

908.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਾ ਇਹ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੭॥
908.t: satigur naal teree bhaavanee laagai taa ieh sojhee pai ||7||
908.e: Enshrine love for the True Guru, and then you shall obtain this understanding. ||7||

909.g: ਏਹੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਿ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਪਰਭਵਣੁ ਕਰਹਿ ॥
909.t: eh jog na hovai jogee j kuTa(n)b chhodd parabhavan kareh ||
909.e: This is not Yoga, O Yogi, to abandon your family and wander around.

909.g: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਸਰੀਰ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਅਪਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਹਹਿ ॥੮॥
909.t: gireh sareer meh har har naam gur parasaadhee apanaa har prabh laheh ||8||
909.e: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is within the household of the body. By Guru's Grace, you shall find your Lord God. ||8||

909.g: ਇਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਮਿਟੀ ਕਾ ਪੁਤਲਾ ਜੋਗੀ ਇਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਰੋਗੁ ਵਡਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
909.t: eih jagat miTee kaa putalaa jogee is meh rog vaddaa tirasanaa maiaa ||
909.e: This world is a puppet of clay, Yogi; the terrible disease, the desire for Maya is in it.

909.g: ਅਨੇਕ ਜਤਨ ਭੇਖ ਕਰੇ ਜੋਗੀ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
909.t: anek jatan bhekh kare jogee rog na jai gavaiaa ||9||
909.e: Making all sorts of efforts, and wearing religious robes, Yogi, this disease cannot be cured. ||9||

909.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਹੈ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
909.t: har kaa naam aaukhadh hai jogee jis no ma(n)n vasaae ||
909.e: The Name of the Lord is the medicine, Yogi; the Lord enshrines it in the mind.

909.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥੧੦॥
909.t: gurmukh hovai soiee boojhai jog jugat so paae ||10||
909.e: One who becomes Gurmukh understands this; he alone finds the Way of Yoga. ||10||

909.g: ਜੋਗੈ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਹੈ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
909.t: jogai kaa maarag bikham hai jogee jis no nadhar kare so paae ||
909.e: The Path of Yoga is very difficult, Yogi; he alone finds it, whom God blesses with His Grace.

909.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਖੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥੧੧॥
909.t: a(n)tar baahar eko vekhai vichahu bharam chukaae ||11||
909.e: Inside and outside, he sees the One Lord; he eliminates doubt from within himself. ||11||

909.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਵਜਾਈ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਵਾਜੈ ਜੋਗੀ ਸਾ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਵਜਾਇ ॥
909.t: vin vajaiee ki(n)guree vaajai jogee saa ki(n)guree vajai ||
909.e: So play the harp which vibrates without being played, Yogi.

909.g: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਰਹਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧੨॥੧॥੧੦॥
909.t: kahai naanak mukat hoveh jogee saache raheh samai ||12||1||10||
909.e: Says Nanak, thus you shall be liberated, Yogi, and remain merged in the True Lord. ||12||1||10||

909.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
909.t: raamakalee mahalaa teejaa ||
909.e: Raamkalee, Third Mehla:

909.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧॥
909.t: bhagat khajaanaa gurmukh jaataa satigur boojh bujhaiee ||1||
909.e: The treasure of devotional worship is revealed to the Gurmukh; the True Guru has inspired me to understand this understanding. ||1||

909.g: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
909.t: sa(n)tahu gurmukh dhei vaddiaaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
909.e: O Saints, the Gurmukh is blessed with glorious greatness. ||1||Pause||

909.g: ਸਚਿ ਰਹਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਜੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
909.t: sach rahahu sadhaa sahaj sukh upajai kaam karodh vichahu jaiee ||2||
909.e: Dwelling always in Truth, celestial peace wells up; sexual desire and anger are eliminated from within. ||2||

909.g: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਮਮਤਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਈ ॥੩॥
909.t: aap chhodd naam liv laagee mamataa sabadh jalaiee ||3||
909.e: Eradicating self-conceit, remain lovingly focused on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; through the Word of the Shabad, burn away possessiveness. ||3||

909.g: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੈ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਅੰਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੪॥
909.t: jis te upajai tis te binasai a(n)te naam sakhaiee ||4||
909.e: By Him we are created, and by Him we are destroyed; in the end, the Naam will be our only help and support. ||4||

909.g: ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਨਹ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਰਚਨਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਾਈ ॥੫॥
909.t: sadhaa hajoor dhoor neh dhekhahu rachanaa jin rachaiee ||5||
909.e: He is ever-present; don't think that He is far away. He created the creation. ||5||

909.g: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਵੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੬॥
909.t: sachaa sabadh ravai ghaT a(n)tar sache siau liv laiee ||6||
909.e: Deep within your heart, chant the True Word of the Shabad; remain lovingly absorbed in the True Lord. ||6||

909.g: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਈ ॥੭॥
909.t: satasa(n)gat meh naam niramolak vaddai bhaag paiaa jaiee ||7||
909.e: The Priceless Naam is in the Society of the Saints; by great good fortune, it is obtained. ||7||

909.g: ਭਰਮਿ ਨ ਭੂਲਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਇਕ ਠਾਈ ॥੮॥
909.t: bharam na bhoolahu satigur sevahu man raakhahu ik Thaiee ||8||
909.e: Do not be deluded by doubt; serve the True Guru, and keep your mind steady in one place. ||8||

909.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਭੂਲੀ ਫਿਰਦੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੯॥
909.t: bin naavai sabh bhoolee firadhee birathaa janam gavaiee ||9||
909.e: Without the Name, everyone wanders around in confusion; they waste away their lives in vain. ||9||

909.g: ਜੋਗੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ਹੰਢੈ ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੦॥
909.t: jogee jugat gavaiee ha(n)ddai paakha(n)dd jog na paiee ||10||
909.e: Yogi, you have lost the Way; you wander around confused. Through hypocrisy, Yoga is not attained. ||10||

909.g: ਸਿਵ ਨਗਰੀ ਮਹਿ ਆਸਣਿ ਬੈਸੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਜੋਗੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੧॥
909.t: siv nagaree meh aasan baisai gur sabadhee jog paiee ||11||
909.e: Sitting in Yogic postures in the City of God, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, you shall find Yoga. ||11||

909.g: ਧਾਤੁਰ ਬਾਜੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਈ ॥੧੨॥
909.t: dhaatur baajee sabadh nivaare naam vasai man aaiee ||12||
909.e: Restrain your restless wanderings through the Shabad, and the Naam will come to dwell in your mind. ||12||

909.g: ਏਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਹੈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੧੩॥
909.t: eh sareer saravar hai sa(n)tahu isanaan kare liv laiee ||13||
909.e: This body is a pool, O Saints; bathe in it, and enshrine love for the Lord. ||13||

909.g: ਨਾਮਿ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਬਦੇ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੧੪॥
909.t: naam isanaan kareh se jan niramal sabadhe mail gavaiee ||14||
909.e: Those who cleanse themselves through the Naam, are the most immaculate people; through the Shabad, they wash off their filth. ||14||

909.g: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਅਚੇਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੫॥
909.t: trai gun achet naam cheteh naahee bin naavai binas jaiee ||15||
909.e: Trapped by the three qualities, the unconscious person does not think of the Naam; without the Name, he wastes away. ||15||

909.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਣਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ॥੧੬॥
909.t: brahamaa bisan mahes trai moorat tiragun bharam bhulaiee ||16||
909.e: The three forms of Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva are trapped in the three qualities, lost in confusion. ||16||

909.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਛੂਟੈ ਚਉਥੈ ਪਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੧੭॥
909.t: gur parasaadhee tirakuTee chhooTai chauthai padh liv laiee ||17||
909.e: By Guru's Grace, this triad is eradicated, and one is lovingly absorbed in the fourth state. ||17||

909.g: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਹਿ ਪੜਿ ਵਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਤਿੰਨਾ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੮॥
909.t: pa(n)ddit paReh paR vaadh vakhaaneh ti(n)naa boojh na paiee ||18||
909.e: The Pandits, the religious scholars, read, study and discuss the arguments; they do not understand. ||18||

909.g: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਾਤੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਹਹਿ ਕਿਸੁ ਭਾਈ ॥੧੯॥
909.t: bikhiaa maate bharam bhulaae upadhes kaheh kis bhaiee ||19||
909.e: Engrossed in corruption, they wander in confusion; who can they possibly instruct, O Siblings of Destiny? ||19||

909.g: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਊਤਮ ਬਾਣੀ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਰਹੀ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੨੦॥
909.t: bhagat janaa kee uootam baanee jug jug rahee samaiee ||20||
909.e: The Bani, the Word of the humble devotee is the most sublime and exalted; it prevails throughout the ages. ||20||

909.g: ਬਾਣੀ ਲਾਗੈ ਸੋ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਸਬਦੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੨੧॥
909.t: baanee laagai so gat paae sabadhe sach samaiee ||21||
909.e: One who is committed to this Bani is emancipated, and through the Shabad, merges in Truth. ||21||

910.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰੀ ਸਬਦੇ ਖੋਜੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਵੰ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੨੨॥
910.t: kaiaa nagaree sabadhe khoje naam nava(n) nidh paiee ||22||
910.e: One who searches the village of the body, through the Shabad, obtains the nine treasures of the Naam. ||22||

910.g: ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਾਈ ॥੨੩॥
910.t: manasaa maar man sahaj samaanaa bin rasanaa usatat karaiee ||23||
910.e: Conquering desire, the mind is absorbed in intuitive ease, and then one chants the Lord's Praises without speaking. ||23||

910.g: ਲੋਇਣ ਦੇਖਿ ਰਹੇ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਅਦਿਸਟਿ ਲਗਾਈ ॥੨੪॥
910.t: loin dhekh rahe bisamaadhee chit adhisaT lagaiee ||24||
910.e: Let your eyes gaze upon the Wondrous Lord; let your consciousness be attached to the Unseen Lord. ||24||

910.g: ਅਦਿਸਟੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੨੫॥
910.t: adhisaT sadhaa rahai niraalam jotee jot milaiee ||25||
910.e: The Unseen Lord is forever absolute and immaculate; one's light merges into the Light. ||25||

910.g: ਹਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਦਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੨੬॥
910.t: hau gur saalaahee sadhaa aapanaa jin saachee boojh bujhaiee ||26||
910.e: I praise my Guru forever, who has inspired me to understand this true understanding. ||26||

910.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਏਕ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਗਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੨੭॥੨॥੧੧॥
910.t: naanak ek kahai bena(n)tee naavahu gat pat paiee ||27||2||11||
910.e: Nanak offers this one prayer: through the Name, may I find salvation and honor. ||27||2||11||

910.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
910.t: raamakalee mahalaa teejaa ||
910.e: Raamkalee, Third Mehla:

910.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਪੂਜਾ ਦੁਲੰਭ ਹੈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
910.t: har kee poojaa dhula(n)bh hai sa(n)tahu kahanaa kachhoo na jaiee ||1||
910.e: It is so hard to obtain that devotional worship of the Lord, O Saints. It cannot be described at all. ||1||

910.g: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈ ॥
910.t: sa(n)tahu gurmukh pooraa paiee ||
910.e: O Saints, as Gurmukh, find the Perfect Lord,

910.g: ਨਾਮੋ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
910.t: naamo pooj karaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
910.e: and worship the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

910.g: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਹਉ ਪੂਜ ਚੜਾਈ ॥੨॥
910.t: har bin sabh kichh mailaa sa(n)tahu kiaa hau pooj chaRaiee ||2||
910.e: Without the Lord, everything is filthy, O Saints; what offering should I place before Him? ||2||

910.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾ ਪੂਜਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਭਾਣਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥੩॥
910.t: har saache bhaavai saa poojaa hovai bhaanaa man vasaiee ||3||
910.e: Whatever pleases the True Lord is devotional worship; His Will abides in the mind. ||3||

910.g: ਪੂਜਾ ਕਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਕੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥
910.t: poojaa karai sabh lok sa(n)tahu manmukh thai na paiee ||4||
910.e: Everyone worships Him, O Saints, but the self-willed manmukh is not accepted or approved. ||4||

910.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਏਹ ਪੂਜਾ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਈ ॥੫॥
910.t: sabadh marai man niramal sa(n)tahu eh poojaa thai paiee ||5||
910.e: If someone dies in the Word of the Shabad, his mind become immaculate, O Saints; such worship is accepted and approved. ||5||

910.g: ਪਵਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਚੇ ਏਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੬॥
910.t: pavit paavan se jan saache ek sabadh liv laiee ||6||
910.e: Sanctified and pure are those true beings, who enshrine love for the Shabad. ||6||

910.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਹੋਰ ਪੂਜ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੀ ਲੋਕਾਈ ॥੭॥
910.t: bin naavai hor pooj na hovee bharam bhulee lokaiee ||7||
910.e: There is no worship of the Lord, other than the Name; the world wanders, deluded by doubt. ||7||

910.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੮॥
910.t: gurmukh aap pachhaanai sa(n)tahu raam naam liv laiee ||8||
910.e: The Gurmukh understands his own self, O Saints; he lolvingly centers his mind on the Lord's Name. ||8||

910.g: ਆਪੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਈ ॥੯॥
910.t: aape niramal pooj karaae gur sabadhee thai paiee ||9||
910.e: The Immaculate Lord Himself inspires worship of Him; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it is accepted and approved. ||9||

910.g: ਪੂਜਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਈ ॥੧੦॥
910.t: poojaa kareh par bidh nahee jaaneh dhoojai bhai mal laiee ||10||
910.e: Those who worship Him, but do not know the Way, are polluted with the love of duality. ||10||

910.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਪੂਜਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਭਾਣਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥੧੧॥
910.t: gurmukh hovai su poojaa jaanai bhaanaa man vasaiee ||11||
910.e: One who becomes Gurmukh, knows what worship is; the Lord's Will abides within his mind. ||11||

910.g: ਭਾਣੇ ਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਅੰਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੧੨॥
910.t: bhaane te sabh sukh paavai sa(n)tahu a(n)te naam sakhaiee ||12||
910.e: One who accepts the Lord's Will obtains total peace, O Saints; in the end, the Naam will be our help and support. ||12||

910.g: ਅਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਕੂੜਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧੩॥
910.t: apanaa aap na pachhaaneh sa(n)tahu kooR kareh vaddiaaiee ||13||
910.e: One who does not understand his own self, O Saints, falsely flatters himself. ||13||

910.g: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਕੀਨੈ ਜਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਛੋਡੈ ਲੈ ਜਾਸੀ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੧੪॥
910.t: paakha(n)dd keenai jam nahee chhoddai lai jaasee pat gavaiee ||14||
910.e: The Messenger of Death does not give up on those who practices hypocrisy; they are dragged away in disgrace. ||14||

910.g: ਜਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੫॥
910.t: jin a(n)tar sabadh aap pachhaaneh gat mit tin hee paiee ||15||
910.e: Those who have the Shabad deep within, understand themselves; they find the way of salvation. ||15||

910.g: ਏਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਵੈ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੧੬॥
910.t: eh manooaa su(n)n samaadh lagaavai jotee jot milaiee ||16||
910.e: Their minds enter into the deepest state of Samaadhi, and their light is absorbed into the Light. ||16||

910.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਾਈ ॥੧੭॥
910.t: sun sun gurmukh naam vakhaaneh satasa(n)gat melaiee ||17||
910.e: The Gurmukhs listen constantly to the Naam, and chant it in the True Congregation. ||17||

910.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਵੈ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੮॥
910.t: gurmukh gaavai aap gavaavai dhar saachai sobhaa paiee ||18||
910.e: The Gurmukhs sing the Lord's Praises, and erase self-conceit; they obtain true honor in the Court of the Lord. ||18||

910.g: ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੧੯॥
910.t: saachee baanee sach vakhaanai sach naam liv laiee ||19||
910.e: True are their words; they speak only the Truth; they lovingly focus on the True Name. ||19||

910.g: ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਅਤਿ ਪਾਪ ਨਿਖੰਜਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੨੦॥
910.t: bhai bha(n)jan at paap nikha(n)jan meraa prabh a(n)t sakhaiee ||20||
910.e: My God is the Destroyer of fear, the Destroyer of sin; in the end, He is our only help and support. ||20||

910.g: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨੧॥੩॥੧੨॥
910.t: sabh kichh aape aap varatai naanak naam vaddiaaiee ||21||3||12||
910.e: He Himself pervades and permeates everything; O Nanak, glorious greatness is obtained through the Naam. ||21||3||12||

910.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
910.t: raamakalee mahalaa teejaa ||
910.e: Raamkalee, Third Mehla:

910.g: ਹਮ ਕੁਚਲ ਕੁਚੀਲ ਅਤਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਬਦੇ ਮੈਲੁ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
910.t: ham kuchal kucheel at abhimaanee mil sabadhe mail utaaree ||1||
910.e: I am filthy and polluted, proud and egotistical; receiving the Word of the Shabad, my filth is taken away. ||1||

910.g: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੀ ॥
910.t: sa(n)tahu gurmukh naam nisataaree ||
910.e: O Saints, the Gurmukhs are saved through the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

910.g: ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
910.t: sachaa naam vasiaa ghaT a(n)tar karatai aap savaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
910.e: The True Name abides deep within their hearts. The Creator Himself embellishes them. ||1||Pause||

911.g: ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਹੋਏ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਅਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
911.t: paaras parase fir paaras hoe har jeeau apanee kirapaa dhaaree ||2||
911.e: Touching the philosopher's stone, they themselves become the philosopher's stone; the Dear Lord Himself blesses them with His Mercy. ||2||

911.g: ਇਕਿ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਹਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਤਿਨ ਜੂਐ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
911.t: eik bhekh kareh fireh abhimaanee tin jooaai baajee haaree ||3||
911.e: Some wear religious robes, and wander around in pride; they lose their life in the gamble. ||3||

911.g: ਇਕਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
911.t: eik anadhin bhagat kareh dhin raatee raam naam ur dhaaree ||4||
911.e: Some worship the Lord in devotion, night and day; day and night, they keep the Lord's Name enshrined in their hearts. ||4||

911.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੫॥
911.t: anadhin raate sahaje maate sahaje haumai maaree ||5||
911.e: Those who are imbued with Him night and day, are spontaneously intoxicated with Him; they intuitively conquer their ego. ||5||

911.g: ਭੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
911.t: bhai bin bhagat na hoiee kab hee bhai bhai bhagat savaaree ||6||
911.e: Without the Fear of God, devotional worship is never performed; through the Love and the Fear of God, devotional worship is embellished. ||6||

911.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇਆ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਤਤਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੭॥
911.t: maiaa moh sabadh jalaiaa giaan tat beechaaree ||7||
911.e: The Shabad burns away emotional attachment to Maya, and then one contemplates the essence of spiritual wisdom. ||7||

911.g: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ ॥੮॥
911.t: aape aap karaae karataa aape bakhas bha(n)ddaaree ||8||
911.e: The Creator Himself inspires us to act; He Himself blesses us with His treasure. ||8||

911.g: ਤਿਸ ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਉ ਗਾਵਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੯॥
911.t: tis kiaa gunaa kaa a(n)t na paiaa hau gaavaa sabadh veechaaree ||9||
911.e: The limits of His virtues cannot be found; I sing His Praises and contemplate the Word of the Shabad. ||9||

911.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਜਪੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥੧੦॥
911.t: har jeeau japee har jeeau saalaahee vichahu aap nivaaree ||10||
911.e: I chant the Lord's Name, and praise my Dear Lord; egotism is eradicated from within me. ||10||

911.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਖੁਟ ਸਚੇ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ ॥੧੧॥
911.t: naam padhaarath gur te paiaa akhuT sache bha(n)ddaaree ||11||
911.e: The treasure of the Naam is obtained from the Guru; the treasures of the True Lord are inexhaustible. ||11||

911.g: ਅਪਣਿਆ ਭਗਤਾ ਨੋ ਆਪੇ ਤੁਠਾ ਅਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੧੨॥
911.t: apaniaa bhagataa no aape tuThaa apanee kirapaa kar kal dhaaree ||12||
911.e: He Himself is pleased with His devotees; by His Grace, He infuses His strength within them. ||12||

911.g: ਤਿਨ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਸਦਾ ਭੁਖ ਲਾਗੀ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੧੩॥
911.t: tin saache naam kee sadhaa bhukh laagee gaavan sabadh veechaaree ||13||
911.e: They always feel hunger for the True Name; they sing and contemplate the Shabad. ||13||

911.g: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਆਖਣੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੧੪॥
911.t: jeeau pi(n)dd sabh kichh hai tis kaa aakhan bikham beechaaree ||14||
911.e: Soul, body and everything are His; it is so difficult to speak of, and contemplate Him. ||14||

911.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਲਗੇ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਨਿਸਤਰੇ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥੧੫॥
911.t: sabadh lage seiee jan nisatare bhaujal paar utaaree ||15||
911.e: Those humble beings who are attached to the Shabad are saved; they cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||15||

911.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੋ ਪਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੧੬॥
911.t: bin har saache ko paar na paavai boojhai ko veechaaree ||16||
911.e: Without the True Lord, no one can cross over; how rare are those who contemplate and understand this. ||16||

911.g: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੧੭॥
911.t: jo dhur likhiaa soiee paiaa mil har sabadh savaaree ||17||
911.e: We obtain only that which is pre-ordained; receiving the Lord's Shabad, we are embellished. ||17||

911.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੧੮॥
911.t: kaiaa ka(n)chan sabadhe raatee saachai nai piaaree ||18||
911.e: Imbued with the Shabad, the body becomes golden, and loves only the True Name. ||18||

911.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਰਹੀ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੧੯॥
911.t: kaiaa a(n)mirat rahee bharapoore paieeaai sabadh veechaaree ||19||
911.e: The body is then filled to overflowing with Ambrosial Nectar, obtained by contemplating the Shabad. ||19||

911.g: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਖੋਜਹਿ ਸੇਈ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਹੋਰਿ ਫੂਟਿ ਮੂਏ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥੨੦॥
911.t: jo prabh khojeh seiee paaveh hor fooT mooe aha(n)kaaree ||20||
911.e: Those who seek God, find Him; others burst and die from their own egotism. ||20||

911.g: ਬਾਦੀ ਬਿਨਸਹਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੨੧॥
911.t: baadhee binaseh sevak seveh gur kai het piaaree ||21||
911.e: The debaters waste away, while the servants serve, with love and affection for the Guru. ||21||

911.g: ਸੋ ਜੋਗੀ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੨੨॥
911.t: so jogee tat giaan beechaare haumai tirasanaa maaree ||22||
911.e: He alone is a Yogi, who contemplates the essence of spiritual wisdom, and conquers egotism and thirsty desire. ||22||

911.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਤਿਨੈ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੨੩॥
911.t: satigur dhaataa tinai pachhaataa jis no kirapaa tumaaree ||23||
911.e: The True Guru, the Great Giver, is revealed to those upon whom You bestow Your Grace, O Lord. ||23||

911.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਲਾਗੇ ਡੂਬਿ ਮੂਏ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥੨੪॥
911.t: satigur na seveh maiaa laage ddoob mooe aha(n)kaaree ||24||
911.e: Those who do not serve the True Guru, and who are attached to Maya, are drowned; they die in their own egotism. ||24||

911.g: ਜਿਚਰੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਾਸੁ ਤਿਚਰੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕੀਚੈ ਜਾਇ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਰਾਮ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੨੫॥
911.t: jichar a(n)dhar saas tichar sevaa keechai jai mileeaai raam muraaree ||25||
911.e: As long as there is breath within you, so long you should serve the Lord; then, you will go and meet the Lord. ||25||

911.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਤ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੨੬॥
911.t: anadhin jaagat rahai dhin raatee apane pria preet piaaree ||26||
911.e: Night and day, she remains awake and aware, day and night; she is the darling bride of her Beloved Husband Lord. ||26||

911.g: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਵਾਰੀ ਵਾਰਿ ਘੁਮਾਈ ਅਪਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੨੭॥
911.t: tan man vaaree vaar ghumaiee apane gur viTahu balihaaree ||27||
911.e: I offer my body and mind in sacrifice to my Guru; I am a sacrifice to Him. ||27||

911.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇਗਾ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨੮॥
911.t: maiaa moh binas jaigaa ubare sabadh veechaaree ||28||
911.e: Attachment to Maya will end and go away; only by contemplating the Shabad will you be saved. ||28||

911.g: ਆਪਿ ਜਗਾਏ ਸੇਈ ਜਾਗੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨੯॥
911.t: aap jagaae seiee jaage gur kai sabadh veechaaree ||29||
911.e: They are awake and aware, whom the Lord Himself awakens; so contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||29||

911.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਈ ਮੂਏ ਜਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਭਗਤ ਜੀਵੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੩੦॥੪॥੧੩॥
911.t: naanak seiee mooe j naam na cheteh bhagat jeeve veechaaree ||30||4||13||
911.e: O Nanak, those who do not remember the Naam are dead. The devotees live in contemplative meditation. ||30||4||13||

911.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
911.t: raamakalee mahalaa teejaa ||
911.e: Raamkalee, Third Mehla:

911.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਆਘਾਈ ॥੧॥
911.t: naam khajaanaa gur te paiaa tirapat rahe aaghaiee ||1||
911.e: Receiving the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, from the Guru, I remain satisfied and fulfilled. ||1||

911.g: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
911.t: sa(n)tahu gurmukh mukat gat paiee ||
911.e: O Saints, the Gurmukhs attain the state of liberation.

912.g: ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
912.t: ek naam vasiaa ghaT a(n)tar poore kee vaddiaaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
912.e: The One Name abides deep within my heart; such is the glorious greatness of the Perfect Lord. ||1||Pause||

912.g: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਦੇਦਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਬਾਈ ॥੨॥
912.t: aape karataa aape bhugataa dhedhaa rijak sabaiee ||2||
912.e: He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself is the Enjoyer. He Himself gives sustenance to all. ||2||

912.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੋ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
912.t: jo kichh karanaa so kar rahiaa avar na karanaa jaiee ||3||
912.e: Whatever He wants to do, He is doing; no one else can do anything. ||3||

912.g: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਜੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਈ ॥੪॥
912.t: aape saaje sirasaT upaae sir sir dha(n)dhai laiee ||4||
912.e: He Himself fashions and creates the creation; He links each and every person to their task. ||4||

912.g: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੫॥
912.t: tiseh sarevahu taa sukh paavahu satigur mel milaiee ||5||
912.e: If you serve Him, then you will find peace; the True Guru will unite you in His Union. ||5||

912.g: ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥੬॥
912.t: aapanaa aap aap upaae alakh na lakhanaa jaiee ||6||
912.e: The Lord Himself creates Himself; the Unseen Lord cannot be seen. ||6||

912.g: ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲੇ ਆਪੇ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਈ ॥੭॥
912.t: aape maar jeevaale aape tis no til na tamaiee ||7||
912.e: He Himself kills, and brings back to life; He does not have even an iota of greed. ||7||

912.g: ਇਕਿ ਦਾਤੇ ਇਕਿ ਮੰਗਤੇ ਕੀਤੇ ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਈ ॥੮॥
912.t: eik dhaate ik ma(n)gate keete aape bhagat karaiee ||8||
912.e: Some are made givers, and some are made beggars; He Himself inspires us to devotional worship. ||8||

912.g: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਨੀ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ਸਚੇ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੯॥
912.t: se vaddabhaagee jinee eko jaataa sache rahe samaiee ||9||
912.e: Those who know the One Lord are very fortunate; they remain absorbed in the True Lord. ||9||

912.g: ਆਪਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੦॥
912.t: aap saroop siaanaa aape keemat kahan na jaiee ||10||
912.e: He Himself is beautiful, He Himself is wise and clever; His worth cannot be expressed. ||10||

912.g: ਆਪੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ॥੧੧॥
912.t: aape dhukh sukh paae a(n)tar aape bharam bhulaiee ||11||
912.e: He Himself infuses pain and pleasure; He Himself makes them wander around in doubt. ||11||

912.g: ਵਡਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਨਿਗੁਰੀ ਅੰਧ ਫਿਰੈ ਲੋਕਾਈ ॥੧੨॥
912.t: vaddaa dhaataa gurmukh jaataa niguree a(n)dh firai lokaiee ||12||
912.e: The Great Giver is revealed to the Gurmukh; without the Guru, the world wanders in darkness. ||12||

912.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਸਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧੩॥
912.t: jinee chaakhiaa tinaa saadh aaiaa satigur boojh bujhaiee ||13||
912.e: Those who taste, enjoy the flavor; the True Guru imparts this understanding. ||13||

912.g: ਇਕਨਾ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਇਕਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧੪॥
912.t: eikanaa naavahu aap bhulaae ikanaa gurmukh dhei bujhaiee ||14||
912.e: Some, the Lord causes to forget and lose the Name; others become Gurmukh, and are granted this understanding. ||14||

912.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧੫॥
912.t: sadhaa sadhaa saalaahih sa(n)tahu tis dhee vaddee vaddiaaiee ||15||
912.e: Forever and ever, praise the Lord, O Saints; how glorious is His greatness! ||15||

912.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਰਾਜਾ ਕਰਿ ਤਪਾਵਸੁ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥੧੬॥
912.t: tis bin avar na koiee raajaa kar tapaavas banat banaiee ||16||
912.e: There is no other King except Him; He administers justice, as He has made it. ||16||

912.g: ਨਿਆਉ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਹੈ ਸਦ ਸਾਚਾ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਈ ॥੧੭॥
912.t: niaau tisai kaa hai sadh saachaa virale hukam manaiee ||17||
912.e: His justice is always True; how rare are those who accept His Command. ||17||

912.g: ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥੧੮॥
912.t: tis no praanee sadhaa dhiaavahu jin gurmukh banat banaiee ||18||
912.e: O mortal, meditate forever on the Lord, who has made the Gurmukh in His making. ||18||

912.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੈ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸੀਝੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਈ ॥੧੯॥
912.t: satigur bheTai so jan seejhai jis hiradhai naam vasaiee ||19||
912.e: That humble being who meets with the True Guru is fulfilled; the Naam abides in his heart. ||19||

912.g: ਸਚਾ ਆਪਿ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਣਾਈ ॥੨੦॥
912.t: sachaa aap sadhaa hai saachaa baanee sabadh sunaiee ||20||
912.e: The True Lord is Himself forever True; He announces His Bani, the Word of His Shabad. ||20||

912.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਣਿ ਵੇਖਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਥਾਈ ॥੨੧॥੫॥੧੪॥
912.t: naanak sun vekh rahiaa visamaadh meraa prabh raviaa srab thaiee ||21||5||14||
912.e: Nanak is wonderstruck, hearing and seeing His Lord; my God is all-pervading, everywhere. ||21||5||14||

912.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ
912.t: raamakalee mahalaa panjavaa asaTapadheeaa
912.e: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa:

912.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
912.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
912.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

912.g: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਕੀਆ ਪਰਵਿਰਤਿ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
912.t: kinahee keeaa paravirat pasaaraa ||
912.e: Some make a big show of their worldly influence.

912.g: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਕੀਆ ਪੂਜਾ ਬਿਸਥਾਰਾ ॥
912.t: kinahee keeaa poojaa bisathaaraa ||
912.e: Some make a big show of devotional worship.

912.g: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਨਿਵਲ ਭੁਇਅੰਗਮ ਸਾਧੇ ॥
912.t: kinahee nival bhuia(n)gam saadhe ||
912.e: Some practice inner cleansing teahniques, and control the breath through Kundalini Yoga.

912.g: ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧੇ ॥੧॥
912.t: moh dheen har har aaraadhe ||1||
912.e: I am meek; I worship and adore the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

912.g: ਤੇਰਾ ਭਰੋਸਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
912.t: teraa bharosaa piaare ||
912.e: I place my faith in You alone, O Beloved Lord.

912.g: ਆਨ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ਵੇਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
912.t: aan na jaanaa vesaa ||1|| rahaau ||
912.e: I do not know any other way. ||1||Pause||

912.g: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਤਜਿ ਵਣ ਖੰਡਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
912.t: kinahee girahu taj van kha(n)dd paiaa ||
912.e: Some abandon their homes, and live in the forests.

912.g: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਮੋਨਿ ਅਉਧੂਤੁ ਸਦਾਇਆ ॥
912.t: kinahee mon aaudhoot sadhaiaa ||
912.e: Some put themselves on silence, and call themselves hermits.

912.g: ਕੋਈ ਕਹਤਉ ਅਨੰਨਿ ਭਗਉਤੀ ॥
912.t: koiee kahatau ana(n)n bhagautee ||
912.e: Some claim that they are devotees of the One Lord alone.

912.g: ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਓਟ ਲੀਤੀ ॥੨॥
912.t: moh dheen har har oT leetee ||2||
912.e: I am meek; I seek the shelter and support of the Lord, Har, Har. ||2||

912.g: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਕਹਿਆ ਹਉ ਤੀਰਥ ਵਾਸੀ ॥
912.t: kinahee kahiaa hau teerath vaasee ||
912.e: Some say that they live at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

912.g: ਕੋਈ ਅੰਨੁ ਤਜਿ ਭਇਆ ਉਦਾਸੀ ॥
912.t: koiee a(n)n taj bhiaa udhaasee ||
912.e: Some refuse food and become Udaasis, shaven-headed renunciates.

912.g: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਭਵਨੁ ਸਭ ਧਰਤੀ ਕਰਿਆ ॥
912.t: kinahee bhavan sabh dharatee kariaa ||
912.e: Some have wandered all across the earth.

912.g: ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਪਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
912.t: moh dheen har har dhar pariaa ||3||
912.e: I am meek; I have fallen at the door of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

912.g: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਕਹਿਆ ਮੈ ਕੁਲਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
912.t: kinahee kahiaa mai kuleh vaddiaaiee ||
912.e: Some say that they belong to great and noble families.

913.e: Some say that they have the arms of their many brothers to protect them.
Some say that they have great expanses of wealth.
I am meek; I have the support of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||
Some dance, wearing ankle bells.
Some fast and take vows, and wear malas.
Some apply ceremonial tilak marks to their foreheads.

913.g: ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੫॥
913.t: moh dheen har har har dhiaaiaa ||5||
913.e: I am meek; I meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, Har. ||5||
Some work spells using the miraculous spiritual powers of the Siddhas.
Some wear various religious robes and establish their authority.
Some perform Tantric spells, and chant various mantras.

913.g: ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ॥੬॥
913.t: moh dheen har har har sevaa ||6||
913.e: I am meek; I serve the Lord, Har, Har, Har. ||6||
One calls himself a wise Pandit, a religious scholar.

913.g: ਕੋ ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮ ਸਹਿਤ ਸਿਉ ਮੰਡਿਤ ॥
913.t: ko khaT karam sahit siau ma(n)ddit ||
913.e: One performs the six rituals to appease Shiva.
One maintains the rituals of pure lifestyle, and does good deeds.

913.g: ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣੀ ॥੭॥
913.t: moh dheen har har har saranee ||7||
913.e: I am meek; I seek the Sanctuary of the Lord, Har, Har, Har. ||7||
I have studied the religions and rituals of all the ages.

913.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਪ੍ਰਬੋਧੇ ॥
913.t: bin naavai ih man na prabodhe ||
913.e: Without the Name, this mind is not awakened.
Says Nanak, when I found the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy,
my thirsty desires were satisfied, and I was totally cooled and soothed. ||8||1||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:

913.g: ਇਸੁ ਪਾਨੀ ਤੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂ ਘਰਿਆ ॥
913.t: eis paanee te jin too ghariaa ||
913.e: He created you out of this water.
From clay, He fashioned your body.
He blessed you with the light of reason and clear consciousness.

913.g: ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਮਹਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥੧॥
913.t: maat garabh meh jin too raakhiaa ||1||
913.e: In your mother's womb, He preserved you. ||1||
Contemplate your Savior Lord.
Give up all others thoughts, O mind. ||1||Pause||
He gave you your mother and father;
he gave you your charming children and siblings;

913.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਏ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਅਰੁ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
