925.t: binava(n)t naanak raas jan kee charan kamaleh aasaraa ||2||
925.e: Prays Nanak, the support of His lotus feet is the capital of His humble servant. ||2||

925.g: ਗੁਣ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਨਈ ॥
925.t: gun bea(n)t suaamee tere koi na jaaniee ||
925.e: Your Glorious Virtues are endless, O my Lord and Master; no one knows them all.

925.g: ਦੇਖਿ ਚਲਤ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੁਣਿ ਭਗਤ ਵਖਾਨਈ ॥
925.t: dhekh chalat dhiaal sun bhagat vakhaaniee ||
925.e: Seeing and hearing of Your wondrous plays, O Merciful Lord, Your devotees narrate them.

925.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਝੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਪੁਰਖਪਤਿ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਾ ॥
925.t: jeea ja(n)t sabh tujh dhiaaveh purakhapat paramesaraa ||
925.e: All beings and creatures meditate on You, O Primal Transcendent Lord, Master of men.

925.g: ਸਰਬ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਏਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਜਗਦੀਸਰਾ ॥
925.t: sarab jaachik ek dhaataa karunaa mai jagadheesaraa ||
925.e: All beings are beggars; You are the One Giver, O Lord of the Universe, Embodiment of mercy.

925.g: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਤੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਸੋਈ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਮਾਨਈ ॥
925.t: saadhoo sa(n)t sujaan soiee jiseh prabh jee maaniee ||
925.e: He alone is holy, a Saint, a truly wise person, who is accepted by the Dear Lord.

925.g: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸੋਇ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਪਛਾਨਈ ॥੩॥
925.t: binava(n)t naanak karahu kirapaa soi tujheh pachhaaniee ||3||
925.e: Prays Nanak, they alone realize You, unto whom You show Mercy. ||3||

925.g: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
925.t: moh niragun anaath saranee aaiaa ||
925.e: I am unworthy and without any master; I seek Your Sanctuary, Lord.

925.g: ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
925.t: bal bal bal gurdhev jin naam dhiraRaiaa ||
925.e: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Divine Guru, who has implanted the Naam within me.

925.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਥੀਆ ਸਰਬ ਇਛਾ ਪੁੰਨੀਆ ॥
925.t: gur naam dheeaa kusal theeaa sarab ichhaa pu(n)neeaa ||
925.e: The Guru blessed me with the Naam; happiness came, and all my desires were fulfilled.

925.g: ਜਲਨੇ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਆਈ ਮਿਲੇ ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ॥
925.t: jalane bujhaiee saa(n)t aaiee mile chiree vichhu(n)niaa ||
925.e: The fire of desire has been quenched, and peace and tranquility have come; after such a long separation, I have met my Lord again.

925.g: ਆਨੰਦ ਹਰਖ ਸਹਜ ਸਾਚੇ ਮਹਾ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
925.t: aana(n)dh harakh sahaj saache mahaa ma(n)gal gun gaiaa ||
925.e: I have found ecstasy, pleasure and true intuitive poise, singing the great glories, the song of bliss of the Lord.

925.g: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੨॥
925.t: binava(n)t naanak naam prabh kaa gur poore te paiaa ||4||2||
925.e: Prays Nanak, I have obtained the Name of God from the Perfect Guru. ||4||2||

925.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
925.t: raamakalee mahalaa panjavaa ||
925.e: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:

925.g: ਰੁਣ ਝੁਣੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਨਾਹਦੁ ਨਿਤ ਉਠਿ ਗਾਈਐ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ॥
925.t: run jhuno sabadh anaahadh nit uTh gaieeaai sa(n)tan kai ||
925.e: Rise early each morning, and with the Saints, sing the melodious harmony, the unstruck sound current of the Shabad.

925.g: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਸਭਿ ਦੋਖ ਬਿਨਾਸਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤਨ ਕੈ ॥
925.t: kilavikh sabh dhokh binaasan har naam japeeaai gur ma(n)tan kai ||
925.e: All sins and sufferings are erased, chanting the Lord's Name, under Guru's Instructions.

925.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੀਜੈ ਅਮਿਉ ਪੀਜੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਅਰਾਧੀਐ ॥
925.t: har naam leejai amiau peejai rain dhinas araadheeaai ||
925.e: Dwell upon the Lord's Name, and drink in the Nectar; day and night, worship and adore Him.

925.g: ਜੋਗ ਦਾਨ ਅਨੇਕ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਲਗਿ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲਹ ਸਾਧੀਐ ॥
925.t: jog dhaan anek kiriaa lag charan kamaleh saadheeaai ||
925.e: The merits of Yoga, charity and religious rituals are obtained by grasping His lotus feet.

925.g: ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਮੋਹਨ ਦੂਖ ਸਗਲੇ ਪਰਹਰੈ ॥
925.t: bhaau bhagat dhiaal mohan dhookh sagale paraharai ||
925.e: Loving devotion to the merciful, enticing Lord takes away all pain.

925.g: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਰੈ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨਰਹਰੈ ॥੧॥
925.t: binava(n)t naanak tarai saagar dhiaai suaamee naraharai ||1||
925.e: Prays Nanak, cross over the world-ocean, meditating on the Lord, your Lord and Master. ||1||

925.g: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਿਮਰਣੁ ਭਗਤ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
925.t: sukh saagar gobi(n)dh simaran bhagat gaaveh gun tere raam ||
925.e: Meditation on the Lord of the Universe is an ocean of peace; Your devotees sing Your Glorious Praises, Lord.

925.g: ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੇ ਪਾਏ ਸੂਖ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
925.t: anadh ma(n)gal gur charanee laage paae sookh ghanere raam ||
925.e: Ecstasy, bliss and great happiness are obtained by grasping hold of the Guru's feet.

925.g: ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਦੂਖ ਹਰਿਆ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥
925.t: sukh nidhaan miliaa dhookh hariaa kirapaa kar prabh raakhiaa ||
925.e: Meeting with the treasure of peace, their pains are taken away; granting His Grace, God protects them.

925.g: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਲਾਗਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਭਾਖਿਆ ॥
925.t: har charan laagaa bhram bhau bhaagaa har naam rasanaa bhaakhiaa ||
925.e: Those who grasp the Lord's feet - their fears and doubts run away, and they chant the Name of the Lord.

925.g: ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
925.t: har ek chitavai prabh ek gaavai har ek dhirasaTee aaiaa ||
925.e: He thinks of the One Lord, and he sings of the One God; he gazes upon the One Lord alone.

926.g: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਰੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
926.t: binava(n)t naanak prabh karee kirapaa pooraa satigur paiaa ||2||
926.e: Prays Nanak, God has granted His Grace, and I have found the Perfect True Guru. ||2||

926.g: ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
926.t: mil raheeaai prabh saadh janaa mil har keeratan suneeaai raam ||
926.e: Meet with the holy, humble servants of God; meeting with the Lord, listen to the Kirtan of His Praises.

926.g: ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਾਮੋਦਰ ਮਾਧੋ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਨੀਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
926.t: dhiaal prabhoo dhaamodhar maadho a(n)t na paieeaai guneeaai raam ||
926.e: God is the Merciful Master, the Lord of wealth; there is no end to His Virtues.

926.g: ਦਇਆਲ ਦੁਖ ਹਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਗਲ ਦੋਖ ਨਿਵਾਰਣੋ ॥
926.t: dhiaal dhukh har saran dhaataa sagal dhokh nivaarano ||
926.e: The Merciful Lord is the Dispeller of pain, the Giver of Sanctuary, the Eradicator of all evil.

926.g: ਮੋਹ ਸੋਗ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਬਿਖੜੇ ਜਪਤ ਨਾਮ ਉਧਾਰਣੋ ॥
926.t: moh sog vikaar bikhaRe japat naam udhaarano ||
926.e: Emotional attachment, sorrow, corruption and pain - chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one is saved from these.

926.g: ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਭ ਰੇਣ ਥੀਵਾ ॥
926.t: sabh jeea tere prabhoo mere kar kirapaa sabh ren theevaa ||
926.e: All beings are Yours, O my God; bless me with Your Mercy, that I may become the dust under the feet of all men.

926.g: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਇਆ ਕੀਜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਾ ॥੩॥
926.t: binava(n)t naanak prabh miaa keejai naam teraa jap jeevaa ||3||
926.e: Prays Nanak, O God, be kind to me, that I may chant Your Name, and live. ||3||

926.g: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਅਪਣੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
926.t: raakh le'ee prabh bhagat janaa apanee charanee laae raam ||
926.e: God saves His humble devotees, attaching them to His feet.

926.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਅਪਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਿਮਰਹ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
926.t: aaTh pahar apanaa prabh simareh eko naam dhiaae raam ||
926.e: Twenty-four hours a day, they meditate in remembrance on their God; they meditae on the One Name.

926.g: ਧਿਆਇ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਰੇ ਭਵਜਲ ਰਹੇ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
926.t: dhiaai so prabh tare bhavajal rahe aavan jaanaa ||
926.e: Meditating on that God, they cross over the terrifying world-ocean, and their comings and goings cease.

926.g: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਲਗਾ ਮੀਠਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
926.t: sadhaa sukh kaliaan keeratan prabh lagaa meeThaa bhaanaa ||
926.e: They enjoy eternal peace and pleasure, singing the Kirtan of God's Praises; His Will seems so sweet to them.

926.g: ਸਭ ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਆਸ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਿਆ ॥
926.t: sabh ichh pu(n)nee aas pooree mile satigur pooriaa ||
926.e: All my desires are fulfilled, meeting with the Perfect True Guru.

926.g: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸੂਰਿਆ ॥੪॥੩॥
926.t: binava(n)t naanak prabh aap mele fir naahee dhookh visooriaa ||4||3||
926.e: Prays Nanak, God has blended me with Himself; I shall never suffer pain or sorrow again. ||4||3||

926.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ॥
926.t: raamakalee mahalaa panjavaa chha(n)t ||
926.e: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla, Chhant.

926.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
926.t: salok ||
926.e: Shalok:

926.g: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਮ ॥
926.t: charan kamal saranaagatee anadh ma(n)gal gun gaam ||
926.e: In the Sanctuary of His lotus feet, I sing His Glorious Praises in ecstasy and bliss.

926.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਬਿਪਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਣ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
926.t: naanak prabh aaraadheeaai bipat nivaaran raam ||1||
926.e: O Nanak, worship God in adoration, the Eradicator of misfortune. ||1||

926.g: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
926.t: chha(n)t ||
926.e: Chhant:

926.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਪਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਣੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
926.t: prabh bipat nivaarano tis bin avar na koi jeeau ||
926.e: God is the Eradicator of misfortune; there is none other than Him.

926.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਸੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
926.t: sadhaa sadhaa har simareeaai jal thal maheeal soi jeeau ||
926.e: Forever and ever, remember the Lord in meditation; He is permeating the water, the land and the sky.

926.g: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ॥
926.t: jal thal maheeal poor rahiaa ik nimakh manahu na veesarai ||
926.e: He is permeating and pervading the water, the land and the sky; do not forget Him from your mind, even for an instant.

926.g: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਲਾਗੇ ਦਿਨ ਸਭਾਗੇ ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣ ਜਗਦੀਸਰੈ ॥
926.t: gur charan laage dhin sabhaage sarab gun jagadheesarai ||
926.e: Blessed was that day, when I grasped the Guru's feet; all virtues rest in the Lord of the Universe.

926.g: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
926.t: kar sev sevak dhinas rainee tis bhaavai so hoi jeeau ||
926.e: So serve Him day and night, O servant; whatever pleases Him, happens.

926.g: ਬਲਿ ਜਾਇ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੁਖਹ ਦਾਤੇ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
926.t: bal jai naanak sukheh dhaate paragaas man tan hoi jeeau ||1||
926.e: Nanak is a sacrifice to the Giver of peace; his mind and body are enlightened. ||1||

926.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
926.t: salok ||
926.e: Shalok:

926.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੁਖੀ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਸੋਚ ॥
926.t: har simarat man tan sukhee binasee dhuteeaa soch ||
926.e: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, the mind and body find peace; the thought of duality is dispelled.

926.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਟੇਕ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ਕੀ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਸੰਕਟ ਮੋਚ ॥੧॥
926.t: naanak Tek guopaal kee govi(n)dh sa(n)kaT moch ||1||
926.e: Nanak takes the support of the Lord of the World, the Lord of the Universe, the Destroyer of troubles. ||1||

926.g: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
926.t: chha(n)t ||
926.e: Chhant:

926.g: ਭੈ ਸੰਕਟ ਕਾਟੇ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਦਇਆਲ ਜੀਉ ॥
926.t: bhai sa(n)kaT kaaTe naarain dhiaal jeeau ||
926.e: The Merciful Lord has eradicated my fears and troubles.

926.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਆਨੰਦ ਗਾਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਜੀਉ ॥
926.t: har gun aana(n)dh gaae prabh dheenaa naath pratipaal jeeau ||
926.e: In ecstasy, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; God is the Cherisher, the Master of the meek.

926.g: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਅਚੁਤ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਏਕੋ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਸਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
926.t: pratipaal achut purakh eko tiseh siau ra(n)g laagaa ||
926.e: The Cherishing Lord is imperishable, the One and only Primal Lord; I am imbued with His Love.

926.g: ਕਰ ਚਰਨ ਮਸਤਕੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਸਦਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਾ ॥
926.t: kar charan masatak mel leene sadhaa anadhin jaagaa ||
926.e: When I placed my hands and forehead upon His Feet, He blended me with Himself; I became awake and aware forever, night and day.

926.g: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਤਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
926.t: jeeau pi(n)dd girahu thaan tis kaa tan joban dhan maal jeeau ||
926.e: My soul, body, household and home belong to Him, along with my body, youth, wealth and property.

926.g: ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਇ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
926.t: sadh sadhaa bal jai naanak sarab jeeaa pratipaal jeeau ||2||
926.e: Forever and ever, Nanak is a sacrifice to Him, who cherishes and nurtures all beings. ||2||

926.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
926.t: salok ||
926.e: Shalok:

926.g: ਰਸਨਾ ਉਚਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਵਖਿਆਨ ॥
926.t: rasanaa ucharai har hare gun govi(n)dh vakhiaan ||
926.e: My tongue chants the Name of the Lord, and chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

926.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਕੜੀ ਟੇਕ ਏਕ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਰਖੈ ਨਿਦਾਨ ॥੧॥
926.t: naanak pakaRee Tek ek paramesar rakhai nidhaan ||1||
926.e: Nanak has grasped the sheltering support of the One Transcendent Lord, who shall save him in the end. ||1||

926.g: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
926.t: chha(n)t ||
926.e: Chhant:

926.g: ਸੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਖਕੋ ਅੰਚਲਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਲਾਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
926.t: so suaamee prabh rakhako a(n)chal taa kai laag jeeau ||
926.e: He is God, our Lord and Master, our Saving Grace. Grab hold of the hem of His robe.

926.g: ਭਜੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਦੇਵ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਤਿਆਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
926.t: bhaj saadhoo sa(n)g dhiaal dhev man kee mat tiaag jeeau ||
926.e: Vibrate, and meditate on the Merciful Divine Lord in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; renounce your intellectual mind.

927.g: ਇਕ ਓਟ ਕੀਜੈ ਜੀਉ ਦੀਜੈ ਆਸ ਇਕ ਧਰਣੀਧਰੈ ॥
927.t: eik oT keejai jeeau dheejai aas ik dharaneedharai ||
927.e: Seek the Support of the One Lord, and surrender your soul to Him; place your hopes only in the Sustainer of the World.

927.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਰੈ ॥
927.t: saadhasa(n)ge har naam ra(n)ge sa(n)saar saagar sabh tarai ||
927.e: Those who are imbued with the Lord's Name, in the Saadh Sangat, cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

927.g: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਛੂਟੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਦਾਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
927.t: janam maran bikaar chhooTe fir na laagai dhaag jeeau ||
927.e: The corrupting sins of birth and death are eradicated, and no stain ever sticks to them again.

927.g: ਬਲਿ ਜਾਇ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਪੂਰਨ ਥਿਰੁ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
927.t: bal jai naanak purakh pooran thir jaa kaa sohaag jeeau ||3||
927.e: Nanak is a sacrifice to the Perfect Primal Lord; His marriage is eternal. ||3||

927.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
927.t: salok ||
927.e: Shalok:

927.g: ਧਰਮ ਅਰਥ ਅਰੁ ਕਾਮ ਮੋਖ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਨਾਥ ॥
927.t: dharam arath ar kaam mokh mukat padhaarath naath ||
927.e: Righteous faith, wealth, fulfilment of desires and salvation; the Lord bestows these four blessings.

927.g: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਮਾਥ ॥੧॥
927.t: sagal manorath pooriaa naanak likhiaa maath ||1||
927.e: One who has such pre-ordained destiny upon his forehead, O Nanak, has all his desires fulfilled. ||1||

927.g: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
927.t: chha(n)t ||
927.e: Chhant:

927.g: ਸਗਲ ਇਛ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੁੰਨੀਆ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਰਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
927.t: sagal ichh meree pu(n)neeaa miliaa nira(n)jan rai jeeau ||
927.e: All my desires are fulfilled, meeting with my Immaculate, Sovereign Lord.

927.g: ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਹੋ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
927.t: anadh bhiaa vaddabhaageeho gireh pragaTe prabh aai jeeau ||
927.e: I am in ecstasy, O very fortunate ones; the Dear Lord has become manifest in my own home.

927.g: ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਲਾਲ ਆਏ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਕਮਾਏ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਕਿਆ ਗਣਾ ॥
927.t: gireh laal aae purab kamaae taa kee upamaa kiaa ganaa ||
927.e: My Beloved has come to my home, because of my past actions; how can I count His Glories?

927.g: ਬੇਅੰਤ ਪੂਰਨ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਦਾਤਾ ਕਵਨ ਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਣ ਭਣਾ ॥
927.t: bea(n)t pooran sukh sahaj dhaataa kavan rasanaa gun bhanaa ||
927.e: The Lord, the Giver of peace and intuition, is infinite and perfect; with what tongue can I describe His Glorious Virtues?

927.g: ਆਪੇ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਗਹਿ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
927.t: aape milaae geh ka(n)Th laae tis binaa nahee jai jeeau ||
927.e: He hugs me close in His embrace, and merges me into Himself; there is no place of rest other than Him.

927.g: ਬਲਿ ਜਾਇ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਤੇ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੪॥
927.t: bal jai naanak sadhaa karate sabh meh rahiaa samai jeeau ||4||4||
927.e: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to the Creator, who is contained in, and permeating all. ||4||4||

927.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
927.t: raag raamakalee mahalaa panjavaa ||
927.e: Raag Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:

927.g: ਰਣ ਝੁੰਝਨੜਾ ਗਾਉ ਸਖੀ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ॥
927.t: ran jhu(n)jhanaRaa gaau sakhee har ek dhiaavahu ||
927.e: Sing the melodious harmonies, O my companions, and meditate on the One Lord.

927.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਮ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਖੀ ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਅੜਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
927.t: satigur tum sev sakhee man chi(n)dhiaRaa fal paavahu ||
927.e: Serve your True Guru, O my companions, and you shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires.

927.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਰੁਤੀ ਸਲੋਕੁ
927.t: raamakalee mahalaa panjavaa rutee saloku
927.e: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla, Ruti ~ The Seasons. Shalok:

927.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
927.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
927.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

927.g: ਕਰਿ ਬੰਦਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਾਛਉ ਸਾਧਹ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
927.t: kar ba(n)dhan prabh paarabraham baachhau saadheh dhoor ||
927.e: Bow to the Supreme Lord God, and seek the dust of the feet of the Holy.

927.g: ਆਪੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
927.t: aap nivaar har har bhajau naanak prabh bharapoor ||1||
927.e: Cast out your self-conceit, and vibrate, meditate, on the Lord, Har, Har. O Nanak, God is all-pervading. ||1||

927.g: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਾਟਣ ਭੈ ਹਰਣ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
927.t: kilavikh kaaTan bhai haran sukh saagar har rai ||
927.e: He is the Eradicator of sins, the Destroyer of fear, the Ocean of peace, the Sovereign Lord King.

927.g: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਨੀਤ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੨॥
927.t: dheen dhiaal dhukh bha(n)jano naanak neet dhiaai ||2||
927.e: Merciful to the meek, the Destroyer of pain: O Nanak, always meditate on Him. ||2||

927.g: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
927.t: chha(n)t ||
927.e: Chhant:

927.g: ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਹੋ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਜੀਉ ॥
927.t: jas gaavahu vaddabhaageeho kar kirapaa bhagava(n)t jeeau ||
927.e: Sing His Praises, O very fortunate ones, and the Dear Lord God shall bless you with His Mercy.

927.g: ਰੁਤੀ ਮਾਹ ਮੂਰਤ ਘੜੀ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰਤ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤ ਜੀਉ ॥
927.t: rutee maeh moorat ghaRee gun ucharat sobhaava(n)t jeeau ||
927.e: Blessed and auspicious is that season, that month, that moment, that hour, when you chant the Lord's Glorious Praises.

927.g: ਗੁਣ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਧੰਨਿ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਜਿਨੀ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
927.t: gun ra(n)g raate dha(n)n te jan jinee ik man dhiaaiaa ||
927.e: Blessed are those humble beings, who are imbued with love for His Praises, and who meditate single-mindedly on Him.

927.g: ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਭਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਜਿਨੀ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
927.t: safal janam bhiaa tin kaa jinee so prabh paiaa ||
927.e: Their lives become fruitful, and they find that Lord God.

927.g: ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਨ ਤੁਲਿ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਪਾਪਾ ਹੰਤ ਜੀਉ ॥
927.t: pu(n)n dhaan na tul kiriaa har sarab paapaa ha(n)t jeeau ||
927.e: Donations to charities and religious rituals are not equal to meditation on the Lord, who destroys all sins.

927.g: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਰਹੰਤ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
927.t: binava(n)t naanak simar jeevaa janam maran raha(n)t jeeau ||1||
927.e: Prays Nanak, meditating in remembrance on Him, I live; birth and death are finished for me. ||1||

927.g: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
927.t: salok ||
927.e: Shalok:

927.g: ਉਦਮੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੋ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ॥
927.t: audham agam agocharo charan kamal namasakaar ||
927.e: Strive for the inaccessible and unfathomable Lord, and bow in humility to His lotus feet.

927.g: ਕਥਨੀ ਸਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਸੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰ ॥੧॥
927.t: kathanee saa tudh bhaavasee naanak naam adhaar ||1||
927.e: O Nanak, that sermon alone is pleasing to You, Lord, which inspires us to take the Support of the Name. ||1||

927.g: ਸੰਤ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਪਰਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਅਨੰਤ ॥
927.t: sa(n)t saran saajan parahu suaamee simar ana(n)t ||
927.e: Seek the Sanctuary of the Saints, O friends; meditate in remembrance on your infinite Lord and Master.

927.g: ਸੂਕੇ ਤੇ ਹਰਿਆ ਥੀਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪਿ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥੨॥
927.t: sooke te hariaa theeaa naanak jap bhagava(n)t ||2||
927.e: The dried branch shall blossom forth in its greenery again, O Nanak, meditating on the Lord God. ||2||

927.g: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
927.t: chha(n)t ||
927.e: Chhant:

927.g: ਰੁਤਿ ਸਰਸ ਬਸੰਤ ਮਾਹ ਚੇਤੁ ਵੈਸਾਖ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
927.t: rut saras basa(n)t maeh chet vaisaakh sukh maas jeeau ||
927.e: The season of spring is delightful; the months of Chayt and Baisaakhi are the most pleasant months.

927.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਨਾਹੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮਉਲਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
927.t: har jeeau naahu miliaa mauliaa man tan saas jeeau ||
927.e: I have obtained the Dear Lord as my Husband, and my mind, body and breath have blossomed forth.

927.g: ਘਰਿ ਨਾਹੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਅਨਦੁ ਸਖੀਏ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰਫੁਲਿਆ ॥
927.t: ghar naahu nihachal anadh sakhe'ee charan kamal prafuliaa ||
927.e: The eternal, unchanging Lord has come into my home as my Husband, O my companions; dwelling upon His lotus feet, I blossom forth in bliss.

928.g: ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਬੇਤਾ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਅਮੁਲਿਆ ॥
928.t: su(n)dhar sughaR sujaan betaa gun govi(n)dh amuliaa ||
928.e: The Lord of the Universe is beautiful, proficient, wise and all-knowing;

928.g: ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਭਈ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸ ਜੀਉ ॥
928.t: vaddabhaag paiaa dhukh gavaiaa bhiee pooran aas jeeau ||
928.e: His Virtues are priceless. By great good fortune, I have found Him; my pain is dispelled, and my hopes are fulfilled.

928.g: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਮਿਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
928.t: binava(n)t naanak saran teree miTee jam kee traas jeeau ||2||
928.e: Prays Nanak, I have entered Your Sanctuary, Lord, and my fear of death is eradicated. ||2||

928.g: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
928.t: salok ||
928.e: Shalok:

928.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਮੁਈ ਕਰਤੀ ਕਰਮ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
928.t: saadhasa(n)gat bin bhram muiee karatee karam anek ||
928.e: Without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one dies wandering around in confusion, performing all sorts of rituals.

928.g: ਕੋਮਲ ਬੰਧਨ ਬਾਧੀਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਮਹਿ ਲੇਖ ॥੧॥
928.t: komal ba(n)dhan baadheeaa naanak karameh lekh ||1||
928.e: O Nanak, all are bound by the attractive bonds of Maya, and the karmic record of past actions. ||1||

928.g: ਜੋ ਭਾਣੇ ਸੇ ਮੇਲਿਆ ਵਿਛੋੜੇ ਭੀ ਆਪਿ ॥
928.t: jo bhaane se meliaa vichhoRe bhee aap ||
928.e: Those who are pleasing to God are united with Him; He separates others from Himself.

928.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥੨॥
928.t: naanak prabh saranaagatee jaa kaa vadd parataap ||2||
928.e: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of God; His greatness is glorious! ||2||

928.g: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
928.t: chha(n)t ||
928.e: Chhant:

928.g: ਗ੍ਰੀਖਮ ਰੁਤਿ ਅਤਿ ਗਾਖੜੀ ਜੇਠ ਅਖਾੜੈ ਘਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
928.t: greekham rut at gaakhaRee jeTh akhaaRai ghaam jeeau ||
928.e: In the summer season, in the months of Jayt'h and Asaarh, the heat is terrible, intense and severe.

928.g: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਿਛੋਹੁ ਦੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨ ਕਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
928.t: prem bichhoh dhuhaaganee dhirasaT na karee raam jeeau ||
928.e: The discarded bride is separated from His Love, and the Lord does not even look at her.

928.g: ਨਹ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਆਵੈ ਮਰਤ ਹਾਵੈ ਮਹਾ ਗਾਰਬਿ ਮੁਠੀਆ ॥
928.t: neh dhirasaT aavai marat haavai mahaa gaarab muTheeaa ||
928.e: She does not see her Lord, and she dies with an aching sigh; she is defrauded and plundered by her great pride.

928.g: ਜਲ ਬਾਝੁ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਤੜਫੜਾਵੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੁਠੀਆ ॥
928.t: jal baajh machhulee taRafaRaavai sa(n)g maiaa ruTheeaa ||
928.e: She flails around, like a fish out of water; attached to Maya, she is alienated from the Lord.

928.g: ਕਰਿ ਪਾਪ ਜੋਨੀ ਭੈ ਭੀਤ ਹੋਈ ਦੇਇ ਸਾਸਨ ਜਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
928.t: kar paap jonee bhai bheet hoiee dhei saasan jaam jeeau ||
928.e: She sins, and so she is fearful of reincarnation; the Messenger of Death will surely punish her.

928.g: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਓਟ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਾਖੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
928.t: binava(n)t naanak oT teree raakh pooran kaam jeeau ||3||
928.e: Prays Nanak, take me under Your sheltering support, Lord, and protect me; You are the Fulfiller of desire. ||3||

928.g: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
928.t: salok ||
928.e: Shalok:

928.g: ਸਰਧਾ ਲਾਗੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੈ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
928.t: saradhaa laagee sa(n)g preetamai ik til rahan na jai ||
928.e: With loving faith, I am attached to my Beloved; I cannot survive without Him, even for an instant.

928.g: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੧॥
928.t: man tan a(n)tar rav rahe naanak sahaj subhai ||1||
928.e: He is permeating and pervading my mind and body, O Nanak, with intuitive ease. ||1||

928.g: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨੀ ਸਾਜਨਹਿ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਮੀਤ ॥
928.t: kar geh leenee saajaneh janam janam ke meet ||
928.e: My Friend has taken me by the hand; He has been my best friend, lifetime after lifetime.

928.g: ਚਰਨਹ ਦਾਸੀ ਕਰਿ ਲਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਿਤ ਚੀਤ ॥੨॥
928.t: charaneh dhaasee kar liee naanak prabh hit cheet ||2||
928.e: He has made me the slave of His feet; O Nanak, my consciousness is filled with love for God. ||2||

928.g: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
928.t: chha(n)t ||
928.e: Chhant:

928.g: ਰੁਤਿ ਬਰਸੁ ਸੁਹੇਲੀਆ ਸਾਵਣ ਭਾਦਵੇ ਆਨੰਦ ਜੀਉ ॥
928.t: rut baras suheleeaa saavan bhaadhave aana(n)dh jeeau ||
928.e: The rainy season is beautiful; the months of Saawan and Bhaadon bring bliss.

928.g: ਘਣ ਉਨਵਿ ਵੁਠੇ ਜਲ ਥਲ ਪੂਰਿਆ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਜੀਉ ॥
928.t: ghan unav vuThe jal thal pooriaa makara(n)dh jeeau ||
928.e: The clouds are low, and heavy with rain; the waters and the lands are filled with honey.

928.g: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬ ਠਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਭਰੇ ॥
928.t: prabh poor rahiaa sarab Thaiee har naam nav nidh gireh bhare ||
928.e: God is all-pervading everywhere; the nine treasures of the Lord's Name fill the homes of all hearts.

928.g: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਕੁਲ ਸਮੂਹਾ ਸਭਿ ਤਰੇ ॥
928.t: simar suaamee a(n)tarajaamee kul samoohaa sabh tare ||
928.e: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord and Master, the Searcher of hearts, all one's ancestry is saved.

928.g: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਰੰਗਿ ਜਾਗੇ ਨਹ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਲਾਗੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਸਦ ਬਖਸਿੰਦੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
928.t: pria ra(n)g jaage neh chhidhr laage kirapaal sadh bakhasi(n)dh jeeau ||
928.e: No blemish sticks to that being who remains awake and aware in the Love of the Lord; the Merciful Lord is forever forgiving.

928.g: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਤੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੰਦੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
928.t: binava(n)t naanak har ka(n)t paiaa sadhaa man bhaava(n)dh jeeau ||4||
928.e: Prays Nanak, I have found my Husband Lord, who is forever pleasing to my mind. ||4||

928.g: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
928.t: salok ||
928.e: Shalok:

928.g: ਆਸ ਪਿਆਸੀ ਮੈ ਫਿਰਉ ਕਬ ਪੇਖਉ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
928.t: aas piaasee mai firau kab pekhau gopaal ||
928.e: Thirsty with desire, I wander around; when will I behold the Lord of the World?

928.g: ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰ ॥੧॥
928.t: hai koiee saajan sa(n)t jan naanak prabh melanahaar ||1||
928.e: Is there any humble Saint, any friend, O Nanak, who can lead me to meet with God? ||1||

928.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਮਿਲਬੇ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਤਿਲੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
928.t: bin milabe saa(n)t na uoopajai til pal rahan na jai ||
928.e: Without meeting Him, I have no peace or tranquility; I cannot survive for a moment, even for an instant.

928.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧਹ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਸ ਪੁਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
928.t: har saadheh saranaagatee naanak aas pujai ||2||
928.e: Entering the Sanctuary of the Lord's Holy Saints, O Nanak, my desires are fulfilled. ||2||

928.g: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
928.t: chha(n)t ||
928.e: Chhant:

928.g: ਰੁਤਿ ਸਰਦ ਅਡੰਬਰੋ ਅਸੂ ਕਤਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਸ ਜੀਉ ॥
928.t: rut saradh adda(n)baro asoo katake har piaas jeeau ||
928.e: In the cool, autumn season, in the months of Assu and Katik, I am thirsty for the Lord.

928.g: ਖੋਜੰਤੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਫਿਰਤ ਕਬ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ਜੀਉ ॥
928.t: khoja(n)tee dharasan firat kab mileeaai gunataas jeeau ||
928.e: Searching for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, I wander around wondering, when will I meet my Lord, the treasure of virtue?

928.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਹ ਸੂਖ ਸਾਰੇ ਹਾਰ ਕੰਙਣ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਬਨਾ ॥
928.t: bin ka(n)t piaare neh sookh saare haar ka(n)n(g)n dhirag banaa ||
928.e: Without my Beloved Husband Lord, I find no peace, and all my necklaces and bracelets become cursed.

928.g: ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਸੁਜਾਣਿ ਚਤੁਰਿ ਬੇਤੀ ਸਾਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੈਸੇ ਤਨਾ ॥
928.t: su(n)dhar sujaan chatur betee saas bin jaise tanaa ||
928.e: So beautiful, so wise, so clever and knowing; still, without the breath, it is just a body.

928.g: ਈਤ ਉਤ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਅਲੋਕਨ ਮਨਿ ਮਿਲਨ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਿਆਸ ਜੀਉ ॥
928.t: e'eet ut dheh dhis alokan man milan kee prabh piaas jeeau ||
928.e: I look here and there, in the ten directions; my mind is so thirsty to meet God!

928.g: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਧਾਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
928.t: binava(n)t naanak dhaar kirapaa melahu prabh gunataas jeeau ||5||
928.e: Prays Nanak, shower Your Mercy upon me; unite me with Yourself, O God, O treasure of virtue. ||5||

928.g: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
928.t: salok ||
928.e: Shalok:

928.g: ਜਲਣਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਸੀਤਲ ਭਏ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਉਪਜੀ ਸਾਂਤਿ ॥
928.t: jalan bujhee seetal bhe man tan upajee saa(n)t ||
928.e: The fire of desire is cooled and quenched; my mind and body are filled with peace and tranquility.

928.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੂਰਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਭ੍ਰਾਂਤਿ ॥੧॥
928.t: naanak prabh pooran mile dhuteeaa binasee bhraa(n)t ||1||
928.e: O Nanak, I have met my Perfect God; the illusion of duality is dispelled. ||1||

929.g: ਸਾਧ ਪਠਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
929.t: saadh paThaae aap har ham tum te naahee dhoor ||
929.e: The Lord Himself sent His Holy Saints, to tell us that He is not far away.

929.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੈ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਰਮਣ ਰਾਮ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
929.t: naanak bhram bhai miT ge raman raam bharapoor ||2||
929.e: O Nanak, doubt and fear are dispelled, chanting the Name of the all-pervading Lord. ||2||

929.g: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
929.t: chha(n)t ||
929.e: Chhant:

929.g: ਰੁਤਿ ਸਿਸੀਅਰ ਸੀਤਲ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਮੰਘਰ ਪੋਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
929.t: rut siseear seetal har pragaTe ma(n)ghar poh jeeau ||
929.e: In the cold season of Maghar and Poh, the Lord reveals Himself.

929.g: ਜਲਨਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਦਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਧ੍ਰੋਹ ਜੀਉ ॥
929.t: jalan bujhee dharas paiaa binase maiaa dhroh jeeau ||
929.e: My burning desires were quenched, when I obtained the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; the fraudulent illusion of Maya is gone.

929.g: ਸਭਿ ਕਾਮ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਜੂਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਸੇਵਕਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ॥
929.t: sabh kaam poore mil hajoore har charan sevak seviaa ||
929.e: All my desires have been fulfilled, meeting the Lord face-to-face; I am His servant, I serve at His feet.

929.g: ਹਾਰ ਡੋਰ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਿਆ ॥
929.t: haar ddor seegaar sabh ras gun gaau alakh abheviaa ||
929.e: My necklaces, hair-ties, all decorations and adornments, are in singing the Glorious Praises of the unseen, mysterious Lord.

929.g: ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਜਮੁ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਜੋਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
929.t: bhaau bhagat govi(n)dh baa(n)chhat jam na saakai joh jeeau ||
929.e: I long for loving devotion to the Lord of the Universe, and so the Messenger of Death cannot even see me.

929.g: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਤਹ ਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਿਛੋਹ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥
929.t: binava(n)t naanak prabh aap melee teh na prem bichhoh jeeau ||6||
929.e: Prays Nanak, God has united me with Himself; I shall never suffer separation from my Beloved again. ||6||

929.g: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
929.t: salok ||
929.e: Shalok:

929.g: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਡੋਲਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਚੀਤ ॥
929.t: har dhan paiaa sohaaganee ddolat naahee cheet ||
929.e: The happy soul bride has found the wealth of the Lord; her consciousness does not waver.

929.g: ਸੰਤ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥
929.t: sa(n)t sa(n)jogee naanakaa gireh pragaTe prabh meet ||1||
929.e: Joining together with the Saints, O Nanak, God, my Friend, has revealed Himself in my home. ||1||

929.g: ਨਾਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਅਨੰਦ ਕੋਡ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਨੇ ॥
929.t: naadh binodh ana(n)dh kodd pria preetam sa(n)g bane ||
929.e: With her Beloved Husband Lord, she enjoys millions of melodies, pleasures and joys.

929.g: ਮਨ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਭਨੇ ॥੨॥
929.t: man baa(n)chhat fal paiaa har naanak naam bhane ||2||
929.e: The fruits of the mind's desires are obtained, O Nanak, chanting the Lord's Name. ||2||

929.g: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
929.t: chha(n)t ||
929.e: Chhant:

929.g: ਹਿਮਕਰ ਰੁਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਤੀ ਮਾਘੁ ਫਗਣੁ ਗੁਣਵੰਤ ਜੀਉ ॥
929.t: himakar rut man bhaavatee maagh fagan gunava(n)t jeeau ||
929.e: The snowy winter season, the months of Maagh and Phagun, are pleasing and ennobling to the mind.

929.g: ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਗਾਉ ਮੰਗਲੋ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਆਏ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਤ ਜੀਉ ॥
929.t: sakhee sahelee gaau ma(n)galo gireh aae har ka(n)t jeeau ||
929.e: O my friends and companions, sing the songs of joy; my Husband Lord has come into my home.

929.g: ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਲਾਲ ਆਏ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਏ ਸੇਜ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਸੋਹੀਆ ॥
929.t: gireh laal aae man dhiaae sej su(n)dhar soheeaa ||
929.e: My Beloved has come into my home; I meditate on Him in my mind. The bed of my heart is beautifully adorned.

929.g: ਵਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਭਏ ਹਰਿਆ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਮੋਹੀਆ ॥
929.t: van tiran tirabhavan bhe hariaa dhekh dharasan moheeaa ||
929.e: The woods, the meadows and the three worlds have blossomed forth in their greenery; gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, I am fascinated.

929.g: ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਮਨਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮੰਤ ਜੀਉ ॥
929.t: mile suaamee ichh pu(n)nee man japiaa niramal ma(n)t jeeau ||
929.e: I have met my Lord and Master, and my desires are fulfilled; my mind chants His Immaculate Mantra.

929.g: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਤ ਕਰਹੁ ਰਲੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਕੰਤ ਜੀਉ ॥੭॥
929.t: binava(n)t naanak nit karahu raleeaa har mile sreedhar ka(n)t jeeau ||7||
929.e: Prays Nanak, I celebrate continuously; I have met my Husband Lord, the Lord of excellence. ||7||

929.g: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
929.t: salok ||
929.e: Shalok:

929.g: ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ਜੀਅ ਕੇ ਭਵਜਲ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰ ॥
929.t: sa(n)t sahaiee jeea ke bhavajal taaranahaar ||
929.e: The Saints are the helpers, the support of the soul; they carry us cross the terrifying world-ocean.

929.g: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚੇ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਪਿਆਰ ॥੧॥
929.t: sabh te uooche jaane'eeh naanak naam piaar ||1||
929.e: Know that they are the highest of all; O Nanak, they love the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

929.g: ਜਿਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਸੇਈ ਤਰੇ ਸੇ ਸੂਰੇ ਸੇ ਬੀਰ ॥
929.t: jin jaaniaa seiee tare se soore se beer ||
929.e: Those who know Him, cross over; they are the brave heroes, the heroic warriors.

929.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਉਤਰੇ ਤੀਰ ॥੨॥
929.t: naanak tin balihaaranai har jap utare teer ||2||
929.e: Nanak is a sacrifice to those who meditate on the Lord, and cross over to the other shore. ||2||

929.g: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
929.t: chha(n)t ||
929.e: Chhant:

929.g: ਚਰਣ ਬਿਰਾਜਿਤ ਸਭ ਊਪਰੇ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਕਲੇਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
929.t: charan biraajit sabh uoopare miTiaa sagal kales jeeau ||
929.e: His feet are exalted above all. They eradicate all suffering.

929.g: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਵਣ ਦੁਖ ਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕੀਆ ਪਰਵੇਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
929.t: aavan jaavan dhukh hare har bhagat keeaa paraves jeeau ||
929.e: They destroy the pains of coming and going. They bring loving devotion to the Lord.

929.g: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਾਤੇ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਬੀਸਰੈ ॥
929.t: har ra(n)g raate sahaj maate til na man te beesarai ||
929.e: Imbued with the Lord's Love, one is intoxicated with intuitive peace and poise, and does not forget the Lord from his mind, even for an instant.

929.g: ਤਜਿ ਆਪੁ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਰੇ ਚਰਨੀ ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣ ਜਗਦੀਸਰੈ ॥
929.t: taj aap saranee pare charanee sarab gun jagadheesarai ||
929.e: Shedding my self-conceit, I have entered the Sanctuary of His Feet; all virtues rest in the Lord of the Universe.

929.g: ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਸ੍ਰੀਰੰਗ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਦਿ ਕਉ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
929.t: govi(n)dh gun nidh sreera(n)g suaamee aadh kau aadhes jeeau ||
929.e: I bow in humility to the Lord of the Universe, the treasure of virtue, the Lord of excellence, our Primal Lord and Master.

929.g: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਇਆ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੋ ਇਕ ਵੇਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੮॥੧॥੬॥੮॥
929.t: binava(n)t naanak miaa dhaarahu jug jugo ik ves jeeau ||8||1||6||8||
929.e: Prays Nanak, shower me with Your Mercy, Lord; throughout the ages, You take the same form. ||8||1||6||8||

929.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਦਖਣੀ ਓਅੰਕਾਰੁ
929.t: raamakalee mahalaa pehilaa dhakhanee oa(n)kaaru
929.e: Raamkalee, First Mehla, Dakhanee, Ongkaar:

929.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
929.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
929.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

929.g: ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਉਤਪਤਿ ॥
929.t: oa(n)kaar brahamaa utapat ||
929.e: From Ongkaar, the One Universal Creator God, Brahma was created.

929.g: ਓਅੰਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ॥
929.t: oa(n)kaar keeaa jin chit ||
929.e: He kept Ongkaar in his consciousness.

929.g: ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਸੈਲ ਜੁਗ ਭਏ ॥
929.t: oa(n)kaar sail jug bhe ||
929.e: From Ongkaar, the mountains and the ages were created.

929.g: ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਬੇਦ ਨਿਰਮਏ ॥
929.t: oa(n)kaar bedh nirame ||
929.e: Ongkaar created the Vedas.

930.e: Ongkaar saves the world through the Shabad.
Ongkaar saves the Gurmukhs.
Listen to the Message of the Universal, Imperishable Creator Lord.
The Universal, Imperishable Creator Lord is the essence of the three worlds. ||1||
Listen, O Pandit, O religious scholar, why are you writing about worldly debates?

930.g: ਲਿਖੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
930.t: likh raam naam gurmukh gopaalaa ||1|| rahaau ||
930.e: As Gurmukh, write only the Name of the Lord, the Lord of the World. ||1||Pause||

930.g: ਸਸੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਤੀਨਿ ਭਵਨ ਇਕ ਜੋਤੀ ॥
930.t: sasai sabh jag sahaj upaiaa teen bhavan ik jotee ||
930.e: Sassa: He created the entire universe with ease; His One Light pervades the three worlds.

930.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਚੁਣਿ ਲੈ ਮਾਣਕ ਮੋਤੀ ॥
930.t: gurmukh vasat paraapat hovai chun lai maanak motee ||
930.e: Become Gurmukh, and obtain the real thing; gather the gems and pearls.

930.g: ਸਮਝੈ ਸੂਝੈ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਅੰਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ॥
930.t: samajhai soojhai paR paR boojhai a(n)t nira(n)tar saachaa ||
930.e: If one understands, realizes and comprehends what he reads and studies, in the end he shall realize that the True Lord dwells deep within his nucleus.

930.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਜਗੁ ਕਾਚਾ ॥੨॥
930.t: gurmukh dhekhai saach samaale bin saache jag kaachaa ||2||
930.e: The Gurmukh sees and contemplates the True Lord; without the True Lord, the world is false. ||2||

930.g: ਧਧੈ ਧਰਮੁ ਧਰੇ ਧਰਮਾ ਪੁਰਿ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰਾ ॥
930.t: dhadhai dharam dhare dharamaa pur gunakaaree man dheeraa ||
930.e: Dhadha: Those who enshrine Dharmic faith and dwell in the City of Dharma are worthy; their minds are steadfast and stable.

930.g: ਧਧੈ ਧੂਲਿ ਪੜੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਕੰਚਨ ਭਏ ਮਨੂਰਾ ॥
930.t: dhadhai dhool paRai mukh masatak ka(n)chan bhe manooraa ||
930.e: Dhadha: If the dust of their feet touches one's face and forehead, he is transformed from iron into gold.

930.g: ਧਨੁ ਧਰਣੀਧਰੁ ਆਪਿ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਤੋਲਿ ਬੋਲਿ ਸਚੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
930.t: dhan dharaneedhar aap ajonee tol bol sach pooraa ||
930.e: Blessed is the Support of the Earth; He Himself is not born; His measure and speech are perfect and True.

930.g: ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੈ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੂਰਾ ॥੩॥
930.t: karate kee mit karataa jaanai kai jaanai gur sooraa ||3||
930.e: Only the Creator Himself knows His own extent; He alone knows the Brave Guru. ||3||

930.g: ਙਿਆਨੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਇਆ ਗਰਬਿ ਗਲੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
930.t: n(g)iaan gavaiaa dhoojaa bhaiaa garab gale bikh khaiaa ||
930.e: In love with duality, spiritual wisdom is lost; the mortal rots away in pride, and eats poison.

930.g: ਗੁਰ ਰਸੁ ਗੀਤ ਬਾਦ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
930.t: gur ras geet baadh nahee bhaavai suneeaai gahir ga(n)bheer gavaiaa ||
930.e: He thinks that the sublime essence of the Guru's song is useless, and he does not like to hear it. He loses the profound, unfathomable Lord.

930.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਹਿਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਲਹਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਸੁਖਾਇਆ ॥
930.t: gur sach kahiaa a(n)mrit lahiaa man tan saach sukhaiaa ||
930.e: Through the Guru's Words of Truth, the Ambrosial Nectar is obtained, and the mind and body find joy in the True Lord.

930.g: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਇਆ ॥੪॥
930.t: aape gurmukh aape dhevai aape a(n)mrit peeaaiaa ||4||
930.e: He Himself is the Gurmukh, and He Himself bestows the Ambrosial Nectar; He Himself leads us to drink it in. ||4||

930.g: ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਵਿਆਪੈ ॥
930.t: eko ek kahai sabh koiee haumai garab viaapai ||
930.e: Everyone says that God is the One and only, but they are engrossed in egotism and pride.

930.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਇਉ ਘਰੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਸਿਞਾਪੈ ॥
930.t: a(n)tar baahar ek pachhaanai iau ghar mahal sin(j)aapai ||
930.e: Realize that the One God is inside and outside; understand this, that the Mansion of His Presence is within the home of your heart.

930.g: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਹਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਏਕੋ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਬਾਈ ॥
930.t: prabh neRai har dhoor na jaanahu eko sirasaT sabaiee ||
930.e: God is near at hand; do not think that God is far away. The One Lord permeates the entire universe.

930.g: ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੁ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੫॥
930.t: eka(n)kaar avar nahee dhoojaa naanak ek samaiee ||5||
930.e: There in One Universal Creator Lord; there is no other at all. O Nanak, merge into the One Lord. ||5||

930.g: ਇਸੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਉ ਕਿਉ ਗਹਿ ਰਾਖਉ ਅਫਰਿਓ ਤੁਲਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
930.t: eis karate kau kiau geh raakhau afario tulio na jaiee ||
930.e: How can you keep the Creator under your control? He cannot be seized or measured.

930.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਦੇਵਾਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਝੂਠਿ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
930.t: maiaa ke dhevaane praanee jhooTh Thagauree paiee ||
930.e: Maya has made the mortal insane; she has administered the poisonous drug of falsehood.

930.g: ਲਬਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਮੁਹਤਾਜਿ ਵਿਗੂਤੇ ਇਬ ਤਬ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਈ ॥
930.t: lab lobh muhataaj vigoote ib tab fir pachhutaiee ||
930.e: Addicted to greed and avarice, the mortal is ruined, and then later, he regrets and repents.

930.g: ਏਕੁ ਸਰੇਵੈ ਤਾ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਰਹਾਈ ॥੬॥
930.t: ek sarevai taa gat mit paavai aavan jaan rahaiee ||6||
930.e: So serve the One Lord, and attain the state of Salvation; your comings and goings shall cease. ||6||
The One Lord is in all actions, colors and forms.
He manifests in many shapes through wind, water and fire.
The One Soul wanders through the three worlds.
One who understands and comprehends the One Lord is honored.
One who gathers in spiritual wisdom and meditation, dwells in the state of balance.
How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, attain the One Lord.

930.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
930.t: jis no dhei kirapaa te sukh paae ||
930.e: They alone find peace, whom the Lord blesses with His Grace.
In the Gurdwara, the Guru's Door, they speak and hear of the Lord. ||7||
His Light illuminates the ocean and the earth.
Throughout the three worlds, is the Guru, the Lord of the World.
The Lord reveals His various forms;
granting His Grace, He enters the home of the heart.
The clouds hang low, and the rain is pouring down.
The Lord embellishes and exalts with the Sublime Word of the Shabad.
One who knows the mystery of the One God,
is Himself the Creator, Himself the Divine Lord. ||8||
When the sun rises, the demons are slain;
the mortal looks upwards, and contemplates the Shabad.
The Lord is beyond the beginning and the end, beyond the three worlds.
He Himself acts, speaks and listens.

931.e: He is the Architect of Destiny; He blesses us with mind and body.
That Architect of Destiny is in my mind and mouth.
God is the Life of the world; there is no other at all.
O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one is honored. ||9||
One who lovingly chants the Name of the Sovereign Lord King,
fights the battle and conquers his own mind;
day and night, he remains imbued with the Lord's Love.
He is famous throughout the three worlds and the four ages.

931.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਜੇਹਾ ॥
931.t: jin jaataa so tis hee jehaa ||
931.e: One who knows the Lord, becomes like Him.
He becomes absolutely immaculate, and his body is sanctified.
His heart is happy, in love with the One Lord.
He lovingly centers his attention deep within upon the True Word of the Shabad. ||10||

931.g: ਰੋਸੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ਰਹਣੁ ਨਹੀ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
931.t: ros na keejai a(n)mrit peejai rahan nahee sa(n)saare ||
931.e: Don't be angry - drink in the Ambrosial Nectar; you shall not remain in this world forever.

931.g: ਰਾਜੇ ਰਾਇ ਰੰਕ ਨਹੀ ਰਹਣਾ ਆਇ ਜਾਇ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
931.t: raaje rai ra(n)k nahee rahanaa aai jai jug chaare ||
931.e: The ruling kings and the paupers shall not remain; they come and go, throughout the four ages.

931.g: ਰਹਣ ਕਹਣ ਤੇ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਉ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ॥
931.t: rahan kahan te rahai na koiee kis peh karau bina(n)tee ||
931.e: Everyone says that they will remain, but none of them remain; unto whom should I offer my prayer?

931.g: ਏਕੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਰੋਧਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਮਤੀ ॥੧੧॥
931.t: ek sabadh raam naam nirodhar gur dhevai pat matee ||11||
931.e: The One Shabad, the Name of the Lord, will never fail you; the Guru grants honor and understanding. ||11||

931.g: ਲਾਜ ਮਰੰਤੀ ਮਰਿ ਗਈ ਘੂਘਟੁ ਖੋਲਿ ਚਲੀ ॥
931.t: laaj mara(n)tee mar giee ghooghaT khol chalee ||
931.e: My shyness and hesitation have died and gone, and I walk with my face unveiled.

931.g: ਸਾਸੁ ਦਿਵਾਨੀ ਬਾਵਰੀ ਸਿਰ ਤੇ ਸੰਕ ਟਲੀ ॥
931.t: saas dhivaanee baavaree sir te sa(n)k Talee ||
931.e: The confusion and doubt from my crazy, insane mother-in-law has been removed from over my head.

931.g: ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਬੁਲਾਈ ਰਲੀ ਸਿਉ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥
931.t: prem bulaiee ralee siau man meh sabadh ana(n)dh ||
931.e: My Beloved has summoned me with joyful caresses; my mind is filled with the bliss of the Shabad.

931.g: ਲਾਲਿ ਰਤੀ ਲਾਲੀ ਭਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਈ ਨਿਚਿੰਦੁ ॥੧੨॥
931.t: laal ratee laalee bhiee gurmukh bhiee nichi(n)dh ||12||
931.e: Imbued with the Love of my Beloved, I have become Gurmukh, and carefree. ||12||
Chant the jewel of the Naam, and earn the profit of the Lord.
Greed, avarice, evil and egotism;
slander, inuendo and gossip;
the self-willed manmukh is blind, foolish and ignorant.
For the sake of earning the profit of the Lord, the mortal comes into the world.
But he becomes a mere slave laborer, and is mugged by the mugger, Maya.
One who earns the profit of the Naam, with the capital of faith,
O Nanak, is truly honored by the True Supreme King. ||13||
The world is ruined on the path of Death.
No one has the power to erase Maya's influence.
If wealth visits the home of the lowliest clown,
seeing that wealth, all pay their respects to him.
Even an idiot is thought of as clever, if he is rich.
Without devotional worship, the world is insane.
The One Lord is contained among all.

931.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧੪॥
931.t: jis no kirapaa kare tis paragaT hoi ||14||
931.e: He reveals Himself, unto those whom He blesses with His Grace. ||14||
Throughout the ages, the Lord is eternally established; He has no vengeance.
He is not subject to birth and death; He is not entangled in worldly affairs.
Whatever is seen, is the Lord Himself.
Creating Himself, He establishes Himself in the heart.
He Himself is unfathomable; He links people to their affairs.
He is the Way of Yoga, the Life of the World.
Living a righteous lifestyle, true peace is found.
Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, how can anyone find liberation? ||15||
Without the Name, even one's own body is an enemy.

931.g: ਕਿਉ ਨ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਕਾਟਹਿ ਮਨ ਪੀਰ ॥
931.t: kiau na mileh kaaTeh man peer ||
931.e: Why not meet the Lord, and take away the pain of your mind?
The traveller comes and goes along the highway.

931.g: ਕਿਆ ਲੇ ਆਇਆ ਕਿਆ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
931.t: kiaa le aaiaa kiaa palai pai ||
931.e: What did he bring when he came, and what will he take away when he goes?
Without the Name, one loses everywhere.
The profit is earned, when the Lord grants understanding.
In merchandise and trade, the merchant is trading.
Without the Name, how can one find honor and nobility? ||16||
One who contemplates the Lord's Virtues is spiritually wise.
Through His Virtues, one receives spiritual wisdom.
How rare in this world, is the Giver of virtue.
The True way of life comes through contemplation of the Guru.
The Lord is inaccessible and unfathomable. His worth cannot be estimated.

932.e: They alone meet Him, whom the Lord causes to meet.
The virtuous soul bride continually contemplates His Virtues.
O Nanak, following the Guru's Teachings, one meets the Lord, the true friend. ||17||
Unfulfilled sexual desire and unresolved anger waste the body away,
as gold is dissolved by borax.
The gold is touched to the touchstone, and tested by fire;
when its pure color shows through, it is pleasing to the eye of the assayer.
The world is a beast, and arrogent Death is the butcher.
The created beings of the Creator receive the karma of their actions.
He who created the world, knows its worth.

932.g: ਹੋਰ ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੮॥
932.t: hor kiaa kaheeaai kichh kahan na jaiee ||18||
932.e: What else can be said? There is nothing at all to say. ||18||
Searching, searching, I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar.
I have adopted the way of tolerance, and given my mind to the True Guru.
Everyone calls himself true and genuine.
He alone is true, who obtains the jewel throughout the four ages.
Eating and drinking, one dies, but still does not know.

932.g: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਮੂਏ ਜਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥
932.t: khin meh mooe jaa sabadh pachhaaniaa ||
932.e: He dies in an instant, when he realizes the Word of the Shabad.
His consciousness becomes permanently stable, and his mind accepts death.
By Guru's Grace, he realizes the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||19||
The Profound Lord dwells in the sky of the mind, the Tenth Gate;
singing His Glorious Praises, one dwells in intuitive poise and peace.

932.g: ਗਇਆ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਆਇ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
932.t: giaa na aavai aai na jai ||
932.e: He does not go to come, or come to go.
By Guru's Grace, he remains lovingly focused on the Lord.
The Lord of the mind-sky is inaccessible, independent and beyond birth.
The most worthy Samaadhi is to keep the consciousness stable, focused on Him.

932.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੇਤਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਵਹਿ ਨ ਜੂਨੀ ॥
932.t: har naam chet fir paveh na joonee ||
932.e: Remembering the Lord's Name, one is not subject to reincarnation.
The Guru's Teachings are the most Excellent; all other ways lack the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||20||
Wandering to countless doorsteps and homes, I have grown weary.
My incarnations are countless, without limit.
I have had so many mothers and fathers, sons and daughters.
I have had so many gurus and disciples.

932.g: ਕਾਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੂਆ ॥
932.t: kaache gur te mukat na hooaa ||
932.e: Through a false guru, liberation is not found.
There are so many brides of the One Husband Lord - consider this.
The Gurmukh dies, and lives with God.

932.g: ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਢੂਢਿ ਘਰੈ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
932.t: dheh dhis ddoodd gharai meh paiaa ||
932.e: Searching in the ten directions, I found Him within my own home.
I have met Him; the True Guru has led me to meet Him. ||21||
The Gurmukh sings, and the Gurmukh speaks.
The Gurmukh evaluates the value of the Lord, and inspires others to evaluate Him as well.
The Gurmukh comes and goes without fear.
His filth is taken away, and his stains are burnt off.
The Gurmukh contemplates the sound current of the Naad for his Vedas.
The Gurmukh's cleansing bath is the performance of good deeds.
For the Gurmukh, the Shabad is the most excellent Ambrosial Nectar.
O Nanak, the Gurmukh crosses over. ||22||
The fickle consciousness does not remain stable.
The deer secretly nibbles at the green sprouts.
One who enshrines the Lord's lotus feet in his heart and consciousness
lives long, always remembering the Lord.
Everyone has worries and cares.
He alone finds peace, who thinks of the One Lord.
When the Lord dwells in the consciousness, and one is absorbed in the Lord's Name,

932.g: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਇਆ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੨੩॥
932.t: mukat bhiaa pat siau ghar jai ||23||
932.e: one is liberated, and returns home with honor. ||23||
The body falls apart, when one knot is untied.
Behold, the world is on the decline; it will be totally destroyed.

932.g: ਧੂਪ ਛਾਵ ਜੇ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
932.t: dhoop chhaav je sam kar jaanai ||
932.e: Only one who looks alike upon sunshine and shade
has his bonds shattered; he is liberated and returns home.
Maya is empty and petty; she has defrauded the world.
Such destiny is pre-ordained by past actions.
Youth is wasting away; old age and death hover above the head.

933.e: The body falls apart, like algae upon the water. ||24||
God Himself appears throughout the three worlds.

933.g: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
933.t: jug jug dhaataa avar na koi ||
933.e: Throughout the ages, He is the Great Giver; there is no other at all.
As it pleases You, You protect and preserve us.
I ask for the Lord's Praises, which bless me with honor and credit.
Remaining awake and aware, I am pleasing to You, O Lord.

933.g: ਜਾ ਤੂ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਤਾ ਤੁਝੈ ਸਮਾਵਾ ॥
933.t: jaa too meleh taa tujhai samaavaa ||
933.e: When You unite me with Yourself, then I am merged in You.
I chant Your Victorious Praises, O Life of the World.
Accepting the Guru's Teachings, one is sure to merge in the One Lord. ||25||

933.g: ਝਖਿ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਕਿਆ ਜਗ ਸਿਉ ਵਾਦੁ ॥
933.t: jhakh bolan kiaa jag siau vaadh ||
933.e: Why do you speak such nonsense, and argue with the world?
You shall die repenting, when you see your own insanity.
He is born, only to die, but he does not wish to live.
He comes hopeful, and then goes, without hope.

933.g: ਝੁਰਿ ਝੁਰਿ ਝਖਿ ਮਾਟੀ ਰਲਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
933.t: jhur jhur jhakh maaTee ral jai ||
933.e: Regretting, repenting and grieving, he is dust mixing with dust.

933.g: ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਚਾਂਪੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
933.t: kaal na chaa(n)pai har gun gai ||
933.e: Death does not chew up one who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

933.g: ਪਾਈ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ॥
933.t: paiee nav nidh har kai nai ||
933.e: The nine treasures are obtained through the Name of the Lord;
the Lord bestows intuitive peace and poise. ||26||
He speaks spiritual wisdom, and He Himself understands it.
He Himself knows it, and He Himself comprehends it.
One who takes the Words of the Guru into his very fiber,
is immaculate and holy, and is pleasing to the True Lord.
In the ocean of the Guru, there is no shortage of pearls.
The treasure of jewels is truly inexhaustible.
Do those deeds which the Guru has ordained.
Why are you chasing after the Guru's actions?
O Nanak, through the Guru's Teachings, merge in the True Lord. ||27||
Love is broken, when one speaks in defiance.
The arm is broken, when it is pulled from both sides.
Love breaks, when the speech goes sour.
The Husband Lord abandons and leaves behind the evil-minded bride.
The broken knot is tied again, through contemplation and meditation.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one's affairs are resolved in one's own home.
One who earns the profit of the True Name, will not lose it again;
the Lord and Master of the three worlds is your best friend. ||28||
Control your mind, and keep it in its place.
The world is destroyed by conflict, regretting its sinful mistakes.
There is one Husband Lord, and all are His brides.
The false bride wears many costumes.
He stops her from going into the homes of others;
He summons her to the Mansion of His Presence, and no obstacles block her path.
She is embellished with the Word of the Shabad, and is loved by the True Lord.
She is the happy soul bride, who takes the Support of her Lord and Master. ||29||

933.g: ਡੋਲਤ ਡੋਲਤ ਹੇ ਸਖੀ ਫਾਟੇ ਚੀਰ ਸੀਗਾਰ ॥
933.t: ddolat ddolat he sakhee faaTe cheer seegaar ||
933.e: Wandering and roaming around, O my companion, your beautiful robes are torn.

933.g: ਡਾਹਪਣਿ ਤਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਡਰ ਬਿਣਠੀ ਡਾਰ ॥
933.t: ddaahapan tan sukh nahee bin ddar binaThee ddaar ||
933.e: In jealousy, the body is not at peace; without the Fear of God, multitudes are ruined.

933.g: ਡਰਪਿ ਮੁਈ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਡੀਠੀ ਕੰਤਿ ਸੁਜਾਣਿ ॥
933.t: ddarap muiee ghar aapanai ddeeThee ka(n)t sujaan ||
933.e: One who remains dead within her own home, through the Fear of God, is looked upon with favor by her all-knowing Husband Lord.

933.g: ਡਰੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣਿ ॥
933.t: ddar raakhiaa gur aapanai nirabhau naam vakhaan ||
933.e: She maintains fear of her Guru, and chants the Name of the Fearless Lord.

933.g: ਡੂਗਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਤਿਖਾ ਘਣੀ ਜਬ ਦੇਖਾ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
933.t: ddoogar vaas tikhaa ghanee jab dhekhaa nahee dhoor ||
933.e: Living on the mountain, I suffer such great thirst; when I see Him, I know that He is not far away.

933.g: ਤਿਖਾ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
933.t: tikhaa nivaaree sabadh ma(n)n a(n)mrit peeaa bharapoor ||
933.e: My thirst is quenched, and I have accepted the Word of the Shabad. I drink my fill of the Ambrosial Nectar.

933.g: ਦੇਹਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਆਖੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥
933.t: dheh dheh aakhai sabh koiee jai bhaavai tai dhei ||
933.e: Everyone says, ""Give! Give!"" As He pleases, He gives.

933.g: ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਦੇਵਸੀ ਤਿਖਾ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੩੦॥
933.t: guroo dhuaarai dhevasee tikhaa nivaarai soi ||30||
933.e: Through the Gurdwara, the Guru's Door, He gives, and quenches the thirst. ||30||

933.g: ਢੰਢੋਲਤ ਢੂਢਤ ਹਉ ਫਿਰੀ ਢਹਿ ਢਹਿ ਪਵਨਿ ਕਰਾਰਿ ॥
933.t: dda(n)ddolat ddooddat hau firee ddeh ddeh pavan karaar ||
933.e: Searching and seeking, I fell down and collapsed upon the bank of the river of life.

933.g: ਭਾਰੇ ਢਹਤੇ ਢਹਿ ਪਏ ਹਉਲੇ ਨਿਕਸੇ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
933.t: bhaare ddahate ddeh pe haule nikase paar ||
933.e: Those who are heavy with sin sink down, but those who are light swim across.

933.g: ਅਮਰ ਅਜਾਚੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
933.t: amar ajaachee har mile tin kai hau bal jaau ||
933.e: I am a sacrifice to those who meet the immortal and immeasurable Lord.

933.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਧੂੜਿ ਅਘੁਲੀਐ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥
933.t: tin kee dhooR aghuleeaai sa(n)gat mel milaau ||
933.e: The dust of their feet brings emancipation; in their company, we are united in the Lord's Union.

933.g: ਮਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਉ ॥
933.t: man dheeaa gur aapanai paiaa niramal naau ||
933.e: I gave my mind to my Guru, and received the Immaculate Name.

934.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਵਸਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
934.t: jin naam dheeaa tis sevasaa tis balihaarai jaau ||
934.e: I serve the One who gave me the Naam; I am a sacrifice to Him.

934.g: ਜੋ ਉਸਾਰੇ ਸੋ ਢਾਹਸੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
934.t: jo usaare so ddaahasee tis bin avar na koi ||
934.e: He who builds, also demolishes; there is no other than Him.

934.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਮੑਲਾ ਤਾ ਤਨਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੩੧॥
934.t: gur parasaadhee tis sa(n)m(h)laa taa tan dhookh na hoi ||31||
934.e: By Guru's Grace, I contemplate Him, and then my body does not suffer in pain. ||31||

934.g: ਣਾ ਕੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਿਸੁ ਗਹੀ ਣਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਆ ਨ ਹੋਗੁ ॥
934.t: naa ko meraa kis gahee naa ko hoaa na hog ||
934.e: No one is mine - whose gown should I grasp and hold? No one ever was, and no one shall ever be mine.

934.g: ਆਵਣਿ ਜਾਣਿ ਵਿਗੁਚੀਐ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
934.t: aavan jaan vigucheeaai dhubidhaa viaapai rog ||
934.e: Coming and going, one is ruined, afflicted with the disease of dual-mindedness.

934.g: ਣਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੇ ਆਦਮੀ ਕਲਰ ਕੰਧ ਗਿਰੰਤਿ ॥
934.t: naam vihoone aadhamee kalar ka(n)dh gira(n)t ||
934.e: Those beings who lack the Naam, the Name of the Lord, collapse like pillars of salt.

934.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਉ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਜਾਇ ਰਸਾਤਲਿ ਅੰਤਿ ॥
934.t: vin naavai kiau chhooTeeaai jai rasaatal a(n)t ||
934.e: Without the Name, how can they find release? They fall into hell in the end.

934.g: ਗਣਤ ਗਣਾਵੈ ਅਖਰੀ ਅਗਣਤੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
934.t: ganat ganaavai akharee aganat saachaa soi ||
934.e: Using a limited number of words, we describe the unlimited True Lord.

934.g: ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਮਤਿਹੀਣੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
934.t: agiaanee matiheen hai gur bin giaan na hoi ||
934.e: The ignorant lack understanding. Without the Guru, there is no spiritual wisdom.

934.g: ਤੂਟੀ ਤੰਤੁ ਰਬਾਬ ਕੀ ਵਾਜੈ ਨਹੀ ਵਿਜੋਗਿ ॥
934.t: tooTee ta(n)t rabaab kee vaajai nahee vijog ||
934.e: The separated soul is like the broken string of a guitar, which does not vibrate its sound.

934.g: ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਮੇਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥੩੨॥
934.t: vichhuRiaa melai prabhoo naanak kar sa(n)jog ||32||
934.e: God unites the separated souls with Himself, awakening their destiny. ||32||

934.g: ਤਰਵਰੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਪੰਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਰਵਰਿ ਪੰਖੀ ਪੰਚ ॥
934.t: taravar kaiaa pa(n)kh man taravar pa(n)khee pa(n)ch ||
934.e: The body is the tree, and the mind is the bird; the birds in the tree are the five senses.

934.g: ਤਤੁ ਚੁਗਹਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਏਕਸੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਫਾਸ ਨ ਰੰਚ ॥
934.t: tat chugeh mil ekase tin kau faas na ra(n)ch ||
934.e: They peck at the essence of reality, and merge with the One Lord. They are never trapped at all.

934.g: ਉਡਹਿ ਤ ਬੇਗੁਲ ਬੇਗੁਲੇ ਤਾਕਹਿ ਚੋਗ ਘਣੀ ॥
934.t: auddeh ta begul begule taakeh chog ghanee ||
934.e: But the others fly away in a hurry, when they see the food.

934.g: ਪੰਖ ਤੁਟੇ ਫਾਹੀ ਪੜੀ ਅਵਗੁਣਿ ਭੀੜ ਬਣੀ ॥
934.t: pa(n)kh tuTe faahee paRee avagun bheeR banee ||
934.e: Their feathers are clipped, and they are caught in the noose; through their mistakes, they are caught in disaster.

934.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਕਿਉ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਕਰਮਿ ਮਣੀ ॥
934.t: bin saache kiau chhooTeeaai har gun karam manee ||
934.e: Without the True Lord, how can anyone find release? The jewel of the Lord's Glorious Praises comes by the karma of good actions.

934.g: ਆਪਿ ਛਡਾਏ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਵਡਾ ਆਪਿ ਧਣੀ ॥
934.t: aap chhaddaae chhooTeeaai vaddaa aap dhanee ||
934.e: When He Himself releases them, only then are they released. He Himself is the Great Master.

934.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
934.t: gur parasaadhee chhooTeeaai kirapaa aap karei ||
934.e: By Guru's Grace, they are released, when He Himself grants His Grace.

934.g: ਅਪਣੈ ਹਾਥਿ ਵਡਾਈਆ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥੩੩॥
934.t: apanai haath vaddaieeaa jai bhaavai tai dhei ||33||
934.e: Glorious greatness rests in His Hands. He blesses those with whom He is pleased. ||33||

934.g: ਥਰ ਥਰ ਕੰਪੈ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਥਾਨ ਵਿਹੂਣਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
934.t: thar thar ka(n)pai jeeaRaa thaan vihoonaa hoi ||
934.e: The soul trembles and shakes, when it loses its mooring and support.

934.g: ਥਾਨਿ ਮਾਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਕਾਜੁ ਨ ਫੀਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
934.t: thaan maan sach ek hai kaaj na feeTai koi ||
934.e: Only the support of the True Lord brings honor and glory. Through it, one's works are never in vain.

934.g: ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਥਿਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
934.t: thir naarain thir guroo thir saachaa beechaar ||
934.e: The Lord is eternal and forever stable; the Guru is stable, and contemplation upon the True Lord is stable.

934.g: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਨਾਥਹ ਨਾਥੁ ਤੂ ਨਿਧਾਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
934.t: sur nar naatheh naath too nidhaaraa aadhaar ||
934.e: O Lord and Master of angels, men and Yogic masters, You are the support of the unsupported.

934.g: ਸਰਬੇ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰੀ ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
934.t: sarabe thaan thana(n)taree too dhaataa dhaataar ||
934.e: In all places and interspaces, You are the Giver, the Great Giver.

934.g: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਏਕੁ ਤੂ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
934.t: jeh dhekhaa teh ek too a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
934.e: Wherever I look, there I see You, Lord; You have no end or limitation.

934.g: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
934.t: thaan thana(n)tar rav rahiaa gur sabadhee veechaar ||
934.e: You are pervading and permeating the places and interspaces; reflecting upon the Word of the Guru's Shabad, You are found.

934.g: ਅਣਮੰਗਿਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵਸੀ ਵਡਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੩੪॥
934.t: anama(n)giaa dhaan dhevasee vaddaa agam apaar ||34||
934.e: You give gifts even when they are not asked for; You are great, inaccessible and infinite. ||34||

934.g: ਦਇਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤੂ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
934.t: dhiaa dhaan dhiaal too kar kar dhekhanahaar ||
934.e: O Merciful Lord, You are the embodiment of mercy; creating the Creation, You behold it.

934.g: ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਢਾਹਿ ਉਸਾਰਿ ॥
934.t: dhiaa kareh prabh mel laih khin meh ddaeh usaar ||
934.e: Please shower Your Mercy upon me, O God, and unite me with Yourself. In an instant, You destroy and rebuild.

934.g: ਦਾਨਾ ਤੂ ਬੀਨਾ ਤੁਹੀ ਦਾਨਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
934.t: dhaanaa too beenaa tuhee dhaanaa kai sir dhaan ||
934.e: You are all-wise and all-seeing; You are the Greatest Giver of all givers.

934.g: ਦਾਲਦ ਭੰਜਨ ਦੁਖ ਦਲਣ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੩੫॥
934.t: dhaaladh bha(n)jan dhukh dhalan gurmukh giaan dhiaan ||35||
934.e: He is the Eradicator of poverty, and the Destroyer of pain; the Gurmukh realizes spiritual wisdom and meditation. ||35||

934.g: ਧਨਿ ਗਇਐ ਬਹਿ ਝੂਰੀਐ ਧਨ ਮਹਿ ਚੀਤੁ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
934.t: dhan giaai beh jhooreeaai dhan meh cheet gavaar ||
934.e: Losing his wealth, he cries out in anguish; the fool's consciousness is engrossed in wealth.

934.g: ਧਨੁ ਵਿਰਲੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
934.t: dhan viralee sach sa(n)chiaa niramal naam piaar ||
934.e: How rare are those who gather the wealth of Truth, and love the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord.

934.g: ਧਨੁ ਗਇਆ ਤਾ ਜਾਣ ਦੇਹਿ ਜੇ ਰਾਚਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਏਕ ॥
934.t: dhan giaa taa jaan dheh je raacheh ra(n)g ek ||
934.e: If by losing your wealth, you may become absorbed in the Love of the One Lord, then just let it go.

934.g: ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਸਿਰੁ ਸਉਪੀਐ ਭੀ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ॥
934.t: man dheejai sir saupeeaai bhee karate kee Tek ||
934.e: Dedicate your mind, and surrender your head; seek only the Support of the Creator Lord.

934.g: ਧੰਧਾ ਧਾਵਤ ਰਹਿ ਗਏ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥
934.t: dha(n)dhaa dhaavat reh ge man meh sabadh ana(n)dh ||
934.e: Worldly affairs and wanderings cease, when the mind is filled with the bliss of the Shabad.

934.g: ਦੁਰਜਨ ਤੇ ਸਾਜਨ ਭਏ ਭੇਟੇ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ॥
934.t: dhurajan te saajan bhe bheTe gur govi(n)dh ||
934.e: Even one's enemies become friends, meeting with the Guru, the Lord of the Universe.

934.g: ਬਨੁ ਬਨੁ ਫਿਰਤੀ ਢੂਢਤੀ ਬਸਤੁ ਰਹੀ ਘਰਿ ਬਾਰਿ ॥
934.t: ban ban firatee ddooddatee basat rahee ghar baar ||
934.e: Wandering from forest to forest searching, you will find that those things are within the home of your own heart.

934.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥੩੬॥
934.t: satigur melee mil rahee janam maran dhukh nivaar ||36||
934.e: United by the True Guru, you shall remain united, and the pains of birth and death will be ended. ||36||

934.g: ਨਾਨਾ ਕਰਤ ਨ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਣ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
934.t: naanaa karat na chhooTeeaai vin gun jam pur jaeh ||
934.e: Through various rituals, one does not find release. Without virtue, one is sent to the City of Death.

934.g: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਏਹੁ ਨ ਓਹੁ ਹੈ ਅਵਗੁਣਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਹਿ ॥
934.t: naa tis eh na oh hai avagun fir pachhutaeh ||
934.e: One will not have this world or the next; committing sinful mistakes, one comes to regret and repent in the end.

935.g: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਹੈ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
935.t: naa tis giaan na dhiaan hai naa tis dharam dhiaan ||
935.e: He has neither spiritual wisdom or meditation; neither Dharmic faith nor meditation.

935.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕਹਾ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਣਾ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
935.t: vin naavai nirabhau kahaa kiaa jaanaa abhimaan ||
935.e: Without the Name, how can one be fearless? How can he understand egotistical pride?

935.g: ਥਾਕਿ ਰਹੀ ਕਿਵ ਅਪੜਾ ਹਾਥ ਨਹੀ ਨਾ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
935.t: thaak rahee kiv apaRaa haath nahee naa paar ||
935.e: I am so tired - how can I get there? This ocean has no bottom or end.

935.g: ਨਾ ਸਾਜਨ ਸੇ ਰੰਗੁਲੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਕਰੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
935.t: naa saajan se ra(n)gule kis peh karee pukaar ||
935.e: I have no loving companions, whom I can ask for help.

935.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਜੇ ਕਰੀ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
935.t: naanak priau priau je karee mele melanahaar ||
935.e: O Nanak, crying out, ""Beloved, Beloved"", we are united with the Uniter.

935.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਛੋੜੀ ਸੋ ਮੇਲਸੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥੩੭॥
935.t: jin vichhoRee so melasee gur kai het apaar ||37||
935.e: He who separated me, unites me again; my love for the Guru is infinite. ||37||

935.g: ਪਾਪੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਪਾਪੀ ਕਉ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
935.t: paap buraa paapee kau piaaraa ||
935.e: Sin is bad, but it is dear to the sinner.

935.g: ਪਾਪਿ ਲਦੇ ਪਾਪੇ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
935.t: paap ladhe paape paasaaraa ||
935.e: He loads himself with sin, and expands his world through sin.

935.g: ਪਰਹਰਿ ਪਾਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਆਪੁ ॥
935.t: parahar paap pachhaanai aap ||
935.e: Sin is far away from one who understands himself.

935.g: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ॥
935.t: naa tis sog vijog sa(n)taap ||
935.e: He is not afflicted by sorrow or separation.

935.g: ਨਰਕਿ ਪੜੰਤਉ ਕਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਕਿਉ ਬੰਚੈ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ॥
935.t: narak paRa(n)tau kiau rahai kiau ba(n)chai jamakaal ||
935.e: How can one avoid falling into hell? How can he cheat the Messenger of Death?

935.g: ਕਿਉ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਝੂਠੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਖੈ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
935.t: kiau aavan jaanaa veesarai jhooTh buraa khai kaal ||
935.e: How can coming and going be forgotten? Falsehood is bad, and death is cruel.

935.g: ਮਨੁ ਜੰਜਾਲੀ ਵੇੜਿਆ ਭੀ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
935.t: man ja(n)jaalee veRiaa bhee ja(n)jaalaa maeh ||
935.e: The mind is enveloped by entanglements, and into entanglements it falls.

935.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਉ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਪਾਪੇ ਪਚਹਿ ਪਚਾਹਿ ॥੩੮॥
935.t: vin naavai kiau chhooTeeaai paape pacheh pachaeh ||38||
935.e: Without the Name, how can anyone be saved? They rot away in sin. ||38||

935.g: ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਾਹੀ ਫਾਸੈ ਕਊਆ ॥
935.t: fir fir faahee faasai kuooaa ||
935.e: Again and again, the crow falls into the trap.

935.g: ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਨਾ ਅਬ ਕਿਆ ਹੂਆ ॥
935.t: fir pachhutaanaa ab kiaa hooaa ||
935.e: Then he regrets it, but what can he do now?

935.g: ਫਾਥਾ ਚੋਗ ਚੁਗੈ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
935.t: faathaa chog chugai nahee boojhai ||
935.e: Even though he is trapped, he pecks at the food; he does not understand.

935.g: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਆਖੀ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
935.t: satagur milai ta aakhee soojhai ||
935.e: If he meets the True Guru, then he sees with his eyes.

935.g: ਜਿਉ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਫਾਥੀ ਜਮ ਜਾਲਿ ॥
935.t: jiau machhulee faathee jam jaal ||
935.e: Like a fish, he is caught in the noose of death.

935.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਦਾਤੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
935.t: vin gur dhaate mukat na bhaal ||
935.e: Do not seek liberation from anyone else, except the Guru, the Great Giver.

935.g: ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
935.t: fir fir aavai fir fir jai ||
935.e: Over and over again, he comes; over and over again, he goes.

935.g: ਇਕ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਚੈ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
935.t: eik ra(n)g rachai rahai liv lai ||
935.e: Be absorbed in love for the One Lord, and remain lovingly focused on Him.

935.g: ਇਵ ਛੂਟੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਾਸ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੩੯॥
935.t: eiv chhooTai fir faas na pai ||39||
935.e: In this way you shall be saved, and you shall not fall into the trap again. ||39||

935.g: ਬੀਰਾ ਬੀਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੀ ਬੀਰ ਭਏ ਬੈਰਾਇ ॥
935.t: beeraa beeraa kar rahee beer bhe bairai ||
935.e: She calls out, ""Brother, O brother - stay, O brother!"" But he becomes a stranger.

935.g: ਬੀਰ ਚਲੇ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਬਹਿਣ ਬਿਰਹਿ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
935.t: beer chale ghar aapanai bahin bireh jal jai ||
935.e: Her brother departs for his own home, and his sister burns with the pain of separation.

935.g: ਬਾਬੁਲ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਬੇਟੜੀ ਬਾਲੀ ਬਾਲੈ ਨੇਹਿ ॥
935.t: baabul kai ghar beTaRee baalee baalai neh ||
935.e: In this world, her father's home, the daughter, the innocent soul bride, loves her Young Husband Lord.

935.g: ਜੇ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਵਰੁ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤੇਹਿ ॥
935.t: je loReh var kaamanee satigur seveh teh ||
935.e: If you long for your Husband Lord, O soul bride, then serve the True Guru with love.

935.g: ਬਿਰਲੋ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਬੂਝਣਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਮਿਲੇਇ ॥
935.t: biralo giaanee boojhanau satigur saach milei ||
935.e: How rare are the spiritually wise, who meet the True Guru, and truly understand.

935.g: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਾਥਿ ਵਡਾਈਆ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥
935.t: Thaakur haath vaddaieeaa jai bhaavai tai dhei ||
935.e: All glorious greatness rests in the Lord and Master's Hands. He grants them, when He is pleased.

935.g: ਬਾਣੀ ਬਿਰਲਉ ਬੀਚਾਰਸੀ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
935.t: baanee biralau beechaarasee je ko gurmukh hoi ||
935.e: How rare are those who contemplate the Word of the Guru's Bani; they become Gurmukh.

935.g: ਇਹ ਬਾਣੀ ਮਹਾ ਪੁਰਖ ਕੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੪੦॥
935.t: eeh baanee mahaa purakh kee nij ghar vaasaa hoi ||40||
935.e: This is the Bani of the Supreme Being; through it, one dwells within the home of his inner being. ||40||

935.g: ਭਨਿ ਭਨਿ ਘੜੀਐ ਘੜਿ ਘੜਿ ਭਜੈ ਢਾਹਿ ਉਸਾਰੈ ਉਸਰੇ ਢਾਹੈ ॥
935.t: bhan bhan ghaReeaai ghaR ghaR bhajai ddaeh usaarai usare ddaahai ||
935.e: Shattering and breaking apart, He creates and re-creates; creating, He shatters again. He builds up what He has demolished, and demolishes what He has built.

935.g: ਸਰ ਭਰਿ ਸੋਖੈ ਭੀ ਭਰਿ ਪੋਖੈ ਸਮਰਥ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੈ ॥
935.t: sar bhar sokhai bhee bhar pokhai samarath veparavaahai ||
935.e: He dries up the pools which are full, and fills the dried tanks again. He is all-powerful and independent.

935.g: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਨੇ ਭਏ ਦਿਵਾਨੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਕਿਆ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
935.t: bharam bhulaane bhe dhivaane vin bhaagaa kiaa paieeaai ||
935.e: Deluded by doubt, they have gone insane; without destiny, what do they obtain?

935.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਡੋਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪਕੜੀ ਜਿਨ ਖਿੰਚੈ ਤਿਨ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
935.t: gurmukh giaan ddoree prabh pakaRee jin khi(n)chai tin jaieeaai ||
935.e: The Gurmukhs know that God holds the string; wherever He pulls it, they must go.

935.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਈਐ ॥
935.t: har gun gai sadhaa ra(n)g raate bahuR na pachhotaieeaai ||
935.e: Those who sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, are forever imbued with His Love; they never again feel regret.

935.g: ਭਭੈ ਭਾਲਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਤਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
935.t: bhabhai bhaaleh gurmukh boojheh taa nij ghar vaasaa paieeaai ||
935.e: Bhabha: If someone seeks, and then becomes Gurmukh, then he comes to dwell in the home of his own heart.

935.g: ਭਭੈ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਵਿਖੜਾ ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ਤਰੀਐ ॥
935.t: bhabhai bhaujal maarag vikhaRaa aas niraasaa tareeaai ||
935.e: Bhabha: The way of the terrifying world-ocean is treacherous. Remain free of hope, in the midst of hope, and you shall cross over.

935.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਆਪੋ ਚੀਨੑੈ ਜੀਵਤਿਆ ਇਵ ਮਰੀਐ ॥੪੧॥
935.t: gur parasaadhee aapo cheen(h)ai jeevatiaa iv mareeaai ||41||
935.e: By Guru's Grace, one comes to understand himself; in this way, he remains dead while yet alive. ||41||

935.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਏ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
935.t: maiaa maiaa kar mue maiaa kisai na saath ||
935.e: Crying out for the wealth and riches of Maya, they die; but Maya does not go along with them.

935.g: ਹੰਸੁ ਚਲੈ ਉਠਿ ਡੁਮਣੋ ਮਾਇਆ ਭੂਲੀ ਆਥਿ ॥
935.t: ha(n)s chalai uTh ddumano maiaa bhoolee aath ||
935.e: The soul-swan arises and departs, sad and depressed, leaving its wealth behind.

935.g: ਮਨੁ ਝੂਠਾ ਜਮਿ ਜੋਹਿਆ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਚਲਹਿ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
935.t: man jhooThaa jam johiaa avagun chaleh naal ||
935.e: The false mind is hunted by the Messenger of Death; it carries its faults along when it goes.

935.g: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਉਲਟੋ ਮਰੈ ਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
935.t: man meh man ulaTo marai je gun hoveh naal ||
935.e: The mind turns inward, and merges with mind, when it is with virtue.

936.g: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਏ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
936.t: meree meree kar mue vin naavai dhukh bhaal ||
936.e: Crying out, ""Mine, mine!"", they have died, but without the Name, they find only pain.

936.g: ਗੜ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਲਾ ਕਹਾ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਜੀ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
936.t: gaR ma(n)dhar mahalaa kahaa jiau baajee dheebaan ||
936.e: So where are their forts, mansions, palaces and courts? They are like a short story.

936.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਣੁ ਝੂਠਾ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
936.t: naanak sache naam vin jhooThaa aavan jaan ||
936.e: O Nanak, without the True Name, the false just come and go.

936.g: ਆਪੇ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥੪੨॥
936.t: aape chatur saroop hai aape jaan sujaan ||42||
936.e: He Himself is clever and so very beautiful; He Himself is wise and all-knowing. ||42||

936.g: ਜੋ ਆਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਆਇ ਗਏ ਪਛੁਤਾਹਿ ॥
936.t: jo aaveh se jaeh fun aai ge pachhutaeh ||
936.e: Those who come, must go in the end; they come and go, regretting and repenting.

936.g: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਮੇਦਨੀ ਘਟੈ ਨ ਵਧੈ ਉਤਾਹਿ ॥
936.t: lakh chauraaseeh medhanee ghaTai na vadhai utaeh ||
936.e: They will pass through 8.4 millions species; this number does not decrease or rise.

936.g: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
936.t: se jan ubare jin har bhaiaa ||
936.e: They alone are saved, who love the Lord.

936.g: ਧੰਧਾ ਮੁਆ ਵਿਗੂਤੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
936.t: dha(n)dhaa muaa vigootee maiaa ||
936.e: Their worldly entanglements are ended, and Maya is conquered.

936.g: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਚਾਲਸੀ ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਮੀਤੁ ਕਰੇਉ ॥
936.t: jo dheesai so chaalasee kis kau meet kareau ||
936.e: Whoever is seen, shall depart; who should I make my friend?

936.g: ਜੀਉ ਸਮਪਉ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਆਗੈ ਦੇਉ ॥
936.t: jeeau samapau aapanaa tan man aagai dheau ||
936.e: I dedicate my soul, and place my body and mind in offering before Him.

936.g: ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਤੂ ਧਣੀ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੀ ਮੈ ਓਟ ॥
936.t: asathir karataa too dhanee tis hee kee mai oT ||
936.e: You are eternally stable, O Creator, Lord and Master; I lean on Your Support.

936.g: ਗੁਣ ਕੀ ਮਾਰੀ ਹਉ ਮੁਈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਚੋਟ ॥੪੩॥
936.t: gun kee maaree hau muiee sabadh ratee man choT ||43||
936.e: Conquered by virtue, egotism is killed; imbued with the Word of the Shabad, the mind rejects the world. ||43||

936.g: ਰਾਣਾ ਰਾਉ ਨ ਕੋ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਤੁੰਗੁ ਫਕੀਰੁ ॥
936.t: raanaa raau na ko rahai ra(n)g na tu(n)g fakeer ||
936.e: Neither the kings nor the nobles will remain; neither the rich nor the poor will remain.

936.g: ਵਾਰੀ ਆਪੋ ਆਪਣੀ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਬੰਧੈ ਧੀਰ ॥
936.t: vaaree aapo aapanee koi na ba(n)dhai dheer ||
936.e: When one's turn comes, no one can stay here.

936.g: ਰਾਹੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਭੀਹਾਵਲਾ ਸਰ ਡੂਗਰ ਅਸਗਾਹ ॥
936.t: raahu buraa bheehaavalaa sar ddoogar asagaeh ||
936.e: The path is difficult and treacherous; the pools and mountains are impassable.

936.g: ਮੈ ਤਨਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਝੁਰਿ ਮੁਈ ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਣ ਕਿਉ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਹ ॥
936.t: mai tan avagan jhur muiee vin gun kiau ghar jaeh ||
936.e: My body is filled with faults; I am dying of grief. Without virtue, how can I enter my home?

936.g: ਗੁਣੀਆ ਗੁਣ ਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲੇ ਕਿਉ ਤਿਨ ਮਿਲਉ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
936.t: guneeaa gun le prabh mile kiau tin milau piaar ||
936.e: The virtuous take virtue, and meet God; how can I meet them with love?

936.g: ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਜੈਸੀ ਥੀ ਰਹਾਂ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
936.t: tin hee jaisee thee rahaa(n) jap jap ridhai muraar ||
936.e: If ony I could be like them, chanting and meditating within my heart on the Lord.

936.g: ਅਵਗੁਣੀ ਭਰਪੂਰ ਹੈ ਗੁਣ ਭੀ ਵਸਹਿ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
936.t: avagunee bharapoor hai gun bhee vaseh naal ||
936.e: He is overflowing with faults and demerits, but virtue dwells within him as well.

936.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਗੁਣ ਨ ਜਾਪਨੀ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੪੪॥
936.t: vin satagur gun na jaapanee jichar sabadh na kare beechaar ||44||
936.e: Without the True Guru, he does not see God's Virtues; he does not chant the Glorious Virtues of God. ||44||

936.g: ਲਸਕਰੀਆ ਘਰ ਸੰਮਲੇ ਆਏ ਵਜਹੁ ਲਿਖਾਇ ॥
936.t: lasakareeaa ghar sa(n)male aae vajahu likhai ||
936.e: God's soldiers take care of their homes; their pay is pre-ordained, before they come into the world.

936.g: ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਧਣੀ ਲਾਹਾ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
936.t: kaar kamaaveh sir dhanee laahaa palai pai ||
936.e: They serve their Supreme Lord and Master, and obtain the profit.

936.g: ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਬੁਰਿਆਈਆ ਛੋਡੇ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ॥
936.t: lab lobh buriaaieeaa chhodde manahu visaar ||
936.e: They renounce greed, avarice and evil, and forget them from their minds.

936.g: ਗੜਿ ਦੋਹੀ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਕੀ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
936.t: gaR dhohee paatisaeh kee kadhe na aavai haar ||
936.e: In the fortress of the body, they announce the victory of their Supreme King; they are never ever vanquished.

936.g: ਚਾਕਰੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਸਉਹੇ ਉਤਰ ਦੇਇ ॥
936.t: chaakar kaheeaai khasam kaa sauhe utar dhei ||
936.e: One who calls himself a servant of his Lord and Master, and yet speaks defiantly to Him,

936.g: ਵਜਹੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਖਤਿ ਨ ਬੈਸਹਿ ਸੇਇ ॥
936.t: vajahu gavaae aapanaa takhat na baiseh sei ||
936.e: shall forfeit his pay, and not be seated upon the throne.

936.g: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਹਥਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥
936.t: preetam hath vaddiaaieeaa jai bhaavai tai dhei ||
936.e: Glorious greatness rests in the hands of my Beloved; He gives, according to the Pleasure of His Will.

936.g: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੪੫॥
936.t: aap kare kis aakheeaai avar na koi karei ||45||
936.e: He Himself does everything; who else should we address? No one else does anything. ||45||

936.g: ਬੀਜਉ ਸੂਝੈ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਬਹੈ ਦੁਲੀਚਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
936.t: beejau soojhai ko nahee bahai dhuleechaa pai ||
936.e: I cannot conceive of any other, who could be seated upon the royal cushions.

936.g: ਨਰਕ ਨਿਵਾਰਣੁ ਨਰਹ ਨਰੁ ਸਾਚਉ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥
936.t: narak nivaaran nareh nar saachau saachai nai ||
936.e: The Supreme Man of men eradicates hell; He is True, and True is His Name.

936.g: ਵਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਢੂਢਤ ਫਿਰਿ ਰਹੀ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਰਉ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
936.t: van tiran ddooddat fir rahee man meh karau beechaar ||
936.e: I wandered around searching for Him in the forests and meadows; I contemplate Him within my mind.

936.g: ਲਾਲ ਰਤਨ ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣਕੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਾਥਿ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥
936.t: laal ratan bahu maanakee satigur haath bha(n)ddaar ||
936.e: The treasures of myriads of pearls, jewels and emeralds are in the hands of the True Guru.

936.g: ਊਤਮੁ ਹੋਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਏਕੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
936.t: uootam hovaa prabh milai ik man ekai bhai ||
936.e: Meeting with God, I am exalted and elevated; I love the One Lord single-mindedly.

936.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਰਸਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਲਾਹਾ ਲੈ ਪਰਥਾਇ ॥
936.t: naanak preetam ras mile laahaa lai parathai ||
936.e: O Nanak, one who lovingly meets with his Beloved, earns profit in the world hereafter.

936.g: ਰਚਨਾ ਰਾਚਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਰਿਆ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
936.t: rachanaa raach jin rachee jin siriaa aakaar ||
936.e: He who created and formed the creation, made your form as well.

936.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੪੬॥
936.t: gurmukh bea(n)t dhiaaieeaai a(n)t na paaraavaar ||46||
936.e: As Gurmukh, meditate on the Infinite Lord, who has no end or limitation. ||46||

936.g: ੜਾੜੈ ਰੂੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸੋਈ ॥
936.t: RaaRai rooRaa har jeeau soiee ||
936.e: Rharha: The Dear Lord is beautiful;

936.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
936.t: tis bin raajaa avar na koiee ||
936.e: There is no other king, except Him.

936.g: ੜਾੜੈ ਗਾਰੁੜੁ ਤੁਮ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
936.t: RaaRai gaaruR tum sunahu har vasai man maeh ||
936.e: Rharha: Listen to the spell, and the Lord will come to dwell in your mind.

936.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਤੁ ਕੋ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਹਿ ॥
936.t: gur parasaadhee har paieeaai mat ko bharam bhulaeh ||
936.e: By Guru's Grace, one finds the Lord; do not be deluded by doubt.

936.g: ਸੋ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
936.t: so saahu saachaa jis har dhan raas ||
936.e: He alone is the true banker, who has the capital of the wealth of the Lord.

936.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
936.t: gurmukh pooraa tis saabaas ||
936.e: The Gurmukh is perfect - applaud him!

936.g: ਰੂੜੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
936.t: rooRee baanee har paiaa gur sabadhee beechaar ||
936.e: Through the beautiful Word of the Guru's Bani, the Lord is obtained; contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
