937.g: ਆਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਟਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਰਿ ॥੪੭॥
937.t: aap giaa dhukh kaTiaa har var paiaa naar ||47||
937.e: Self-conceit is eliminated, and pain is eradicated; the soul bride obtains her Husband Lord. ||47||

937.g: ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਸੰਚੀਐ ਧਨੁ ਕਾਚਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
937.t: suinaa rupaa sa(n)cheeaai dhan kaachaa bikh chhaar ||
937.e: He hoards gold and silver, but this wealth is false and poisonous, nothing more than ashes.

937.g: ਸਾਹੁ ਸਦਾਏ ਸੰਚਿ ਧਨੁ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
937.t: saahu sadhaae sa(n)ch dhan dhubidhaa hoi khuaar ||
937.e: He calls himself a banker, gathering wealth, but he is ruined by his dual-mindedness.

937.g: ਸਚਿਆਰੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਸਾਚਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ॥
937.t: sachiaaree sach sa(n)chiaa saachau naam amol ||
937.e: The truthful ones gather Truth; the True Name is priceless.

937.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਾਇਲੁ ਊਜਲੋ ਪਤਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਸਚੁ ਬੋਲੁ ॥
937.t: har niramail uoojalo pat saachee sach bol ||
937.e: The Lord is immaculate and pure; through Him, their honor is true, and their speech is true.

937.g: ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੀਤੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਤੂ ਤੂ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਤੂ ਹੰਸੁ ॥
937.t: saajan meet sujaan too too saravar too ha(n)s ||
937.e: You are my friend and companion, all-knowing Lord; You are the lake, and You are the swan.

937.g: ਸਾਚਉ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਸੁ ॥
937.t: saachau Thaakur man vasai hau balihaaree tis ||
937.e: I am a sacrifice to that being, whose mind is filled with the True Lord and Master.

937.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤੀ ਸੋ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
937.t: maiaa mamataa mohanee jin keetee so jaan ||
937.e: Know the One who created love and attachment to Maya, the Enticer.

937.g: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥੪੮॥
937.t: bikhiaa a(n)mrit ek hai boojhai purakh sujaan ||48||
937.e: One who realizes the all-knowing Primal Lord, looks alike upon poison and nectar. ||48||

937.g: ਖਿਮਾ ਵਿਹੂਣੇ ਖਪਿ ਗਏ ਖੂਹਣਿ ਲਖ ਅਸੰਖ ॥
937.t: khimaa vihoone khap ge khoohan lakh asa(n)kh ||
937.e: Without patience and forgiveness, countless hundreds of thousands have perished.

937.g: ਗਣਤ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕਿਉ ਗਣੀ ਖਪਿ ਖਪਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਸੰਖ ॥
937.t: ganat na aavai kiau ganee khap khap mue bisa(n)kh ||
937.e: Their numbers cannot be counted; how could I count them? Bothered and bewildered, uncounted numbers have died.

937.g: ਖਸਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਖੂਲੈ ਬੰਧੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
937.t: khasam pachhaanai aapanaa khoolai ba(n)dh na pai ||
937.e: One who realizes his Lord and Master is set free, and not bound by chains.

937.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਹਲੀ ਖਰਾ ਤੂ ਖਿਮਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਖ ਭਾਇ ॥
937.t: sabadh mahalee kharaa too khimaa sach sukh bhai ||
937.e: Through the Word of the Shabad, enter the Mansion of the Lord's Presence; you shall be blessed with patience, forgiveness, truth and peace.

937.g: ਖਰਚੁ ਖਰਾ ਧਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਵਸਹਿ ਸਰੀਰਿ ॥
937.t: kharach kharaa dhan dhiaan too aape vaseh sareer ||
937.e: Partake of the true wealth of meditation, and the Lord Himself shall abide within your body.

937.g: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਪੈ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਧੀਰ ॥
937.t: man tan mukh jaapai sadhaa gun a(n)tar man dheer ||
937.e: With mind, body and mouth, chant His Glorious Virtues forever; courage and composure shall enter deep within your mind.

937.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਖਪੈ ਖਪਾਇਸੀ ਬੀਜਉ ਵਥੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
937.t: haumai khapai khapaisee beejau vath vikaar ||
937.e: Through egotism, one is distracted and ruined; other than the Lord, all things are corrupt.

937.g: ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਇਅਨੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਅਲਗੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੪੯॥
937.t: ja(n)t upai vich paian karataa alag apaar ||49||
937.e: Forming His creatures, He placed Himself within them; the Creator is unattached and infinite. ||49||

937.g: ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟੇ ਭੇਉ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
937.t: sirasaTe bheau na jaanai koi ||
937.e: No one knows the mystery of the Creator of the World.

937.g: ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਾ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਨਿਹਚਉ ਹੋਇ ॥
937.t: sirasaTaa karai su nihachau hoi ||
937.e: Whatever the Creator of the World does, is certain to occur.

937.g: ਸੰਪੈ ਕਉ ਈਸਰੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
937.t: sa(n)pai kau ieesar dhiaaieeaai ||
937.e: For wealth, some meditate on the Lord.

937.g: ਸੰਪੈ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਲਿਖੇ ਕੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
937.t: sa(n)pai purab likhe kee paieeaai ||
937.e: By pre-ordained destiny, wealth is obtained.

937.g: ਸੰਪੈ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਚਾਕਰ ਚੋਰ ॥
937.t: sa(n)pai kaaran chaakar chor ||
937.e: For the sake of wealth, some become servants or thieves.

937.g: ਸੰਪੈ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਹੋਰ ॥
937.t: sa(n)pai saath na chaalai hor ||
937.e: Wealth does not go along with them when they die; it passes into the hands of others.

937.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਹੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
937.t: bin saache nahee dharageh maan ||
937.e: Without Truth, honor is not obtained in the Court of the Lord.

937.g: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਛੁਟੈ ਨਿਦਾਨਿ ॥੫੦॥
937.t: har ras peevai chhuTai nidhaan ||50||
937.e: Drinking in the subtle essence of the Lord, one is emancipated in the end. ||50||

937.g: ਹੇਰਤ ਹੇਰਤ ਹੇ ਸਖੀ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੀ ਹੈਰਾਨੁ ॥
937.t: herat herat he sakhee hoi rahee hairaan ||
937.e: Seeing and perceiving, O my companions, I am wonder-struck and amazed.

937.g: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤੀ ਮੈ ਮੁਈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
937.t: hau hau karatee mai muiee sabadh ravai man giaan ||
937.e: My egotism, which proclaimed itself in possessiveness and self-conceit, is dead. My mind chants the Word of the Shabad, and attains spiritual wisdom.

937.g: ਹਾਰ ਡੋਰ ਕੰਕਨ ਘਣੇ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਕੀ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
937.t: haar ddor ka(n)kan ghane kar thaakee seegaar ||
937.e: I am so tired of wearing all these necklaces, hair-ties and bracelets, and decorating myself.

937.g: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਗਲ ਗੁਣਾ ਗਲਿ ਹਾਰੁ ॥
937.t: mil preetam sukh paiaa sagal gunaa gal haar ||
937.e: Meeting with my Beloved, I have found peace; now, I wear the necklace of total virtue.

937.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
937.t: naanak gurmukh paieeaai har siau preet piaar ||
937.e: O Nanak, the Gurmukh attains the Lord, with love and affection.

937.g: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
937.t: har bin kin sukh paiaa dhekhahu man beechaar ||
937.e: Without the Lord, who has found peace? Reflect upon this in your mind, and see.

937.g: ਹਰਿ ਪੜਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਬੁਝਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਖਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
937.t: har paRanaa har bujhanaa har siau rakhahu piaar ||
937.e: Read about the Lord, understand the Lord, and enshrine love for the Lord.

937.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥੫੧॥
937.t: har japeeaai har dhiaaieeaai har kaa naam adhaar ||51||
937.e: Chant the Lord's Name, and meditate on the Lord; hold tight to the Support of the Name of the Lord. ||51||

937.g: ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਮਿਟਈ ਹੇ ਸਖੀ ਜੋ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
937.t: lekh na miTiee he sakhee jo likhiaa karataar ||
937.e: The inscription inscribed by the Creator Lord cannot be erased, O my companions.

937.g: ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਗੁ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
937.t: aape kaaran jin keeaa kar kirapaa pag dhaar ||
937.e: He who created the universe, in His Mercy, installs His Feet within us.

937.g: ਕਰਤੇ ਹਥਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
937.t: karate hath vaddiaaieeaa boojhahu gur beechaar ||
937.e: Glorious greatness rests in the Hands of the Creator; reflect upon the Guru, and understand this.

937.g: ਲਿਖਿਆ ਫੇਰਿ ਨ ਸਕੀਐ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੀ ਤਿਉ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
937.t: likhiaa fer na sakeeaai jiau bhaavee tiau saar ||
937.e: This inscription cannot be challenged. As it pleases You, You care for me.

937.g: ਨਦਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
937.t: nadhar teree sukh paiaa naanak sabadh veechaar ||
937.e: By Your Glance of Grace, I have found peace; O Nanak, reflect upon the Shabad.

937.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭੂਲੇ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਉਬਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
937.t: manmukh bhoole pach mue ubare gur beechaar ||
937.e: The self-willed manmukhs are confused; they rot away and die. Only by reflecting upon the Guru can they be saved.

937.g: ਜਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
937.t: j purakh nadhar na aaviee tis kaa kiaa kar kahiaa jai ||
937.e: What can anyone say, about that Primal Lord, who cannot be seen?

937.g: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦਿਤਾ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥੫੨॥
937.t: balihaaree gur aapane jin hiradhai dhitaa dhikhai ||52||
937.e: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, who has revealed Him to me, within my own heart. ||52||

937.g: ਪਾਧਾ ਪੜਿਆ ਆਖੀਐ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਬਿਚਰੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
937.t: paadhaa paRiaa aakheeaai bidhiaa bicharai sahaj subhai ||
937.e: That Pandit, that religious scholar, is said to be well-educated, if he contemplates knowledge with intuitive ease.

938.g: ਬਿਦਿਆ ਸੋਧੈ ਤਤੁ ਲਹੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
938.t: bidhiaa sodhai tat lahai raam naam liv lai ||
938.e: Considering his knowledge, he finds the essence of reality, and lovingly focuses his attention on the Name of the Lord.

938.g: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਬਿਕ੍ਰਦਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਟੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
938.t: manmukh bidhiaa bikaradhaa bikh khaTe bikh khai ||
938.e: The self-willed manmukh sells his knowledge; he earns poison, and eats poison.

938.g: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਚੀਨਈ ਸੂਝ ਬੂਝ ਨਹ ਕਾਇ ॥੫੩॥
938.t: moorakh sabadh na cheeniee soojh boojh neh kai ||53||
938.e: The fool does not think of the Word of the Shabad. He has no understanding, no comprehension. ||53||

938.g: ਪਾਧਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਖੀਐ ਚਾਟੜਿਆ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਇ ॥
938.t: paadhaa gurmukh aakheeaai chaaTaRiaa mat dhei ||
938.e: That Pandit is called Gurmukh, who imparts understanding to his students.

938.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਗਰਹੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਲੇਇ ॥
938.t: naam samaalahu naam sa(n)garahu laahaa jag meh lei ||
938.e: Contemplate the Naam, the Name of the Lord; gather in the Naam, and earn the true profit in this world.

938.g: ਸਚੀ ਪਟੀ ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਪੜੀਐ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
938.t: sachee paTee sach man paReeaai sabadhu su saar ||
938.e: With the true notebook of the true mind, study the most sublime Word of the Shabad.

938.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪੜਿਆ ਸੋ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਬੀਨਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਗਲਿ ਹਾਰੁ ॥੫੪॥੧॥
938.t: naanak so paRiaa so pa(n)ddit beenaa jis raam naam gal haar ||54||1||
938.e: O Nanak, he alone is learned, and he alone is a wise Pandit, who wears the necklace of the Lord's Name. ||54||1||

938.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਸਿਧ ਗੋਸਟਿ
938.t: raamakalee mahalaa pehilaa sidh gosaT
938.e: Raamkalee, First Mehla, Sidh Gosht ~ Conversations With The Siddhas:

938.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
938.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
938.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

938.g: ਸਿਧ ਸਭਾ ਕਰਿ ਆਸਣਿ ਬੈਠੇ ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਜੈਕਾਰੋ ॥
938.t: sidh sabhaa kar aasan baiThe sa(n)t sabhaa jaikaaro ||
938.e: The Siddhas formed an assembly; sitting in their Yogic postures, they shouted, ""Salute this gathering of Saints.""

938.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰੋ ॥
938.t: tis aagai raharaas hamaaree saachaa apar apaaro ||
938.e: I offer my salutation to the One who is true, infinite and incomparably beautiful.

938.g: ਮਸਤਕੁ ਕਾਟਿ ਧਰੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਆਗੈ ਦੇਉ ॥
938.t: masatak kaaT dharee tis aagai tan man aagai dheau ||
938.e: I cut off my head, and offer it to Him; I dedicate my body and mind to Him.

938.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਹਜ ਭਾਇ ਜਸੁ ਲੇਉ ॥੧॥
938.t: naanak sa(n)t milai sach paieeaai sahaj bhai jas leau ||1||
938.e: O Nanak, meeting with the Saints, Truth is obtained, and one is spontaneously blessed with distinction. ||1||

938.g: ਕਿਆ ਭਵੀਐ ਸਚਿ ਸੂਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
938.t: kiaa bhaveeaai sach soochaa hoi ||
938.e: What is the use of wandering around? Purity comes only through Truth.

938.g: ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
938.t: saach sabadh bin mukat na koi ||1|| rahaau ||
938.e: Without the True Word of the Shabad, no one finds liberation. ||1||Pause||

938.g: ਕਵਨ ਤੁਮੇ ਕਿਆ ਨਾਉ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਕਉਨੁ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਸੁਆਓ ॥
938.t: kavan tume kiaa naau tumaaraa kaun maarag kaun suaao ||
938.e: "Who are you? What is your name? What is your way? What is your goal?

938.g: ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹਉ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਹਉ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਓ ॥
938.t: saach kahau aradhaas hamaaree hau sa(n)t janaa bal jaao ||
938.e: We pray that you will answer us truthfully; we are a sacrifice to the humble Saints.

938.g: ਕਹ ਬੈਸਹੁ ਕਹ ਰਹੀਐ ਬਾਲੇ ਕਹ ਆਵਹੁ ਕਹ ਜਾਹੋ ॥
938.t: keh baisahu keh raheeaai baale keh aavahu keh jaaho ||
938.e: Where is your seat? Where do you live, boy? Where did you come from, and where are you going?

938.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਕਿਆ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਰਾਹੋ ॥੨॥
938.t: naanak bolai sun bairaagee kiaa tumaaraa raaho ||2||
938.e: Tell us, Nanak - the detached Siddhas wait to hear your reply. What is your path?""||2||

938.g: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਬੈਸਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਚਾਲਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਏ ॥
938.t: ghaT ghaT bais nira(n)tar raheeaai chaaleh satigur bhaae ||
938.e: He dwells deep within the nucleus of each and every heart. This is my seat and my home. I walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru.

938.g: ਸਹਜੇ ਆਏ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਿਧਾਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਰਜਾਏ ॥
938.t: sahaje aae hukam sidhaae naanak sadhaa rajaae ||
938.e: I came from the Celestial Lord God; I go wherever He orders me to go. I am Nanak, forever under the Command of His Will.

938.g: ਆਸਣਿ ਬੈਸਣਿ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਐਸੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
938.t: aasan baisan thir naarain aaisee gurmat paae ||
938.e: I sit in the posture of the eternal, imperishable Lord. These are the Teachings I have received from the Guru.

938.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੩॥
938.t: gurmukh boojhai aap pachhaanai sache sach samaae ||3||
938.e: As Gurmukh, I have come to understand and realize myself; I merge in the Truest of the True. ||3||

938.g: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਾਰੋ ॥
938.t: dhuneeaa saagar dhutar kaheeaai kiau kar paieeaai paaro ||
938.e: "The world-ocean is treacherous and impassable; how can one cross over?

938.g: ਚਰਪਟੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਅਉਧੂ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਹੁ ਸਚਾ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
938.t: charapaT bolai aaudhoo naanak dheh sachaa beechaaro ||
938.e: Charpat the Yogi says, O Nanak, think it over, and give us your true reply.""

938.g: ਆਪੇ ਆਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਸਮਝੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਉਤਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
938.t: aape aakhai aape samajhai tis kiaa utar dheejai ||
938.e: What answer can I give to someone, who claims to understand himself?

938.g: ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਪਾਰਗਰਾਮੀ ਤੁਝੁ ਕਿਆ ਬੈਸਣੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੪॥
938.t: saach kahahu tum paaragaraamee tujh kiaa baisan dheejai ||4||
938.e: I speak the Truth; if you have already crossed over, how can I argue with you? ||4||

938.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਮੁਰਗਾਈ ਨੈ ਸਾਣੇ ॥
938.t: jaise jal meh kamal niraalam muragaiee nai saane ||
938.e: The lotus flower floats untouched upon the surface of the water, and the duck swims through the stream;

938.g: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੇ ॥
938.t: surat sabadh bhav saagar tareeaai naanak naam vakhaane ||
938.e: with one's consciousness focused on the Word of the Shabad, one crosses over the terrifying world-ocean. O Nanak, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

938.g: ਰਹਹਿ ਇਕਾਂਤਿ ਏਕੋ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਆਸਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਸੋ ॥
938.t: raheh ikaa(n)t eko man vasiaa aasaa maeh niraaso ||
938.e: One who lives alone, as a hermit, enshrining the One Lord in his mind, remaining unaffected by hope in the midst of hope,

938.g: ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੋ ॥੫॥
938.t: agam agochar dhekh dhikhaae naanak taa kaa dhaaso ||5||
938.e: sees and inspires others to see the inaccessible, unfathomable Lord. Nanak is his slave. ||5||

938.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਪੂਛਉ ਸਾਚੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
938.t: sun suaamee aradhaas hamaaree poochhau saach beechaaro ||
938.e: "Listen, Lord, to our prayer. We seek your true opinion.

938.g: ਰੋਸੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਉਤਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਦੁਆਰੋ ॥
938.t: ros na keejai utar dheejai kiau paieeaai gur dhuaaro ||
938.e: Don't be angry with us - please tell us: How can we find the Guru's Door?""

938.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਚਲਤਉ ਸਚ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਸੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੋ ॥
938.t: eih man chalatau sach ghar baisai naanak naam adhaaro ||
938.e: This fickle mind sits in its true home, O Nanak, through the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

938.g: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥੬॥
938.t: aape mel milaae karataa laagai saach piaaro ||6||
938.e: The Creator Himself unites us in Union, and inspires us to love the Truth. ||6||

938.g: ਹਾਟੀ ਬਾਟੀ ਰਹਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਲੇ ਰੂਖਿ ਬਿਰਖਿ ਉਦਿਆਨੇ ॥
938.t: haaTee baaTee raheh niraale rookh birakh udhiaane ||
938.e: "Away from stores and highways, we live in the woods, among plants and trees.

938.g: ਕੰਦ ਮੂਲੁ ਅਹਾਰੋ ਖਾਈਐ ਅਉਧੂ ਬੋਲੈ ਗਿਆਨੇ ॥
938.t: ka(n)dh mool ahaaro khaieeaai aaudhoo bolai giaane ||
938.e: For food, we take fruits and roots. This is the spiritual wisdom spoken by the renunciates.

939.g: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਈਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕਾਈ ॥
939.t: teerath naieeaai sukh fal paieeaai mail na laagai kaiee ||
939.e: We bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, and obtain the fruits of peace; not even an iota of filth sticks to us.

939.g: ਗੋਰਖ ਪੂਤੁ ਲੋਹਾਰੀਪਾ ਬੋਲੈ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਸਾਈ ॥੭॥
939.t: gorakh poot lohaareepaa bolai jog jugat bidh saiee ||7||
939.e: Luhaareepaa, the disciple of Gorakh says, this is the Way of Yoga.""||7||

939.g: ਹਾਟੀ ਬਾਟੀ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਪਰ ਘਰਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਡੋੁਲਾਈ ॥
939.t: haaTee baaTee needh na aavai par ghar chit na dduolaiee ||
939.e: In the stores and on the road, do not sleep; do not let your consciousness covet anyone else's home.

939.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮਨੁ ਟੇਕ ਨ ਟਿਕਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
939.t: bin naavai man Tek na Tikiee naanak bhookh na jaiee ||
939.e: Without the Name, the mind has no firm support; O Nanak, this hunger never departs.

939.g: ਹਾਟੁ ਪਟਣੁ ਘਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੋ ॥
939.t: haaT paTan ghar guroo dhikhaiaa sahaje sach vaapaaro ||
939.e: The Guru has revealed the stores and the city within the home of my own heart, where I intuitively carry on the true trade.

939.g: ਖੰਡਿਤ ਨਿਦ੍ਰਾ ਅਲਪ ਅਹਾਰੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥੮॥
939.t: kha(n)ddit nidhraa alap ahaara(n) naanak tat beechaaro ||8||
939.e: Sleep little, and eat little; O Nanak, this is the essence of wisdom. ||8||

939.g: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਹੁ ਜੋਗਿੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਝੋਲੀ ਖਿੰਥਾ ॥
939.t: dharasan bhekh karahu jogi(n)dhraa mu(n)dhraa jholee khi(n)thaa ||
939.e: "Wear the robes of the sect of Yogis who follow Gorakh; put on the ear-rings, begging wallet and patched coat.

939.g: ਬਾਰਹ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਖਟੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਇਕ ਪੰਥਾ ॥
939.t: baareh a(n)tar ek sarevahu khaT dharasan ik pa(n)thaa ||
939.e: Among the twelve schools of Yoga, ours is the highest; among the six schools of philosophy, ours is the best path.

939.g: ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਪੁਰਖਾ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਚੋਟ ਨ ਖਾਈਐ ॥
939.t: ein bidh man samajhaieeaai purakhaa baahuR choT na khaieeaai ||
939.e: This is the way to instruct the mind, so you will never suffer beatings again.""

939.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਇਵ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੯॥
939.t: naanak bolai gurmukh boojhai jog jugat iv paieeaai ||9||
939.e: Nanak speaks: the Gurmukh understands; this is the way that Yoga is attained. ||9||

939.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਮੁਦ੍ਰਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰੀ ॥
939.t: a(n)tar sabadh nira(n)tar mudhraa haumai mamataa dhoor karee ||
939.e: Let constant absorption in the Word of the Shabad deep within be your ear-rings; eradicate egotism and attachment.

939.g: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁ ਸਮਝ ਪਰੀ ॥
939.t: kaam karodh aha(n)kaar nivaarai gur kai sabadh su samajh paree ||
939.e: Discard sexual desire, anger and egotism, and through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, attain true understanding.

939.g: ਖਿੰਥਾ ਝੋਲੀ ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾਰੈ ਏਕੁ ਹਰੀ ॥
939.t: khi(n)thaa jholee bharipur rahiaa naanak taarai ek haree ||
939.e: For your patched coat and begging bowl, see the Lord God pervading and permeating everywhere; O Nanak, the One Lord will carry you across.

939.g: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਾਈ ਪਰਖੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਖਰੀ ॥੧੦॥
939.t: saachaa saahib saachee naiee parakhai gur kee baat kharee ||10||
939.e: True is our Lord and Master, and True is His Name. Analyze it, and you shall find the Word of the Guru to be True. ||10||
Let your mind turn away in detachment from the world, and let this be your begging bowl. Let the lessons of the five elements be your cap.
Let the body be your meditation mat, and the mind your loin cloth.
Let truth, contentment and self-discipline be your companions.
O Nanak, the Gurmukh dwells on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||11||

939.g: ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਗੁਪਤਾ ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
939.t: kavanu su gupataa kavanu su mukataa ||
939.e: "Who is hidden? Who is liberated?
Who is united, inwardly and outwardly?

939.g: ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਆਵੈ ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
939.t: kavanu su aavai kavanu su jai ||
939.e: Who comes, and who goes?
Who is permeating and pervading the three worlds?""||12||
He is hidden within each and every heart. The Gurmukh is liberated.
Through the Word of the Shabad, one is united, inwardly and outwardly.
The self-willed manmukh perishes, and comes and goes.
O Nanak, the Gurmukh merges in Truth. ||13||
"How is one placed in bondage, and consumed by the serpent of Maya?

939.g: ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਖੋਇਆ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਲਾਧਾ ॥
939.t: kiau kar khoiaa kiau kar laadhaa ||
939.e: How does one lose, and how does one gain?

939.g: ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥
939.t: kiau kar niramal kiau kar a(n)dhiaaraa ||
939.e: How does one become immaculate and pure? How is the darkness of ignorance removed?

939.g: ਇਹੁ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ਸੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੧੪॥
939.t: eih tat beechaarai su guroo hamaaraa ||14||
939.e: One who understands this essence of reality is our Guru.""||14||
Man is bound by evil-mindedness, and consumed by Maya, the serpent.
The self-willed manmukh loses, and the Gurmukh gains.
Meeting the True Guru, darkness is dispelled.
O Nanak, eradicating egotism, one merges in the Lord. ||15||
Focused deep within, in perfect absorption,

939.g: ਉਡੈ ਨ ਹੰਸਾ ਪੜੈ ਨ ਕੰਧੁ ॥
939.t: auddai na ha(n)saa paRai na ka(n)dh ||
939.e: the soul-swan does not fly away, and the body-wall does not collapse.
Then, one knows that his true home is in the cave of intuitive poise.
O Nanak, the True Lord loves those who are truthful. ||16||
"Why have you left your house and become a wandering Udaasee?
Why have you adopted these religious robes?
What merchandise do you trade?
How will you carry others across with you?""||17||
I became a wandering Udaasee, searching for the Gurmukhs.
I have adopted these robes seeking the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.
I trade in the merchandise of Truth.
O Nanak, as Gurmukh, I carry others across. ||18||
"How have you changed the course of your life?

939.g: ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਤੁਝੁ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
939.t: kaahe kau tujh ih man laiaa ||
939.e: With what have you linked your mind?

940.g: ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਖਾਈ ॥
940.t: kit bidh aasaa manasaa khaiee ||
940.e: How have you subdued your hopes and desires?

940.g: ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
940.t: kit bidh jot nira(n)tar paiee ||
940.e: How have you found the Light deep within your nucleus?

940.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਦੰਤਾ ਕਿਉ ਖਾਈਐ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
940.t: bin dha(n)taa kiau khaieeaai saar ||
940.e: Without teeth, how can you eat iron?

940.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੧੯॥
940.t: naanak saachaa karahu beechaar ||19||
940.e: Give us your true opinion, Nanak.""||19||

940.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਜਨਮੇ ਗਵਨੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥
940.t: satigur kai janame gavan miTaiaa ||
940.e: Born into the House of the True Guru, my wandering in reincarnation ended.

940.g: ਅਨਹਤਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
940.t: anahat raate ih man laiaa ||
940.e: My mind is attached and attuned to the unstruck sound current.

940.g: ਮਨਸਾ ਆਸਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਈ ॥
940.t: manasaa aasaa sabadh jalaiee ||
940.e: Through the Word of the Shabad, my hopes and desires have been burnt away.

940.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
940.t: gurmukh jot nira(n)tar paiee ||
940.e: As Gurmukh, I found the Light deep within the nucleus of my self.

940.g: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮੇਟੇ ਖਾਈਐ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
940.t: trai gun meTe khaieeaai saar ||
940.e: Eradicating the three qualities, one eats iron.

940.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾਰੇ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨੦॥
940.t: naanak taare taaranahaar ||20||
940.e: O Nanak, the Emancipator emancipates. ||20||

940.g: ਆਦਿ ਕਉ ਕਵਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਕਥੀਅਲੇ ਸੁੰਨ ਕਹਾ ਘਰ ਵਾਸੋ ॥
940.t: aadh kau kavan beechaar katheeale su(n)n kahaa ghar vaaso ||
940.e: "What can you tell us about the beginning? In what home did the absolute dwell then?

940.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਕੀ ਮੁਦ੍ਰਾ ਕਵਨ ਕਥੀਅਲੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਕਵਨ ਨਿਵਾਸੋ ॥
940.t: giaan kee mudhraa kavan katheeale ghaT ghaT kavan nivaaso ||
940.e: What are the ear-rings of spiritual wisdom? Who dwells in each and every heart?

940.g: ਕਾਲ ਕਾ ਠੀਗਾ ਕਿਉ ਜਲਾਈਅਲੇ ਕਿਉ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
940.t: kaal kaa Theegaa kiau jalaieeale kiau nirabhau ghar jaieeaai ||
940.e: How can one avoid the attack of death? How can one enter the home of fearlessness?

940.g: ਸਹਜ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਕਾ ਆਸਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਿਉ ਛੇਦੇ ਬੈਰਾਈਐ ॥
940.t: sahaj sa(n)tokh kaa aasan jaanai kiau chhedhe bairaieeaai ||
940.e: How can one know the posture of intuition and contentment, and overcome one's adversaries?""

940.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਰੈ ਤਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਵਾਸੋ ॥
940.t: gur kai sabadh haumai bikh maarai taa nij ghar hovai vaaso ||
940.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, egotism and corruption are conquered, and then one comes to dwell in the home of the self within.

940.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਿ ਰਚਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੋ ॥੨੧॥
940.t: jin rach rachiaa tis sabadh pachhaanai naanak taa kaa dhaaso ||21||
940.e: One who realizes the Shabad of the One who created the creation - Nanak is his slave. ||21||

940.g: ਕਹਾ ਤੇ ਆਵੈ ਕਹਾ ਇਹੁ ਜਾਵੈ ਕਹਾ ਇਹੁ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
940.t: kahaa te aavai kahaa ih jaavai kahaa ih rahai samaiee ||
940.e: "Where did we come from? Where are we going? Where will we be absorbed?

940.g: ਏਸੁ ਸਬਦ ਕਉ ਜੋ ਅਰਥਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਈ ॥
940.t: es sabadh kau jo arathaavai tis gur til na tamaiee ||
940.e: One who reveals the meaning of this Shabad is the Guru, who has no greed at all.

940.g: ਕਿਉ ਤਤੈ ਅਵਿਗਤੈ ਪਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
940.t: kiau tatai avigatai paavai gurmukh lagai piaaro ||
940.e: How can one find the essence of the unmanifest reality? How does one become Gurmukh, and enshrine love for the Lord?

940.g: ਆਪੇ ਸੁਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
940.t: aape surataa aape karataa kahu naanak beechaaro ||
940.e: He Himself is consciousness, He Himself is the Creator; share with us, Nanak, your wisdom.""

940.g: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਆਵੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਜਾਵੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
940.t: hukame aavai hukame jaavai hukame rahai samaiee ||
940.e: By His Command we come, and by His Command we go; by His Command, we merge in absorption.

940.g: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਸਬਦੇ ਪਾਈ ॥੨੨॥
940.t: poore gur te saach kamaavai gat mit sabadhe paiee ||22||
940.e: Through the Perfect Guru, live the Truth; through the Word of the Shabad, the state of dignity is attained. ||22||

940.g: ਆਦਿ ਕਉ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਕਥੀਅਲੇ ਸੁੰਨ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਲੀਆ ॥
940.t: aadh kau bisamaadh beechaar katheeale su(n)n nira(n)tar vaas leeaa ||
940.e: We can only express a sense of wonder about the beginning. The absolute abided endlessly deep within Himself then.

940.g: ਅਕਲਪਤ ਮੁਦ੍ਰਾ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਅਲੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ॥
940.t: akalapat mudhraa gur giaan beechaareeale ghaT ghaT saachaa sarab jeeaa ||
940.e: Consider freedom from desire to be the ear-rings of the Guru's spiritual wisdom. The True Lord, the Soul of all, dwells within each and every heart.

940.g: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਅਵਿਗਤਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ਤਤੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਲਹੈ ॥
940.t: gur bachanee avigat samaieeaai tat nira(n)jan sahaj lahai ||
940.e: Through the Guru's Word, one merges in the absolute, and intuitively receives the immaculate essence.

940.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੂਜੀ ਕਾਰ ਨ ਕਰਣੀ ਸੇਵੈ ਸਿਖੁ ਸੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹੈ ॥
940.t: naanak dhoojee kaar na karanee sevai sikhu su khoj lahai ||
940.e: O Nanak, that Sikh who seeks and finds the Way does not serve any other.

940.g: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਜੀਅ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
940.t: hukam bisamaadh hukam pachhaanai jeea jugat sach jaanai soiee ||
940.e: Wonderful and amazing is His Command; He alone realizes His Command and knows the true way of life of His creatures.

940.g: ਆਪੁ ਮੇਟਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਕਹੀਐ ਸੋਈ ॥੨੩॥
940.t: aap meT niraalam hovai a(n)tar saach jogee kaheeaai soiee ||23||
940.e: One who eradicates his self-conceit becomes free of desire; he alone is a Yogi, who enshrines the True Lord deep within. ||23||

940.g: ਅਵਿਗਤੋ ਨਿਰਮਾਇਲੁ ਉਪਜੇ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਤੇ ਸਰਗੁਣੁ ਥੀਆ ॥
940.t: avigato niramail upaje niragun te saragun theeaa ||
940.e: From His state of absolute existence, He assumed the immaculate form; from formless, He assumed the supreme form.

940.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਰਚੈ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਲੀਆ ॥
940.t: satigur parachai param padh paieeaai saachai sabadh samai leeaa ||
940.e: By pleasing the True Guru, the supreme status is obtained, and one is absorbed in the True Word of the Shabad.

940.g: ਏਕੇ ਕਉ ਸਚੁ ਏਕਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਕੀਆ ॥
940.t: eke kau sach ekaa jaanai haumai dhoojaa dhoor keeaa ||
940.e: He knows the True Lord as the One and only; he sends his egotism and duality far away.

940.g: ਸੋ ਜੋਗੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਥੀਆ ॥
940.t: so jogee gur sabadh pachhaanai a(n)tar kamal pragaas theeaa ||
940.e: He alone is a Yogi, who realizes the Word of the Guru's Shabad; the lotus of the heart blossoms forth within.

940.g: ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਰਬ ਦਇਆ ॥
940.t: jeevat marai taa sabh kichh soojhai a(n)tar jaanai sarab dhiaa ||
940.e: If one remains dead while yet alive, then he understands everything; he knows the Lord deep within himself, who is kind and compassionate to all.

940.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ॥੨੪॥
940.t: naanak taa kau milai vaddaiee aap pachhaanai sarab jeeaa ||24||
940.e: O Nanak, he is blessed with glorious greatness; he realizes himself in all beings. ||24||

940.g: ਸਾਚੌ ਉਪਜੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਸੂਚੇ ਏਕ ਮਇਆ ॥
940.t: saachau upajai saach samaavai saache sooche ek miaa ||
940.e: We emerge from Truth, and merge into Truth again. The pure being merges into the One True Lord.

940.g: ਝੂਠੇ ਆਵਹਿ ਠਵਰ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
940.t: jhooThe aaveh Thavar na paaveh dhoojai aavaa gaun bhiaa ||
940.e: The false come, and find no place of rest; in duality, they come and go.

940.g: ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਆਪੇ ਪਰਖੈ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
940.t: aavaa gaun miTai gur sabadhee aape parakhai bakhas liaa ||
940.e: This coming and going in reincarnation is ended through the Word of the Guru's Shabad; the Lord Himself analyzes and grants His forgiveness.

940.g: ਏਕਾ ਬੇਦਨ ਦੂਜੈ ਬਿਆਪੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਵੀਸਰਿਆ ॥
940.t: ekaa bedhan dhoojai biaapee naam rasain veesariaa ||
940.e: One who suffers from the disease of duality, forgets the Naam, the source of nectar.

941.g: ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
941.t: so boojhai jis aap bujhaae gur kai sabadh su mukat bhiaa ||
941.e: He alone understands, whom the Lord inspires to understand. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one is liberated.

941.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾਰੇ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਪਰਹਰਿਆ ॥੨੫॥
941.t: naanak taare taaranahaaraa haumai dhoojaa parahariaa ||25||
941.e: O Nanak, the Emancipator emancipates one who drives out egotism and duality. ||25||
The self-willed manmukhs are deluded, under the shadow of death.
They look into the homes of others, and lose.
The manmukhs are confused by doubt, wandering in the wilderness.
Having lost their way, they are plundered; they chant their mantras at cremation grounds.
They do not think of the Shabad; instead, they utter obscenities.
O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Truth know peace. ||26||
The Gurmukh lives in the Fear of God, the True Lord.
Through the Word of the Guru's Bani, the Gurmukh refines the unrefined.
The Gurmukh sings the immaculate, Glorious Praises of the Lord.
The Gurmukh attains the supreme, sanctified status.
The Gurmukh meditates on the Lord with every hair of his body.
O Nanak, the Gurmukh merges in Truth. ||27||
The Gurmukh is pleasing to the True Guru; this is contemplation on the Vedas.
Pleasing the True Guru, the Gurmukh is carried across.
Pleasing the True Guru, the Gurmukh receives the spiritual wisdom of the Shabad.
Pleasing the True Guru, the Gurmukh comes to know the path within.
The Gurmukh attains the unseen and infinite Lord.
O Nanak, the Gurmukh finds the door of liberation. ||28||
The Gurmukh speaks the unspoken wisdom.
In the midst of his family, the Gurmukh lives a spiritual life.
The Gurmukh lovingly meditates deep within.
The Gurmukh obtains the Shabad, and righteous conduct.
He knows the mystery of the Shabad, and inspires others to know it.
O Nanak, burning away his ego, he merges in the Lord. ||29||
The True Lord fashioned the earth for the sake of the Gurmukhs.

941.g: ਤਿਸ ਮਹਿ ਓਪਤਿ ਖਪਤਿ ਸੁ ਬਾਜੀ ॥
941.t: tis meh opat khapat su baajee ||
941.e: There, he set in motion the play of creation and destruction.

941.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਪੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
941.t: gur kai sabadh rapai ra(n)g lai ||
941.e: One who is filled with the Word of the Guru's Shabad enshrines love for the Lord.

941.g: ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤਉ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
941.t: saach ratau pat siau ghar jai ||
941.e: Attuned to the Truth, he goes to his home with honor.

941.g: ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
941.t: saach sabadh bin pat nahee paavai ||
941.e: Without the True Word of the Shabad, no one receives honor.

941.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਉ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੩੦॥
941.t: naanak bin naavai kiau saach samaavai ||30||
941.e: O Nanak, without the Name, how can one be absorbed in Truth? ||30||
The Gurmukh obtains the eight miraculous spiritual powers, and all wisdom.
The Gurmukh crosses over the terrifying world-ocean, and obtains true understanding.
The Gurmukh knows the ways of truth and untruth.
The Gurmukh knows worldliness and renunciation.
The Gurmukh crosses over, and carries others across as well.
O Nanak, the Gurmukh is emancipated through the Shabad. ||31||
Attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, egotism is dispelled.
Attuned to the Naam, they remain absorbed in the True Lord.
Attuned to the Naam, they contemplate the Way of Yoga.
Attuned to the Naam, they find the door of liberation.
Attuned to the Naam, they understand the three worlds.

941.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੩੨॥
941.t: naanak naam rate sadhaa sukh hoi ||32||
941.e: O Nanak, attuned to the Naam, eternal peace is found. ||32||
Attuned to the Naam, they attain Sidh Gosht - conversation with the Siddhas.
Attuned to the Naam, they practice intense meditation forever.
Attuned to the Naam, they live the true and excellent lifestyle.
Attuned to the Naam, they contemplate the Lord's virtues and spiritual wisdom.
Without the Name, all that is spoken is useless.

941.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥੩੩॥
941.t: naanak naam rate tin kau jaikaar ||33||
941.e: O Nanak, attuned to the Naam, their victory is celebrated. ||33||

941.g: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
941.t: poore gur te naam paiaa jai ||
941.e: Through the Perfect Guru, one obtains the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
The Way of Yoga is to remain absorbed in Truth.

941.g: ਬਾਰਹ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਭਰਮਾਏ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਛਿਅ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
941.t: baareh meh jogee bharamaae sa(n)niaasee chhia chaar ||
941.e: The Yogis wander in the twelve schools of Yoga; the Sannyaasis in six and four.

941.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜੋ ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
941.t: gur kai sabadh jo mar jeevai so paae mokh dhuaar ||
941.e: One who remains dead while yet alive, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, finds the door of liberation.

942.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਸਭਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਗੇ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
942.t: bin sabadhai sabh dhoojai laage dhekhahu ridhai beechaar ||
942.e: Without the Shabad, all are attached to duality. Contemplate this in your heart, and see.

942.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਡੇ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੩੪॥
942.t: naanak vadde se vaddabhaagee jinee sach rakhiaa ur dhaar ||34||
942.e: O Nanak, blessed and very fortunate are those who keep the True Lord enshrined in their hearts. ||34||
The Gurmukh obtains the jewel, lovingly focused on the Lord.
The Gurmukh intuitively recognizes the value of this jewel.
The Gurmukh practices Truth in action.
The mind of the Gurmukh is pleased with the True Lord.
The Gurmukh sees the unseen, when it pleases the Lord.
O Nanak, the Gurmukh does not have to endure punishment. ||35||
The Gurmukh is blessed with the Name, charity and purification.
The Gurmukh centers his meditation on the celestial Lord.
The Gurmukh obtains honor in the Court of the Lord.
The Gurmukh obtains the Supreme Lord, the Destroyer of fear.
The Gurmukh does good deeds, and inspires others to do so.
O Nanak, the Gurmukh unites in the Lord's Union. ||36||
The Gurmukh understands the Simritees, the Shaastras and the Vedas.
The Gurmukh knows the secrets of each and every heart.
The Gurmukh eliminates hate and envy.
The Gurmukh erases all accounting.
The Gurmukh is imbued with love for the Lord's Name.
O Nanak, the Gurmukh realizes his Lord and Master. ||37||
Without the Guru, one wanders, coming and going in reincarnation.

942.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਘਾਲ ਨ ਪਵਈ ਥਾਇ ॥
942.t: bin gur ghaal na paviee thai ||
942.e: Without the Guru, one's work is useless.
Without the Guru, the mind is totally unsteady.

942.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
942.t: bin gur tirapat nahee bikh khai ||
942.e: Without the Guru, one is unsatisfied, and eats poison.

942.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਸੀਅਰੁ ਡਸੈ ਮਰਿ ਵਾਟ ॥
942.t: bin gur biseear ddasai mar vaaT ||
942.e: Without the Guru, one is stung by the poisonous snake of Maya, and dies.
O Nanak without the Guru, all is lost. ||38||

942.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੈ ॥
942.t: jis gur milai tis paar utaarai ||
942.e: One who meets the Guru is carried across.
His sins are erased, and he is emancipated through virtue.

942.g: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
942.t: mukat mahaa sukh gur sabadh beechaar ||
942.e: The supreme peace of liberation is attained, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
The Gurmukh is never defeated.
In the store of the body, this mind is the merchant;
O Nanak, it deals intuitively in Truth. ||39||
The Gurmukh is the bridge, built by the Architect of Destiny.
The demons of passion which plundered Sri Lanka - the body - have been conquered.
Ram Chand - the mind - has slaughtered Raawan - pride;
the Gurmukh understands the secret revealed by Babheekhan.
The Gurmukh carries even stones across the ocean.
The Gurmukh saves millions of people. ||40||
The comings and goings in reincarnation are ended for the Gurmukh.
The Gurmukh is honored in the Court of the Lord.
The Gurmukh distinguishes the true from the false.
The Gurmukh focuses his meditation on the celestial Lord.
In the Court of the Lord, the Gurmukh is absorbed in His Praises.
O Nanak, the Gurmukh is not bound by bonds. ||41||
The Gurmukh obtains the Name of the Immaculate Lord.
Through the Shabad, the Gurmukh burns away his ego.
The Gurmukh sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord.
The Gurmukh remains absorbed in the True Lord.

942.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਇ ॥
942.t: gurmukh saach naam pat uootam hoi ||
942.e: Through the True Name, the Gurmukh is honored and exalted.

942.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਗਲ ਭਵਣ ਕੀ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਇ ॥੪੨॥
942.t: naanak gurmukh sagal bhavan kee sojhee hoi ||42||
942.e: O Nanak, the Gurmukh understands all the worlds. ||42||
"What is the root, the source of all? What teachings hold for these times?

942.g: ਤੇਰਾ ਕਵਣੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਤੂ ਚੇਲਾ ॥
942.t: teraa kavan guroo jis kaa too chelaa ||
942.e: Who is your guru? Whose disciple are you?
What is that speech, by which you remain unattached?
Listen to what we say, O Nanak, you little boy.
Give us your opinion on what we have said.
How can the Shabad carry us across the terrifying world-ocean?""||43||

943.e: From the air came the beginning. This is the age of the True Guru's Teachings.
The Shabad is the Guru, upon whom I lovingly focus my consciousness; I am the chaylaa, the disciple.
Speaking the Unspoken Speech, I remain unattached.
O Nanak, throughout the ages, the Lord of the World is my Guru.
I contemplate the sermon of the Shabad, the Word of the One God.
The Gurmukh puts out the fire of egotism. ||44||

943.g: ਮੈਣ ਕੇ ਦੰਤ ਕਿਉ ਖਾਈਐ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
943.t: main ke dha(n)t kiau khaieeaai saar ||
943.e: "With teeth of wax, how can one chew iron?

943.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਗਰਬੁ ਜਾਇ ਸੁ ਕਵਣੁ ਆਹਾਰੁ ॥
943.t: jit garab jai su kavan aahaar ||
943.e: What is that food, which takes away pride?

943.g: ਹਿਵੈ ਕਾ ਘਰੁ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਪਿਰਾਹਨੁ ॥
943.t: hivai kaa ghar ma(n)dhar agan piraahan ||
943.e: How can one live in the palace, the home of snow, wearing robes of fire?
Where is that cave, within which one may remain unshaken?

943.g: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਜਾਣਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
943.t: eit ut kis kau jaan samaavai ||
943.e: Who should we know to be pervading here and there?
What is that meditation, which leads the mind to be absorbed in itself?""||45||

943.g: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਮੈ ਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
943.t: hau hau mai mai vichahu khovai ||
943.e: Eradicating egotism and individualism from within,
and erasing duality, the mortal becomes one with God.
The world is difficult for the foolish, self-willed manmukh;
practicing the Shabad, one chews iron.
Know the One Lord, inside and out.

943.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ॥੪੬॥
943.t: naanak agan marai satigur kai bhaanai ||46||
943.e: O Nanak, the fire is quenched, through the Pleasure of the True Guru's Will. ||46||
Imbued with the True Fear of God, pride is taken away;
realize that He is One, and contemplate the Shabad.
With the True Shabad abiding deep within the heart,
the body and mind are cooled and soothed, and colored with the Lord's Love.
The fire of sexual desire, anger and corruption is quenched.
O Nanak, the Beloved bestows His Glance of Grace. ||47||

943.g: ਕਵਨ ਮੁਖਿ ਚੰਦੁ ਹਿਵੈ ਘਰੁ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
943.t: kavan mukh cha(n)dh hivai ghar chhaiaa ||
943.e: "The moon of the mind is cool and dark; how is it enlightened?
How does the sun blaze so brilliantly?

943.g: ਕਵਨ ਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਜੋਹਤ ਨਿਤ ਰਹੈ ॥
943.t: kavan mukh kaal johat nit rahai ||
943.e: How can the constant watchful gaze of Death be turned away?
By what understanding is the honor of the Gurmukh preserved?
Who is the warrior, who conquers Death?
Give us your thoughtful reply, O Nanak.""||48||
Giving voice to the Shabad, the moon of the mind is illuminated with infinity.

943.g: ਸਸਿ ਘਰਿ ਸੂਰੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਿਟੈ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥
943.t: sas ghar soor vasai miTai a(n)dhiaaraa ||
943.e: When the sun dwells in the house of the moon, the darkness is dispelled.

943.g: ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
943.t: sukh dhukh sam kar naam adhaaraa ||
943.e: Pleasure and pain are just the same, when one takes the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
He Himself saves, and carries us across.
With faith in the Guru, the mind merges in Truth,
and then, prays Nanak, one is not consumed by Death. ||49||

943.g: ਨਾਮ ਤਤੁ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
943.t: naam tat sabh hee sir jaapai ||
943.e: The essence of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is known to be the most exalted and excellent of all.
Without the Name, one is afflicted by pain and death.
When one's essence merges into the essence, the mind is satisfied and fulfilled.
Duality is gone, and one enters into the home of the One Lord.
The breath blows across the sky of the Tenth Gate and vibrates.
O Nanak, the mortal then intuitively meets the eternal, unchanging Lord. ||50||

943.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੁੰਨੰ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੁੰਨੰ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੁੰਨ ਮਸੁੰਨੰ ॥
943.t: a(n)tar su(n)na(n) baahar su(n)na(n) tirabhavan su(n)n masu(n)na(n) ||
943.e: The absolute Lord is deep within; the absolute Lord is outside us as well. The absolute Lord totally fills the three worlds.

943.g: ਚਉਥੇ ਸੁੰਨੈ ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਪਾਪੁ ਨ ਪੁੰਨੰ ॥
943.t: chauthe su(n)nai jo nar jaanai taa kau paap na pu(n)na(n) ||
943.e: One who knows the Lord in the fourth state, is not subject to virtue or vice.

943.g: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸੁੰਨ ਕਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਭੇਉ ॥ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦੇਉ ॥
943.t: ghaT ghaT su(n)n kaa jaanai bheau || aadh purakh nira(n)jan dheau ||
943.e: One who knows the mystery of God the Absolute, who pervades each and every heart, knows the Primal Being, the Immaculate Divine Lord.
That humble being who is imbued with the Immaculate Naam,
O Nanak, is himself the Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny. ||51||
"Everyone speaks of the Absolute Lord, the unmanifest void.
How can one find this absolute void?
Who are they, who are attuned to this absolute void?""

943.g: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੇ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਜੈਸੇ ॥
943.t: jis te upaje tis hee jaise ||
943.e: They are like the Lord, from whom they originated.

943.g: ਓਇ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਮਰਹਿ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
943.t: oi janam na mareh na aaveh jaeh ||
943.e: They are not born, they do not die; they do not come and go.
O Nanak, the Gurmukhs instruct their minds. ||52||
By practicing control over the nine gates, one attains perfect control over the Tenth Gate.
There, the unstruck sound current of the absolute Lord vibrates and resounds.
Behold the True Lord ever-present, and merge with Him.
The True Lord is pervading and permeating each and every heart.

944.g: ਗੁਪਤੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
944.t: gupatee baanee paragaT hoi ||
944.e: The hidden Bani of the Word is revealed.

944.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਖਿ ਲਏ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੫੩॥
944.t: naanak parakh le sach soi ||53||
944.e: O Nanak, the True Lord is revealed and known. ||53||

944.g: ਸਹਜ ਭਾਇ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
944.t: sahaj bhai mileeaai sukh hovai ||
944.e: Meeting with the Lord through intuition and love, peace is found.

944.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਗੈ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਸੋਵੈ ॥
944.t: gurmukh jaagai needh na sovai ||
944.e: The Gurmukh remains awake and aware; he does not fall sleep.

944.g: ਸੁੰਨ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਿ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
944.t: su(n)n sabadh apara(n)par dhaarai ||
944.e: He enshrines the unlimited, absolute Shabad deep within.

944.g: ਕਹਤੇ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੈ ॥
944.t: kahate mukat sabadh nisataarai ||
944.e: Chanting the Shabad, he is liberated, and saves others as well.

944.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
944.t: gur kee dheekhiaa se sach raate ||
944.e: Those who practice the Guru's Teachings are attuned to the Truth.

944.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਮਿਲਣ ਨਹੀ ਭ੍ਰਾਤੇ ॥੫੪॥
944.t: naanak aap gavai milan nahee bhraate ||54||
944.e: O Nanak, those who eradicate their self-conceit meet with the Lord; they do not remain separated by doubt. ||54||

944.g: ਕੁਬੁਧਿ ਚਵਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਿਤੁ ਠਾਇ ॥
944.t: kubudh chavaavai so kit Thai ||
944.e: "Where is that place, where evil thoughts are destroyed?

944.g: ਕਿਉ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
944.t: kiau tat na boojhai choTaa khai ||
944.e: The mortal does not understand the essence of reality; why must he suffer in pain?""

944.g: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਾਧੇ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
944.t: jam dhar baadhe koi na raakhai ||
944.e: No one can save one who is tied up at Death's door.

944.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਤਿ ਸਾਖੈ ॥
944.t: bin sabadhai naahee pat saakhai ||
944.e: Without the Shabad, no one has any credit or honor.

944.g: ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
944.t: kiau kar boojhai paavai paar ||
944.e: "How can one obtain understanding and cross over?"

944.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਨ ਬੁਝੈ ਗਵਾਰੁ ॥੫੫॥
944.t: naanak manmukh na bujhai gavaar ||55||
944.e: O Nanak, the foolish self-willed manmukh does not understand. ||55||

944.g: ਕੁਬੁਧਿ ਮਿਟੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
944.t: kubudh miTai gur sabadh beechaar ||
944.e: Evil thoughts are erased, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

944.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
944.t: satigur bheTai mokh dhuaar ||
944.e: Meeting with the True Guru, the door of liberation is found.

944.g: ਤਤੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੈ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
944.t: tat na cheenai manmukh jal jai ||
944.e: The self-willed manmukh does not understand the essence of reality, and is burnt to ashes.

944.g: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
944.t: dhuramat vichhuR choTaa khai ||
944.e: His evil-mindedness separates him from the Lord, and he suffers.

944.g: ਮਾਨੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਭੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਿਆਨ ॥
944.t: maanai hukam sabhe gun giaan ||
944.e: Accepting the Hukam of the Lord's Command, he is blessed with all virtues and spiritual wisdom.

944.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੫੬॥
944.t: naanak dharageh paavai maan ||56||
944.e: O Nanak, he is honored in the Court of the Lord. ||56||

944.g: ਸਾਚੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਹੋਇ ॥
944.t: saach vakhar dhan palai hoi ||
944.e: One who possesses the merchandise, the wealth of the True Name,

944.g: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਤਾਰੇ ਭੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
944.t: aap tarai taare bhee soi ||
944.e: crosses over, and carries others across with him as well.

944.g: ਸਹਜਿ ਰਤਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
944.t: sahaj rataa boojhai pat hoi ||
944.e: One who intuitively understands, and is attuned to the Lord, is honored.

944.g: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
944.t: taa kee keemat karai na koi ||
944.e: No one can estimate his worth.

944.g: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
944.t: jeh dhekhaa teh rahiaa samai ||
944.e: Wherever I look, I see the Lord permeating and pervading.

944.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੈ ਸਚ ਭਾਇ ॥੫੭॥
944.t: naanak paar parai sach bhai ||57||
944.e: O Nanak, through the Love of the True Lord, one crosses over. ||57||

944.g: ਸੁ ਸਬਦ ਕਾ ਕਹਾ ਵਾਸੁ ਕਥੀਅਲੇ ਜਿਤੁ ਤਰੀਐ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ॥
944.t: s sabadh kaa kahaa vaas katheeale jit tareeaai bhavajal sa(n)saaro ||
944.e: "Where is the Shabad said to dwell? What will carry us across the terrifying world-ocean?

944.g: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਸਤ ਅੰਗੁਲ ਵਾਈ ਕਹੀਐ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਹੁ ਕਵਨੁ ਅਧਾਰੋ ॥
944.t: trai sat a(n)gul vaiee kaheeaai tis kahu kavan adhaaro ||
944.e: The breath, when exhaled, extends out ten finger lengths; what is the support of the breath?

944.g: ਬੋਲੈ ਖੇਲੈ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਏ ॥
944.t: bolai khelai asathir hovai kiau kar alakh lakhaae ||
944.e: Speaking and playing, how can one be stable and steady? How can the unseen be seen?""

944.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਅਪਣੇ ਮਨ ਸਮਝਾਏ ॥
944.t: sun suaamee sach naanak pranavai apane man samajhaae ||
944.e: Listen, O master; Nanak prays truly. Instruct your own mind.

944.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੇ ਸਚਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੈ ਕਰਿ ਨਦਰੀ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
944.t: gurmukh sabadhe sach liv laagai kar nadharee mel milaae ||
944.e: The Gurmukh is lovingly attuned to the True Shabad. Bestowing His Glance of Grace, He unites us in His Union.

944.g: ਆਪੇ ਦਾਨਾ ਆਪੇ ਬੀਨਾ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੫੮॥
944.t: aape dhaanaa aape beenaa poorai bhaag samaae ||58||
944.e: He Himself is all-knowing and all-seeing. By perfect destiny, we merge in Him. ||58||

944.g: ਸੁ ਸਬਦ ਕਉ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਅਲਖੰ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਸੋਈ ॥
944.t: s sabadh kau nira(n)tar vaas alakha(n) jeh dhekhaa teh soiee ||
944.e: That Shabad dwells deep within the nucleus of all beings. God is invisible; wherever I look, there I see Him.

944.g: ਪਵਨ ਕਾ ਵਾਸਾ ਸੁੰਨ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ਅਕਲ ਕਲਾ ਧਰ ਸੋਈ ॥
944.t: pavan kaa vaasaa su(n)n nivaasaa akal kalaa dhar soiee ||
944.e: The air is the dwelling place of the absolute Lord. He has no qualities; He has all qualities.

944.g: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਵਸੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
944.t: nadhar kare sabadh ghaT meh vasai vichahu bharam gavaae ||
944.e: When He bestows His Glance of Grace, the Shabad comes to abide within the heart, and doubt is eradicated from within.

944.g: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮੋੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
944.t: tan man niramal niramal baanee naamuo ma(n)n vasaae ||
944.e: The body and mind become immaculate, through the Immaculate Word of His Bani. Let His Name be enshrined in your mind.

944.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਭਵਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰੀਐ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
944.t: sabadh guroo bhavasaagar tareeaai it ut eko jaanai ||
944.e: The Shabad is the Guru, to carry you across the terrifying world-ocean. Know the One Lord alone, here and hereafter.

944.g: ਚਿਹਨੁ ਵਰਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਛਾਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੫੯॥
944.t: chihan varan nahee chhaiaa maiaa naanak sabadh pachhaanai ||59||
944.e: He has no form or color, shadow or illusion; O Nanak, realize the Shabad. ||59||

944.g: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਸਤ ਅੰਗੁਲ ਵਾਈ ਅਉਧੂ ਸੁੰਨ ਸਚੁ ਆਹਾਰੋ ॥
944.t: trai sat a(n)gul vaiee aaudhoo su(n)n sach aahaaro ||
944.e: O reclusive hermit, the True, Absolute Lord is the support of the exhaled breath, which extends out ten finger lengths.

944.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੈ ਤਤੁ ਬਿਰੋਲੈ ਚੀਨੈ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੋ ॥
944.t: gurmukh bolai tat birolai cheenai alakh apaaro ||
944.e: The Gurmukh speaks and churns the essence of reality, and realizes the unseen, infinite Lord.

944.g: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮੇਟੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸਾਏ ਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਚੂਕੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੋ ॥
944.t: trai gun meTai sabadh vasaae taa man chookai aha(n)kaaro ||
944.e: Eradicating the three qualities, he enshrines the Shabad within, and then, his mind is rid of egotism.

944.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
944.t: a(n)tar baahar eko jaanai taa har naam lagai piaaro ||
944.e: Inside and out, he knows the One Lord alone; he is in love with the Name of the Lord.

944.g: ਸੁਖਮਨਾ ਇੜਾ ਪਿੰਗੁਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਏ ॥
944.t: sukhamanaa iRaa pi(n)gulaa boojhai jaa aape alakh lakhaae ||
944.e: He understands the Sushmana, Ida and Pingala, when the unseen Lord reveals Himself.

944.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਹੁ ਤੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੬੦॥
944.t: naanak tih te uoopar saachaa satigur sabadh samaae ||60||
944.e: O Nanak, the True Lord is above these three energy channels. Through the Word, the Shabad of the True Guru, one merges with Him. ||60||

944.g: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਵਨੁ ਕਥੀਅਲੇ ਪਵਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਈ ॥
944.t: man kaa jeeau pavan katheeale pavan kahaa ras khaiee ||
944.e: "The air is said to be the soul of the mind. But what does the air feed on?

944.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਕੀ ਮੁਦ੍ਰਾ ਕਵਨ ਅਉਧੂ ਸਿਧ ਕੀ ਕਵਨ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
944.t: giaan kee mudhraa kavan aaudhoo sidh kee kavan kamaiee ||
944.e: What is the way of the spiritual teacher, and the reclusive hermit? What is the occupation of the Siddha?""

945.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਰਸੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਅਉਧੂ ਹਉਮੈ ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
945.t: bin sabadhai ras na aavai aaudhoo haumai piaas na jaiee ||
945.e: Without the Shabad, the essence does not come, O hermit, and the thirst of egotism does not depart.

945.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਚੇ ਰਹੇ ਅਘਾਈ ॥
945.t: sabadh rate a(n)mirat ras paiaa saache rahe aghaiee ||
945.e: Imbued with the Shabad, one finds the ambrosial essence, and remains fulfilled with the True Name.

945.g: ਕਵਨ ਬੁਧਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਰਹੀਐ ਕਿਤੁ ਭੋਜਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੈ ॥
945.t: kavan budh jit asathir raheeaai kit bhojan tirapataasai ||
945.e: "What is that wisdom, by which one remains steady and stable? What food brings satisfaction?"

945.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਪੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਗ੍ਰਾਸੈ ॥੬੧॥
945.t: naanak dhukh sukh sam kar jaapai satigur te kaal na graasai ||61||
945.e: O Nanak, when one looks upon pain and pleasure alike, through the True Guru, then he is not consumed by Death. ||61||

945.g: ਰੰਗਿ ਨ ਰਾਤਾ ਰਸਿ ਨਹੀ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
945.t: ra(n)g na raataa ras nahee maataa ||
945.e: If one is not imbued with the Lord's Love, nor intoxicated with His subtle essence,

945.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੈ ਜਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਤਾਤਾ ॥
945.t: bin gur sabadhai jal bal taataa ||
945.e: without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he is frustrated, and consumed by his own inner fire.

945.g: ਬਿੰਦੁ ਨ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਭਾਖਿਆ ॥
945.t: bi(n)dh na raakhiaa sabadh na bhaakhiaa ||
945.e: He does not preserve his semen and seed, and does not chant the Shabad.

945.g: ਪਵਨੁ ਨ ਸਾਧਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ॥
945.t: pavan na saadhiaa sach na araadhiaa ||
945.e: He does not control his breath; he does not worship and adore the True Lord.

945.g: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਲੇ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
945.t: akath kathaa le sam kar rahai ||
945.e: But one who speaks the Unspoken Speech, and remains balanced,

945.g: ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮ ਕਉ ਲਹੈ ॥੬੨॥
945.t: tau naanak aatam raam kau lahai ||62||
945.e: O Nanak, attains the Lord, the Supreme Soul. ||62||

945.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਰੰਗੇ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
945.t: gur parasaadhee ra(n)ge raataa ||
945.e: By Guru's Grace, one is attuned to the Lord's Love.

945.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ਸਾਚੇ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
945.t: a(n)mrit peeaa saache maataa ||
945.e: Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar, he is intoxicated with the Truth.

945.g: ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥
945.t: gur veechaaree agan nivaaree ||
945.e: Contemplating the Guru, the fire within is put out.

945.g: ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀਓ ਆਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
945.t: apiau peeo aatam sukh dhaaree ||
945.e: Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar, the soul settles in peace.

945.g: ਸਚੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੀ ॥
945.t: sach araadhiaa gurmukh tar taaree ||
945.e: Worshipping the True Lord in adoration, the Gurmukh crosses over the river of life.

945.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੬੩॥
945.t: naanak boojhai ko veechaaree ||63||
945.e: O Nanak, after deep contemplation, this is understood. ||63||

945.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੈਗਲੁ ਕਹਾ ਬਸੀਅਲੇ ਕਹਾ ਬਸੈ ਇਹੁ ਪਵਨਾ ॥
945.t: eih man maigal kahaa baseeale kahaa basai ih pavanaa ||
945.e: "Where does this mind-elephant live? Where does the breath reside?

945.g: ਕਹਾ ਬਸੈ ਸੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਉਧੂ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਚੂਕੈ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਭਵਨਾ ॥
945.t: kahaa basai su sabadh aaudhoo taa kau chookai man kaa bhavanaa ||
945.e: Where should the Shabad reside, so that the wanderings of the mind may cease?""

945.g: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਤਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
945.t: nadhar kare taa satigur mele taa nij ghar vaasaa ih man paae ||
945.e: When the Lord blesses one with His Glance of Grace, he leads him to the True Guru. Then, this mind dwells in its own home within.

945.g: ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਖਾਇ ਤਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਵਰਜਿ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
945.t: aapai aap khai taa niramal hovai dhaavat varaj rahaae ||
945.e: When the individual consumes his egotism, he becomes immaculate, and his wandering mind is restrained.

945.g: ਕਿਉ ਮੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਆਤਮੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਿਉ ਸਸਿ ਘਰਿ ਸੂਰੁ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
945.t: kiau mool pachhaanai aatam jaanai kiau sas ghar soor samaavai ||
945.e: "How can the root, the source of all be realized? How can the soul know itself? How can the sun enter into the house of the moon?"

945.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਖੋਵੈ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੬੪॥
945.t: gurmukh haumai vichahu khovai tau naanak sahaj samaavai ||64||
945.e: The Gurmukh eliminates egotism from within; then, O Nanak, the sun naturally enters into the home of the moon. ||64||

945.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸੀਅਲੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਣਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
945.t: eih man nihachal hiradhai vaseeale gurmukh mool pachhaan rahai ||
945.e: When the mind becomes steady and stable, it abides in the heart, and then the Gurmukh realizes the root, the source of all.

945.g: ਨਾਭਿ ਪਵਨੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਸਣਿ ਬੈਸੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਜਤ ਤਤੁ ਲਹੈ ॥
945.t: naabh pavan ghar aasan baisai gurmukh khojat tat lahai ||
945.e: The breath is seated in the home of the navel; the Gurmukh searches, and finds the essence of reality.

945.g: ਸੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਆਛੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਜੋਤਿ ਸੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਹੈ ॥
945.t: s sabadh nira(n)tar nij ghar aachhai tirabhavan jot su sabadh lahai ||
945.e: This Shabad permeates the nucleus of the self, deep within, in its own home; the Light of this Shabad pervades the three worlds.

945.g: ਖਾਵੈ ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
945.t: khaavai dhookh bhookh saache kee saache hee tirapataas rahai ||
945.e: Hunger for the True Lord shall consume your pain, and through the True Lord, you shall be satisfied.

945.g: ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣੀ ਬਿਰਲੋ ਕੋ ਅਰਥਾਵੈ ॥
945.t: anahadh baanee gurmukh jaanee biralo ko arathaavai ||
945.e: The Gurmukh knows the unstruck sound current of the Bani; how rare are those who understand.

945.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਭਾਖੈ ਸਚਿ ਰਪੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੬੫॥
945.t: naanak aakhai sach subhaakhai sach rapai ra(n)g kabahoo na jaavai ||65||
945.e: Says Nanak, one who speaks the Truth is dyed in the color of Truth, which will never fade away. ||65||

945.g: ਜਾ ਇਹੁ ਹਿਰਦਾ ਦੇਹ ਨ ਹੋਤੀ ਤਉ ਮਨੁ ਕੈਠੈ ਰਹਤਾ ॥
945.t: jaa ih hiradhaa dheh na hotee tau man kaiThai rahataa ||
945.e: "When this heart and body did not exist, where did the mind reside?

945.g: ਨਾਭਿ ਕਮਲ ਅਸਥੰਭੁ ਨ ਹੋਤੋ ਤਾ ਪਵਨੁ ਕਵਨ ਘਰਿ ਸਹਤਾ ॥
945.t: naabh kamal asatha(n)bh na hoto taa pavan kavan ghar sahataa ||
945.e: When there was no support of the navel lotus, then in which home did the breath reside?

945.g: ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਹੋਤੋ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਤਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਕਹਾ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
945.t: roop na hoto rekh na kaiee taa sabadh kahaa liv laiee ||
945.e: When there was no form or shape, then how could anyone lovingly focus on the Shabad?

945.g: ਰਕਤੁ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਕੀ ਮੜੀ ਨ ਹੋਤੀ ਮਿਤਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
945.t: rakat bi(n)dh kee maRee na hotee mit keemat nahee paiee ||
945.e: When there was no dungeon formed from egg and sperm, who could measure the Lord's value and extent?

945.g: ਵਰਨੁ ਭੇਖੁ ਅਸਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੀ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਪਸਿ ਸਾਚਾ ॥
945.t: varan bhekh asaroop na jaapee kiau kar jaapas saachaa ||
945.e: When color, dress and form could not be seen, how could the True Lord be known?""

945.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਇਬ ਤਬ ਸਾਚੋ ਸਾਚਾ ॥੬੬॥
945.t: naanak naam rate bairaagee ib tab saacho saachaa ||66||
945.e: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are detached. Then and now, they see the Truest of the True. ||66||

945.g: ਹਿਰਦਾ ਦੇਹ ਨ ਹੋਤੀ ਅਉਧੂ ਤਉ ਮਨੁ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਰਹੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
945.t: hiradhaa dheh na hotee aaudhoo tau man su(n)n rahai bairaagee ||
945.e: When the heart and the body did not exist, O hermit, then the mind resided in the absolute, detached Lord.

945.g: ਨਾਭਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਅਸਥੰਭੁ ਨ ਹੋਤੋ ਤਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਬਸਤਉ ਪਵਨੁ ਅਨਰਾਗੀ ॥
945.t: naabh kamal asatha(n)bh na hoto taa nij ghar basatau pavan anaraagee ||
945.e: When there was no support of the lotus of the navel, the breath remained in its own home, attuned to the Lord's Love.

945.g: ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਤੀ ਤਉ ਅਕੁਲੀਣਿ ਰਹਤਉ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
945.t: roop na rekhiaa jaat na hotee tau akuleen rahatau sabadhu su saar ||
945.e: When there was no form or shape or social class, then the Shabad, in its essence, resided in the unmanifest Lord.

945.g: ਗਉਨੁ ਗਗਨੁ ਜਬ ਤਬਹਿ ਨ ਹੋਤਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਜੋਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
945.t: gaun gagan jab tabeh na hotau tirabhavan jot aape nira(n)kaar ||
945.e: When the world and the sky did not even exist, the Light of the Formless Lord filled the three worlds.

946.g: ਵਰਨੁ ਭੇਖੁ ਅਸਰੂਪੁ ਸੁ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ॥
946.t: varan bhekh asaroopu su eko eko sabadh viddaanee ||
946.e: Color, dress and form were contained in the One Lord; the Shabad was contained in the One, Wondrous Lord.

946.g: ਸਾਚ ਬਿਨਾ ਸੂਚਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥੬੭॥
946.t: saach binaa soochaa ko naahee naanak akath kahaanee ||67||
946.e: Without the True Name, no one can become pure; O Nanak, this is the Unspoken Speech. ||67||

946.g: ਕਿਤੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਗੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਪੁਰਖਾ ਕਿਤੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਦੁਖਿ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
946.t: kit kit bidh jag upajai purakhaa kit kit dhukh binas jaiee ||
946.e: "How, in what way, was the world formed, O man? And what disaster will end it?"

946.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਗੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਪੁਰਖਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਿਸਰਿਐ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
946.t: haumai vich jag upajai purakhaa naam visariaai dhukh paiee ||
946.e: In egotism, the world was formed, O man; forgetting the Naam, it suffers and dies.

946.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
946.t: gurmukh hovai su giaan tat beechaarai haumai sabadh jalaae ||
946.e: One who becomes Gurmukh contemplates the essence of spiritual wisdom; through the Shabad, he burns away his egotism.

946.g: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਾਚੈ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
946.t: tan man niramal niramal baanee saachai rahai samaae ||
946.e: His body and mind become immaculate, through the Immaculate Bani of the Word. He remains absorbed in Truth.

946.g: ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
946.t: naame naam rahai bairaagee saach rakhiaa ur dhaare ||
946.e: Through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he remains detached; he enshrines the True Name in his heart.

946.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੬੮॥
946.t: naanak bin naavai jog kadhe na hovai dhekhahu ridhai beechaare ||68||
946.e: O Nanak, without the Name, Yoga is never attained; reflect upon this in your heart, and see. ||68||

946.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
946.t: gurmukh saach sabadh beechaarai koi ||
946.e: The Gurmukh is one who reflects upon the True Word of the Shabad.

946.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
946.t: gurmukh sach baanee paragaT hoi ||
946.e: The True Bani is revealed to the Gurmukh.

946.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
946.t: gurmukh man bheejai viralaa boojhai koi ||
946.e: The mind of the Gurmukh is drenched with the Lord's Love, but how rare are those who understand this.

946.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
946.t: gurmukh nij ghar vaasaa hoi ||
946.e: The Gurmukh dwells in the home of the self, deep within.

946.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
946.t: gurmukh jogee jugat pachhaanai ||
946.e: The Gurmukh realizes the Way of Yoga.

946.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥੬੯॥
946.t: gurmukh naanak eko jaanai ||69||
946.e: O Nanak, the Gurmukh knows the One Lord alone. ||69||

946.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
946.t: bin satigur seve jog na hoiee ||
946.e: Without serving the True Guru, Yoga is not attained;

946.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
946.t: bin satigur bheTe mukat na koiee ||
946.e: without meeting the True Guru, no one is liberated.

946.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
946.t: bin satigur bheTe naam paiaa na jai ||
946.e: Without meeting the True Guru, the Naam cannot be found.

946.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
946.t: bin satigur bheTe mahaa dhukh pai ||
946.e: Without meeting the True Guru, one suffers in terrible pain.

946.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਮਹਾ ਗਰਬਿ ਗੁਬਾਰਿ ॥
946.t: bin satigur bheTe mahaa garab gubaar ||
946.e: Without meeting the True Guru, there is only the deep darkness of egotistical pride.

946.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਆ ਜਨਮੁ ਹਾਰਿ ॥੭੦॥
946.t: naanak bin gur muaa janam haar ||70||
946.e: O Nanak, without the True Guru, one dies, having lost the opportunity of this life. ||70||

946.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਤਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
946.t: gurmukh man jeetaa haumai maar ||
946.e: The Gurmukh conquers his mind by subduing his ego.

946.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
946.t: gurmukh saach rakhiaa ur dhaar ||
946.e: The Gurmukh enshrines Truth in his heart.

946.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਗੁ ਜੀਤਾ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਬਿਦਾਰਿ ॥
946.t: gurmukh jag jeetaa jamakaal maar bidhaar ||
946.e: The Gurmukh conquers the world; he knocks down the Messenger of Death, and kills it.

946.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
946.t: gurmukh dharageh na aavai haar ||
946.e: The Gurmukh does not lose in the Court of the Lord.

946.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਸੋੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
946.t: gurmukh mel milaae suo jaanai ||
946.e: The Gurmukh is united in God's Union; he alone knows.

946.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੭੧॥
946.t: naanak gurmukh sabadh pachhaanai ||71||
946.e: O Nanak, the Gurmukh realizes the Word of the Shabad. ||71||

946.g: ਸਬਦੈ ਕਾ ਨਿਬੇੜਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਤੂ ਅਉਧੂ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
946.t: sabadhai kaa nibeRaa sun too aaudhoo bin naavai jog na hoiee ||
946.e: This is the essence of the Shabad - listen, you hermits and Yogis. Without the Name, there is no Yoga.

946.g: ਨਾਮੇ ਰਾਤੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਮਾਤੇ ਨਾਮੈ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
946.t: naame raate anadhin maate naamai te sukh hoiee ||
946.e: Those who are attuned to the Name, remain intoxicated night and day; through the Name, they find peace.

946.g: ਨਾਮੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
946.t: naamai hee te sabh paragaT hovai naame sojhee paiee ||
946.e: Through the Name, everything is revealed; through the Name, understanding is obtained.

946.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਸਚੈ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਈ ॥
946.t: bin naavai bhekh kareh bahutere sachai aap khuaaiee ||
946.e: Without the Name, people wear all sorts of religious robes; the True Lord Himself has confused them.

946.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਉਧੂ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਤਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
946.t: satigur te naam paieeaai aaudhoo jog jugat taa hoiee ||
946.e: The Name is obtained only from the True Guru, O hermit, and then, the Way of Yoga is found.

946.g: ਕਰਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਮਨਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੭੨॥
946.t: kar beechaar man dhekhahu naanak bin naavai mukat na hoiee ||72||
946.e: Reflect upon this in your mind, and see; O Nanak, without the Name, there is no liberation. ||72||

946.g: ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
946.t: teree gat mit toohai jaaneh kiaa ko aakh vakhaanai ||
946.e: You alone know Your state and extent, Lord; What can anyone say about it?

946.g: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਪਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਭਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੈ ॥
946.t: too aape gupataa aape paragaT aape sabh ra(n)g maanai ||
946.e: You Yourself are hidden, and You Yourself are revealed. You Yourself enjoy all pleasures.

946.g: ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਗੁਰੂ ਬਹੁ ਚੇਲੇ ਖੋਜਤ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਣੈ ॥
946.t: saadhik sidh guroo bahu chele khojat fireh furamaanai ||
946.e: The seekers, the Siddhas, the many gurus and disciples wander around searching for You, according to Your Will.

946.g: ਮਾਗਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇ ਇਹ ਭਿਖਿਆ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੈ ॥
946.t: maageh naam pai ieh bhikhiaa tere dharasan kau kurabaanai ||
946.e: They beg for Your Name, and You bless them with this charity. I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

946.g: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
946.t: abinaasee prabh khel rachaiaa gurmukh sojhee hoiee ||
946.e: The eternal imperishable Lord God has staged this play; the Gurmukh understands it.

946.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭਿ ਜੁਗ ਆਪੇ ਵਰਤੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੭੩॥੧॥
946.t: naanak sabh jug aape varatai dhoojaa avar na koiee ||73||1||
946.e: O Nanak, He extends Himself throughout the ages; there is no other than Him. ||73||1||

947.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
947.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
947.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

947.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
947.t: raamakalee kee vaar mahalaa teejaa ||
947.e: Vaar Of Raamkalee, Third Mehla,

947.g: ਜੋਧੈ ਵੀਰੈ ਪੂਰਬਾਣੀ ਕੀ ਧੁਨੀ ॥
947.t: jodhai veerai poorabaanee kee dhunee ||
947.e: To Be Sung To The Tune Of 'Jodha And Veera Poorbaanee':

947.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
947.t: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
947.e: Shalok, Third Mehla:

947.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਹਜੈ ਦਾ ਖੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਏ ਭਾਉ ॥
947.t: satigur sahajai dhaa khet hai jis no laae bhaau ||
947.e: The True Guru is the field of intuitive wisdom. One who is inspired to love Him,

947.g: ਨਾਉ ਬੀਜੇ ਨਾਉ ਉਗਵੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
947.t: naau beeje naau ugavai naame rahai samai ||
947.e: plants the seed of the Name there. The Name sprouts up, and he remains absorbed in the Name.

947.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਏਹੋ ਬੀਜੁ ਹੈ ਸਹਸਾ ਗਇਆ ਵਿਲਾਇ ॥
947.t: haumai eho beej hai sahasaa giaa vilai ||
947.e: But this egotism is the seed of skepticism; it has been uprooted.

947.g: ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਬੀਜੇ ਨ ਉਗਵੈ ਜੋ ਬਖਸੇ ਸੋ ਖਾਇ ॥
947.t: naa kichh beeje na ugavai jo bakhase so khai ||
947.e: It is not planted there, and it does not sprout; whatever God grants us, we eat.

947.g: ਅੰਭੈ ਸੇਤੀ ਅੰਭੁ ਰਲਿਆ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਨਿਕਸਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
947.t: a(n)bhai setee a(n)bh raliaa bahuR na nikasiaa jai ||
947.e: When water mixes with water, it cannot be separated again.

947.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਲਤੁ ਹੈ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਲੋਕਾ ਆਇ ॥
947.t: naanak gurmukh chalat hai vekhahu lokaa aai ||
947.e: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is wonderful; come, poeple, and see!

947.g: ਲੋਕੁ ਕਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਬਪੁੜਾ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਸੋਝੀ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
947.t: lok k vekhai bapuRaa jis no sojhee naeh ||
947.e: But what can the poor people see? They do not understand.

947.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਵੇਖਾਲੇ ਸੋ ਵੇਖੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
947.t: jis vekhaale so vekhai jis vasiaa man maeh ||1||
947.e: He alone sees, whom the Lord causes to see; the Lord comes to dwell in his mind. ||1||

947.t: mahalaa teejaa ||
947.e: Third Mehla:

947.g: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਦੁਖ ਕਾ ਖੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਬੀਜੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
947.t: manmukh dhukh kaa khet hai dhukh beeje dhukh khai ||
947.e: The self-willed manmukh is the field of sorrow and suffering. He plains sorrow, and eats sorrow.

947.g: ਦੁਖ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਦੁਖਿ ਮਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਤ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
947.t: dhukh vich ja(n)mai dhukh marai haumai karat vihai ||
947.e: In sorrow he is born, and in sorrow he dies. Acting in egotism, his life passes away.

947.g: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਅੰਧਾ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
947.t: aavan jaan na sujhiee a(n)dhaa a(n)dh kamai ||
947.e: He does not understand the coming and going of reincarnation; the blind man acts in blindness.

947.g: ਜੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਦਿਤੇ ਕਉ ਲਪਟਾਇ ॥
947.t: jo dhevai tisai na jaaniee dhite kau lapaTai ||
947.e: He does not know the One who gives, but he is attached to what is given.

947.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
947.t: naanak poorab likhiaa kamaavanaa avar na karanaa jai ||2||
947.e: O Nanak, he acts according to his pre-ordained destiny. He cannot do anything else. ||2||

947.t: mahalaa teejaa ||
947.e: Third Mehla:

947.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੋਇ ॥
947.t: satigur miliaai sadhaa sukh jis no aape mele soi ||
947.e: Meeting the True Guru, everlasting peace is obtained. He Himself leads us to meet Him.

947.g: ਸੁਖੈ ਏਹੁ ਬਿਬੇਕੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
947.t: sukhai eh bibek hai a(n)tar niramal hoi ||
947.e: This is the true meaning of peace, that one becomes immaculate within oneself.

947.g: ਅਗਿਆਨ ਕਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
947.t: agiaan kaa bhram kaTeeaai giaan paraapat hoi ||
947.e: The doubt of ignorance is eradicated, and spiritual wisdom is obtained.

947.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੋ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
947.t: naanak eko nadharee aaiaa jeh dhekhaa teh soi ||3||
947.e: Nanak comes to gaze upon the One Lord alone; wherever he looks, there He is. ||3||

947.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
947.t: pauRee ||
947.e: Pauree:

947.g: ਸਚੈ ਤਖਤੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ਬੈਸਣ ਕਉ ਜਾਂਈ ॥
947.t: sachai takhat rachaiaa baisan kau jaa(n)iee ||
947.e: The True Lord created His throne, upon which He sits.

947.g: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਣਾਈ ॥
947.t: sabh kichh aape aap hai gur sabadh sunaiee ||
947.e: He Himself is everything; this is what the Word of the Guru's Shabad says.

947.g: ਆਪੇ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਹਲ ਸਰਾਈ ॥
947.t: aape kudharat saajeean kar mahal saraiee ||
947.e: Through His almighty creative power, He created and fashioned the mansions and hotels.

947.g: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਚਾਨਣੇ ਪੂਰੀ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
947.t: cha(n)dh sooraj dhui chaanane pooree banat banaiee ||
947.e: He made the two lamps, the sun and the moon; He formed the perfect form.

947.g: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੇ ਆਪਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
947.t: aape vekhai sune aap gur sabadh dhiaaiee ||1||
947.e: He Himself sees, and He Himself hears; meditate on the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

947.g: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਚੇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਤੂ ਸਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
947.t: vaahu vaahu sache paatisaeh too sachee naiee ||1|| rahaau ||
947.e: Waaho! Waaho! Hail, hail, O True King! True is Your Name. ||1||Pause||

947.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
947.t: salok ||
947.e: Shalok:

947.g: ਕਬੀਰ ਮਹਿਦੀ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਘਾਲਿਆ ਆਪੁ ਪੀਸਾਇ ਪੀਸਾਇ ॥
947.t: kabeer mahidhee kar kai ghaaliaa aap peesai peesai ||
947.e: Kabeer, I have ground myself into henna paste.

947.g: ਤੈ ਸਹ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਪੁਛੀਆ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਲਾਈ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
947.t: tai seh baat na puchheeaa kabahoo na laiee pai ||1||
947.e: O my Husband Lord, You took no notice of me; You never applied me to Your feet. ||1||

947.t: mahalaa teejaa ||
947.e: Third Mehla:

947.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਹਿਦੀ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਰਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
947.t: naanak mahidhee kar kai rakhiaa so sahu nadhar karei ||
947.e: O Nanak, my Husband Lord keeps me like henna paste; He blesses me with His Glance of Grace.

947.g: ਆਪੇ ਪੀਸੈ ਆਪੇ ਘਸੈ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਲਾਇ ਲਏਇ ॥
947.t: aape peesai aape ghasai aape hee lai lei ||
947.e: He Himself grinds me, and He Himself rubs me; He Himself applies me to His feet.

947.g: ਇਹੁ ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥੨॥
947.t: eih piram piaalaa khasam kaa jai bhaavai tai dhei ||2||
947.e: This is the cup of love of my Lord and Master; He gives it as He chooses. ||2||

947.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
947.t: pauRee ||
947.e: Pauree:

947.g: ਵੇਕੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈਅਨੁ ਸਭ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥
947.t: vekee sirasaT upaieean sabh hukam aavai jai samaahee ||
947.e: You created the world with its variety; by the Hukam of Your Command, it comes, goes, and merges again in You.

947.g: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸਦਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
947.t: aape vekh vigasadhaa dhoojaa ko naahee ||
947.e: You Yourself see, and blossom forth; there is no one else at all.

947.g: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਖੁ ਤੂ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਹੀ ॥
947.t: jiau bhaavai tiau rakh too gur sabadh bujhaahee ||
947.e: As it pleases You, You keep me. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I understand You.

947.g: ਸਭਨਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਜੋਰੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਹੀ ॥
947.t: sabhanaa teraa jor hai jiau bhaavai tivai chalaahee ||
947.e: You are the strength of all. As it pleases You, You lead us on.

947.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡ ਮੈ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਈ ॥੨॥
947.t: tudh jevadd mai naeh ko kis aakh sunaiee ||2||
947.e: There is no other as great as You; unto whom should I speak and talk? ||2||

947.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
947.t: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
947.e: Shalok, Third Mehla:

947.g: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਫਿਰੀ ਫਾਵੀ ਹੋਈ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
947.t: bharam bhulaiee sabh jag firee faavee hoiee bhaal ||
947.e: Deluded by doubt, I wandered over the whole world. Searching, I became frustrated.

948.g: ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਦੇਵਈ ਕਿਆ ਚਲੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
948.t: so sahu saa(n)t na dheviee kiaa chalai tis naal ||
948.e: My Husband Lord has not blessed me with peace and tranquility; what will work with Him?

948.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਖੀਐ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
948.t: gur parasaadhee har dhiaaieeaai a(n)tar rakheeaai ur dhaar ||
948.e: By Guru's Grace, I meditate on the Lord; I enshrine Him deep within my heart.

948.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਠਿਆ ਸਹੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਤੀ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
948.t: naanak ghar baiThiaa sahu paiaa jaa kirapaa keetee karataar ||1||
948.e: O Nanak, seated in his her own home, she finds her Husband Lord, when the Creator Lord grants His Grace. ||1||

948.t: mahalaa teejaa ||
948.e: Third Mehla:

948.g: ਧੰਧਾ ਧਾਵਤ ਦਿਨੁ ਗਇਆ ਰੈਣਿ ਗਵਾਈ ਸੋਇ ॥
948.t: dha(n)dhaa dhaavat dhin giaa rain gavaiee soi ||
948.e: Chasing after worldly affairs, the day is wasted, and the night passes in sleep.

948.g: ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇਆ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਰੋਇ ॥
948.t: kooR bol bikh khaiaa manmukh chaliaa roi ||
948.e: Speaking lies, one eats poison; the self-willed manmukh departs, crying out in pain.

948.g: ਸਿਰੈ ਉਪਰਿ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥
948.t: sirai upar jam dda(n)dd hai dhoojai bhai pat khoi ||
948.e: The Mesenger of Death holds his club over the mortal's head; in the love of duality, he loses his honor.

948.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
948.t: har naam kadhe na chetio fir aavan jaanaa hoi ||
948.e: He never even thinks of the Name of the Lord; over and over again, he comes and goes in reincarnation.

948.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
948.t: gur parasaadhee har man vasai jam dda(n)dd na laagai koi ||
948.e: But if, by Guru's Grace, the Lord's Name comes to dwell in his mind, then the Messenger of Death will not strike him down with his club.

948.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
948.t: naanak sahaje mil rahai karam paraapat hoi ||2||
948.e: Then, O Nanak, he merges intuitively into the Lord, receiving His Grace. ||2||

948.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
948.t: pauRee ||
948.e: Pauree:

948.g: ਇਕਿ ਆਪਣੀ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਦੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਤੀ ॥
948.t: eik aapanee sifatee laian dhe satigur matee ||
948.e: Some are linked to His Praises, when the Lord blesses them with the Guru's Teachings.

948.g: ਇਕਨਾ ਨੋ ਨਾਉ ਬਖਸਿਓਨੁ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਤੀ ॥
948.t: eikanaa no naau bakhasion asathir har satee ||
948.e: Some are blessed with the Name of the eternal, unchanging True Lord.

948.g: ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੋ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਭਗਤੀ ॥
948.t: paun paanee baisa(n)taro hukam kareh bhagatee ||
948.e: Water, air and fire, by His Will, worship Him.

948.g: ਏਨਾ ਨੋ ਭਉ ਅਗਲਾ ਪੂਰੀ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਤੀ ॥
948.t: enaa no bhau agalaa pooree banat banatee ||
948.e: They are held in the Fear of God; He has formed the perfect form.

948.g: ਸਭੁ ਇਕੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
948.t: sabh iko hukam varatadhaa ma(n)niaai sukh paiee ||3||
948.e: The Hukam, the Command of the One Lord is all-pervasive; accepting it, peace is found. ||3||

948.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
948.t: salok ||
948.e: Shalok:

948.g: ਕਬੀਰ ਕਸਉਟੀ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਝੂਠਾ ਟਿਕੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
948.t: kabeer kasauTee raam kee jhooThaa Tikai na koi ||
948.e: Kabeer, such is the touchstone of the Lord; the false cannot even touch it.

948.g: ਰਾਮ ਕਸਉਟੀ ਸੋ ਸਹੈ ਜੋ ਮਰਜੀਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
948.t: raam kasauTee so sahai jo marajeevaa hoi ||1||
948.e: He alone passes this test of the Lord, who remains dead while yet alive. ||1||

948.t: mahalaa teejaa ||
948.e: Third Mehla:

948.g: ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਰਤਕੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
948.t: kiau kar ih man maareeaai kiau kar mritak hoi ||
948.e: How can this mind be conquered? How can it be killed?

948.g: ਕਹਿਆ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਮਾਨਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਛਡੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
948.t: kahiaa sabadh na maaniee haumai chhaddai na koi ||
948.e: If one does not accept the Word of the Shabad, egotism does not depart.

948.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਛੁਟੈ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
948.t: gur parasaadhee haumai chhuTai jeevan mukat so hoi ||
948.e: By Guru's Grace, egotism is eradicated, and then, one is Jivan Mukta - liberated while yet alive.

948.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਖਸੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
948.t: naanak jis no bakhase tis milai tis bighan na laagai koi ||2||
948.e: O Nanak, one whom the Lord forgives is united with Him, and then no obstacles block his way. ||2||

948.t: mahalaa teejaa ||
948.e: Third Mehla:

948.g: ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰਣਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਿਉ ਹੋਇ ॥
948.t: jeevat maranaa sabh ko kahai jeevan mukat kiau hoi ||
948.e: Everyone can say that they are dead while yet alive; how can they be liberated while yet alive?

948.g: ਭੈ ਕਾ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਦਾਰੂ ਭਾਉ ਲਾਏਇ ॥
948.t: bhai kaa sa(n)jam je kare dhaaroo bhaau laaei ||
948.e: If someone restrains himself through the Fear of God, and takes the medicine of the Love of God,

948.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਰੇਇ ॥
948.t: anadhin gun gaavai sukh sahaje bikh bhavajal naam tarei ||
948.e: night and day, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. In celestial peace and poise, he crosses over the poisonous, terrifying world-ocean, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

948.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੩॥
948.t: naanak gurmukh paieeaai jaa kau nadhar karei ||3||
948.e: O Nanak, the Gurmukh finds the Lord; he is blessed with His Glance of Grace. ||3||

948.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
948.t: pauRee ||
948.e: Pauree:

948.g: ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਰਚਾਇਓਨੁ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ॥
948.t: dhoojaa bhaau rachaion trai gun varataaraa ||
948.e: God created the love of duality, and the three modes which pervade the universe.

948.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਉਪਾਇਅਨੁ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਕਮਾਵਨਿ ਕਾਰਾ ॥
948.t: brahamaa bisan mahes upaian hukam kamaavan kaaraa ||
948.e: He created Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva, who act according to His Will.

948.g: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਦੇ ਜੋਤਕੀ ਨਾ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
948.t: pa(n)ddit paRadhe jotakee naa boojheh beechaaraa ||
948.e: The Pandits, the religious scholars, and the astrologers study their books, but they do not understand contemplation.

948.g: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
948.t: sabh kichh teraa khel hai sach sirajanahaaraa ||
948.e: Everything is Your play, O True Creator Lord.

948.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੪॥
