948.t: jis bhaavai tis bakhas laih sach sabadh samaiee ||4||
948.e: As it pleases You, You bless us with forgiveness, and merge us in the True Word of the Shabad. ||4||

948.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
948.t: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
948.e: Shalok, Third Mehla:

948.g: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਝੂਠਾ ਝੂਠੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
948.t: man kaa jhooThaa jhooTh kamaavai ||
948.e: The man of false mind practices falsehood.

948.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਨੋ ਫਿਰੈ ਤਪਾ ਸਦਾਵੈ ॥
948.t: maiaa no firai tapaa sadhaavai ||
948.e: He runs after Maya, and yet pretends to be a man of disciplined meditation.

948.g: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਸਭਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਗਹੈ ॥
948.t: bharame bhoolaa sabh teerath gahai ||
948.e: Deluded by doubt, he visits all the sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

948.g: ਓਹੁ ਤਪਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਲਹੈ ॥
948.t: oh tapaa kaise param gat lahai ||
948.e: How can such a man of disciplined meditation attain the supreme status?

948.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
948.t: gur parasaadhee ko sach kamaavai ||
948.e: By Guru's Grace, one lives the Truth.

948.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਤਪਾ ਮੋਖੰਤਰੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
948.t: naanak so tapaa mokha(n)tar paavai ||1||
948.e: O Nanak, such a man of disciplined meditation attains liberation. ||1||

948.t: mahalaa teejaa ||
948.e: Third Mehla:

948.g: ਸੋ ਤਪਾ ਜਿ ਇਹੁ ਤਪੁ ਘਾਲੇ ॥
948.t: so tapaa j ih tap ghaale ||
948.e: He alone is a man of disciplined meditation, who practices this self-discipline.

948.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
948.t: satigur no milai sabadh samaale ||
948.e: Meeting with the True Guru, he contemplates the Word of the Shabad.

948.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਇਹੁ ਤਪੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
948.t: satigur kee sevaa ih tap paravaan ||
948.e: Serving the True Guru - this is the only acceptable disciplined meditation.

948.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਤਪਾ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
948.t: naanak so tapaa dharageh paavai maan ||2||
948.e: O Nanak, such a man of disciplined meditation is honored in the Court of the Lord. ||2||

948.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
948.t: pauRee ||
948.e: Pauree:

948.g: ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਉਪਾਇਅਨੁ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕੀ ਵਰਤਣਿ ॥
948.t: raat dhinas upaian sa(n)saar kee varatan ||
948.e: He created the night and the day, for the activities of the world.

949.g: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਆਨੇਰੁ ਬਿਨਾਸਣਿ ॥
949.t: gurmatee ghaT chaananaa aaner binaasan ||
949.e: Following the Guru's Teachings, one's heart is illumined, and the darkness is dispelled.

949.g: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹੀ ਸਭ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਭ ਵਣਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਣਿ ॥
949.t: hukame hee sabh saajeean raviaa sabh van tiran ||
949.e: By the Hukam of His Command, He creates everything; He pervades and permeates all the woods and meadows.

949.g: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਣਿ ॥
949.t: sabh kichh aape aap hai gurmukh sadhaa har bhan ||
949.e: He Himself is everything; the Gurmukh constantly chants the Lord's Name.

949.g: ਸਬਦੇ ਹੀ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਈ ਸਚੈ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੫॥
949.t: sabadhe hee sojhee piee sachai aap bujhaiee ||5||
949.e: Through the Shabad, understanding comes; the True Lord Himself inspires us to understand. ||5||

949.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
949.t: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
949.e: Shalok, Third Mehla:

949.g: ਅਭਿਆਗਤ ਏਹਿ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਚਿਤ ਮਹਿ ਭਰਮੁ ॥
949.t: abhiaagat eh na aakheean jin ke chit meh bharam ||
949.e: He is not called a renunciate, whose consciousness is filled with doubt.

949.g: ਤਿਸ ਦੈ ਦਿਤੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਤੇਹੋ ਜੇਹਾ ਧਰਮੁ ॥
949.t: tis dhai dhitai naanakaa teho jehaa dharam ||
949.e: Donations to him bring proportionate rewards.

949.g: ਅਭੈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਭੂਖਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
949.t: abhai nira(n)jan param padh taa kaa bhookhaa hoi ||
949.e: He hungers for the supreme status of the Fearless, Immaculate Lord;

949.g: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
949.t: tis kaa bhojan naanakaa viralaa paae koi ||1||
949.e: O Nanak, how rare are those who offer him this food. ||1||

949.t: mahalaa teejaa ||
949.e: Third Mehla:

949.g: ਅਭਿਆਗਤ ਏਹਿ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ ਜਿ ਪਰ ਘਰਿ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
949.t: abhiaagat eh na aakheean j par ghar bhojan karen ||
949.e: They are not called renunciates, who take food in the homes of others.

949.g: ਉਦਰੈ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਆਪਣੇ ਬਹਲੇ ਭੇਖਿ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
949.t: audharai kaaran aapane bahale bhekh karen ||
949.e: For the sake of their bellies, they wear various religious robes.

949.g: ਅਭਿਆਗਤ ਸੇਈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿ ਆਤਮ ਗਉਣੁ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
949.t: abhiaagat seiee naanakaa j aatam gaun karen ||
949.e: They alone are renunciates, O Nanak, who enter into their own souls.

949.g: ਭਾਲਿ ਲਹਨਿ ਸਹੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਰਹਣੁ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥੨॥
949.t: bhaal lahan sahu aapanaa nij ghar rahan karen ||2||
949.e: They seek and find their Husband Lord; they dwell within the home of their own inner self. ||2||

949.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
949.t: pauRee ||
949.e: Pauree:

949.g: ਅੰਬਰੁ ਧਰਤਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਿਅਨੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਚਾ ਅਸਰਾਉ ॥
949.t: a(n)bar dharat vichhoRian vich sachaa asaraau ||
949.e: They sky and the earth are separate, but the True Lord supports them from within.

949.g: ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਸਭੋ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
949.t: ghar dhar sabho sach hai jis vich sachaa naau ||
949.e: True are all those homes and gates, within which the True Name is enshrined.

949.g: ਸਭੁ ਸਚਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥
949.t: sabh sachaa hukam varatadhaa gurmukh sach samaau ||
949.e: The Hukam of the True Lord's Command is effective everywhere. The Gurmukh merges in the True Lord.

949.g: ਸਚਾ ਆਪਿ ਤਖਤੁ ਸਚਾ ਬਹਿ ਸਚਾ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਆਉ ॥
949.t: sachaa aap takhat sachaa beh sachaa kare niaau ||
949.e: He Himself is True, and True is His throne. Seated upon it, He administers true justice.

949.g: ਸਭੁ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਈ ॥੬॥
949.t: sabh sacho sach varatadhaa gurmukh alakh lakhaiee ||6||
949.e: The Truest of the True is all-pervading everywhere; the Gurmukh sees the unseen. ||6||

949.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
949.t: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
949.e: Shalok, Third Mehla:

949.g: ਰੈਣਾਇਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਅਨੰਤੁ ਹੈ ਕੂੜੀ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
949.t: rainair maeh ana(n)t hai kooRee aavai jai ||
949.e: In the world-ocean, the Infinite Lord abides. The false come and go in reincarnation.

949.g: ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲੈ ਆਪਣੈ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਲਹੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
949.t: bhaanai chalai aapanai bahutee lahai sajai ||
949.e: One who walks according to his own will, suffers terrible punishment.

949.g: ਰੈਣਾਇਰ ਮਹਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੈ ਕਰਮੀ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
949.t: rainair meh sabh kichh hai karamee palai pai ||
949.e: All things are in the world-ocean, but they are obtained only by the karma of good actions.

949.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੇ ਚਲੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
949.t: naanak nau nidh paieeaai je chalai tisai rajai ||1||
949.e: O Nanak, he alone obtains the nine treasures, who walks in the Will of the Lord. ||1||

949.t: mahalaa teejaa ||
949.e: Third Mehla:

949.g: ਸਹਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਨਮਿ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥
949.t: sahaje satigur na sevio vich haumai janam binaas ||
949.e: One who doesn't intuitively serves the True Guru, loses his life in egotism.

949.g: ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਨ ਚਖਿਓ ਕਮਲੁ ਨ ਹੋਇਓ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
949.t: rasanaa har ras na chakhio kamal na hoio paragaas ||
949.e: His tongue does not taste the sublime essence of the Lord, and his heart-lotus does not blossom forth.

949.g: ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਧੀ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਮੁਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥
949.t: bikh khaadhee manmukh muaa maiaa moh vinaas ||
949.e: The self-willed manmukh eats poison and dies; he is ruined by love and attachment to Maya.

949.g: ਇਕਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਣੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
949.t: eikas har ke naam vin dhirag jeevan dhirag vaas ||
949.e: Without the Name of the One Lord, his life is cursed, and his home is cursed as well.

949.g: ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਚਾ ਤਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ ॥
949.t: jaa aape nadhar kare prabh sachaa taa hovai dhaasan dhaas ||
949.e: When God Himself bestows His Glance of Grace, then one becomes the slave of His slaves.

949.g: ਤਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਪਾਸੁ ॥
949.t: taa anadhin sevaa kare satiguroo kee kabeh na chhoddai paas ||
949.e: And then, night and day, he serves the True Guru, and never leaves His side.

949.g: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਅਲਿਪਤੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਤਿਉ ਵਿਚੇ ਗਿਰਹ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥
949.t: jiau jal meh kamal alipato varatai tiau viche gireh udhaas ||
949.e: As the lotus flower floats unaffected in the water, so does he remain detached in his own household.

949.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
949.t: jan naanak kare karaiaa sabh ko jiau bhaavai tiv har gunataas ||2||
949.e: O servant Nanak, the Lord acts, and inspires everyone to act, according to the Pleasure of His Will. He is the treasure of virtue. ||2||

949.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
949.t: pauRee ||
949.e: Pauree:

949.g: ਛਤੀਹ ਜੁਗ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਸਾ ਆਪੇ ਗਣਤ ਕੀਨੀ ॥
949.t: chhateeh jug gubaar saa aape ganat keenee ||
949.e: For thirty-six ages, there was utter darkness. Then, the Lord revealed Himself.

949.g: ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਆਪਿ ਮਤਿ ਦੀਨੀ ॥
949.t: aape sirasaT sabh saajeean aap mat dheenee ||
949.e: He Himself created the entire universe. He Himself blessed it with understanding.

949.g: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਸਾਜਿਅਨੁ ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਗਣਤ ਗਣੀਨੀ ॥
949.t: simirat saasat saajian paap pu(n)n ganat ganeenee ||
949.e: He created the Simritees and the Shaastras; He calculates the accounts of virtue and vice.

949.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋ ਬੁਝਸੀ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਤੀਨੀ ॥
949.t: jis bujhaae so bujhasee sachai sabadh pateenee ||
949.e: He alone understands, whom the Lord inspires to understand and to be pleased with the True Word of the Shabad.

949.g: ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੭॥
949.t: sabh aape aap varatadhaa aape bakhas milaiee ||7||
949.e: He Himself is all-pervading; He Himself forgives, and unites with Himself. ||7||

949.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
949.t: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
949.e: Shalok, Third Mehla:

949.g: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਭੋ ਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਰਤੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਤੰਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
949.t: eih tan sabho rat hai rat bin ta(n)n na hoi ||
949.e: This body is all blood; without blood, the body cannot exist.

949.g: ਜੋ ਸਹਿ ਰਤੇ ਆਪਣੈ ਤਿਨ ਤਨਿ ਲੋਭ ਰਤੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
949.t: jo seh rate aapanai tin tan lobh rat na hoi ||
949.e: Those who are attuned to their Lord - their bodies are not filled with the blood of greed.

949.g: ਭੈ ਪਇਐ ਤਨੁ ਖੀਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਲੋਭ ਰਤੁ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
949.t: bhai piaai tan kheen hoi lobh rat vichahu jai ||
949.e: In the Fear of God, the body becomes thin, and the blood of greed passes out of the body.

950.g: ਜਿਉ ਬੈਸੰਤਰਿ ਧਾਤੁ ਸੁਧੁ ਹੋਇ ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
950.t: jiau baisa(n)tar dhaat sudh hoi tiau har kaa bhau dhuramat mail gavai ||
950.e: As fire purifies metal, so does the Fear of the Lord eradicate the filth of evil-mindedness.

950.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
950.t: naanak te jan sohane jo rate har ra(n)g lai ||1||
950.e: O Nanak, beautiful are those humble beings, who are imbued with the Lord's Love. ||1||

950.t: mahalaa teejaa ||
950.e: Third Mehla:

950.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਤਾ ਬਨਿਆ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
950.t: raamakalee raam man vasiaa taa baniaa seegaar ||
950.e: In Raamkalee, I have enshrined the Lord in my mind; thus I have been embellished.

950.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਸਿਆ ਤਾ ਸਉਪਿਆ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥
950.t: gur kai sabadh kamal bigasiaa taa saupiaa bhagat bha(n)ddaar ||
950.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, my heart-lotus has blossomed forth; the Lord blessed me with the treasure of devotional worship.

950.g: ਭਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਤਾ ਜਾਗਿਆ ਚੂਕਾ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ॥
950.t: bharam giaa taa jaagiaa chookaa agiaan a(n)dhaar ||
950.e: My doubt was dispelled, and I woke up; the darkness of ignorance was dispelled.

950.g: ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਤਿ ਅਗਲਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
950.t: tis no roop at agalaa jis har naal piaar ||
950.e: She who is in love with her Lord, is the most infinitely beautiful.

950.g: ਸਦਾ ਰਵੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
950.t: sadhaa ravai pir aapanaa sobhaava(n)tee naar ||
950.e: Such a beautiful, happy soul-bride enjoys her Husband Lord forever.

950.g: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਜਾਸਨਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
950.t: manmukh seegaar na jaananee jaasan janam sabh haar ||
950.e: The self-willed manmukhs do not know how to decorate themselves; wasting their whole lives, they depart.

950.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
950.t: bin har bhagatee seegaar kareh nit ja(n)meh hoi khuaar ||
950.e: Those who decorate themselves without devotional worship to the Lord, are continually reincarnated to suffer.

950.g: ਸੈਸਾਰੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੋਭ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੀ ਅਗੈ ਜਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
950.t: saisaarai vich sobh na painee agai j kare su jaanai karataar ||
950.e: They do not obtain respect in this world; the Creator Lord alone knows what will happen to them in the world hereafter.

950.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਦੁਹੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਹੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
950.t: naanak sachaa ek hai dhuh vich hai sa(n)saar ||
950.e: O Nanak, the True Lord is the One and only; duality exists only in the world.

950.g: ਚੰਗੈ ਮੰਦੈ ਆਪਿ ਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਸੋ ਕਰਨਿ ਜਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
950.t: cha(n)gai ma(n)dhai aap laian so karan j aap karaae karataar ||2||
950.e: He Himself enjoins them to good and bad; they do only that which the Creator Lord causes them to do. ||2||

950.t: mahalaa teejaa ||
950.e: Third Mehla:

950.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
950.t: bin satigur seve saa(n)t na aaviee dhoojee naahee jai ||
950.e: Without serving the True Guru, tranquility is not obtained. It cannot be found anywhere else.

950.g: ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰਾ ਲੋਚੀਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
950.t: je bahuteraa locheeaai vin karamaa paiaa na jai ||
950.e: No matter how much one may long for it, without the karma of good actions, it cannot be found.

950.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਇ ॥
950.t: a(n)tar lobh vikaar hai dhoojai bhai khuaai ||
950.e: Those whose inner beings are filled with greed and corruption, are ruined through the love of duality.

950.g: ਤਿਨ ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
950.t: tin ja(n)man maran na chukiee haumai vich dhukh pai ||
950.e: The cycle of birth and death is not ended, and filled with egotism, they suffer in pain.

950.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਸੋ ਖਾਲੀ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
950.t: jinee satigur siau chit laiaa so khaalee koiee naeh ||
950.e: Those who focus their consciousness on the True Guru, do not remain unfulfilled.

950.g: ਤਿਨ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤਲਬ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਾ ਓਇ ਦੁਖ ਸਹਾਹਿ ॥
950.t: tin jam kee talab na hoviee naa oi dhukh sahaeh ||
950.e: They are not summoned by the Messenger of Death, and they do not suffer in pain.

950.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
950.t: naanak gurmukh ubare sachai sabadh samaeh ||3||
950.e: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is saved, merging in the True Word of the Shabad. ||3||

950.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
950.t: pauRee ||
950.e: Pauree:

950.g: ਆਪਿ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਹੋਰਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਸਭਿ ਧਾਵਹਿ ॥
950.t: aap alipat sadhaa rahai hor dha(n)dhai sabh dhaaveh ||
950.e: He Himself remains unattached forever; all others run after worldly affairs.

950.g: ਆਪਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਅਚਲੁ ਹੈ ਹੋਰਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ॥
950.t: aap nihachal achal hai hor aaveh jaaveh ||
950.e: He Himself is eternal, unchanging and unmoving; the others continue coming and going in reincarnation.

950.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
950.t: sadhaa sadhaa har dhiaaieeaai gurmukh sukh paaveh ||
950.e: Meditating on the Lord forever and ever, the Gurmukh finds peace.

950.g: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚਿ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ॥
950.t: nij ghar vaasaa paieeaai sach sifat samaaveh ||
950.e: He dwells in the home of his own inner being, absorbed in the Praise of the True Lord.

950.g: ਸਚਾ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੮॥
950.t: sachaa gahir ga(n)bheer hai gur sabadh bujhaiee ||8||
950.e: The True Lord is profound and unfathomable; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is understood. ||8||

950.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
950.t: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
950.e: Shalok, Third Mehla:

950.g: ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਸਭੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਚੁ ॥
950.t: sachaa naam dhiaai too sabho varatai sach ||
950.e: Meditate on the True Name; the True Lord is all-pervading.

950.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਜੋ ਬੁਝੈ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਸਚੁ ॥
950.t: naanak hukamai jo bujhai so fal paae sach ||
950.e: O Nanak, one who realizes the Hukam of the Lord's Command, obtains the fruit of Truth.

950.g: ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਨੀ ਕਰਤਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਚੁ ॥
950.t: kathanee badhanee karataa firai hukam na boojhai sach ||
950.e: One who merely mouths the words, does not understand the Hukam of the True Lord's Command.

950.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨੇ ਸੋ ਭਗਤੁ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਣੁ ਮੰਨੇ ਕਚੁ ਨਿਕਚੁ ॥੧॥
950.t: naanak har kaa bhaanaa ma(n)ne so bhagat hoi vin ma(n)ne kach nikach ||1||
950.e: O Nanak, one who accepts the Will of the Lord is His devotee. Without accepting it, he is the falsest of the false. ||1||

950.t: mahalaa teejaa ||
950.e: Third Mehla:

950.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬੋਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਓਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
950.t: manmukh bol na jaananee onaa a(n)dhar kaam karodh aha(n)kaar ||
950.e: The self-willed manmukhs do not know what they are saying. They are filled with sexual desire, anger and egotism.

950.g: ਓਇ ਥਾਉ ਕੁਥਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਉਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
950.t: oi thaau kuthaau na jaananee un a(n)tar lobh vikaar ||
950.e: They do not understand right places and wrong places; they are filled with greed and corruption.

950.g: ਓਇ ਆਪਣੈ ਸੁਆਇ ਆਇ ਬਹਿ ਗਲਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਓਨਾ ਮਾਰੇ ਜਮੁ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ॥
950.t: oi aapanai suaai aai beh galaa kareh onaa maare jam ja(n)dhaar ||
950.e: They come, and sit and talk for their own purposes. The Messenger of Death strikes them down.

950.g: ਅਗੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਲੇਖੈ ਮੰਗਿਐ ਮਾਰਿ ਖੁਆਰੁ ਕੀਚਹਿ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ॥
950.t: agai dharageh lekhai ma(n)giaai maar khuaar keecheh kooRiaar ||
950.e: Hereafter, they are called to account in the Court of the Lord; the false ones are struck down and humiliated.

950.g: ਏਹ ਕੂੜੈ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਕਿਉ ਉਤਰੈ ਕੋਈ ਕਢਹੁ ਇਹੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
950.t: eh kooRai kee mal kiau utarai koiee kaddahu ih veechaar ||
950.e: How can this filth of falsehood be washed off? Can anyone think about this, and find the way?

950.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜਾਏ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
950.t: satigur milai taa naam dhiRaae sabh kilavikh kaTanahaar ||
950.e: If one meets with the True Guru, He implants the Naam, the Name of the Lord within; all his sins are destroyed.

950.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇ ਨਾਮੋ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਸਭਿ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ॥
950.t: naam jape naamo aaraadhe tis jan kau karahu sabh namasakaar ||
950.e: Let all bow in humility to that humble being who chants the Naam, and worships the Naam in adoration.

951.g: ਮਲੁ ਕੂੜੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਉਤਾਰੀਅਨੁ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ॥
951.t: mal kooRee naam utaareean jap naam hoaa sachiaar ||
951.e: The Naam washes off the filth of falsehood; chanting the Naam, one becomes truthful.

951.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸ ਦੇ ਏਹਿ ਚਲਤ ਹਹਿ ਸੋ ਜੀਵਉ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
951.t: jan naanak jis dhe eh chalat heh so jeevau dhevanahaar ||2||
951.e: O servant Nanak, wondrous are the plays of the Lord, the Giver of life. ||2||
Pauree:

951.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਹਿ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ॥
951.t: tudh jevadd dhaataa naeh kis aakh sunaieeaai ||
951.e: You are the Great Giver; no other is as great as You. Unto whom should I speak and talk?

951.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਇ ਜਿਥਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
951.t: gur parasaadhee pai jithahu haumai jaieeaai ||
951.e: By Guru's Grace, I find You; You eradicate egotism from within.

951.g: ਰਸ ਕਸ ਸਾਦਾ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈਐ ॥
951.t: ras kas saadhaa baaharaa sachee vaddiaaieeaai ||
951.e: You are beyond sweet and salty flavors; True is Your glorious greatness.

951.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਖਸੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਇ ਆਪਿ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਈਐ ॥
951.t: jis no bakhase tis dhei aap le milaieeaai ||
951.e: You bless those whom You forgive, and unite them with Yourself.

951.g: ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਪਿਆਈ ॥੯॥
951.t: ghaT a(n)tar a(n)mrit rakhion gurmukh kisai piaaiee ||9||
951.e: You have placed the Ambrosial Nectar deep within the heart; the Gurmukh drinks it in. ||9||
Shalok, Third Mehla:
The stories of one's ancestors make the children good children.

951.g: ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਲੈਨਿ ਸੇਈ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
951.t: j satigur bhaavai su ma(n)n lain seiee karam karen ||
951.e: They accept what is pleasing to the Will of the True Guru, and act accordingly.

951.g: ਜਾਇ ਪੁਛਹੁ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਬਿਆਸ ਸੁਕ ਨਾਰਦ ਬਚਨ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
951.t: jai puchhahu simirat saasat biaas suk naaradh bachan sabh sirasaT karen ||
951.e: Go and consult the Simritees, the Shaastras, the writings of Vyaas, Suk Dayv, Naarad, and all those who preach to the world.

951.g: ਸਚੈ ਲਾਏ ਸਚਿ ਲਗੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਲੇਨਿ ॥
951.t: sachai laae sach lage sadhaa sach samaalen ||
951.e: Those, whom the True Lord attaches, are attached to the Truth; they contemplate the True Name forever.

951.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਏ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਭਏ ਜਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੇਨਿ ॥੧॥
951.t: naanak aae se paravaan bhe j sagale kul taaren ||1||
951.e: O Nanak, their coming into the world is approved; they redeem all their ancestors. ||1||
Third Mehla:

951.g: ਗੁਰੂ ਜਿਨਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਧੁਲਾ ਸਿਖ ਭੀ ਅੰਧੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
951.t: guroo jinaa kaa a(n)dhulaa sikh bhee a(n)dhe karam karen ||
951.e: The disciples whose teacher is blind, act blindly as well.

951.g: ਓਇ ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲਨਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਨਿਤ ਝੂਠੋ ਝੂਠੁ ਬੋਲੇਨਿ ॥
951.t: oi bhaanai chalan aapanai nit jhooTho jhooTh bolen ||
951.e: They walk according to their own wills, and continually speak falsehood and lies.

951.g: ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਸਤੁ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
951.t: kooR kusat kamaavadhe par ni(n)dhaa sadhaa karen ||
951.e: They practice falsehood and deception, and endlessly slander others.

951.g: ਓਇ ਆਪਿ ਡੁਬੇ ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਕਾ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਡੋਬੇਨਿ ॥
951.t: oi aap ddube par ni(n)dhakaa sagale kul ddoben ||
951.e: Slandering others, they drown themselves, and drown all their generations as well.

951.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਤੁ ਓਇ ਲਾਏ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗੇ ਉਇ ਬਪੁੜੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥੨॥
951.t: naanak jit oi laae tit lage ui bapuRe kiaa karen ||2||
951.e: O Nanak, whatever the Lord links them to, to that they are linked; what can the poor creatures do? ||2||
Pauree:

951.g: ਸਭ ਨਦਰੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਖਦਾ ਜੇਤੀ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਕੀਤੀ ॥
951.t: sabh nadharee a(n)dhar rakhadhaa jetee sisaT sabh keetee ||
951.e: He keeps all under His Gaze; He created the entire Universe.

951.g: ਇਕਿ ਕੂੜਿ ਕੁਸਤਿ ਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਵਿਗੂਤੀ ॥
951.t: eik kooR kusat laian manmukh vigootee ||
951.e: He has linked some to falsehood and deception; these self-willed manmukhs are plundered.

951.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤੀ ॥
951.t: gurmukh sadhaa dhiaaieeaai a(n)dhar har preetee ||
951.e: The Gurmukhs meditate on the Lord forever; their inner beings are filled with love.

951.g: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੋਤੈ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਨੑ ਵਾਤਿ ਸਿਪੀਤੀ ॥
951.t: jin kau potai pu(n)n hai tin(h) vaat sipeetee ||
951.e: Those who have the treasure of virtue, chant the Praises of the Lord.

951.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਚੁ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਨਾਈ ॥੧੦॥
951.t: naanak naam dhiaaieeaai sach sifat sanaiee ||10||
951.e: O Nanak, meditate on the Naam, and the Glorious Praises of the True Lord. ||10||
Shalok, First Mehla:
Men of charity gather wealth by committing sins, and then give it away in donations to charity.
Their spiritual teachers go to their homes to instruct them.
The woman loves the man only for his wealth;
they come and go as they please.
No one obeys the Shaastras or the Vedas.
Everyone worships himself.
Becoming judges, they sit and administer justice.
They chant on their malas, and call upon God.
They accept bribes, and block justice.

951.g: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਪੁਛੈ ਤਾ ਪੜਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
951.t: je ko puchhai taa paR sunaae ||
951.e: If someone asks them, they read quotations from their books.
The Muslim scriptures are in their ears and in their hearts.
They plunder the people, and engage in gossip and flattery.
They anoint their kitchens to try to become pure.
Behold, such is the Hindu.
The Yogi, with matted hair and ashes on his body, has become a householder.
The children weep in front of him and behind him.
He does not attain Yoga - he has lost his way.
Why does he apply ashes to his forehead?
O Nanak, this is the sign of the Dark Age of Kali Yuga;
everyone says that he himself knows. ||1||
First Mehla:
The Hindu comes to the house of a Hindu.
He puts the sacred thread around his neck and reads the scriptures.
He puts on the thread, but does evil deeds.
His cleansings and washings will not be approved.
The Muslim glorifies his own faith.

952.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੀਰੈ ਕੋ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
952.t: vin gur peerai ko thai na paiee ||
952.e: Without the Guru or a spiritual teacher, no one is accepted.
They may be shown the way, but only a few go there.
Without the karma of good actions, heaven is not attained.
The Way of Yoga is demonstrated in the Yogi's monastery.
They wear ear-rings to show the way.
Wearing ear-rings, they wander around the world.
The Creator Lord is everywhere.
There are as many travellers as there are beings.
When one's death warrant is issued, there is no delay.
One who knows the Lord here, realizes Him there as well.
Others, whether Hindu or Muslim, are just babbling.
Everyone's account is read in the Court of the Lord;
without the karma of good actions, no one crosses over.
One who speaks the True Name of the True Lord,
O Nanak, is not called to account hereafter. ||2||
Pauree:

952.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟੁ ਗੜੁ ॥
952.t: har kaa ma(n)dhar aakheeaai kaiaa koT gaR ||
952.e: The fortress of the body is called the Mansion of the Lord.

952.g: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਲਾਲ ਜਵੇਹਰੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੜੁ ॥
952.t: a(n)dhar laal javeharee gurmukh har naam paR ||
952.e: The rubies and gems are found within it; the Gurmukh chants the Name of the Lord.

952.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਅਤਿ ਸੋਹਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜੁ ॥
952.t: har kaa ma(n)dhar sareer at sohanaa har har naam dhiR ||
952.e: The body, the Mansion of the Lord, is very beautiful, when the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is implanted deep within.

952.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਇਅਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਨਿਤ ਕੜੁ ॥
952.t: manmukh aap khuaaian maiaa moh nit kaR ||
952.e: The self-willed manmukhs ruin themselves; they boil continuously in attachment to Maya.

952.g: ਸਭਨਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੧॥
952.t: sabhanaa saahib ek hai poorai bhaag paiaa jaiee ||11||
952.e: The One Lord is the Master of all. He is found only by perfect destiny. ||11||
Shalok, First Mehla:

952.g: ਨਾ ਸਤਿ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਨਾ ਸਤਿ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਨਾ ਸਤਿ ਪਾਣੀ ਜੰਤ ਫਿਰਹਿ ॥
952.t: naa sat dhukheeaa naa sat sukheeaa naa sat paanee ja(n)t fireh ||
952.e: There is no Truth in suffering, there is no Truth in comfort. There is no Truth in wandering like animals through the water.

952.g: ਨਾ ਸਤਿ ਮੂੰਡ ਮੁਡਾਈ ਕੇਸੀ ਨਾ ਸਤਿ ਪੜਿਆ ਦੇਸ ਫਿਰਹਿ ॥
952.t: naa sat moo(n)dd muddaiee kesee naa sat paRiaa dhes fireh ||
952.e: There is no Truth in shaving one's head; there is no Truth is studying the scriptures or wandering in foreign lands.

952.g: ਨਾ ਸਤਿ ਰੁਖੀ ਬਿਰਖੀ ਪਥਰ ਆਪੁ ਤਛਾਵਹਿ ਦੁਖ ਸਹਹਿ ॥
952.t: naa sat rukhee birakhee pathar aap tachhaaveh dhukh saheh ||
952.e: There is no Truth in trees, plants or stones, in mutilating oneself or suffering in pain.

952.g: ਨਾ ਸਤਿ ਹਸਤੀ ਬਧੇ ਸੰਗਲ ਨਾ ਸਤਿ ਗਾਈ ਘਾਹੁ ਚਰਹਿ ॥
952.t: naa sat hasatee badhe sa(n)gal naa sat gaiee ghaahu chareh ||
952.e: There is no Truth in binding elephants in chains; there is no Truth in grazing cows.

952.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਹਥਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਜੇ ਸੋਈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੈ ॥
952.t: jis hath sidh dhevai je soiee jis no dhei tis aai milai ||
952.e: He alone grants it, whose hands hold spritual perfection; he alone receives it, unto whom it is given.

952.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਵੈ ॥
952.t: naanak taa kau milai vaddaiee jis ghaT bheetar sabadh ravai ||
952.e: O Nanak, he alone is blessed with glorious greatness, whose heart is filled with the Word of the Shabad.

952.g: ਸਭਿ ਘਟ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਉ ਸਭਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਖੁਆਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਉਣੁ ਕਹੈ ॥
952.t: sabh ghaT mere hau sabhanaa a(n)dhar jiseh khuaaiee tis kaun kahai ||
952.e: God says, all hearts are mine, and I am in all hearts. Who can explain this to one who is confused?

952.g: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਲਾ ਵਾਟੜੀ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਭੁਲਾਵੈ ਕਉਣੁ ॥
952.t: jiseh dhikhaalaa vaaTaRee tiseh bhulaavai kaun ||
952.e: Who can confuse that being, unto whom I have shown the Way?

952.g: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ਪੰਧ ਸਿਰਿ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਕਉਣੁ ॥੧॥
952.t: jiseh bhulaiee pa(n)dh sir tiseh dhikhaavai kaun ||1||
952.e: And who can show the Path to that being whom I have confused since the beginning of time? ||1||
First Mehla:
He alone is a householder, who restrains his passions
and begs for meditation, austerity and self-discipline.
He gives donations to charity with his body;
such a householder is as pure as the water of the Ganges.
Says Eeshar, the Lord is the embodiment of Truth.

952.g: ਪਰਮ ਤੰਤ ਮਹਿ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਰੂਪੁ ॥੨॥
952.t: param ta(n)t meh rekh na roop ||2||
952.e: The supreme essence of reality has no shape or form. ||2||
First Mehla:
He alone is a detached hermit, who burns away his self-conceit.
He begs for suffering as his food.
In the city of the heart, he begs for charity.
Such a renunciate ascends to the City of God.
Says Gorakh, God is the embodiment of Truth;

952.g: ਪਰਮ ਤੰਤ ਮਹਿ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਰੂਪੁ ॥੩॥
952.t: param ta(n)t meh rekh na roop ||3||
952.e: the supreme essence of reality has no shape or form. ||3||
First Mehla:
He alone is an Udasi, a shaven-headed renunciate, who embraces renunciation.
He sees the Immaculate Lord dwelling in both the upper and lower regions.
He balances the sun and the moon energies.

952.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਕਾ ਪੜੈ ਨ ਕੰਧੁ ॥
952.t: tis udhaasee kaa paRai na ka(n)dh ||
952.e: The body-wall of such an Udasi does not collapse.
Says Gopi Chand, God is the embodiment of Truth;

952.g: ਪਰਮ ਤੰਤ ਮਹਿ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਰੂਪੁ ॥੪॥
952.t: param ta(n)t meh rekh na roop ||4||
952.e: the supreme essence of reality has no shape or form. ||4||
First Mehla:
He alone is a Paakhandi, who cleanses his body of filth.
The fire of his body illuminates God within.
He does not waste his energy in wet dreams.

953.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਪਾਖੰਡੀ ਜਰਾ ਨ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
953.t: tis paakha(n)ddee jaraa na maranaa ||
953.e: Such a Paakhandi does not grow old or die.

953.g: ਬੋਲੈ ਚਰਪਟੁ ਸਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ॥
953.t: bolai charapaT sat saroop ||
953.e: Says Charpat, God is the embodiment of Truth;

953.g: ਪਰਮ ਤੰਤ ਮਹਿ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਰੂਪੁ ॥੫॥
953.t: param ta(n)t meh rekh na roop ||5||
953.e: the supreme essence of reality has no shape or form. ||5||

953.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
953.e: First Mehla:

953.g: ਸੋ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਜਿ ਉਲਟੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ॥
953.t: so bairaagee j ulaTe braham ||
953.e: He alone is a Bairaagi, who turns himself toward God.

953.g: ਗਗਨ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ ਰੋਪੈ ਥੰਮੁ ॥
953.t: gagan ma(n)ddal meh ropai tha(n)m ||
953.e: In the Tenth Gate, the sky of the mind, he erects his pillar.

953.g: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਹੈ ਧਿਆਨਿ ॥
953.t: ahinis a(n)tar rahai dhiaan ||
953.e: Night and day, he remains in deep inner meditation.

953.g: ਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਸਤ ਸਮਾਨਿ ॥
953.t: te bairaagee sat samaan ||
953.e: Such a Bairaagi is just like the True Lord.

953.g: ਬੋਲੈ ਭਰਥਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ॥
953.t: bolai bharathar sat saroop ||
953.e: Says Bhart'har, God is the embodiment of Truth;

953.g: ਪਰਮ ਤੰਤ ਮਹਿ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਰੂਪੁ ॥੬॥
953.t: param ta(n)t meh rekh na roop ||6||
953.e: the supreme essence of reality has no shape or form. ||6||

953.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
953.e: First Mehla:

953.g: ਕਿਉ ਮਰੈ ਮੰਦਾ ਕਿਉ ਜੀਵੈ ਜੁਗਤਿ ॥
953.t: kiau marai ma(n)dhaa kiau jeevai jugat ||
953.e: How is evil eradicated? How can the true way of life be found?

953.g: ਕੰਨ ਪੜਾਇ ਕਿਆ ਖਾਜੈ ਭੁਗਤਿ ॥
953.t: ka(n)n paRai kiaa khaajai bhugat ||
953.e: What is the use of piercing the ears, or begging for food?

953.g: ਆਸਤਿ ਨਾਸਤਿ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
953.t: aasat naasat eko naau ||
953.e: Throughout existence and non-existence, there is only the Name of the One Lord.

953.g: ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਅਖਰੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਹਿਆਉ ॥
953.t: kaunu su akhar jit rahai hiaau ||
953.e: What is that Word, which holds the heart in its place?

953.g: ਧੂਪ ਛਾਵ ਜੇ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਸਹੈ ॥
953.t: dhoop chhaav je sam kar sahai ||
953.e: When you look alike upon sunshine and shade,

953.g: ਤਾ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ॥
953.t: taa naanak aakhai gur ko kahai ||
953.e: says Nanak, then the Guru will speak to you.

953.g: ਛਿਅ ਵਰਤਾਰੇ ਵਰਤਹਿ ਪੂਤ ॥
953.t: chhia varataare varateh poot ||
953.e: The students follow the six systems.

953.g: ਨਾ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ਨਾ ਅਉਧੂਤ ॥
953.t: naa sa(n)saaree naa aaudhoot ||
953.e: They are neither worldly people, nor detached renunciates.

953.g: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਿ ਜੋ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
953.t: nira(n)kaar jo rahai samai ||
953.e: One who remains absorbed in the Formless Lord

953.g: ਕਾਹੇ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਮੰਗਣਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੭॥
953.t: kaahe bheekhiaa ma(n)gan jai ||7||
953.e: - why should he go out begging? ||7||

953.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
953.t: pauRee ||
953.e: Pauree:

953.g: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਸੋਈ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿਥਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
953.t: har ma(n)dhar soiee aakheeaai jithahu har jaataa ||
953.e: That alone is said to be the Lord's temple, where the Lord is known.

953.g: ਮਾਨਸ ਦੇਹ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
953.t: maanas dheh gur bachanee paiaa sabh aatam raam pachhaataa ||
953.e: In the human body, the Guru's Word is found, when one understands that the Lord, the Supreme Soul, is in all.

953.g: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਖੋਜੀਐ ਘਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
953.t: baahar mool na khojeeaai ghar maeh bidhaataa ||
953.e: Don't look for Him outside your self. The Creator, the Architect of Destiny, is within the home of your own heart.

953.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਤਿਨੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਤਾ ॥
953.t: manmukh har ma(n)dhar kee saar na jaananee tinee janam gavaataa ||
953.e: The self-willed manmukh does not appreciate the value of the Lord's temple; they waste away and lose their lives.

953.g: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੨॥
953.t: sabh meh ik varatadhaa gur sabadhee paiaa jaiee ||12||
953.e: The One Lord is pervading in all; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He can be found. ||12||

953.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
953.t: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
953.e: Shalok, Third Mehla:

953.g: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਸੁਣੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਕਾ ਕਹਣਾ ॥
953.t: moorakh hovai so sunai moorakh kaa kahanaa ||
953.e: Only a fool listens to the words of the fool.

953.g: ਮੂਰਖ ਕੇ ਕਿਆ ਲਖਣ ਹੈ ਕਿਆ ਮੂਰਖ ਕਾ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
953.t: moorakh ke kiaa lakhan hai kiaa moorakh kaa karanaa ||
953.e: What are the signs of the fool? What does the fool do?

953.g: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਓਹੁ ਜਿ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਹੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੇ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
953.t: moorakh oh j mugadh hai aha(n)kaare maranaa ||
953.e: A fool is stupid; he dies of egotism.

953.g: ਏਤੁ ਕਮਾਣੈ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੁਖ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਣਾ ॥
953.t: et kamaanai sadhaa dhukh dhukh hee meh rahanaa ||
953.e: His actions always bring him pain; he lives in pain.

953.g: ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਪਵੈ ਖੂਹਿ ਕਿਹੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
953.t: at piaaraa pavai khooh kih sa(n)jam karanaa ||
953.e: If someone's beloved friend falls into the pit, what can be used to pull him out?

953.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਓਸੁ ਅਲਿਪਤੋ ਰਹਣਾ ॥
953.t: gurmukh hoi su kare veechaar os alipato rahanaa ||
953.e: One who becomes Gurmukh contemplates the Lord, and remains detached.

953.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਆਪਿ ਉਧਰੈ ਓਸੁ ਪਿਛੈ ਡੁਬਦੇ ਭੀ ਤਰਣਾ ॥
953.t: har naam japai aap udharai os pichhai ddubadhe bhee taranaa ||
953.e: Chanting the Lord's Name, he saves himself, and he carries across those who are drowning as well.

953.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜੋ ਦੇਇ ਸੁ ਸਹਣਾ ॥੧॥
953.t: naanak jo tis bhaavai so kare jo dhei su sahanaa ||1||
953.e: O Nanak, he acts in accordance with the Will of God; he endures whatever he is given. ||1||

953.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
953.e: First Mehla:

953.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਸਿਖ ਸਹੀ ॥
953.t: naanak aakhai re manaa suneeaai sikh sahee ||
953.e: Says Nanak, listen, O mind, to the True Teachings.

953.g: ਲੇਖਾ ਰਬੁ ਮੰਗੇਸੀਆ ਬੈਠਾ ਕਢਿ ਵਹੀ ॥
953.t: lekhaa rab ma(n)geseeaa baiThaa kadd vahee ||
953.e: Opening His ledger, God will call you to account.

953.g: ਤਲਬਾ ਪਉਸਨਿ ਆਕੀਆ ਬਾਕੀ ਜਿਨਾ ਰਹੀ ॥
953.t: talabaa pausan aakeeaa baakee jinaa rahee ||
953.e: Those rebels who have unpaid accounts shall be called out.

953.g: ਅਜਰਾਈਲੁ ਫਰੇਸਤਾ ਹੋਸੀ ਆਇ ਤਈ ॥
953.t: ajaraieel faresataa hosee aai tiee ||
953.e: Azraa-eel, the Angel of Death, shall be appointed to punish them.

953.g: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਭੀੜੀ ਗਲੀ ਫਹੀ ॥
953.t: aavan jaan na sujhiee bheeRee galee fahee ||
953.e: They will find no way to escape coming and going in reincarnation; they are trapped in the narrow path.

953.g: ਕੂੜ ਨਿਖੁਟੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਓੜਕਿ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੀ ॥੨॥
953.t: kooR nikhuTe naanakaa oRak sach rahee ||2||
953.e: Falsehood will come to an end, O Nanak, and Truth will prevail in the end. ||2||

953.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
953.t: pauRee ||
953.e: Pauree:

953.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਆਪੈ ॥
953.t: har kaa sabh sareer hai har rav rahiaa sabh aapai ||
953.e: The body and everything belongs to the Lord; the Lord Himself is all-pervading.

953.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨ ਪਵੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
953.t: har kee keemat na pavai kichh kahan na jaapai ||
953.e: The Lord's value cannot be estimated; nothing can be said about it.

953.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਾਪੈ ॥
953.t: gur parasaadhee saalaaheeaai har bhagatee raapai ||
953.e: By Guru's Grace, one praises the Lord, imbued with feelings of devotion.

953.g: ਸਭੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਗਵਾਪੈ ॥
953.t: sabh man tan hariaa hoiaa aha(n)kaar gavaapai ||
953.e: The mind and body are totally rejuvenated, and egotism is eradicated.

953.g: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧੩॥
953.t: sabh kichh har kaa khel hai gurmukh kisai bujhaiee ||13||
953.e: Everything is the play of the Lord. The Gurmukh understands this. ||13||

953.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
953.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
953.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

953.g: ਸਹੰਸਰ ਦਾਨ ਦੇ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੁ ਰੋਆਇਆ ॥
953.t: saha(n)sar dhaan dhe i(n)dhr roaaiaa ||
953.e: Branded with a thousand marks of disgrace, Indra cried in shame.

953.g: ਪਰਸ ਰਾਮੁ ਰੋਵੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
953.t: paras raam rovai ghar aaiaa ||
953.e: Paras Raam returned home crying.

953.g: ਅਜੈ ਸੁ ਰੋਵੈ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਖਾਇ ॥
953.t: ajai su rovai bheekhiaa khai ||
953.e: Ajai cried and wept, when he was made to eat the manure he had given, pretending it was charity.

953.g: ਐਸੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
953.t: aaisee dharageh milai sajai ||
953.e: Such is the punishment received in the Court of the Lord.

953.g: ਰੋਵੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਨਿਕਾਲਾ ਭਇਆ ॥
953.t: rovai raam nikaalaa bhiaa ||
953.e: Rama wept when he was sent into exile,

954.g: ਸੀਤਾ ਲਖਮਣੁ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
954.t: seetaa lakhaman vichhuR giaa ||
954.e: and separated from Sita and Lakhshman.

954.g: ਰੋਵੈ ਦਹਸਿਰੁ ਲੰਕ ਗਵਾਇ ॥ ਜਿਨਿ ਸੀਤਾ ਆਦੀ ਡਉਰੂ ਵਾਇ ॥
954.t: rovai dhahasir la(n)k gavai || jin seetaa aadhee ddauroo vai ||
954.e: The ten-headed Raawan, who stole away Sita with the beat of his tambourine, wept when he lost Sri Lanka.

954.g: ਰੋਵਹਿ ਪਾਂਡਵ ਭਏ ਮਜੂਰ ॥ ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਹਤ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
954.t: roveh paa(n)ddav bhe majoor || jin kai suaamee rahat hadhoor ||
954.e: The Paandavas once lived in the Presence of the Lord; they were made slaves, and wept.

954.g: ਰੋਵੈ ਜਨਮੇਜਾ ਖੁਇ ਗਇਆ ॥
954.t: rovai janamejaa khui giaa ||
954.e: Janmayjaa wept, that he had lost his way.

954.g: ਏਕੀ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਪਾਪੀ ਭਇਆ ॥
954.t: ekee kaaran paapee bhiaa ||
954.e: One mistake, and he became a sinner.

954.g: ਰੋਵਹਿ ਸੇਖ ਮਸਾਇਕ ਪੀਰ ॥
954.t: roveh sekh masaik peer ||
954.e: The Shaykhs, Pirs and spiritual teachers weep;

954.g: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਮਤੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਭੀੜ ॥
954.t: a(n)t kaal mat laagai bheeR ||
954.e: at the very last instant, they suffer in agony.

954.g: ਰੋਵਹਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਕੰਨ ਪੜਾਇ ॥
954.t: roveh raaje ka(n)n paRai ||
954.e: The kings weep - their ears are cut;

954.g: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
954.t: ghar ghar maageh bheekhiaa jai ||
954.e: they go begging from house to house.

954.g: ਰੋਵਹਿ ਕਿਰਪਨ ਸੰਚਹਿ ਧਨੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
954.t: roveh kirapan sa(n)cheh dhan jai ||
954.e: The miser weeps; he has to leave behind the wealth he has gathered.

954.g: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
954.t: pa(n)ddit roveh giaan gavai ||
954.e: The Pandit, the religious scholar, weeps when his learning is gone.

954.g: ਬਾਲੀ ਰੋਵੈ ਨਾਹਿ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥
954.t: baalee rovai naeh bhataar ||
954.e: The young woman weeps because she has no husband.

954.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
954.t: naanak dhukheeaa sabh sa(n)saar ||
954.e: O Nanak, the whole world is suffering.

954.g: ਮੰਨੇ ਨਾਉ ਸੋਈ ਜਿਣਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
954.t: ma(n)ne naau soiee jin jai ||
954.e: He alone is victorious, who believes in the Lord's Name.

954.g: ਅਉਰੀ ਕਰਮ ਨ ਲੇਖੈ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
954.t: aauree karam na lekhai lai ||1||
954.e: No other action is of any account. ||1||

954.t: mahalaa doojaa ||
954.e: Second Mehla:

954.g: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਅਵਰਿ ਕਾਰਾ ਸਭਿ ਬਾਦਿ ॥
954.t: jap tap sabh kichh ma(n)niaai avar kaaraa sabh baadh ||
954.e: Meditation, austerity and everything come through belief in the Lord's Name. All other actions are useless.

954.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ॥੨॥
954.t: naanak ma(n)niaa ma(n)neeaai bujheeaai gur parasaadh ||2||
954.e: O Nanak, believe in the One who is worth believing in. By Guru's Grace, he is realized. ||2||

954.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
954.t: pauRee ||
954.e: Pauree:

954.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਹੰਸ ਧੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੁ ਕਰਤੈ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
954.t: kaiaa ha(n)s dhur mel karatai likh paiaa ||
954.e: The union of the body and the soul-swan was pre-ordained by the Creator Lord.

954.g: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਆ ॥
954.t: sabh meh gupat varatadhaa gurmukh pragaTaiaa ||
954.e: He is hidden, and yet pervading all. He is revealed to the Gurmukh.

954.g: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
954.t: gun gaavai gun ucharai gun maeh samaiaa ||
954.e: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and chanting His Praises, one merges in His Glories.

954.g: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
954.t: sachee baanee sach hai sach mel milaiaa ||
954.e: True is the True Word of the Guru's Bani. One unites in Union with the True Lord.

954.g: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧੪॥
954.t: sabh kichh aape aap hai aape dhei vaddiaaiee ||14||
954.e: He Himself is everything; He Himself grants glorious greatness. ||14||

954.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
954.t: salok mahalaa doojaa ||
954.e: Shalok, Second Mehla:

954.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਧਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਰਤਨਾ ਪਰਖਣ ਜਾਇ ॥
954.t: naanak a(n)dhaa hoi kai ratanaa parakhan jai ||
954.e: O Nanak, the blind man may go to appraise the jewels,

954.g: ਰਤਨਾ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਆਵੈ ਆਪੁ ਲਖਾਇ ॥੧॥
954.t: ratanaa saar na jaaniee aavai aap lakhai ||1||
954.e: but he will not know their value; he will return home after exposing his ignorance. ||1||

954.t: mahalaa doojaa ||
954.e: Second Mehla:

954.g: ਰਤਨਾ ਕੇਰੀ ਗੁਥਲੀ ਰਤਨੀ ਖੋਲੀ ਆਇ ॥
954.t: ratanaa keree guthalee ratanee kholee aai ||
954.e: The Jeweller has come, and opened up the bag of jewels.

954.g: ਵਖਰ ਤੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਦੁਹਾ ਰਹੀ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
954.t: vakhar tai vanajaariaa dhuhaa rahee samai ||
954.e: The merchandise and the merchant are merged together.

954.g: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਣੁ ਪਲੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਮਾਣਕ ਵਣਜਹਿ ਸੇਇ ॥
954.t: jin gun palai naanakaa maanak vanajeh sei ||
954.e: They alone purchase the gem, O Nanak, who have virtue in their purse.

954.g: ਰਤਨਾ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਅੰਧੇ ਵਤਹਿ ਲੋਇ ॥੨॥
954.t: ratanaa saar na jaananee a(n)dhe vateh loi ||2||
954.e: Those who do not appreciate the value of the jewels, wander like blind men in the world. ||2||

954.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
954.t: pauRee ||
954.e: Pauree:

954.g: ਨਉ ਦਰਵਾਜੇ ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟੁ ਹੈ ਦਸਵੈ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਰਖੀਜੈ ॥
954.t: nau dharavaaje kaiaa koT hai dhasavai gupat rakheejai ||
954.e: The fortress of the body has nine gates; the tenth gate is kept hidden.

954.g: ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਨ ਖੁਲਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਖੁਲੀਜੈ ॥
954.t: bajar kapaaT na khulanee gur sabadh khuleejai ||
954.e: The rigid door is not open; only through the Word of the Guru's Shabad can it be opened.

954.g: ਅਨਹਦ ਵਾਜੇ ਧੁਨਿ ਵਜਦੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਣੀਜੈ ॥
954.t: anahadh vaaje dhun vajadhe gur sabadh suneejai ||
954.e: The unstruck sound current resounds and vibrates there. The Word of the Guru's Shabad is heard.

954.g: ਤਿਤੁ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਕਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ ॥
954.t: tit ghaT a(n)tar chaananaa kar bhagat mileejai ||
954.e: Deep within the nucleus of the heart, the Divine Light shines forth. Through devotional worship, one meets the Lord.

954.g: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੇ ਰਚਨ ਰਚਾਈ ॥੧੫॥
954.t: sabh meh ek varatadhaa jin aape rachan rachaiee ||15||
954.e: The One Lord is pervading and permeating all. He Himself created the creation. ||15||

954.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
954.t: salok mahalaa doojaa ||
954.e: Shalok, Second Mehla:

954.g: ਅੰਧੇ ਕੈ ਰਾਹਿ ਦਸਿਐ ਅੰਧਾ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
954.t: a(n)dhe kai raeh dhasiaai a(n)dhaa hoi su jai ||
954.e: He is truly blind, who follows the way shown by the blind man.

954.g: ਹੋਇ ਸੁਜਾਖਾ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਉਝੜਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
954.t: hoi sujaakhaa naanakaa so kiau ujhaR pai ||
954.e: O Nanak, why should the one who can see, get lost?

954.g: ਅੰਧੇ ਏਹਿ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ ਜਿਨ ਮੁਖਿ ਲੋਇਣ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
954.t: a(n)dhe eh na aakheean jin mukh loin naeh ||
954.e: Do not call them blind, who have no eyes in their face.

954.g: ਅੰਧੇ ਸੇਈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਖਸਮਹੁ ਘੁਥੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
954.t: a(n)dhe seiee naanakaa khasamahu ghuthe jaeh ||1||
954.e: They alone are blind, O Nanak, who wander away from their Lord and Master. ||1||

954.t: mahalaa doojaa ||
954.e: Second Mehla:

954.g: ਸਾਹਿਬਿ ਅੰਧਾ ਜੋ ਕੀਆ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਜਾਖਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
954.t: saahib a(n)dhaa jo keeaa kare sujaakhaa hoi ||
954.e: One whom the Lord has made blind - the Lord can make him see again.

954.g: ਜੇਹਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਤੇਹੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਜੇ ਸਉ ਆਖੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
954.t: jehaa jaanai teho varatai je sau aakhai koi ||
954.e: He acts only as he knows, although he may be spoken to a hundred times.

954.g: ਜਿਥੈ ਸੁ ਵਸਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਪਈ ਆਪੇ ਵਰਤਉ ਜਾਣਿ ॥
954.t: jithai su vasat na jaapiee aape varatau jaan ||
954.e: Where the real thing is not seen, self-conceit prevails there - know this well.

954.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਕਿਉ ਲਏ ਸਕੈ ਨ ਵਸਤੁ ਪਛਾਣਿ ॥੨॥
954.t: naanak gaahak kiau le sakai na vasat pachhaan ||2||
954.e: O Nanak, how can the purshaser purchase the real thing, if he cannot recognize it? ||2||

954.t: mahalaa doojaa ||
954.e: Second Mehla:

954.g: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਅੰਧਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿ ਹੁਕਮਹੁ ਅੰਧਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
954.t: so kiau a(n)dhaa aakheeaai j hukamahu a(n)dhaa hoi ||
954.e: How can someone be called blind, if he was made blind by the Lord's Command?

954.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੁਝਈ ਅੰਧਾ ਕਹੀਐ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
954.t: naanak hukam na bujhiee a(n)dhaa kaheeaai soi ||3||
954.e: O Nanak, one who does not understand the Hukam of the Lord's Command should be called blind. ||3||

955.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
955.t: pauRee ||
955.e: Pauree:

955.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਗੜੁ ਕੋਟੁ ਹੈ ਸਭਿ ਦਿਸੰਤਰ ਦੇਸਾ ॥
955.t: kaiaa a(n)dhar gaR koT hai sabh dhisa(n)tar dhesaa ||
955.e: Deep within the body is the fortress of the Lord, and all lands and countries.

955.g: ਆਪੇ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈਅਨੁ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਪਰਵੇਸਾ ॥
955.t: aape taaRee laieean sabh meh paravesaa ||
955.e: He Himself sits in primal, profound Samaadhi; He Himself is all-pervading.

955.g: ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਆਪਿ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਰਖੇਸਾ ॥
955.t: aape sirasaT saajeean aap gupat rakhesaa ||
955.e: He Himself created the Universe, and He Himself remains hidden within it.

955.g: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਪਰਗਟੀਏਸਾ ॥
955.t: gur sevaa te jaaniaa sach paragaTe'eesaa ||
955.e: Serving the Guru, the Lord is known, and the Truth is revealed.

955.g: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੬॥
955.t: sabh kichh sacho sach hai gur sojhee paiee ||16||
955.e: He is True, the Truest of the True; the Guru has imparted this understanding. ||16||

955.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
955.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
955.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

955.g: ਸਾਵਣੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਅਹਾੜੁ ਦਿਹੁ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਦੁਇ ਖੇਤ ॥
955.t: saavan raat ahaaR dhih kaam karodh dhui khet ||
955.e: Night is the summer season, and day is the winter season; sexual desire and anger are the two fields planted.

955.g: ਲਬੁ ਵਤ੍ਰ ਦਰੋਗੁ ਬੀਉ ਹਾਲੀ ਰਾਹਕੁ ਹੇਤ ॥
955.t: lab vatr dharog beeau haalee raahak het ||
955.e: Greed prepares the soil, and the seed of falsehood is planted; attachment and love are the farmer and hired hand.

955.g: ਹਲੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਮਣ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਖਟੇ ਖਾਇ ॥
955.t: hal beechaar vikaar man hukamee khaTe khai ||
955.e: Contemplation is the plow, and corruption is the harvest; this is what one earns and eats, according to the Hukam of the Lord's Command.

955.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਲੇਖੈ ਮੰਗਿਐ ਅਉਤੁ ਜਣੇਦਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
955.t: naanak lekhai ma(n)giaai aaut janedhaa jai ||1||
955.e: O Nanak, when one is called to give his account, he will be barren and infertile. ||1||

955.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
955.e: First Mehla:

955.g: ਭਉ ਭੁਇ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਬਲੇਦ ॥
955.t: bhau bhui pavit paanee sat sa(n)tokh baledh ||
955.e: Make the Fear of God the farm, purity the water, truth and contentment the cows and bulls,

955.g: ਹਲੁ ਹਲੇਮੀ ਹਾਲੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਚੇਤਾ ਵਤ੍ਰ ਵਖਤ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥
955.t: hal halemee haalee chit chetaa vatr vakhat sa(n)jog ||
955.e: humility the plow, consciousness the plowman, remembrance the preparation of the soil, and union with the Lord the planting time.

955.g: ਨਾਉ ਬੀਜੁ ਬਖਸੀਸ ਬੋਹਲ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਸਗਲ ਦਰੋਗ ॥
955.t: naau beej bakhasees bohal dhuneeaa sagal dharog ||
955.e: Let the Lord's Name be the seed, and His Forgiving Grace the harvest. Do this, and the whole world will seem false.

955.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਵਿਜੋਗ ॥੨॥
955.t: naanak nadharee karam hoi jaaveh sagal vijog ||2||
955.e: O Nanak, if He bestows His Merciful Glance of Grace, then all your separation will be ended. ||2||

955.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
955.t: pauRee ||
955.e: Pauree:

955.g: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਬੋਲੈ ॥
955.t: manmukh moh gubaar hai dhoojai bhai bolai ||
955.e: The self-willed manmukh is trapped in the darkness of emotional attachment; in the love of duality he speaks.

955.g: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਨਿਤ ਨੀਰੁ ਵਿਰੋਲੈ ॥
955.t: dhoojai bhai sadhaa dhukh hai nit neer virolai ||
955.e: The love of duality brings pain forever; he churns the water endlessly.

955.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਮਥਿ ਤਤੁ ਕਢੋਲੈ ॥
955.t: gurmukh naam dhiaaieeaai math tat kaddolai ||
955.e: The Gurmukh meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; he churns, and obtains the essence of reality.

955.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਲਧਾ ਟੋਲੈ ॥
955.t: a(n)tar paragaas ghaT chaananaa har ladhaa Tolai ||
955.e: The Divine Light illuminates his heart deep within; he seeks the Lord, and obtains Him.

955.g: ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਦਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੭॥
955.t: aape bharam bhulaidhaa kichh kahan na jaiee ||17||
955.e: He Himself deludes in doubt; no one can comment on this. ||17||

955.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
955.t: salok mahalaa doojaa ||
955.e: Shalok, Second Mehla:

955.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਹੇਇ ॥
955.t: naanak chi(n)taa mat karahu chi(n)taa tis hee hei ||
955.e: O Nanak, don't be anxious; the Lord will take care of you.

955.g: ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇਅਨੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਭਿ ਰੋਜੀ ਦੇਇ ॥
955.t: jal meh ja(n)t upaian tinaa bh rojee dhei ||
955.e: He created the creatures in water, and He gives them their nourishment.

955.g: ਓਥੈ ਹਟੁ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਕਿਰਸ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
955.t: othai haT na chaliee naa ko kiras karei ||
955.e: There are no stores open there, and no one farms there.

955.g: ਸਉਦਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਲਏ ਨ ਦੇਇ ॥
955.t: saudhaa mool na hoviee naa ko le na dhei ||
955.e: No business is ever transacted there, and no one buys or sells.

955.g: ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਆਹਾਰੁ ਜੀਅ ਖਾਣਾ ਏਹੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
955.t: jeeaa kaa aahaar jeea khaanaa eh karei ||
955.e: Animals eat other animals; this is what the Lord has given them as food.

955.g: ਵਿਚਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਸਾਇਰਾ ਤਿਨਾ ਭਿ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
955.t: vich upaae sairaa tinaa bh saar karei ||
955.e: He created them in the oceans, and He provides for them as well.

955.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਤ ਕਰਹੁ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਹੇਇ ॥੧॥
955.t: naanak chi(n)taa mat karahu chi(n)taa tis hee hei ||1||
955.e: O Nanak, don't be anxious; the Lord will take care of you. ||1||

955.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
955.e: First Mehla:

955.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਝੀਵਰੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
955.t: naanak ih jeeau machhulee jheevar tirasanaa kaal ||
955.e: O Nanak, this soul is the fish, and death is the hungry fisherman.

955.g: ਮਨੂਆ ਅੰਧੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਈ ਪੜੈ ਅਚਿੰਤਾ ਜਾਲੁ ॥
955.t: manooaa a(n)dh na chetiee paRai achi(n)taa jaal ||
955.e: The blind man does not even think of this. And suddenly, the net is cast.

955.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਿਤੁ ਅਚੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਬਧਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
955.t: naanak chit achet hai chi(n)taa badhaa jai ||
955.e: O Nanak, his consciousness is unconscious, and he departs, bound by anxiety.

955.g: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
955.t: nadhar kare je aapanee taa aape le milai ||2||
955.e: But if the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, then He unites the soul with Himself. ||2||

955.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
955.t: pauRee ||
955.e: Pauree:

955.g: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਤਾ ॥
955.t: se jan saache sadhaa sadhaa jinee har ras peetaa ||
955.e: They are true, forever true, who drink in the sublime essence of the Lord.

955.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਉਦਾ ਕੀਤਾ ॥
955.t: gurmukh sachaa man vasai sach saudhaa keetaa ||
955.e: The True Lord abides in the mind of the Gurmukh; He strikes the true bargain.

955.g: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਹੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਲੀਤਾ ॥
955.t: sabh kichh ghar hee maeh hai vaddabhaagee leetaa ||
955.e: Everything is in the home of the self within; only the very fortunate obtain it.

955.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਰਿ ਗਈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੀਤਾ ॥
955.t: a(n)tar tirasanaa mar giee har gun gaaveetaa ||
955.e: The hunger within is conquered and overcome, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

955.g: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧੮॥
955.t: aape mel milaian aape dhei bujhaiee ||18||
955.e: He Himself unites in His Union; He Himself blesses them with understanding. ||18||

955.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
955.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
955.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

955.g: ਵੇਲਿ ਪਿੰਞਾਇਆ ਕਤਿ ਵੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
955.t: vel pi(n)n(j)aiaa kat vunaiaa ||
955.e: The cotton is ginned, woven and spun;

955.g: ਕਟਿ ਕੁਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਖੁੰਬਿ ਚੜਾਇਆ ॥
955.t: kaT kuT kar khu(n)b chaRaiaa ||
955.e: the cloth is laid out, washed and bleached white.

955.g: ਲੋਹਾ ਵਢੇ ਦਰਜੀ ਪਾੜੇ ਸੂਈ ਧਾਗਾ ਸੀਵੈ ॥
955.t: lohaa vadde dharajee paaRe sooiee dhaagaa seevai ||
955.e: The tailor cuts it with his scissors, and sews it with his thread.

955.g: ਇਉ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਟੀ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਸੀਪੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵਤ ਜੀਵੈ ॥
955.t: eiau pat paaTee sifatee seepai naanak jeevat jeevai ||
955.e: Thus, the torn and tattered honor is sewn up again, through the Lord's Praise, O Nanak, and one lives the true life.

955.g: ਹੋਇ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ ਕਪੜੁ ਪਾਟੈ ਸੂਈ ਧਾਗਾ ਗੰਢੈ ॥
955.t: hoi puraanaa kapaR paaTai sooiee dhaagaa ga(n)ddai ||
955.e: Becoming worn, the cloth is torn; with needle and thread it is sewn up again.

955.g: ਮਾਹੁ ਪਖੁ ਕਿਹੁ ਚਲੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹਤੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੰਢੈ ॥
955.t: maahu pakh kih chalai naahee ghaRee muhat kichh ha(n)ddai ||
955.e: It will not last for a month, or even a week. It barely lasts for an hour, or even a moment.

956.g: ਸਚੁ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੀਤਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਪਾਟੈ ॥
956.t: sach puraanaa hovai naahee seetaa kadhe na paaTai ||
956.e: But the Truth does not grow old; and when it is stitched, it is never torn again.

956.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੋ ਸਚਾ ਤਿਚਰੁ ਜਾਪੀ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੧॥
956.t: naanak saahib sacho sachaa tichar jaapee jaapai ||1||
956.e: O Nanak, the Lord and Master is the Truest of the True. While we meditate on Him, we see Him. ||1||

956.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
956.e: First Mehla:

956.g: ਸਚ ਕੀ ਕਾਤੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
956.t: sach kee kaatee sach sabh saar ||
956.e: The knife is Truth, and its steel is totally True.

956.g: ਘਾੜਤ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
956.t: ghaaRat tis kee apar apaar ||
956.e: Its workmanship is incomparably beautiful.

956.g: ਸਬਦੇ ਸਾਣ ਰਖਾਈ ਲਾਇ ॥
956.t: sabadhe saan rakhaiee lai ||
956.e: It is sharpened on the grindstone of the Shabad.

956.g: ਗੁਣ ਕੀ ਥੇਕੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
956.t: gun kee thekai vich samai ||
956.e: It is placed in the scabbard of virtue.

956.g: ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਕੁਠਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੇਖੁ ॥
956.t: tis dhaa kuThaa hovai sekh ||
956.e: If the Shaykh is killed with that,

956.g: ਲੋਹੂ ਲਬੁ ਨਿਕਥਾ ਵੇਖੁ ॥
956.t: lohoo lab nikathaa vekh ||
956.e: then the blood of greed will spill out.

956.g: ਹੋਇ ਹਲਾਲੁ ਲਗੈ ਹਕਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
956.t: hoi halaal lagai hak jai ||
956.e: One who is slaughtered in this ritualistic way, will be attached to the Lord.

956.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਿ ਦੀਦਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
956.t: naanak dhar dheedhaar samai ||2||
956.e: O Nanak, at the Lord's door, he is absorbed into His Blessed Vision. ||2||

956.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
956.e: First Mehla:

956.g: ਕਮਰਿ ਕਟਾਰਾ ਬੰਕੁੜਾ ਬੰਕੇ ਕਾ ਅਸਵਾਰੁ ॥
956.t: kamar kaTaaraa ba(n)kuRaa ba(n)ke kaa asavaar ||
956.e: A beautiful dagger hangs by your waist, and you ride such a beautiful horse.

956.g: ਗਰਬੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਮਤੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਭਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
956.t: garab na keejai naanakaa mat sir aavai bhaar ||3||
956.e: But don't be too proud; O Nanak, you may fall head first to the ground. ||3||

956.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
956.t: pauRee ||
956.e: Pauree:

956.g: ਸੋ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਲੈ ॥
956.t: so satasa(n)gat sabadh milai jo gurmukh chalai ||
956.e: They alone walk as Gurmukh, who receive the Shabad in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

956.g: ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਸੇ ਸਚੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਖਰਚੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ॥
956.t: sach dhiaain se sache jin har kharach dhan palai ||
956.e: Meditating on the True Lord, they become truthful; they carry in their robes the supplies of the Lord's wealth.

956.g: ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਦੇ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਅਚਲੈ ॥
956.t: bhagat sohan gun gaavadhe gurmat achalai ||
956.e: The devotees look beautiful, singing the Praises of the Lord; following the Guru's Teachings, they become stable and unchanging.

956.g: ਰਤਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਭਲੈ ॥
956.t: ratan beechaar man vasiaa gur kai sabadh bhalai ||
956.e: They enshrine the jewel of contemplation within their minds, and the most sublime Word of the Guru's Shabad.

956.g: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧੯॥
956.t: aape mel milaidhaa aape dhei vaddiaaiee ||19||
956.e: He Himself unites in His Union; He Himself grants glorious greatness. ||19||

956.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
956.t: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
956.e: Shalok, Third Mehla:

956.g: ਆਸਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਕੋਇ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
956.t: aasaa a(n)dhar sabh ko koi niraasaa hoi ||
956.e: Everyone is filled with hope; hardly anyone is free of hope.

956.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਸਹਿਲਾ ਆਇਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
956.t: naanak jo mar jeeviaa sahilaa aaiaa soi ||1||
956.e: O Nanak, blessed is the birth of one, who remains dead while yet alive. ||1||

956.t: mahalaa teejaa ||
956.e: Third Mehla:

956.g: ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਸਾ ਹਥਿ ਹੈ ਕੇਉ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
956.t: naa kichh aasaa hath hai keau niraasaa hoi ||
956.e: Nothing is in the hands of hope. How can one become free of hope?

956.g: ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਏਹ ਬਪੁੜੀ ਜਾਂ ਭੋੁਲਾਏ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
956.t: kiaa kare eh bapuRee jaa(n) bhuolaae soi ||2||
956.e: What can this poor being do? The Lord Himself creates confusion. ||2||

956.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
956.t: pauRee ||
956.e: Pauree:

956.g: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ॥
956.t: dhirag jeevan sa(n)saar sache naam bin ||
956.e: Cursed is the life in this world, without the True Name.

956.g: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਤਾਰ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਏਹੁ ਧਨੁ ॥
956.t: prabh dhaataa dhaataar nihachal eh dhan ||
956.e: God is the Great Giver of givers. His wealth is permanent and unchanging.

956.g: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸੋਇ ਜਨੁ ॥
956.t: saas saas aaraadhe niramal soi jan ||
956.e: That humble being is immaculate, who worships the Lord with each and every breath.

956.g: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਅਗਮੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਏਕੁ ਭਨੁ ॥
956.t: a(n)tarajaamee agam rasanaa ek bhan ||
956.e: With your tongue, vibrate the One Inaccessible Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

956.g: ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੨੦॥
956.t: rav rahiaa sarabat naanak bal jaiee ||20||
956.e: He is all-pervading everywhere. Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||20||

956.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
956.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
956.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

956.g: ਸਰਵਰ ਹੰਸ ਧੁਰੇ ਹੀ ਮੇਲਾ ਖਸਮੈ ਏਵੈ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
956.t: saravar ha(n)s dhure hee melaa khasamai evai bhaanaa ||
956.e: The union between the lake of the True Guru, and the swan of the soul, was pre-ordained from the very beginning, by the Pleasure of the Lord's Will.

956.g: ਸਰਵਰ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹੀਰਾ ਮੋਤੀ ਸੋ ਹੰਸਾ ਕਾ ਖਾਣਾ ॥
956.t: saravar a(n)dhar heeraa motee so ha(n)saa kaa khaanaa ||
956.e: The diamonds are in this lake; they are the food of the swans.

956.g: ਬਗੁਲਾ ਕਾਗੁ ਨ ਰਹਈ ਸਰਵਰਿ ਜੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਤਿ ਸਿਆਣਾ ॥
956.t: bagulaa kaag na rahiee saravar je hovai at siaanaa ||
956.e: The cranes and the ravens may be very wise, but they do not remain in this lake.

956.g: ਓਨਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਨ ਪਇਓ ਓਥੈ ਓਨੑਾ ਹੋਰੋ ਖਾਣਾ ॥
956.t: onaa rijak na pio othai on(h)aa horo khaanaa ||
956.e: They do not find their food there; their food is different.

956.g: ਸਚਿ ਕਮਾਣੈ ਸਚੋ ਪਾਈਐ ਕੂੜੈ ਕੂੜਾ ਮਾਣਾ ॥
956.t: sach kamaanai sacho paieeaai kooRai kooRaa maanaa ||
956.e: Practicing Truth, the True Lord is found. False is the pride of the false.

956.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੌ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਿਨਾ ਧੁਰੇ ਪੈਯਾ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ ॥੧॥
956.t: naanak tin kau satigur miliaa jinaa dhure paiyaa paravaanaa ||1||
956.e: O Nanak, they alone meet the True Guru, who are so pre-destined by the Lord's Command. ||1||

956.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
956.e: First Mehla:

956.g: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਉਜਲਾ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
956.t: saahib meraa ujalaa je ko chit karei ||
956.e: My Lord and Master is immaculate, as are those who think of Him.

956.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਈ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜੋ ਦੇਇ ॥
956.t: naanak soiee seveeaai sadhaa sadhaa jo dhei ||
956.e: O Nanak, serve Him, who gives to you forever and ever.

956.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਈ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
956.t: naanak soiee seveeaai jit seviaai dhukh jai ||
956.e: O Nanak, serve Him; by serving Him, sorrow is dispelled.

956.g: ਅਵਗੁਣ ਵੰਞਨਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸੈ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
956.t: avagun va(n)n(j)n gun raveh man sukh vasai aai ||2||
956.e: Faults and demerits vanish, and virtues take their place; peace comes to dwell in the mind. ||2||

956.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
956.t: pauRee ||
956.e: Pauree:

956.g: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਆਪਿ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈਅਨੁ ॥
956.t: aape aap varatadhaa aap taaRee laieean ||
956.e: He Himself is all-pervading; He Himself is absorbed in the profound state of Samaadhi.

956.g: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਉਪਦੇਸਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਤੀਆਈਅਨੁ ॥
956.t: aape hee upadhesadhaa gurmukh pateeaaieean ||
956.e: He Himself instructs; the Gurmukh is satisfied and fulfilled.

956.g: ਇਕਿ ਆਪੇ ਉਝੜਿ ਪਾਇਅਨੁ ਇਕਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਇਅਨੁ ॥
956.t: eik aape ujhaR paian ik bhagatee laian ||
956.e: Some, He causes to wander in the wilderness, while others are committed to His devotional worship.

956.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋ ਬੁਝਸੀ ਆਪੇ ਨਾਇ ਲਾਈਅਨੁ ॥
956.t: jis aap bujhaae so bujhasee aape nai laieean ||
956.e: He alone understands, whom the Lord causes to understand; He Himself attaches mortals to His Name.

956.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨੧॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ ॥
956.t: naanak naam dhiaaieeaai sachee vaddiaaiee ||21||1|| sudh ||
956.e: O Nanak, meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, true greatness is obtained. ||21||1|| Sudh||

957.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫
957.t: raamakalee kee vaar mahalaa panjavaa
957.e: Vaar Of Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:

957.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
957.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
957.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

957.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
957.t: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
957.e: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

957.g: ਜੈਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੁਣੀਦਾ ਤੈਸੋ ਹੀ ਮੈ ਡੀਠੁ ॥
957.t: jaisaa satigur suneedhaa taiso hee mai ddeeTh ||
957.e: As I have heard of the True Guru, so I have seen Him.

957.g: ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਮੇਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਕਾ ਬਸੀਠੁ ॥
957.t: vichhuRiaa mele prabhoo har dharageh kaa baseeTh ||
957.e: He re-unites the separated ones with God; He is the Mediator at the Court of the Lord.

957.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਦਾ ਕਟੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
957.t: har naamo ma(n)tr dhiraRaidhaa kaTe haumai rog ||
957.e: He implants the Mantra of the Lord's Name, and eradicates the illness of egotism.

957.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਾ ਧੁਰੇ ਪਇਆ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
957.t: naanak satigur tinaa milaiaa jinaa dhure piaa sa(n)jog ||1||
957.e: O Nanak, he alone meets the True Guru, who has such union pre-ordained. ||1||

957.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
957.e: Fifth Mehla:

957.g: ਇਕੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਸਭਿ ਸਜਣਾ ਇਕੁ ਵੈਰੀ ਸਭਿ ਵਾਦਿ ॥
957.t: eik sajan sabh sajanaa ik vairee sabh vaadh ||
957.e: If the One Lord is my Friend, then all are my friends. If the One Lord is my enemy, then all fight with me.

957.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੇਖਾਲਿਆ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਬਾਦਿ ॥
957.t: gur poorai dhekhaaliaa vin naavai sabh baadh ||
957.e: The Perfect Guru has shown me that, without the Name, everything is useless.

957.g: ਸਾਕਤ ਦੁਰਜਨ ਭਰਮਿਆ ਜੋ ਲਗੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਸਾਦਿ ॥
957.t: saakat dhurajan bharamiaa jo lage dhoojai saadh ||
957.e: The faithless cynics and the evil people wander in reincarnation; they are attached to other tastes.

957.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ॥੨॥
957.t: jan naanak har prabh bujhiaa gur satigur kai parasaadh ||2||
957.e: Servant Nanak has realized the Lord God, by the Grace of the Guru, the True Guru. ||2||

957.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
957.t: pauRee ||
957.e: Pauree:

957.g: ਥਟਣਹਾਰੈ ਥਾਟੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਥਟਿਆ ॥
957.t: thaTanahaarai thaaT aape hee thaTiaa ||
957.e: The Creator Lord created the Creation.

957.g: ਆਪੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਖਟਿਆ ॥
957.t: aape pooraa saahu aape hee khaTiaa ||
957.e: He Himself is the perfect Banker; He Himself earns His profit.

957.g: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਸਾਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਰੰਗ ਰਟਿਆ ॥
957.t: aape kar paasaar aape ra(n)g raTiaa ||
957.e: He Himself made the expansive Universe; He Himself is imbued with joy.

957.g: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਇ ਅਲਖ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਟਿਆ ॥
957.t: kudharat keem na pai alakh brahamaTiaa ||
957.e: The value of God's almighty creative power cannot be estimated.

957.g: ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਪਰੈ ਪਰਟਿਆ ॥
957.t: agam athaeh bea(n)t parai paraTiaa ||
957.e: He is inaccessible, unfathomable, endless, the farthest of the far.

957.g: ਆਪੇ ਵਡ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਵਜੀਰਟਿਆ ॥
957.t: aape vadd paatisaahu aap vajeeraTiaa ||
957.e: He Himself is the greatest Emperor; He Himself is His own Prime Minister.

957.g: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੀਮ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਮਟਿਆ ॥
957.t: koi na jaanai keem kevadd maTiaa ||
957.e: No one knows His worth, or the greatness of His resting place.

957.g: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਆਪਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਟਿਆ ॥੧॥
957.t: sachaa saahib aap gurmukh paragaTiaa ||1||
957.e: He Himself is our True Lord and Master. He reveals Himself to the Gurmukh. ||1||

957.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
957.t: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
957.e: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

957.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਜਣ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਿਖਾਲਿ ॥
957.t: sun sajan preetam meriaa mai satigur dheh dhikhaal ||
957.e: Listen, O my beloved friend: please show me the True Guru.

957.g: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਵਾ ਮਨੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਿਤ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਖਾ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
957.t: hau tis dhevaa man aapanaa nit hiradhai rakhaa samaal ||
957.e: I dedicate my mind to Him; I keep Him continually enshrined within my heart.

957.g: ਇਕਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
957.t: eikas satigur baaharaa dhirag jeevan sa(n)saar ||
957.e: Without the One and Only True Guru, life in this world is cursed.

957.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਮਿਲਾਇਓਨੁ ਜਿਨ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਵਰਤੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
957.t: jan naanak satigur tinaa milaion jin sadh hee varatai naal ||1||
957.e: O servant Nanak, they alone meet the True Guru, with whom He constantly abides. ||1||

957.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
957.e: Fifth Mehla:

957.g: ਮੇਰੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਚਾ ਮਿਲਣ ਕੀ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੋਹਿ ॥
957.t: merai a(n)tar lochaa milan kee kiau paavaa prabh toh ||
957.e: Deep within me is the longing to meet You; how can I find You, God?

957.g: ਕੋਈ ਐਸਾ ਸਜਣੁ ਲੋੜਿ ਲਹੁ ਜੋ ਮੇਲੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮੋਹਿ ॥
957.t: koiee aaisaa sajan loR lahu jo mele preetam moh ||
957.e: I will search for someone, some friend, who will unite me with my Beloved.

957.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਮੇਲਾਇਆ ਜਤ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਤ ਸੋਇ ॥
957.t: gur poorai melaiaa jat dhekhaa tat soi ||
957.e: The Perfect Guru has united me with Him; wherever I look, there He is.

957.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
957.t: jan naanak so prabh seviaa tis jevadd avar na koi ||2||
957.e: Servant Nanak serves that God; there is no other as great as He is. ||2||

957.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
957.t: pauRee ||
957.e: Pauree:

957.g: ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ॥
957.t: dhevanahaar dhaataar kit mukh saalaaheeaai ||
957.e: He is the Great Giver, the Generous Lord; with what mouth can I praise Him?

957.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਰਖੈ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਮਾਹੀਐ ॥
957.t: jis rakhai kirapaa dhaar rijak samaaheeaai ||
957.e: In His Mercy, He protects, preserves and sustains us.

957.g: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਵਸਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਇਕ ਧਰ ॥
957.t: koi na kis hee vas sabhanaa ik dhar ||
957.e: No one is under anyone else's control; He is the One Support of all.

957.g: ਪਾਲੇ ਬਾਲਕ ਵਾਗਿ ਦੇ ਕੈ ਆਪਿ ਕਰ ॥
957.t: paale baalak vaag dhe kai aap kar ||
957.e: He cherishes all as His children, and reaches out with His hand.

957.g: ਕਰਦਾ ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
957.t: karadhaa anadh binodh kichhoo na jaaneeaai ||
957.e: He stages His joyous plays, which no one understands at all.

957.g: ਸਰਬ ਧਾਰ ਸਮਰਥ ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀਐ ॥
957.t: sarab dhaar samarath hau tis kurabaaneeaai ||
957.e: The all-powerful Lord gives His Support to all; I am a sacrifice to Him.

957.g: ਗਾਈਐ ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਨੰਤੁ ਗਾਵਣ ਜੋਗਿਆ ॥
957.t: gaieeaai raat dhina(n)t gaavan jogiaa ||
957.e: Night and day, sing the Praises of the One who is worthy of being praised.

957.g: ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਹਿ ਤਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਭੋਗਿਆ ॥੨॥
957.t: jo gur kee pairee paeh tinee har ras bhogiaa ||2||
957.e: Those who fall at the Guru's Feet, enjoy the sublime essence of the Lord. ||2||

957.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
957.t: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
957.e: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

957.g: ਭੀੜਹੁ ਮੋਕਲਾਈ ਕੀਤੀਅਨੁ ਸਭ ਰਖੇ ਕੁਟੰਬੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
957.t: bheeRahu mokalaiee keeteean sabh rakhe kuTa(n)bai naal ||
957.e: He has widened the narrow path for me, and preserved my integrity, along with that of my family.

957.g: ਕਾਰਜ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਅਨੁ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਦਾ ਸਭਾਲਿ ॥
957.t: kaaraj aap savaarian so prabh sadhaa sabhaal ||
957.e: He Himself has arranged and resolved my affairs. I dwell upon that God forever.

957.g: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇਦਾ ਲਹੁੜੇ ਬਾਲਕ ਪਾਲਿ ॥
957.t: prabh maat pitaa ka(n)Th laidhaa lahuRe baalak paal ||
957.e: God is my mother and father; He hugs me close in His embrace, and cherishes me, like His tiny baby.

957.g: ਦਇਆਲ ਹੋਏ ਸਭ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੧॥
957.t: dhiaal hoe sabh jeea ja(n)tr har naanak nadhar nihaal ||1||
957.e: All beings and creatures have become kind and compassionate to me. O Nanak, the Lord has blessed me with His Glance of Grace. ||1||

958.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
958.e: Fifth Mehla:

958.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਜਿ ਮੰਗਣਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਦੁਖਾ ਕੈ ਦੁਖ ॥
958.t: vin tudh hor j ma(n)ganaa sir dhukhaa kai dhukh ||
958.e: To ask for any other than You, Lord, is the most miserable of miseries.

958.g: ਦੇਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ ਉਤਰੈ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਭੁਖ ॥
958.t: dheh naam sa(n)tokheeaa utarai man kee bhukh ||
958.e: Please bless me with Your Name, and make me content; may the hunger of my mind be satisfied.

958.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਵਣੁ ਤਿਣੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਕੀਤਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਆ ਮਨੁਖ ॥੨॥
958.t: gur van tin hariaa keetiaa naanak kiaa manukh ||2||
958.e: The Guru has made the woods and meadows green again. O Nanak, is it any wonder that He blesses human beings as well? ||2||

958.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
958.t: pauRee ||
958.e: Pauree:

958.g: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ॥
958.t: so aaisaa dhaataar manahu na veesarai ||
958.e: Such is that Great Giver; may I never forget Him from my mind.

958.g: ਘੜੀ ਨ ਮੁਹਤੁ ਚਸਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾ ਸਰੈ ॥
958.t: ghaRee na muhat chasaa tis bin naa sarai ||
958.e: I cannot survive without Him, for an instant, for a moment, for a second.

958.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਲੁਕਿ ਕਰੈ ॥
958.t: a(n)tar baahar sa(n)g kiaa ko luk karai ||
958.e: Inwardly and outwardly, He is with us; how can we hide anything from Him?

958.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਤਿ ਰਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਸੋ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰੈ ॥
958.t: jis pat rakhai aap so bhavajal tarai ||
958.e: One whose honor He Himself has preserved, crosses over the terrifying world-ocean.

958.g: ਭਗਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਤਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
958.t: bhagat giaanee tapaa jis kirapaa karai ||
958.e: He alone is a devotee, a spiritual teacher, and a disciplined pratictioner of meditation, whom the Lord has so blessed.

958.g: ਸੋ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਲੁ ਧਰੈ ॥
958.t: so pooraa paradhaan jis no bal dharai ||
958.e: He alone is perfect and renowned as supreme, whom the Lord has blessed with His power.

958.g: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਜਰਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਸੋਈ ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰੈ ॥
958.t: jiseh jaraae aap soiee ajar jarai ||
958.e: He alone endures the unendurable, whom the Lord inspires to endure it.

958.g: ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਨਿ ਧਰੈ ॥੩॥
958.t: tis hee miliaa sach ma(n)tr gur man dharai ||3||
958.e: And he alone meets the True Lord, within whose mind the Guru's Mantra is implanted. ||3||

958.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
958.t: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
958.e: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

958.g: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਰਾਗ ਸੁਰੰਗੜੇ ਆਲਾਪਤ ਸਭ ਤਿਖ ਜਾਇ ॥
958.t: dha(n)nu su raag sura(n)gaRe aalaapat sabh tikh jai ||
958.e: Blessed are those beautiful Ragas which, when chanted, quench all thirst.

958.g: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਜੰਤ ਸੁਹਾਵੜੇ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਪਦੇ ਨਾਉ ॥
958.t: dha(n)nu su ja(n)t suhaavaRe jo gurmukh japadhe naau ||
958.e: Blessed are those beautiful people who, as Gurmukh, chant the Name of the Lord.

958.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
958.t: jinee ik man ik araadhiaa tin sadh balihaarai jaau ||
958.e: I am a sacrifice to those who single-mindedly worship and adore the One Lord.

958.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਧੂੜਿ ਹਮ ਬਾਛਦੇ ਕਰਮੀ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
958.t: tin kee dhooR ham baachhadhe karamee palai pai ||
958.e: I yearn for the dust of their feet; by His Grace, it is obtained.

958.g: ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਗੋਵਿਦ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
958.t: jo rate ra(n)g govidh kai hau tin balihaarai jaau ||
958.e: I am a sacrifice to those who are imbued with love for the Lord of the Universe.

958.g: ਆਖਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਰਾਇ ॥
958.t: aakhaa birathaa jeea kee har sajan melahu rai ||
958.e: I tell them the state of my soul, and pray that I may be united with the Sovereign Lord King, my Friend.

958.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਮੇਲਾਇਆ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
958.t: gur poorai melaiaa janam maran dhukh jai ||
958.e: The Perfect Guru has united me with Him, and the pains of birth and death have departed.

958.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਗਮ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
958.t: jan naanak paiaa agam roop anat na kaahoo jai ||1||
958.e: Servant Nanak has found the inaccessible, infinitely beautiful Lord, and he will not go anywhere else. ||1||

958.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
958.e: Fifth Mehla:

958.g: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਘੜੀ ਧੰਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਮੂਰਤੁ ਪਲੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
958.t: dha(n)nu su velaa ghaRee dha(n)n dhan moorat pal saar ||
958.e: Blessed is that time, blessed is that hour, blessed is that second, excellent is that instant;

958.g: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਸੰਜੋਗੜਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਡਿਠਾ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਾਰੁ ॥
958.t: dha(n)nu su dhinas sa(n)jogaRaa jit ddiThaa gur dharasaar ||
958.e: blessed is that day, and that opportunity, when I gazed upon the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan.

958.g: ਮਨ ਕੀਆ ਇਛਾ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
958.t: man keeaa ichhaa pooreeaa har paiaa agam apaar ||
958.e: The mind's desires are fulfilled, when the inaccessible, unfathomable Lord is obtained.

958.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਤੁਟਾ ਮੋਹੜਾ ਇਕੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
958.t: haumai tuTaa mohaRaa ik sach naam aadhaar ||
958.e: Egotism and emotional attachment are eradicated, and one leans only on the Support of the True Name.

958.g: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਲਗਾ ਸੇਵ ਹਰਿ ਉਧਰਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
958.t: jan naanak lagaa sev har udhariaa sagal sa(n)saar ||2||
958.e: O servant Nanak, one who is committed to the Lord's service - the whole world is saved along with him. ||2||

958.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
958.t: pauRee ||
958.e: Pauree:

958.g: ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹਣੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਦਿਤੀਅਨੁ ॥
958.t: sifat salaahan bhagat virale dhiteean ||
958.e: How rare are those who are blessed to praise the Lord, in devotional worship.

958.g: ਸਉਪੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਫਿਰਿ ਪੁਛ ਨ ਲੀਤੀਅਨੁ ॥
958.t: saupe jis bha(n)ddaar fir puchh na leeteean ||
958.e: Those who are blessed with the Lord's treasures are not called to give their account again.

958.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਗਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਸੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਿਆ ॥
958.t: jis no lagaa ra(n)g se ra(n)g ratiaa ||
958.e: Those who are imbued with His Love are absorbed in ecstasy.

958.g: ਓਨਾ ਇਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਇਕਾ ਉਨ ਭਤਿਆ ॥
958.t: onaa iko naam adhaar ikaa un bhatiaa ||
958.e: They take the Support of the One Name; the One Name is their only food.

958.g: ਓਨਾ ਪਿਛੈ ਜਗੁ ਭੁੰਚੈ ਭੋਗਈ ॥
958.t: onaa pichhai jag bhu(n)chai bhogiee ||
958.e: For their sake, the world eats and enjoys.

958.g: ਓਨਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਰਬੁ ਓਨਾਹਾ ਜੋਗਈ ॥
958.t: onaa piaaraa rab onaahaa jogiee ||
958.e: Their Beloved Lord belongs to them alone.

958.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਇ ਤਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
958.t: jis miliaa gur aai tin prabh jaaniaa ||
958.e: The Guru comes and meets them; they alone know God.

958.g: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਜਿ ਖਸਮੈ ਭਾਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
958.t: hau balihaaree tin j khasamai bhaaniaa ||4||
958.e: I am a sacrifice to those who are pleasing to their Lord and Master. ||4||

958.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
958.t: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
958.e: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

958.g: ਹਰਿ ਇਕਸੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਮੈ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਇਕਸੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਮੈ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
958.t: har ikasai naal mai dhosatee har ikasai naal mai ra(n)g ||
958.e: My friendship is with the One Lord alone; I am in love with the One Lord alone.

958.g: ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਜਣੋ ਹਰਿ ਇਕਸੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਮੈ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
958.t: har iko meraa sajano har ikasai naal mai sa(n)g ||
958.e: The Lord is my only friend; my companionship is with the One Lord alone.

958.g: ਹਰਿ ਇਕਸੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਮੈ ਗੋਸਟੇ ਮੁਹੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਕਰੈ ਨ ਭੰਗੁ ॥
958.t: har ikasai naal mai gosaTe muh mailaa karai na bha(n)g ||
958.e: My conversation is with the One Lord alone; He never frowns, or turns His face away.

958.g: ਜਾਣੈ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਮੋੜੈ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
958.t: jaanai birathaa jeea kee kadhe na moRai ra(n)g ||
958.e: He alone knows the state of my soul; He never ignores my love.

958.g: ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਸਲਤੀ ਭੰਨਣ ਘੜਨ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥
958.t: har iko meraa masalatee bha(n)nan ghaRan samarath ||
958.e: He is my only counselor, all-powerful to destroy and create.

958.g: ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਦਾਤਿਆ ਜਗ ਹਥੁ ॥
958.t: har iko meraa dhaataar hai sir dhaatiaa jag hath ||
958.e: The Lord is my only Giver. He places His hand upon the heads of the generous in the world.

958.g: ਹਰਿ ਇਕਸੈ ਦੀ ਮੈ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥
958.t: har ikasai dhee mai Tek hai jo sir sabhanaa samarath ||
958.e: I take the Support of the One Lord alone; He is all-powerful, over the heads of all.

958.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੰਤੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਰਿ ਕੈ ਹਥੁ ॥
958.t: satigur sa(n)t milaiaa masatak dhar kai hath ||
958.e: The Saint, the True Guru, has united me with the Lord. He placed His hand on my forehead.

959.g: ਵਡਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਤਾਰਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਜਗਤੁ ॥
959.t: vaddaa saahib guroo milaiaa jin taariaa sagal jagat ||
959.e: The Guru led me to meet the greatest Lord and Master; He saved the whole world.

959.g: ਮਨ ਕੀਆ ਇਛਾ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥
959.t: man keeaa ichhaa pooreeaa paiaa dhur sa(n)jog ||
959.e: The desires of the mind are fulfilled; I have attained my pre-destined Union with God.

959.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਭੋਗੇ ਭੋਗ ॥੧॥
959.t: naanak paiaa sach naam sadh hee bhoge bhog ||1||
959.e: Nanak has obtained the True Name; He enjoys the enjoyments forever. ||1||

959.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
959.e: Fifth Mehla:

959.g: ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਕੇਰੀ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਸਨਬੰਧੁ ॥
959.t: manmukhaa keree dhosatee maiaa kaa sanaba(n)dh ||
959.e: Friendship with the self-willed manmukhs is an alliance with Maya.

959.g: ਵੇਖਦਿਆ ਹੀ ਭਜਿ ਜਾਨਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਬੰਧੁ ॥
959.t: vekhadhiaa hee bhaj jaan kadhe na pain ba(n)dh ||
959.e: As we watch, they run away; they never stand firm.

959.g: ਜਿਚਰੁ ਪੈਨਨਿ ਖਾਵਨੑੇ ਤਿਚਰੁ ਰਖਨਿ ਗੰਢੁ ॥
959.t: jichar painan khaavan(h)e tichar rakhan ga(n)dd ||
959.e: As long as they get food and clothing, they stick around.

959.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਦਿਨਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਤਿਤੁ ਦਿਨਿ ਬੋਲਨਿ ਗੰਧੁ ॥
959.t: jit dhin kichh na hoviee tit dhin bolan ga(n)dh ||
959.e: But on that day when they receive nothing, then they start to curse.

959.g: ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧੁ ॥
959.t: jeea kee saar na jaananee manmukh agiaanee a(n)dh ||
959.e: The self-willed manmukhs are ignorant and blind; they do not know the secrets of the soul.

959.g: ਕੂੜਾ ਗੰਢੁ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਚਿਕੜਿ ਪਥਰ ਬੰਧੁ ॥
959.t: kooRaa ga(n)dd na chaliee chikaR pathar ba(n)dh ||
959.e: The false bond does not last; it is like stones joined with mud.

959.g: ਅੰਧੇ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਫਕੜੁ ਪਿਟਨਿ ਧੰਧੁ ॥
959.t: a(n)dhe aap na jaananee fakaR piTan dha(n)dh ||
959.e: The blind do not understand themselves; they are engrossed in false worldly entanglements.

959.g: ਝੂਠੈ ਮੋਹਿ ਲਪਟਾਇਆ ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਹੰਧੁ ॥
959.t: jhooThai moh lapaTaiaa hau hau karat biha(n)dh ||
959.e: Entangled in false attachments, they pass their lives in egotism and self-conceit.

959.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਧੁਰਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
959.t: kirapaa kare jis aapanee dhur pooraa karam karei ||
959.e: But that being, whom the Lord has blessed with His Mercy from the very beginning, does perfect deeds, and accumulates good karma.

959.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਉਬਰੇ ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ॥੨॥
959.t: jan naanak se jan ubare jo satigur saran pare ||2||
959.e: O servant Nanak, those humble beings alone are saved, who enter the Sanctuary of the True Guru. ||2||

959.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
959.t: pauRee ||
959.e: Pauree:

959.g: ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਦੀਦਾਰ ਸੇਈ ਸਚੁ ਹਾਕੁ ॥
959.t: jo rate dheedhaar seiee sach haak ||
959.e: Those who are imbued with the Lord's Vision, speak the Truth.

959.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਜਾਤਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਕਿਉ ਲਭੈ ਤਿਨਾ ਖਾਕੁ ॥
959.t: jinee jaataa khasam kiau labhai tinaa khaak ||
959.e: How can I obtain the dust of those who realize their Lord and Master?

959.g: ਮਨੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਵੇਕਾਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਕੁ ॥
959.t: man mailaa vekaar hovai sa(n)g paak ||
959.e: The mind, stained by corruption, becomes pure by associating with them.

959.g: ਦਿਸੈ ਸਚਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਖੁਲੈ ਭਰਮ ਤਾਕੁ ॥
959.t: dhisai sachaa mahal khulai bharam taak ||
959.e: One sees the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, when the door of doubt is opened.

959.g: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਲੇ ਮਹਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਧਾਕੁ ॥
959.t: jiseh dhikhaale mahal tis na milai dhaak ||
959.e: That one, unto whom the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is revealed, is never pushed or shoved.

959.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਬਿੰਦਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਝਾਕੁ ॥
959.t: man tan hoi nihaal bi(n)dhak nadhar jhaak ||
959.e: My mind and body are enraptured, when the Lord blesses me, even for an instant, with His Glance of Grace.

959.g: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਾਗੁ ॥
959.t: nau nidh naam nidhaan gur kai sabadh laag ||
959.e: The nine treasures, and the treasure of the Naam are obtained by commitment to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

959.g: ਤਿਸੈ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੰਤ ਖਾਕੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਜਿਸੈ ਭਾਗੁ ॥੫॥
959.t: tisai milai sa(n)t khaak masatak jisai bhaag ||5||
959.e: He alone is blessed with the dust of the feet of the Saints, upon whose forehead such pre-ordained destiny is inscribed. ||5||

959.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
959.t: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
959.e: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

959.g: ਹਰਣਾਖੀ ਕੂ ਸਚੁ ਵੈਣੁ ਸੁਣਾਈ ਜੋ ਤਉ ਕਰੇ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ॥
959.t: haranaakhee koo sach vain sunaiee jo tau kare udhaaran ||
959.e: O deer-eyed bride, I speak the Truth, which shall save you.

959.g: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਬਚਨ ਤੁਮ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਛਬੀਲੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਤੈਡਾ ਮਨ ਸਾਧਾਰਣੁ ॥
959.t: su(n)dhar bachan tum sunahu chhabeelee pir taiddaa man saadhaaran ||
