959.e: Listen to these beautiful words, O beauteous bride; your Beloved Lord is your mind's only support.

959.g: ਦੁਰਜਨ ਸੇਤੀ ਨੇਹੁ ਰਚਾਇਓ ਦਸਿ ਵਿਖਾ ਮੈ ਕਾਰਣੁ ॥
959.t: dhurajan setee neh rachaio dhas vikhaa mai kaaran ||
959.e: You have fallen in love with an evil person; tell me - show me why!

959.g: ਊਣੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਝੂਣੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਵਿਹੂਣੀ ॥
959.t: uoonee naahee jhoonee naahee naahee kisai vihoonee ||
959.e: I lack nothing, and I am not sad or depressed; I have no deficiency at all.

959.g: ਪਿਰੁ ਛੈਲੁ ਛਬੀਲਾ ਛਡਿ ਗਵਾਇਓ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਰਮਿ ਵਿਹੂਣੀ ॥
959.t: pir chhail chhabeelaa chhadd gavaio dhuramat karam vihoonee ||
959.e: I abandoned and lost my fascinating and beautiful Husband Lord; in this evil-mindedness, I have lost my good fortune.

959.g: ਨਾ ਹਉ ਭੁਲੀ ਨਾ ਹਉ ਚੁਕੀ ਨਾ ਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੋਸਾ ॥
959.t: naa hau bhulee naa hau chukee naa mai naahee dhosaa ||
959.e: I am not mistaken, and I am not confused; I have no egotism, and commit no offense.

959.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਹਉ ਲਾਈ ਤਿਤੁ ਹਉ ਲਗੀ ਤੂ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਦੇਸਾ ॥
959.t: jit hau laiee tit hau lagee too sun sach sa(n)dhesaa ||
959.e: As You have linked me, so I am linked; listen to my true message.

959.g: ਸਾਈ ਸੋੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਾਈ ਭਾਗਣਿ ਜੈ ਪਿਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
959.t: saiee suohaagan saiee bhaagan jai pir kirapaa dhaaree ||
959.e: She alone is the blessed soul-bride, and she alone is fortunate, upon whom the Husband Lord has showered His Mercy.

959.g: ਪਿਰਿ ਅਉਗਣ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਗਵਾਏ ਗਲ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਾਇ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
959.t: pir aaugan tis ke sabh gavaae gal setee lai savaaree ||
959.e: Her Husband Lord takes away all her faults and mistakes; hugging her close in His embrace, He embellishes her.

959.g: ਕਰਮਹੀਣ ਧਨ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਕਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਵੈ ਵਾਰੀ ॥
959.t: karamaheen dhan karai bina(n)tee kadh naanak aavai vaaree ||
959.e: The unfortunate soul-bride makes this prayer: O Nanak, when will my turn come?

959.g: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਮਾਣਹਿ ਰਲੀਆ ਇਕ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
959.t: sabh suhaagan maaneh raleeaa ik dhevahu raat muraaree ||1||
959.e: All the blessed soul-brides celebrate and make merry; bless me as well with a night of bliss, O Lord. ||1||

959.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
959.e: Fifth Mehla:

959.g: ਕਾਹੇ ਮਨ ਤੂ ਡੋਲਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
959.t: kaahe man too ddolataa har manasaa pooranahaar ||
959.e: Why do you waver, O my mind? The Lord is the Fulfiller of hopes and desires.

959.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖ ਵਿਸਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
959.t: satigur purakh dhiaai too sabh dhukh visaaranahaar ||
959.e: Meditate on the True Guru, the Primal Being; He is the Destroyer of all pains.

959.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਆਰਾਧਿ ਮਨ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਜਾਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
959.t: har naamaa aaraadh man sabh kilavikh jaeh vikaar ||
959.e: Worship and adore the Lord's Name, O my mind; all sins and corruption shall be washed away.

959.g: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਗਾ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥
959.t: jin kau poorab likhiaa tin ra(n)g lagaa nira(n)kaar ||
959.e: Those who are blessed with such pre-ordained destiny, are in love with the Formless Lord.

959.g: ਓਨੀ ਛਡਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੁਆਵੜਾ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
959.t: onee chhaddiaa maiaa suaavaRaa dhan sa(n)chiaa naam apaar ||
959.e: They abandon the tastes of Maya, and gather in the infinite wealth of the Naam.

959.g: ਅਠੇ ਪਹਰ ਇਕਤੈ ਲਿਵੈ ਮੰਨੇਨਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
959.t: aThe pahar ikatai livai ma(n)nen hukam apaar ||
959.e: Twenty-four hours a day, they are lovingly absorbed in the One Lord; they surrender and accept the Will of the Infinite Lord.

960.g: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਕੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
960.t: jan naanak ma(n)gai dhaan ik dheh dharas man piaar ||2||
960.e: Servant Nanak begs for this one gift: please bless me, Lord, with the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; my mind is in love with You. ||2||

960.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
960.t: pauRee ||
960.e: Pauree:

960.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖ ॥
960.t: jis too aaveh chit tis no sadhaa sukh ||
960.e: One who is conscious of You finds everlasting peace.

960.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਮ ਨਾਹਿ ਦੁਖ ॥
960.t: jis too aaveh chit tis jam naeh dhukh ||
960.e: One who is conscious of You does not suffer at the hands of the Messenger of Death.

960.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਿ ਕਾੜਿਆ ॥
960.t: jis too aaveh chit tis k kaaRiaa ||
960.e: One who is conscious of You is not anxious.

960.g: ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
960.t: jis dhaa karataa mitr sabh kaaj savaariaa ||
960.e: One who has the Creator as his Friend - all his affairs are resolved.

960.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਜਨੁ ॥
960.t: jis too aaveh chit so paravaan jan ||
960.e: One who is conscious of You is renowned and respected.

960.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਨੁ ॥
960.t: jis too aaveh chit bahutaa tis dhan ||
960.e: One who is conscious of You becomes very wealthy.

960.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਸੋ ਵਡ ਪਰਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
960.t: jis too aaveh chit so vadd paravaariaa ||
960.e: One who is conscious of You has a great family.

960.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰਿਆ ॥੬॥
960.t: jis too aaveh chit tin kul udhaariaa ||6||
960.e: One who is conscious of You saves his ancestors. ||6||

960.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
960.t: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
960.e: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

960.g: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਅੰਨਾ ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਅੰਨਾ ਕੂੜੀ ਕੂੜੀ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
960.t: a(n)dharahu a(n)naa baaharahu a(n)naa kooRee kooRee gaavai ||
960.e: Blind inwardly, and blind outwardly, he sings falsely, falsely.

960.g: ਦੇਹੀ ਧੋਵੈ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਬਣਾਏ ਮਾਇਆ ਨੋ ਬਹੁ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
960.t: dhehee dhovai chakar banaae maiaa no bahu dhaavai ||
960.e: He washes his body, and draws ritual marks on it, and totally runs after wealth.

960.g: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
960.t: a(n)dhar mail na utarai haumai fir fir aavai jaavai ||
960.e: But the filth of his egotism is not removed from within, and over and over again, he comes and goes in reincarnation.

960.g: ਨੀਂਦ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਕਾਮਿ ਸੰਤਾਪਿਆ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥
960.t: nee(n)dh viaapiaa kaam sa(n)taapiaa mukhahu har har kahaavai ||
960.e: Engulfed in sleep, and tormented by frustrated sexual desire, he chants the Lord's Name with his mouth.

960.g: ਬੈਸਨੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਮ ਹਉ ਜੁਗਤਾ ਤੁਹ ਕੁਟੇ ਕਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
960.t: baisano naam karam hau jugataa tuh kuTe kiaa fal paavai ||
960.e: He is called a Vaishnav, but he is bound to deeds of egotism; by threshing only husks, what rewards can be obtained?

960.g: ਹੰਸਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਬੈਠਾ ਬਗੁ ਨ ਬਣਈ ਨਿਤ ਬੈਠਾ ਮਛੀ ਨੋ ਤਾਰ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
960.t: ha(n)saa vich baiThaa bag na baniee nit baiThaa machhee no taar laavai ||
960.e: Sitting among the swans, the crane does not become one of them; sitting there, he keeps staring at the fish.

960.g: ਜਾ ਹੰਸ ਸਭਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਨਿ ਤਾ ਬਗਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਜੋੜੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
960.t: jaa ha(n)s sabhaa veechaar kar dhekhan taa bagaa naal joR kadhe na aavai ||
960.e: And when the gathering of swans looks and sees, they realize that they can never form an alliance with the crane.

960.g: ਹੰਸਾ ਹੀਰਾ ਮੋਤੀ ਚੁਗਣਾ ਬਗੁ ਡਡਾ ਭਾਲਣ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
960.t: ha(n)saa heeraa motee chuganaa bag ddaddaa bhaalan jaavai ||
960.e: The swans peck at the diamonds and pearls, while the crane chases after frogs.

960.g: ਉਡਰਿਆ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ਬਗੁਲਾ ਮਤੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੰਞੁ ਲਖਾਵੈ ॥
960.t: auddariaa vechaaraa bagulaa mat hovai ma(n)n(j) lakhaavai ||
960.e: The poor crane flies away, so that his secret will not be exposed.

960.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਲਾਗਾ ਕਿਸੁ ਦੋਸੁ ਦਿਚੈ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਏਵੈ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
960.t: jit ko laiaa tit hee laagaa kis dhos dhichai jaa har evai bhaavai ||
960.e: Whatever the Lord attaches one to, to that he is attached. Who is to blame, when the Lord wills it so?

960.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਰਤਨੀ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
960.t: satigur saravar ratanee bharapoore jis praapat so paavai ||
960.e: The True Guru is the lake, overflowing with pearls. One who meets the True Guru obtains them.

960.g: ਸਿਖ ਹੰਸ ਸਰਵਰਿ ਇਕਠੇ ਹੋਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੁਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
960.t: sikh ha(n)s saravar ikaThe hoe satigur kai hukamaavai ||
960.e: The Sikh-swans gather at the lake, according to the Will of the True Guru.

960.g: ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਮਾਣਕ ਸਰਵਰਿ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ਖਾਇ ਖਰਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
960.t: ratan padhaarath maanak saravar bharapoore khai kharach rahe toT na aavai ||
960.e: The lake is filled with the wealth of these jewels and pearls; they are spent and consumed, but they never run out.

960.g: ਸਰਵਰ ਹੰਸੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਕਰਤੇ ਏਵੈ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
960.t: saravar ha(n)s dhoor na hoiee karate evai bhaavai ||
960.e: The swan never leaves the lake; such is the Pleasure of the Creator's Will.

960.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸ ਦੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਸਿਖੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਹਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
960.t: jan naanak jis dhai masatak bhaag dhur likhiaa so sikh guroo peh aavai ||
960.e: O servant Nanak, one who has such pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon his forehead - that Sikh comes to the Guru.

960.g: ਆਪਿ ਤਰਿਆ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਭਿ ਤਾਰੇ ਸਭਾ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਛਡਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
960.t: aap tariaa kuTa(n)b sabh taare sabhaa sirasaT chhaddaavai ||1||
960.e: He saves himself, and saves all his generations as well; he emancipates the whole world. ||1||

960.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
960.e: Fifth Mehla:

960.g: ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਆਖਾਏ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਰਾਹੀ ਕੋਰੜ ਮੋਠ ਜਿਨੇਹਾ ॥
960.t: pa(n)ddit aakhaae bahutee raahee koraR moTh jinehaa ||
960.e: He is called a Pandit, a religious scholar, and yet he wanders along many pathways. He is as hard as uncooked beans.

960.g: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਭਰਮਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਤਿਸਟਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੇਹਾ ॥
960.t: a(n)dhar moh nit bharam viaapiaa tisaTas naahee dhehaa ||
960.e: He is filled with attachment, and constantly engrossed in doubt; his body cannot hold still.

960.g: ਕੂੜੀ ਆਵੈ ਕੂੜੀ ਜਾਵੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੀ ਨਿਤ ਜੋਹਾ ॥
960.t: kooRee aavai kooRee jaavai maiaa kee nit johaa ||
960.e: False is his coming, and false is his going; he is continually on the lookout for Maya.

960.g: ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਤਾ ਛੋਹੋ ਆਵੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਰੋਹਾ ॥
960.t: sach kahai taa chhoho aavai a(n)tar bahutaa rohaa ||
960.e: If someone speaks the truth, then he is aggravated; he is totally filled with anger.

960.g: ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕੁਬੁਧਿ ਕੁਮੂੜਾ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੋਹਾ ॥
960.t: viaapiaa dhuramat kubudh kumooRaa man laagaa tis mohaa ||
960.e: The evil fool is engrossed in evil-mindedness and false intellectualizations; his mind is attached to emotional attachment.

960.g: ਠਗੈ ਸੇਤੀ ਠਗੁ ਰਲਿ ਆਇਆ ਸਾਥੁ ਭਿ ਇਕੋ ਜੇਹਾ ॥
960.t: Thagai setee Thag ral aaiaa saath bh iko jehaa ||
960.e: The deceiver abides with the five deceivers; it is a gathering of like minds.

960.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਾਫੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਵਿਚਦੋ ਕਢੈ ਤਾਂ ਉਘੜਿ ਆਇਆ ਲੋਹਾ ॥
960.t: satigur saraaf nadharee vichadho kaddai taa(n) ughaR aaiaa lohaa ||
960.e: And when the Jeweller, the True Guru, appraises him, then he is exposed as mere iron.

960.g: ਬਹੁਤੇਰੀ ਥਾਈ ਰਲਾਇ ਰਲਾਇ ਦਿਤਾ ਉਘੜਿਆ ਪੜਦਾ ਅਗੈ ਆਇ ਖਲੋਹਾ ॥
960.t: bahuteree thaiee ralai ralai dhitaa ughaRiaa paRadhaa agai aai khalohaa ||
960.e: Mixed and mingled with others, he was passed off as genuine in many places; but now, the veil has been lifted, and he stands naked before all.

960.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਜੇ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਵੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਨੂਰਹੁ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਹੋਹਾ ॥
960.t: satigur kee je saranee aavai fir manoorahu ka(n)chan hohaa ||
960.e: One who comes to the Sanctuary of the True Guru, shall be transformed from iron into gold.

960.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਮਾਨੇ ਅਉਗਣ ਕਟੇ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਧੁ ਦੇਹਾ ॥
960.t: satigur niravair putr satr samaane aaugan kaTe kare sudh dhehaa ||
960.e: The True Guru has no anger or vengeance; He looks upon son and enemy alike. Removing faults and mistakes, He purifies the human body.

960.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਸਨੇਹਾ ॥
960.t: naanak jis dhur masatak hovai likhiaa tis satigur naal sanehaa ||
960.e: O Nanak, one who has such pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon his forehead, is in love with the True Guru.

961.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸੇਹਾ ॥
961.t: a(n)mirat baanee satigur poore kee jis kirapaal hovai tis ridhai vasehaa ||
961.e: The Word of the Perfect True Guru's Bani is Ambrosial Nectar; it dwells in the heart of one who is blessed by the Guru's Mercy.

961.g: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਕਟੀਐ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਹਾ ॥੨॥
961.t: aavan jaanaa tis kaa kaTeeaai sadhaa sadhaa sukh hohaa ||2||
961.e: His coming and going in reincarnation is ended; forever and ever, he is at peace. ||2||

961.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
961.t: pauRee ||
961.e: Pauree:

961.g: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਜੰਤੁ ਸੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਬੁਝਈ ॥
961.t: jo tudh bhaanaa ja(n)t so tudh bujhiee ||
961.e: He alone understands You, Lord, with whom You are pleased.

961.g: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਜੰਤੁ ਸੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਿਝਈ ॥
961.t: jo tudh bhaanaa ja(n)tu su dharageh sijhiee ||
961.e: He alone is approved in the Court of the Lord, with whom You are pleased.

961.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਗਈ ॥
961.t: jis no teree nadhar haumai tis giee ||
961.e: Egotism is eradicated, when You bestow Your Grace.

961.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਸੰਤੁਸਟੁ ਕਲਮਲ ਤਿਸੁ ਖਈ ॥
961.t: jis no too sa(n)tusaT kalamal tis khiee ||
961.e: Sins are erased, when You are thoroughly pleased.

961.g: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਵਲਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸੋ ਭਈ ॥
961.t: jis kai suaamee val nirabhau so bhiee ||
961.e: One who has the Lord Master on his side, becomes fearless.

961.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਸਚਾ ਸੋ ਥਿਅਈ ॥
961.t: jis no too kirapaal sachaa so thiee ||
961.e: One who is blessed with Your Mercy, becomes truthful.

961.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਮਇਆ ਨ ਪੋਹੈ ਅਗਨਈ ॥
961.t: jis no teree miaa na pohai aganiee ||
961.e: One who is blessed with Your Kindness, is not touched by fire.

961.g: ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਤਿ ਲਈ ॥੭॥
961.t: tis no sadhaa dhiaal jin gur te mat liee ||7||
961.e: You are forever Merciful to those who are receptive to the Guru's Teachings. ||7||

961.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
961.t: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
961.e: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

961.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈ ॥
961.t: kar kirapaa kirapaal aape bakhas lai ||
961.e: Please grant Your Grace, O Merciful Lord; please forgive me.

961.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਪੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਇ ਪੈ ॥
961.t: sadhaa sadhaa japee teraa naam satigur pai pai ||
961.e: Forever and ever, I chant Your Name; I fall at the feet of the True Guru.

961.g: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸੁ ਦੂਖਾ ਨਾਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
961.t: man tan a(n)tar vas dhookhaa naas hoi ||
961.e: Please, dwell within my mind and body, and end my sufferings.

961.g: ਹਥ ਦੇਇ ਆਪਿ ਰਖੁ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਭਉ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
961.t: hath dhei aap rakh viaapai bhau na koi ||
961.e: Please give me Your hand, and save me, that fear may not afflict me.

961.g: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਏਤੈ ਕੰਮਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
961.t: gun gaavaa dhin rain etai ka(n)m lai ||
961.e: May I sing Your Glorious Praises day and night; please commit me to this task.

961.g: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
961.t: sa(n)t janaa kai sa(n)g haumai rog jai ||
961.e: Associating with the humble Saints, the disease of egotism is eradicated.

961.g: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
961.t: sarab nira(n)tar khasam eko rav rahiaa ||
961.e: The One Lord and Master is all-pervading, permeating everywhere.

961.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਲਹਿਆ ॥
961.t: gur parasaadhee sach sacho sach lahiaa ||
961.e: By Guru's Grace, I have truly found the Truest of the True.

961.g: ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਅਪਣੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਦੇਹੁ ॥
961.t: dhiaa karahu dhiaal apanee sifat dheh ||
961.e: Please bless me with Your Kindness, O Kind Lord, and bless me with Your Praises.

961.g: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਏਹ ॥੧॥
961.t: dharasan dhekh nihaal naanak preet eh ||1||
961.e: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, I am in ecstasy; this is what Nanak loves. ||1||

961.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
961.e: Fifth Mehla:

961.g: ਏਕੋ ਜਪੀਐ ਮਨੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਇਕਸ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥
961.t: eko japeeaai manai maeh ikas kee saranai ||
961.e: Meditate on the One Lord within your mind, and enter the Sanctuary of the One Lord alone.

961.g: ਇਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਪਿਰਹੜੀ ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
961.t: eikas siau kar pirahaRee dhoojee naahee jai ||
961.e: Be in love with the One Lord; there is no other at all.

961.g: ਇਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
961.t: eiko dhaataa ma(n)geeaai sabh kichh palai pai ||
961.e: Beg from the One Lord, the Great Giver, and you will be blessed with everything.

961.g: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਇਕੋ ਇਕੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
961.t: man tan saas giraas prabh iko ik dhiaai ||
961.e: In your mind and body, with each breath and morsel of food, meditate on the One and only Lord God.

961.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
961.t: a(n)mrit naam nidhaan sach gurmukh paiaa jai ||
961.e: The Gurmukh obtains the true treasure, the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord.

961.g: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਆਇ ॥
961.t: vaddabhaagee te sa(n)t jan jin man vuThaa aai ||
961.e: Very fortunate are those humble Saints, within whose minds the Lord has come to abide.

961.g: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
961.t: jal thal maheeal rav rahiaa dhoojaa koiee naeh ||
961.e: He is pervading and permeating the water, the land and the sky; there is no other at all.

961.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਚਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਖਸਮ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
961.t: naam dhiaaiee naam ucharaa naanak khasam rajai ||2||
961.e: Meditating on the Naam, and chanting the Naam, Nanak abides in the Will of his Lord and Master. ||2||

961.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
961.t: pauRee ||
961.e: Pauree:

961.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਉਣੁ ॥
961.t: jis no too rakhavaalaa maare tis kaun ||
961.e: One who has You as his Saving Grace - who can kill him?

961.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ਜਿਤਾ ਤਿਨੈ ਭੈਣੁ ॥
961.t: jis no too rakhavaalaa jitaa tinai bhain ||
961.e: One who has You as his Saving Grace conquers the three worlds.

961.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਗੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਉਜਲਾ ॥
961.t: jis no teraa a(n)g tis mukh ujalaa ||
961.e: One who has You on his side - his face is radiant and bright.

961.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਗੁ ਸੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੀ ਹੂੰ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ॥
961.t: jis no teraa a(n)gu su niramalee hoo(n) niramalaa ||
961.e: One who has You on his side, is the purest of the Pure.

961.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਲੇਖਾ ਪੁਛੀਐ ॥
961.t: jis no teree nadhar na lekhaa puchheeaai ||
961.e: One who is blessed with Your Grace is not called to give his account.

961.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਖੁਸੀ ਤਿਨਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਭੁੰਚੀਐ ॥
961.t: jis no teree khusee tin nau nidh bhu(n)cheeaai ||
961.e: One with whom You are pleased, obtains the nine treasures.

961.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਵਲਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹਛੰਦਗੀ ॥
961.t: jis no too prabh val tis kiaa muhachha(n)dhagee ||
961.e: One who has You on his side, God - unto whom is he subservient?

961.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਮਿਹਰ ਸੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਬੰਦਿਗੀ ॥੮॥
961.t: jis no teree mihar su teree ba(n)dhigee ||8||
961.e: One who is blessed with Your Kind Mercy is dedicated to Your worship. ||8||

961.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
961.t: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
961.e: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

961.g: ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੰਤਾਂ ਸੰਗਿ ਵਿਹਾਵੇ ॥
961.t: hoh kirapaal suaamee mere sa(n)taa(n) sa(n)g vihaave ||
961.e: Be Merciful, O my Lord and Master, that I may pass my life in the Society of the Saints.

961.g: ਤੁਧਹੁ ਭੁਲੇ ਸਿ ਜਮਿ ਜਮਿ ਮਰਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੁਕਨਿ ਹਾਵੇ ॥੧॥
961.t: tudhahu bhule s jam jam maradhe tin kadhe na chukan haave ||1||
961.e: Those who forget You are born only to die and be reincarnated again; their sufferings will never end. ||1||

961.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
961.e: Fifth Mehla:

961.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਘਟਿ ਅਵਘਟਿ ਘਟ ਘਾਟ ॥
961.t: satigur simarahu aapanaa ghaT avaghaT ghaT ghaaT ||
961.e: Meditate in remembrance within your heart on the True Guru, whether you are on the most difficult path, on the mountain or by the river bank.

961.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੰਤਿਆ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਬੰਧੈ ਵਾਟ ॥੨॥
961.t: har har naam japa(n)tiaa koi na ba(n)dhai vaaT ||2||
961.e: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, no one shall block your way. ||2||

961.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
961.t: pauRee ||
961.e: Pauree:

962.g: ਤਿਥੈ ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਜਿਥੈ ਕੋਇ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
962.t: tithai too samarath jithai koi naeh ||
962.e: Where You are, Almighty Lord, there is no one else.

962.g: ਓਥੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਖ ਅਗਨੀ ਉਦਰ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
962.t: othai teree rakh aganee udhar maeh ||
962.e: There, in the fire of the mother's womb, You protected us.

962.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਕੈ ਜਮ ਕੇ ਦੂਤ ਨਾਇ ਤੇਰੈ ਛਡਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
962.t: sun kai jam ke dhoot nai terai chhadd jaeh ||
962.e: Hearing Your Name, the Messenger of Death runs away.

962.g: ਭਉਜਲੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਅਸਗਾਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
962.t: bhaujal bikham asagaahu gur sabadhee paar paeh ||
962.e: The terrifying, treacherous, impassible world-ocean is crossed over, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

962.g: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਗੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸੇਇ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
962.t: jin kau lagee piaas a(n)mrit sei khaeh ||
962.e: Those who feel thirst for You, take in Your Ambrosial Nectar.

962.g: ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਏਹੋ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗਾਹਿ ॥
962.t: kal meh eho pu(n)n gun govi(n)dh gaeh ||
962.e: This is the only act of goodness in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, to sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

962.g: ਸਭਸੈ ਨੋ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ਸਾਹਿ ਸਾਹਿ ॥
962.t: sabhasai no kirapaal sam(h)aale saeh saeh ||
962.e: He is Merciful to all; He sustains us with each and every breath.

962.g: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਜਿ ਆਵੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਹਿ ॥੯॥
962.t: birathaa koi na jai j aavai tudh aaeh ||9||
962.e: Those who come to You with love and faith are never turned away empty-handed. ||9||

962.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
962.t: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
962.e: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

962.g: ਦੂਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਨ ਬੁਝਾਇਹੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
962.t: dhoojaa tis na bujhaih paarabraham naam dheh aadhaar ||
962.e: Those whom You bless with the Support of Your Name, O Supreme Lord God, do not know any other.

962.g: ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੋ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸਚੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
962.t: agam agochar saahibo samarath sach dhaataar ||
962.e: Inaccessible, Unfathomable Lord and Master, All-powerful True Great Giver:

962.g: ਤੂ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥
962.t: too nihachal niravair sach sachaa tudh dharabaar ||
962.e: You are eternal and unchanging, without vengeance and True; True is the Darbaar of Your Court.

962.g: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
962.t: keemat kahan na jaieeaai a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
962.e: Your worth cannot be described; You have no end or limitation.

962.g: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਹੋਰੁ ਜਿ ਮੰਗਣਾ ਸਭੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਸ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
962.t: prabh chhodd hor j ma(n)ganaa sabh bikhiaa ras chhaar ||
962.e: To forsake God, and ask for something else, is all corruption and ashes.

962.g: ਸੇ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹ ਸੇ ਜਿਨ ਸਚਾ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ॥
962.t: se sukhe'ee sach saeh se jin sachaa biauhaar ||
962.e: They alone find peace, and they are the true kings, whose dealings are true.

962.g: ਜਿਨਾ ਲਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
962.t: jinaa lagee preet prabh naam sahaj sukh saar ||
962.e: Those who are in love with God's Name, intuitively enjoy the essence of peace.

962.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਕੁ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਸੰਤਨ ਰੇਣਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
962.t: naanak ik aaraadhe sa(n)tan renaar ||1||
962.e: Nanak worships and adores the One Lord; he seeks the dust of the Saints. ||1||

962.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
962.e: Fifth Mehla:

962.g: ਅਨਦ ਸੂਖ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਇ ॥
962.t: anadh sookh bisraam nit har kaa keeratan gai ||
962.e: Singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, bliss, peace and rest are obtained.

962.g: ਅਵਰ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਛਾਡਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਉਧਰਸਿ ਨਾਇ ॥੨॥
962.t: avar siaanap chhaadd dheh naanak udharas nai ||2||
962.e: Forsake other clever tricks, O Nanak; only through the Name will you be saved. ||2||

962.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
962.t: pauRee ||
962.e: Pauree:

962.g: ਨਾ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਵਸਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਘਿਣਾਵਣੇ ॥
962.t: naa too aaveh vas bahut ghinaavane ||
962.e: No one can bring You under control, by despising the world.

962.g: ਨਾ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਵਸਿ ਬੇਦ ਪੜਾਵਣੇ ॥
962.t: naa too aaveh vas bedh paRaavane ||
962.e: No one can bring You under control, by studying the Vedas.

962.g: ਨਾ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਵਸਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਈਐ ॥
962.t: naa too aaveh vas teerath naieeaai ||
962.e: No one can bring You under control, by bathing at the holy places.

962.g: ਨਾ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਵਸਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਧਾਈਐ ॥
962.t: naa too aaveh vas dharatee dhaieeaai ||
962.e: No one can bring You under control, by wandering all over the world.

962.g: ਨਾ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਵਸਿ ਕਿਤੈ ਸਿਆਣਪੈ ॥
962.t: naa too aaveh vas kitai siaanapai ||
962.e: No one can bring You under control, by any clever tricks.

962.g: ਨਾ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਵਸਿ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇ ॥
962.t: naa too aaveh vas bahutaa dhaan dhe ||
962.e: No one can bring You under control, by giving huge donations to charities.

962.g: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਵਸਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰਾ ॥
962.t: sabh ko terai vas agam agocharaa ||
962.e: Everyone is under Your power, O inaccessible, unfathomable Lord.

962.g: ਤੂ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਤਾਣੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੧੦॥
962.t: too bhagataa kai vas bhagataa taan teraa ||10||
962.e: You are under the control of Your devotees; You are the strength of Your devotees. ||10||

962.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
962.t: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
962.e: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

962.g: ਆਪੇ ਵੈਦੁ ਆਪਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ॥
962.t: aape vaidh aap naarain ||
962.e: The Lord Himself is the true physician.

962.g: ਏਹਿ ਵੈਦ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਇਣ ॥
962.t: eh vaidh jeea kaa dhukh lain ||
962.e: These physicians of the world only burden the soul with pain.

962.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਇਣ ॥
962.t: gur kaa sabadh a(n)mirat ras khain ||
962.e: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is Ambrosial Nectar; it is so delicious to eat.

962.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਦੂਖ ਮਿਟਾਇਣ ॥੧॥
962.t: naanak jis man vasai tis ke sabh dhookh miTain ||1||
962.e: O Nanak, one whose mind is filled with this Nectar - all his pains are dispelled. ||1||

962.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
962.e: Fifth Mehla:

962.g: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਉਛਲੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਰਹੈ ॥
962.t: hukam uchhalai hukame rahai ||
962.e: By the Hukam of Lord's Command, they move about; by the Lord's Command, they remain still.

962.g: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਸਹੈ ॥
962.t: hukame dhukh sukh sam kar sahai ||
962.e: By His Hukam, they endure pain and pleasure alike.

962.g: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
962.t: hukame naam japai dhin raat ||
962.e: By His Hukam, they chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, day and night.

962.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
962.t: naanak jis no hovai dhaat ||
962.e: O Nanak, he alone does so, who is blessed.

962.g: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹੀ ਜੀਵੈ ॥
962.t: hukam marai hukame hee jeevai ||
962.e: By the Hukam of the Lord's Command, they die; by the Hukam of His Command, they live.

962.g: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਨਾਨੑਾ ਵਡਾ ਥੀਵੈ ॥
962.t: hukame naan(h)aa vaddaa theevai ||
962.e: By His Hukam, they become tiny, and huge.

962.g: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸੋਗ ਹਰਖ ਆਨੰਦ ॥
962.t: hukame sog harakh aana(n)dh ||
962.e: By His Hukam, they receive pain, happiness and bliss.

962.g: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਜਪੈ ਨਿਰੋਧਰ ਗੁਰਮੰਤ ॥
962.t: hukame japai nirodhar gurma(n)t ||
962.e: By His Hukam, they chant the Guru's Mantra, which always works.

962.g: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
962.t: hukame aavan jaan rahaae ||
962.e: By His Hukam, coming and going in reincarnation cease,

962.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
962.t: naanak jaa kau bhagatee laae ||2||
962.e: O Nanak, when He links them to His devotional worship. ||2||

962.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
962.t: pauRee ||
962.e: Pauree:

962.g: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਢਾਢੀ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਜਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੇਵਦਾਰੁ ॥
962.t: hau tis ddaaddee kurabaan j teraa sevadhaar ||
962.e: I am a sacrifice to that musician who is Your servant, O Lord.

962.g: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਢਾਢੀ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ਜਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
962.t: hau tis ddaaddee balihaar j gaavai gun apaar ||
962.e: I am a sacrifice to that musician who sings the Glorious Praises of the Infinite Lord.

962.g: ਸੋ ਢਾਢੀ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਲੋੜੇ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
962.t: so ddaaddee dhan dha(n)n jis loRe nira(n)kaar ||
962.e: Blessed, blessed is that musician, for whom the Formless Lord Himself longs.

962.g: ਸੋ ਢਾਢੀ ਭਾਗਠੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਚਾ ਦੁਆਰ ਬਾਰੁ ॥
962.t: so ddaaddee bhaagaTh jis sachaa dhuaar baar ||
962.e: Very fortunate is that musician who comes to the gate of the Court of the True Lord.

962.g: ਓਹੁ ਢਾਢੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਕਲਾਣੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਾਰ ॥
962.t: oh ddaaddee tudh dhiaai kalaane dhin rainaar ||
962.e: That musician meditates on You, Lord, and praises You day and night.

962.g: ਮੰਗੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕਦੇ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
962.t: ma(n)gai a(n)mirat naam na aavai kadhe haar ||
962.e: He begs for the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, and will never be defeated.

962.g: ਕਪੜੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਰਹਦਾ ਲਿਵੈ ਧਾਰ ॥
962.t: kapaR bhojan sach rahadhaa livai dhaar ||
962.e: His clothes and his food are true, and he enshrines love for the Lord within.

962.g: ਸੋ ਢਾਢੀ ਗੁਣਵੰਤੁ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧੧॥
962.t: so ddaaddee gunava(n)t jis no prabh piaar ||11||
962.e: Praiseworthy is that musician who loves God. ||11||

963.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
963.t: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
963.e: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

963.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਅਮਿਉ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
963.t: a(n)mirat baanee amiau ras a(n)mrit har kaa naau ||
963.e: The Bani of the Guru's Word is Ambrosial Nectar; its taste is sweet. The Name of the Lord is Ambrosial Nectar.

963.g: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
963.t: man tan hiradhai simar har aaTh pahar gun gaau ||
963.e: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord in your mind, body and heart; twenty-four hours a day, sing His Glorious Praises.

963.g: ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਹੁ ਸਚਾ ਇਹੈ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
963.t: aupadhes sunahu tum gursikhahu sachaa ihai suaau ||
963.e: Listen to these Teachings, O Sikhs of the Guru. This is the true purpose of life.

963.g: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਲਾਇਹੁ ਭਾਉ ॥
963.t: janam padhaarath safal hoi man meh laih bhaau ||
963.e: This priceless human life will be made fruitful; embrace love for the Lord in your mind.

963.g: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨਦੁ ਘਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਪਤਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
963.t: sookh sahaj aanadh ghanaa prabh japatiaa dhukh jai ||
963.e: Celestial peace and absolute bliss come when one meditates on God - suffering is dispelled.

963.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਈਐ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥
963.t: naanak naam japat sukh uoopajai dharageh paieeaai thaau ||1||
963.e: O Nanak, chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, peace wells up, and one obtains a place in the Court of the Lord. ||1||

963.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
963.e: Fifth Mehla:

963.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਇ ॥
963.t: naanak naam dhiaaieeaai gur pooraa mat dhei ||
963.e: O Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; this is the Teaching imparted by the Perfect Guru.

963.g: ਭਾਣੈ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮੋ ਭਾਣੈ ਹੀ ਕਢਿ ਲੇਇ ॥
963.t: bhaanai jap tap sa(n)jamo bhaanai hee kadd lei ||
963.e: In the Lord's Will, they practice meditation, austerity and self-discipline; in the Lord's Will, they are released.

963.g: ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋਨਿ ਭਵਾਈਐ ਭਾਣੈ ਬਖਸ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
963.t: bhaanai jon bhavaieeaai bhaanai bakhas karei ||
963.e: In the Lord's Will, they are made to wander in reincarnation; in the Lord's Will, they are forgiven.

963.g: ਭਾਣੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਭੋਗੀਐ ਭਾਣੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
963.t: bhaanai dhukh sukh bhogeeaai bhaanai karam karei ||
963.e: In the Lord's Will, pain and pleasure are experienced; in the Lord's Will, actions are performed.

963.g: ਭਾਣੈ ਮਿਟੀ ਸਾਜਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋਤਿ ਧਰੇਇ ॥
963.t: bhaanai miTee saaj kai bhaanai jot dharei ||
963.e: In the Lord's Will, clay is fashioned into form; in the Lord's Will, His Light is infused into it.

963.g: ਭਾਣੈ ਭੋਗ ਭੋਗਾਇਦਾ ਭਾਣੈ ਮਨਹਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
963.t: bhaanai bhog bhogaidhaa bhaanai maneh karei ||
963.e: In the Lord's Will, enjoyments are enjoyed; in the Lord's Will, these enjoyments are denied.

963.g: ਭਾਣੈ ਨਰਕਿ ਸੁਰਗਿ ਅਉਤਾਰੇ ਭਾਣੈ ਧਰਣਿ ਪਰੇਇ ॥
963.t: bhaanai narak surag aautaare bhaanai dharan parei ||
963.e: In the Lord's Will, they are incarnated in heaven and hell; in the Lord's Will, they fall to the ground.

963.g: ਭਾਣੈ ਹੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
963.t: bhaanai hee jis bhagatee laae naanak virale he ||2||
963.e: In the Lord's Will, they are committed to His devotional worship and Praise; O Nanak, how rare are these! ||2||

963.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
963.t: pauRee ||
963.e: Pauree:

963.g: ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣੇ ॥
963.t: vaddiaaiee sache naam kee hau jeevaa sun sune ||
963.e: Hearing, hearing of the glorious greatness of the True Name, I live.

963.g: ਪਸੂ ਪਰੇਤ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਇਕ ਖਣੇ ॥
963.t: pasoo paret agiaan udhaare ik khane ||
963.e: Even ignorant beasts and goblins can be saved, in an instant.

963.g: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਦ ਜਾਪੀਐ ॥
963.t: dhinas rain teraa naau sadhaa sadh jaapeeaai ||
963.e: Day and night, chant the Name, forever and ever.

963.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਵਿਕਰਾਲ ਨਾਇ ਤੇਰੈ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੀਐ ॥
963.t: tirasanaa bhukh vikaraal nai terai dhraapeeaai ||
963.e: The most horrible thirst and hunger is satisfied through Your Name, O Lord.

963.g: ਰੋਗੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਵੰਞੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਉ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ॥
963.t: rog sog dhukh va(n)n(j)ai jis naau man vasai ||
963.e: Disease, sorrow and pain run away, when the Name dwells within the mind.

963.g: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਲਾਲੁ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਰਸੈ ॥
963.t: tiseh paraapat laal jo gur sabadhee rasai ||
963.e: He alone attains his Beloved, who loves the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

963.g: ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਉਧਾਰਣਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
963.t: kha(n)dd brahama(n)dd bea(n)t udhaaranahaariaa ||
963.e: The worlds and solar systems are saved by the Infinite Lord.

963.g: ਤੇਰੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਚੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥੧੨॥
963.t: teree sobhaa tudh sache mere piaariaa ||12||
963.e: Your glory is Yours alone, O my Beloved True Lord. ||12||

963.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
963.t: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
963.e: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

963.g: ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀ ਮੈ ਛਡਿ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਰੰਗਿ ਕਸੁੰਭੈ ਭੁਲੀ ॥
963.t: mitr piaaraa naanak jee mai chhadd gavaiaa ra(n)g kasu(n)bhai bhulee ||
963.e: I abandoned and lost my Beloved Friend, O Nanak; I was fooled by the transitory color of the safflower, which fades away.

963.g: ਤਉ ਸਜਣ ਕੀ ਮੈ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਉਦੀ ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਢੁ ਨ ਲਹਦੀ ॥੧॥
963.t: tau sajan kee mai keem na paudhee hau tudh bin add na lahadhee ||1||
963.e: I did not know Your value, O my Friend; without You, I am not worth even half a shell. ||1||

963.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
963.e: Fifth Mehla:

963.g: ਸਸੁ ਵਿਰਾਇਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਉ ਸਸੁਰਾ ਵਾਦੀ ਜੇਠੋ ਪਉ ਪਉ ਲੂਹੈ ॥
963.t: sas virain naanak jeeau sasuraa vaadhee jeTho pau pau loohai ||
963.e: My mother-in-law is my enemy, O Nanak; my father-in-law is argumentative and my brother-in-law burns me at every step.

963.g: ਹਭੇ ਭਸੁ ਪੁਣੇਦੇ ਵਤਨੁ ਜਾ ਮੈ ਸਜਣੁ ਤੂਹੈ ॥੨॥
963.t: habhe bhas punedhe vatan jaa mai sajan toohai ||2||
963.e: They can all just play in the dust, when You are my Friend, O Lord. ||2||

963.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
963.t: pauRee ||
963.e: Pauree:

963.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਵੁਠਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਣੋ ॥
963.t: jis too vuThaa chit tis dharadh nivaarano ||
963.e: You relieve the pains of those, within whose consciousness You dwell, O Lord.

963.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਵੁਠਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹਾਰਣੋ ॥
963.t: jis too vuThaa chit tis kadhe na haarano ||
963.e: Those, within whose consciousness You dwell, never lose.

963.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਸੁ ਸਰਪਰ ਤਾਰਣੋ ॥
963.t: jis miliaa pooraa guroo su sarapar taarano ||
963.e: One who meets the Perfect Guru will surely be saved.

963.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਏ ਸਚਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਣੋ ॥
963.t: jis no laae sach tis sach sam(h)aalano ||
963.e: One who is attached to Truth, contemplates Truth.

963.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਇਆ ਹਥਿ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਾਲਣੋ ॥
963.t: jis aaiaa hath nidhaanu su rahiaa bhaalano ||
963.e: One, into whose hands the treasure comes, stops searching.

963.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਇਕੋ ਰੰਗੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਸੋ ਜਾਨਣੋ ॥
963.t: jis no iko ra(n)g bhagat so jaanano ||
963.e: He alone is known as a devotee, who loves the One Lord.

963.g: ਓਹੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਬਿਰਹੀ ਚਾਰਣੋ ॥
963.t: oh sabhanaa kee ren birahee chaarano ||
963.e: He is the dust under the feet of all; he is the lover of the Lord's feet.

963.g: ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਾਰਣੋ ॥੧੩॥
963.t: sabh tere choj viddaan sabh teraa kaarano ||13||
963.e: Everything is Your wonderful play; the whole creation is Yours. ||13||

963.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
963.t: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
963.e: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

963.g: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀ ਮੈ ਹਭ ਵਞਾਈ ਛੋੜਿਆ ਹਭੁ ਕਿਝੁ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥
963.t: ausatat ni(n)dhaa naanak jee mai habh van(j)aiee chhoRiaa habh kijh tiaagee ||
963.e: I have totally discarded praise and slander, O Nanak; I have forsaken and abandoned everything.

963.g: ਹਭੇ ਸਾਕ ਕੂੜਾਵੇ ਡਿਠੇ ਤਉ ਪਲੈ ਤੈਡੈ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੧॥
963.t: habhe saak kooRaave ddiThe tau palai taiddai laagee ||1||
963.e: I have seen that all relationships are false, and so I have grasped hold of the hem of Your robe, Lord. ||1||

963.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
963.e: Fifth Mehla:

963.g: ਫਿਰਦੀ ਫਿਰਦੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਉ ਹਉ ਫਾਵੀ ਥੀਈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦਿਸਾਵਰ ਪੰਧਾ ॥
963.t: firadhee firadhee naanak jeeau hau faavee theeiee bahut dhisaavar pa(n)dhaa ||
963.e: I wandered and wandered and went crazy, O Nanak, in countless foreign lands and pathways.

963.g: ਤਾ ਹਉ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਸੁਤੀ ਜਾ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਮੈ ਲਧਾ ॥੨॥
963.t: taa hau sukh sukhaalee sutee jaa gur mil sajan mai ladhaa ||2||
963.e: But then, I slept in peace and comfort, when I met the Guru, and found my Friend. ||2||

964.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
964.t: pauRee ||
964.e: Pauree:

964.g: ਸਭੇ ਦੁਖ ਸੰਤਾਪ ਜਾਂ ਤੁਧਹੁ ਭੁਲੀਐ ॥
964.t: sabhe dhukh sa(n)taap jaa(n) tudhahu bhuleeaai ||
964.e: When I forget You, I endure all pains and afflictions.

964.g: ਜੇ ਕੀਚਨਿ ਲਖ ਉਪਾਵ ਤਾਂ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਘੁਲੀਐ ॥
964.t: je keechan lakh upaav taa(n) kahee na ghuleeaai ||
964.e: Making thousands of efforts, they are still not eliminated.

964.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਨਾਉ ਸੁ ਨਿਰਧਨੁ ਕਾਂਢੀਐ ॥
964.t: jis no visarai naau su niradhan kaa(n)ddeeaai ||
964.e: One who forgets the Name, is known as a poor person.

964.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਨਾਉ ਸੋ ਜੋਨੀ ਹਾਂਢੀਐ ॥
964.t: jis no visarai naau so jonee haa(n)ddeeaai ||
964.e: One who forgets the Name, wanders in reincarnation.

964.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਖਸਮੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਮੁ ਡੰਡੁ ਦੇ ॥
964.t: jis khasam na aavai chit tis jam dda(n)dd dhe ||
964.e: One who does not remember his Lord and Master, is punished by the Messenger of Death.

964.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਖਸਮੁ ਨ ਆਵੀ ਚਿਤਿ ਰੋਗੀ ਸੇ ਗਣੇ ॥
964.t: jis khasam na aavee chit rogee se gane ||
964.e: One who does not remember his Lord and Master, is judged to be a sick person.

964.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਖਸਮੁ ਨ ਆਵੀ ਚਿਤਿ ਸੁ ਖਰੋ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀਆ ॥
964.t: jis khasam na aavee chit su kharo aha(n)kaareeaa ||
964.e: One who does not remember his Lord and Master, is egotistical and proud.

964.g: ਸੋਈ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ਜਗਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਉ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਆ ॥੧੪॥
964.t: soiee dhuhelaa jag jin naau visaareeaa ||14||
964.e: One who forgets the Name is miserable in this world. ||14||

964.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
964.t: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
964.e: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

964.g: ਤੈਡੀ ਬੰਦਸਿ ਮੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਡਿਠਾ ਤੂ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
964.t: taiddee ba(n)dhas mai koi na ddiThaa too naanak man bhaanaa ||
964.e: I have not seen any other like You. You alone are pleasing to Nanak's mind.

964.g: ਘੋਲਿ ਘੁਮਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਵਿਚੋਲੇ ਜੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੰਤੁ ਪਛਾਣਾ ॥੧॥
964.t: ghol ghumaiee tis mitr vichole jai mil ka(n)t pachhaanaa ||1||
964.e: I am a dedicated, devoted sacrifice to that friend, that mediator, who leads me to recognize my Husband Lord. ||1||

964.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
964.e: Fifth Mehla:

964.g: ਪਾਵ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ ਜਾਂ ਤਉ ਧਿਰਿ ਜੁਲਦੇ ਸੀਸੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਚਰਣੀ ॥
964.t: paav suhaave jaa(n) tau dhir juladhe sees suhaavaa charanee ||
964.e: Beautiful are those feet which walk towards You; beautiful is that head which falls at Your Feet.

964.g: ਮੁਖੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਜਾਂ ਤਉ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ ਪਇਆ ਤਉ ਸਰਣੀ ॥੨॥
964.t: mukh suhaavaa jaa(n) tau jas gaavai jeeau piaa tau saranee ||2||
964.e: Beautiful is that mouth which sings Your Praises; beautiful is that soul which seeks Your Sanctuary. ||2||

964.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
964.t: pauRee ||
964.e: Pauree:

964.g: ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਰੀ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਵੀਆ ॥
964.t: mil naaree satasa(n)g ma(n)gal gaaveeaa ||
964.e: Meeting the Lord's brides, in the True Congregation, I sing the songs of joy.

964.g: ਘਰ ਕਾ ਹੋਆ ਬੰਧਾਨੁ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਧਾਵੀਆ ॥
964.t: ghar kaa hoaa ba(n)dhaan bahuR na dhaaveeaa ||
964.e: The home of my heart is now held steady, and I shall not go out wandering again.

964.g: ਬਿਨਠੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੁਰਤੁ ਸੋਇ ਕੂੜਾਵੀਆ ॥
964.t: binaThee dhuramat dhurat soi kooRaaveeaa ||
964.e: Evil-mindedness has been dispelled, along with sin and my bad reputation.

964.g: ਸੀਲਵੰਤਿ ਪਰਧਾਨਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਚਾਵੀਆ ॥
964.t: seelava(n)t paradhaan ridhai sachaaveeaa ||
964.e: I am well-known as being calm and good-natured; my heart is filled with Truth.

964.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਇਕ ਰੀਤਾਵੀਆ ॥
964.t: a(n)tar baahar ik ik reetaaveeaa ||
964.e: Inwardly and outwardly, the One and only Lord is my way.

964.g: ਮਨਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਚਰਣ ਦਾਸਾਵੀਆ ॥
964.t: man dharasan kee piaas charan dhaasaaveeaa ||
964.e: My mind is thirsty for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. I am a slave at His feet.

964.g: ਸੋਭਾ ਬਣੀ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਖਸਮਿ ਜਾਂ ਰਾਵੀਆ ॥
964.t: sobhaa banee seegaar khasam jaa(n) raaveeaa ||
964.e: I am glorified and embellished, when my Lord and Master enjoys me.

964.g: ਮਿਲੀਆ ਆਇ ਸੰਜੋਗਿ ਜਾਂ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੀਆ ॥੧੫॥
964.t: mileeaa aai sa(n)jog jaa(n) tis bhaaveeaa ||15||
964.e: I meet Him through my blessed destiny, when it is pleasing to His Will. ||15||

964.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
964.t: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
964.e: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

964.g: ਹਭਿ ਗੁਣ ਤੈਡੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਉ ਮੈ ਕੂ ਥੀਏ ਮੈ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਤੇ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
964.t: habh gun taidde naanak jeeau mai koo the'ee mai niragun te kiaa hovai ||
964.e: All virtues are Yours, Dear Lord; You bestow them upon us. I am unworthy - what can I achieve, O Nanak?

964.g: ਤਉ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਚਕੁ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਚੋਵੈ ॥੧॥
964.t: tau jevadd dhaataar na koiee jaachak sadhaa jaachovai ||1||
964.e: There is no other Giver as great as You. I am a beggar; I beg from You forever. ||1||

964.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
964.e: Fifth Mehla:

964.g: ਦੇਹ ਛਿਜੰਦੜੀ ਊਣ ਮਝੂਣਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਜਣਿ ਜੀਉ ਧਰਾਇਆ ॥
964.t: dheh chhija(n)dhaRee uoon majhoonaa gur sajan jeeau dharaiaa ||
964.e: My body was wasting away, and I was depressed. The Guru, my Friend, has encouraged and consoled me.

964.g: ਹਭੇ ਸੁਖ ਸੁਹੇਲੜਾ ਸੁਤਾ ਜਿਤਾ ਜਗੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
964.t: habhe sukh suhelaRaa sutaa jitaa jag sabaiaa ||2||
964.e: I sleep in total peace and comfort; I have conquered the whole world. ||2||

964.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
964.t: pauRee ||
964.e: Pauree:

964.g: ਵਡਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਤਖਤੁ ॥
964.t: vaddaa teraa dharabaar sachaa tudh takhat ||
964.e: The Darbaar of Your Court is glorious and great. Your holy throne is True.

964.g: ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਚਉਰੁ ਛਤੁ ॥
964.t: sir saahaa paatisaahu nihachal chaur chhat ||
964.e: You are the Emperor over the heads of kings. Your canopy and chauree (fly-brush) are permanent and unchanging.

964.g: ਜੋ ਭਾਵੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੋਈ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਆਉ ॥
964.t: jo bhaavai paarabraham soiee sach niaau ||
964.e: That alone is true justice, which is pleasing to the Will of the Supreme Lord God.

964.g: ਜੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਥਾਉ ॥
964.t: je bhaavai paarabraham nithaave milai thaau ||
964.e: Even the homeless receive a home, when it is pleasing to the Will of the Supreme Lord God.

964.g: ਜੋ ਕੀਨੑੀ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ਸਾਈ ਭਲੀ ਗਲ ॥
964.t: jo keen(h)ee karataar saiee bhalee gal ||
964.e: Whatever the Creator Lord does, is a good thing.

964.g: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਸੇ ਦਰਗਾਹ ਮਲ ॥
964.t: jin(h)ee pachhaataa khasam se dharagaeh mal ||
964.e: Those who recognize their Lord and Master, are seated in the Court of the Lord.

964.g: ਸਹੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਫੁਰਮਾਨੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਫੇਰੀਐ ॥
964.t: sahee teraa furamaan kinai na fereeaai ||
964.e: True is Your Command; no one can challenge it.

964.g: ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਣ ਕਰੀਮ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਤੇਰੀਐ ॥੧੬॥
964.t: kaaran karan kareem kudharat tereeaai ||16||
964.e: O Merciful Lord, Cause of causes, Your creative power is all-powerful. ||16||

964.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
964.t: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
964.e: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

964.g: ਸੋਇ ਸੁਣੰਦੜੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਉਲਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੰਦੜੀ ਲਾਲੀ ॥
964.t: soi suna(n)dhaRee meraa tan man maulaa naam japa(n)dhaRee laalee ||
964.e: Hearing of You, my body and mind have blossomed forth; chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, I am flushed with life.

964.g: ਪੰਧਿ ਜੁਲੰਦੜੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਅੰਦਰੁ ਠੰਢਾ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀ ॥੧॥
964.t: pa(n)dh jula(n)dhaRee meraa a(n)dhar Tha(n)ddaa gur dharasan dhekh nihaalee ||1||
964.e: Walking on the Path, I have found cool tranquility deep within; gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan, I am enraptured. ||1||

964.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
964.e: Fifth Mehla:

964.g: ਹਠ ਮੰਝਾਹੂ ਮੈ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਲਧਾ ॥
964.t: haTh ma(n)jhaahoo mai maanak ladhaa ||
964.e: I have found the jewel within my heart.

964.g: ਮੁਲਿ ਨ ਘਿਧਾ ਮੈ ਕੂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਤਾ ॥
964.t: mul na ghidhaa mai koo satigur dhitaa ||
964.e: I was not charged for it; the True Guru gave it to me.

964.g: ਢੂੰਢ ਵਞਾਈ ਥੀਆ ਥਿਤਾ ॥
964.t: ddoo(n)dd van(j)aiee theeaa thitaa ||
964.e: My search has ended, and I have become stable.

964.g: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਤਾ ॥੨॥
964.t: janam padhaarath naanak jitaa ||2||
964.e: O Nanak, I have conquered this priceless human life. ||2||

964.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
964.t: pauRee ||
964.e: Pauree:

964.g: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
964.t: jis kai masatak karam hoi so sevaa laagaa ||
964.e: One who has such good karma inscribed upon his forehead, is committed to the Lord's service.

964.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਸੋ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਾ ॥
964.t: jis gur mil kamal pragaasiaa so anadhin jaagaa ||
964.e: One whose heart lotus blossoms forth upon meeting the Guru, remains awake and aware, night and day.

964.g: ਲਗਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਚਰਣਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਸਭੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ॥
964.t: lagaa ra(n)g charanaarabi(n)dh sabh bhram bhau bhaagaa ||
964.e: All doubt and fear run away from one who is in love with the Lord's lotus feet.

965.g: ਆਤਮੁ ਜਿਤਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਆਗੰਜਤ ਪਾਗਾ ॥
965.t: aatam jitaa gurmatee aaga(n)jat paagaa ||
965.e: He conquers his soul, following the Guru's Teachings, and attains the Imperishable Lord.

965.g: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸੋ ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਤਾਗਾ ॥
965.t: jiseh dhiaaiaa paarabraham so kal meh taagaa ||
965.e: He alone keeps up in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, who meditates on the Supreme Lord God.

965.g: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਮਜਨਾਗਾ ॥
965.t: saadhoo sa(n)gat niramalaa aThasaTh majanaagaa ||
965.e: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he is immaculate, as if he has bathed at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

965.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਭਾਗਾ ॥
965.t: jis prabh miliaa aapanaa so purakh sabhaagaa ||
965.e: He alone is a man of good fortune, who has met with God.

965.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਏਵਡ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੧੭॥
965.t: naanak tis balihaaranai jis evadd bhaagaa ||17||
965.e: Nanak is a sacrifice to such a one, whose destiny is so great! ||17||

965.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
965.t: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
965.e: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

965.g: ਜਾਂ ਪਿਰੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤਾਂ ਧਨ ਬਾਹਰਿ ॥
965.t: jaa(n) pir a(n)dhar taa(n) dhan baahar ||
965.e: When the Husband Lord is within the heart, then Maya, the bride, goes outside.

965.g: ਜਾਂ ਪਿਰੁ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਤਾਂ ਧਨ ਮਾਹਰਿ ॥
965.t: jaa(n) pir baahar taa(n) dhan maahar ||
965.e: When one's Husband Lord is outside of oneself, then Maya, the bride, is supreme.

965.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਹੁ ਫੇਰੁ ਫਿਰਾਹਰਿ ॥
965.t: bin naavai bahu fer firaahar ||
965.e: Without the Name, one wanders all around.

965.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਜਾਹਰਿ ॥
965.t: satigur sa(n)g dhikhaiaa jaahar ||
965.e: The True Guru shows us that the Lord is with us.

965.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਰਿ ॥੧॥
965.t: jan naanak sache sach samaahar ||1||
965.e: Servant Nanak merges in the Truest of the True. ||1||

965.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
965.e: Fifth Mehla:

965.g: ਆਹਰ ਸਭਿ ਕਰਦਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਆਹਰੁ ਇਕੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
965.t: aahar sabh karadhaa firai aahar ik na hoi ||
965.e: Making all sorts of efforts, they wander around; but they do not make even one effort.

965.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਤੁ ਆਹਰਿ ਜਗੁ ਉਧਰੈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
965.t: naanak jit aahar jag udharai viralaa boojhai koi ||2||
965.e: O Nanak, how rare are those who understand the effort which saves the world. ||2||

965.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
965.t: pauRee ||
965.e: Pauree:

965.g: ਵਡੀ ਹੂ ਵਡਾ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਮਰਤਬਾ ॥
965.t: vaddee hoo vaddaa apaar teraa maratabaa ||
965.e: The greatest of the great, infinite is Your dignity.

965.g: ਰੰਗ ਪਰੰਗ ਅਨੇਕ ਨ ਜਾਪਨਿੑ ਕਰਤਬਾ ॥
965.t: ra(n)g para(n)g anek na jaapani(h) karatabaa ||
965.e: Your colors and hues are so numerous; no one can know Your actions.

965.g: ਜੀਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਲਾ ॥
965.t: jeeaa a(n)dhar jeeau sabh kichh jaanalaa ||
965.e: You are the Soul within all souls; You alone know everything.

965.g: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਵਸਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਘਰੁ ਭਲਾ ॥
965.t: sabh kichh terai vas teraa ghar bhalaa ||
965.e: Everything is under Your control; Your home is beautiful.

965.g: ਤੇਰੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਵਧਾਈ ਤੁਧੁ ਘਰਿ ॥
965.t: terai ghar aana(n)dh vadhaiee tudh ghar ||
965.e: Your home is filled with bliss, which resonates and resounds throughout Your home.

965.g: ਮਾਣੁ ਮਹਤਾ ਤੇਜੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪਿ ਜਰਿ ॥
965.t: maan mahataa tej aapanaa aap jar ||
965.e: Your honor, majesty and glory are Yours alone.

965.g: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਭਰਪੂਰੁ ਦਿਸੈ ਜਤ ਕਤਾ ॥
965.t: sarab kalaa bharapoor dhisai jat kataa ||
965.e: You are overflowing with all powers; wherever we look, there You are.

965.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਗੈ ਬਿਨਵਤਾ ॥੧੮॥
965.t: naanak dhaasan dhaas tudh aagai binavataa ||18||
965.e: Nanak, the slave of Your slaves, prays to You alone. ||18||

965.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
965.t: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
965.e: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

965.g: ਛਤੜੇ ਬਾਜਾਰ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਪਾਰੀਏ ॥
965.t: chhataRe baajaar sohan vich vapaare'e ||
965.e: Your streets are covered with canopies; under them, the traders look beautiful.

965.g: ਵਖਰੁ ਹਿਕੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਖਟੇ ਸੋ ਧਣੀ ॥੧॥
965.t: vakhar hik apaar naanak khaTe so dhanee ||1||
965.e: O Nanak, he alone is truly a banker, who buys the infinite commodity. ||1||

965.g: ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
965.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
965.e: Fifth Mehla:

965.g: ਕਬੀਰਾ ਹਮਰਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਹਮ ਕਿਸ ਹੂ ਕੇ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
965.t: kabeeraa hamaraa ko nahee ham kis hoo ke naeh ||
965.e: Kabeer, no one is mine, and I belong to no one.

965.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
965.t: jin ih rachan rachaiaa tis hee maeh samaeh ||2||
965.e: I am absorbed in the One, who created this creation. ||2||

965.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
965.t: pauRee ||
965.e: Pauree:

965.g: ਸਫਲਿਉ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਸੁਹਾਵੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਫਲ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਾ ॥
965.t: safaliau birakh suhaavaRaa har safal a(n)mritaa ||
965.e: The Lord is the most beautiful fruit tree, bearing fruits of Ambrosial Nectar.

965.g: ਮਨੁ ਲੋਚੈ ਉਨੑ ਮਿਲਣ ਕਉ ਕਿਉ ਵੰਞੈ ਘਿਤਾ ॥
965.t: man lochai un(h) milan kau kiau va(n)n(j)ai ghitaa ||
965.e: My mind longs to meet Him; how can I ever find Him?

965.g: ਵਰਨਾ ਚਿਹਨਾ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਓਹੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਜਿਤਾ ॥
965.t: varanaa chihanaa baaharaa oh agam ajitaa ||
965.e: He has no color or form; He is inaccessible and unconquerable.

965.g: ਓਹੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਜੋ ਖੋਲੑੈ ਭਿਤਾ ॥
965.t: oh piaaraa jeea kaa jo khol(h)ai bhitaa ||
965.e: I love Him with all my soul; He opens the door for me.

965.g: ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੀ ਤੁਸਾੜੀਆ ਮੈ ਦਸਿਹੁ ਮਿਤਾ ॥
965.t: sevaa karee tusaaReeaa mai dhasih mitaa ||
965.e: I shall serve you forever, if you tell me of my Friend.

965.g: ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਵੰਞਾ ਵਾਰਣੈ ਬਲੇ ਬਲਿ ਕਿਤਾ ॥
965.t: kurabaanee va(n)n(j)aa vaaranai bale bal kitaa ||
965.e: I am a sacrifice, a dedicated, devoted sacrifice to Him.

965.g: ਦਸਨਿ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਲਾਇ ਚਿਤਾ ॥
965.t: dhasan sa(n)t piaariaa sunahu lai chitaa ||
965.e: The Beloved Saints tell us, to listen with our consciousness.

965.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਉ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਤਾ ॥੧੯॥
965.t: jis likhiaa naanak dhaas tis naau a(n)mrit satigur dhitaa ||19||
965.e: One who has such pre-ordained destiny, O slave Nanak, is blessed with the Ambrosial Name by the True Guru. ||19||

965.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
965.t: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
965.e: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

965.g: ਕਬੀਰ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਤਸਕਰ ਬੈਸਹਿ ਗਾਹਿ ॥
965.t: kabeer dharatee saadh kee tasakar baiseh gaeh ||
965.e: Kabeer, the earth belongs to the Holy, but the thieves have come and now sit among them.

965.g: ਧਰਤੀ ਭਾਰਿ ਨ ਬਿਆਪਈ ਉਨ ਕਉ ਲਾਹੂ ਲਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
965.t: dharatee bhaar na biaapiee un kau laahoo laeh ||1||
965.e: The earth does not feel their weight; even they profit. ||1||

965.g: ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
965.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
965.e: Fifth Mehla:

965.g: ਕਬੀਰ ਚਾਵਲ ਕਾਰਣੇ ਤੁਖ ਕਉ ਮੁਹਲੀ ਲਾਇ ॥
965.t: kabeer chaaval kaarane tukh kau muhalee lai ||
965.e: Kabeer, for the sake of the rice, the husks are beaten and threshed.

965.g: ਸੰਗਿ ਕੁਸੰਗੀ ਬੈਸਤੇ ਤਬ ਪੂਛੇ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ॥੨॥
965.t: sa(n)g kusa(n)gee baisate tab poochhe dharam rai ||2||
965.e: When one sits in the company of evil people, then he will be called to account by the Righteous Judge of Dharma. ||2||

965.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
965.t: pauRee ||
965.e: Pauree:

965.g: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਵਡ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ਆਪਿ ਇਕਾਤੀਆ ॥
965.t: aape hee vadd paravaar aap ikaateeaa ||
965.e: He Himself has the greatest family; He Himself is all alone.

965.g: ਆਪਣੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਜਾਤੀਆ ॥
965.t: aapanee keemat aap aape hee jaateeaa ||
965.e: He alone knows His own worth.

965.g: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਉਪੰਨਿਆ ॥
965.t: sabh kichh aape aap aap upa(n)niaa ||
965.e: He Himself, by Himself, created everything.

965.g: ਆਪਣਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਰੰਨਿਆ ॥
965.t: aapanaa keetaa aap aap vara(n)niaa ||
965.e: Only He Himself can describe His own creation.

965.g: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਜਿਥੈ ਤੂ ਵੁਠਾ ॥
965.t: dha(n)nu su teraa thaan jithai too vuThaa ||
965.e: Blessed is Your place, where You dwell, Lord.

966.g: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਸਚੁ ਤੂੰ ਡਿਠਾ ॥
966.t: dha(n)nu su tere bhagat jin(h)ee sach too(n) ddiThaa ||
966.e: Blessed are Your devotees, who see You, O True Lord.

966.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਇਆ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਸੋਇ ਤੁਧੁ ॥
966.t: jis no teree dhiaa salaahe soi tudh ||
966.e: He alone praises You, who is blessed by Your Grace.

966.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਧੁ ॥੨੦॥
966.t: jis gur bheTe naanak niramal soiee sudh ||20||
966.e: One who meets the Guru, O Nanak, is immaculate and sanctified. ||20||

966.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
966.t: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
966.e: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

966.g: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਭੂਮਿ ਰੰਗਾਵਲੀ ਮੰਝਿ ਵਿਸੂਲਾ ਬਾਗੁ ॥
966.t: fareedhaa bhoom ra(n)gaavalee ma(n)jh visoolaa baag ||
966.e: Fareed, this world is beautiful, but there is a thorny garden within it.

966.g: ਜੋ ਨਰ ਪੀਰਿ ਨਿਵਾਜਿਆ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਅੰਚ ਨ ਲਾਗ ॥੧॥
966.t: jo nar peer nivaajiaa tin(h)aa a(n)ch na laag ||1||
966.e: Those who are blessed by their spiritual teacher are not even scratched. ||1||

966.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
966.e: Fifth Mehla:

966.g: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਉਮਰ ਸੁਹਾਵੜੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਵੰਨੜੀ ਦੇਹ ॥
966.t: fareedhaa umar suhaavaRee sa(n)g suva(n)naRee dheh ||
966.e: Fareed, blessed is the life, with such a beautiful body.

966.g: ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕੇਈ ਪਾਈਅਨਿੑ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨੇਹ ॥੨॥
966.t: virale keiee paieeani(h) jin(h)aa piaare neh ||2||
966.e: How rare are those who are found to love their Beloved Lord. ||2||

966.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
966.t: pauRee ||
966.e: Pauree:

966.g: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
966.t: jap tap sa(n)jam dhiaa dharam jis dheh su paae ||
966.e: He alone obtains meditation, austerities, self-discipline, compassion and Dharmic faith, whom the Lord so blesses.

966.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਹਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਆਪਿ ਸੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
966.t: jis bujhaieh agan aap so naam dhiaae ||
966.e: He alone meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, whose fire the Lord puts out.

966.g: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਅਗਮ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਇਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਿਖਾਏ ॥
966.t: a(n)tarajaamee agam purakh ik dhirasaT dhikhaae ||
966.e: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, the Inaccessible Primal Lord, inspires us to look upon all with an impartial eye.

966.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਆਸਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
966.t: saadhasa(n)gat kai aasarai prabh siau ra(n)g laae ||
966.e: With the support of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one falls in love with God.

966.g: ਅਉਗਣ ਕਟਿ ਮੁਖੁ ਉਜਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਰਾਏ ॥
966.t: aaugan kaT mukh ujalaa har naam taraae ||
966.e: One's faults are eradicated, and one's face becomes radiant and bright; through the Lord's Name, one crosses over.

966.g: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭਉ ਕਟਿਓਨੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
966.t: janam maran bhau kaTion fir jon na paae ||
966.e: The fear of birth and death is removed, and he is not reincarnated again.

966.g: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਕਾਢਿਅਨੁ ਲੜੁ ਆਪਿ ਫੜਾਏ ॥
966.t: a(n)dh koop te kaaddian laR aap faRaae ||
966.e: God lifts him up and pulls him out of the deep, dark pit, and attaches him to the hem of His robe.

966.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਰਖੇ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਏ ॥੨੧॥
966.t: naanak bakhas milaian rakhe gal laae ||21||
966.e: O Nanak, God forgives him, and holds him close in His embrace. ||21||

966.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
966.t: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
966.e: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

966.g: ਮੁਹਬਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਦੀ ਰਤਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲਿ ॥
966.t: muhabat jis khudhai dhee rataa ra(n)g chalool ||
966.e: One who loves God is imbued with the deep crimson color of His love.

966.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਮੂਲਿ ॥੧॥
966.t: naanak virale paie'eeh tis jan keem na mool ||1||
966.e: O Nanak, such a person is rarely found; the value of such a humble person can never be estimated. ||1||

966.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
966.e: Fifth Mehla:

966.g: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਵਿਧਾ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭੀ ਸਚੁ ਡਿਠੋਮਿ ॥
966.t: a(n)dhar vidhaa sach nai baahar bhee sach ddiThom ||
966.e: The True Name has pierced the nucleus of my self deep within. Outside, I see the True Lord as well.

966.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਵਿਆ ਹਭ ਥਾਇ ਵਣਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਣਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਰੋਮਿ ॥੨॥
966.t: naanak raviaa habh thai van tiran tirabhavan rom ||2||
966.e: O Nanak, He is pervading and permeating all places, the forests and the meadows, the three worlds, and every hair. ||2||

966.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
966.t: pauRee ||
966.e: Pauree:

966.g: ਆਪੇ ਕੀਤੋ ਰਚਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਰਤਿਆ ॥
966.t: aape keeto rachan aape hee ratiaa ||
966.e: He Himself created the Universe; He Himself imbues it.

966.g: ਆਪੇ ਹੋਇਓ ਇਕੁ ਆਪੇ ਬਹੁ ਭਤਿਆ ॥
966.t: aape hoio ik aape bahu bhatiaa ||
966.e: He Himself is One, and He Himself has numerous forms.

966.g: ਆਪੇ ਸਭਨਾ ਮੰਝਿ ਆਪੇ ਬਾਹਰਾ ॥
966.t: aape sabhanaa ma(n)jh aape baaharaa ||
966.e: He Himself is within all, and He Himself is beyond them.

966.g: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਜਾਹਰਾ ॥
966.t: aape jaaneh dhoor aape hee jaaharaa ||
966.e: He Himself is known to be far away, and He Himself is right here.

966.g: ਆਪੇ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਆਪੇ ਪਰਗਟੀਐ ॥
966.t: aape hoveh gupat aape paragaTeeaai ||
966.e: He Himself is hidden, and He Himself is revealed.

966.g: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਪਾਇ ਤੇਰੀ ਥਟੀਐ ॥
966.t: keemat kisai na pai teree thaTeeaai ||
966.e: No one can estimate the value of Your Creation, Lord.

966.g: ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਅਗਣਤੁ ਤੂੰ ॥
966.t: gahir ga(n)bheer athaahu apaar aganat too(n) ||
966.e: You are deep and profound, unfathomable, infinite and invaluable.

966.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਰਤੈ ਇਕੁ ਇਕੋ ਇਕੁ ਤੂੰ ॥੨੨॥੧॥੨॥ ਸੁਧੁ ॥
966.t: naanak varatai ik iko ik too(n) ||22||1||2|| sudh ||
966.e: O Nanak, the One Lord is all-pervading. You are the One and only. ||22||1||2|| Sudh||

966.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਰਾਇ ਬਲਵੰਡਿ ਤਥਾ ਸਤੈ ਡੂਮਿ ਆਖੀ
966.t: raamakalee kee vaar rai balava(n)dd tathaa satai ddoom aakhee
966.e: Vaar Of Raamkalee, Uttered By Satta And Balwand The Drummer:

966.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
966.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
966.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

966.g: ਨਾਉ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਾਦਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਉ ਬੋਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੋਖੀਵਦੈ ॥
966.t: naau karataa kaadhar kare kiau bol hovai jokheevadhai ||
966.e: One who chants the Name of the Almighty Creator - how can his words be judged?

966.g: ਦੇ ਗੁਨਾ ਸਤਿ ਭੈਣ ਭਰਾਵ ਹੈ ਪਾਰੰਗਤਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਪੜੀਵਦੈ ॥
966.t: dhe gunaa sat bhain bharaav hai paara(n)gat dhaan paReevadhai ||
966.e: His divine virtues are the true sisters and brothers; through them, the gift of supreme status is obtained.

966.g: ਨਾਨਕਿ ਰਾਜੁ ਚਲਾਇਆ ਸਚੁ ਕੋਟੁ ਸਤਾਣੀ ਨੀਵ ਦੈ ॥
966.t: naanak raaj chalaiaa sach koT sataanee neev dhai ||
966.e: Nanak established the kingdom; He built the true fortress on the strongest foundations.

966.g: ਲਹਣੇ ਧਰਿਓਨੁ ਛਤੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਦੈ ॥
966.t: lahane dharion chhat sir kar sifatee a(n)mrit peevadhai ||
966.e: He installed the royal canopy over Lehna's head; chanting the Lord's Praises, He drank in the Ambrosial Nectar.

966.g: ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਆਤਮ ਦੇਵ ਦੀ ਖੜਗਿ ਜੋਰਿ ਪਰਾਕੁਇ ਜੀਅ ਦੈ ॥
966.t: mat gur aatam dhev dhee khaRag jor paraakui jeea dhai ||
966.e: The Guru implanted the almighty sword of the Teachings to illuminate his soul.

966.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਚੇਲੇ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਕੀਈ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਥੀਵਦੈ ॥
966.t: gur chele raharaas keeiee naanak salaamat theevadhai ||
966.e: The Guru bowed down to His disciple, while Nanak was still alive.

966.g: ਸਹਿ ਟਿਕਾ ਦਿਤੋਸੁ ਜੀਵਦੈ ॥੧॥
966.t: seh Tikaa dhitos jeevadhai ||1||
966.e: The King, while still alive, applied the ceremonial mark to his forehead. ||1||

966.g: ਲਹਣੇ ਦੀ ਫੇਰਾਈਐ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਦੋਹੀ ਖਟੀਐ ॥
966.t: lahane dhee feraieeaai naanakaa dhohee khaTeeaai ||
966.e: Nanak proclaimed Lehna's succession - he earned it.

966.g: ਜੋਤਿ ਓਹਾ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਾਇ ਸਹਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਫੇਰਿ ਪਲਟੀਐ ॥
966.t: jot ohaa jugat sai seh kaiaa fer palaTeeaai ||
966.e: They shared the One Light and the same way; the King just changed His body.

966.g: ਝੁਲੈ ਸੁ ਛਤੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੀ ਮਲਿ ਤਖਤੁ ਬੈਠਾ ਗੁਰ ਹਟੀਐ ॥
966.t: jhulai su chhat nira(n)janee mal takhat baiThaa gur haTeeaai ||
966.e: The immaculate canopy waves over Him, and He sits on the throne in the Guru's shop.

966.g: ਕਰਹਿ ਜਿ ਗੁਰ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ਸਿਲ ਜੋਗੁ ਅਲੂਣੀ ਚਟੀਐ ॥
966.t: kareh j gur furamaiaa sil jog aloonee chaTeeaai ||
966.e: He does as the Guru commands; He tasted the tasteless stone of Yoga.

967.g: ਲੰਗਰੁ ਚਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੀ ਖਟੀਐ ॥
967.t: la(n)gar chalai gur sabadh har toT na aavee khaTeeaai ||
967.e: The Langar - the Kitchen of the Guru's Shabad has been opened, and its supplies never run short.

967.g: ਖਰਚੇ ਦਿਤਿ ਖਸੰਮ ਦੀ ਆਪ ਖਹਦੀ ਖੈਰਿ ਦਬਟੀਐ ॥
967.t: kharache dhit khasa(n)m dhee aap khahadhee khair dhabaTeeaai ||
967.e: Whatever His Master gave, He spent; He distributed it all to be eaten.

967.g: ਹੋਵੈ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਖਸੰਮ ਦੀ ਨੂਰੁ ਅਰਸਹੁ ਕੁਰਸਹੁ ਝਟੀਐ ॥
967.t: hovai sifat khasa(n)m dhee noor arasahu kurasahu jhaTeeaai ||
967.e: The Praises of the Master were sung, and the Divine Light descended from the heavens to the earth.

967.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਡਿਠੇ ਸਚੇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਮਲੁ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਦੀ ਕਟੀਐ ॥
967.t: tudh ddiThe sache paatisaeh mal janam janam dhee kaTeeaai ||
967.e: Gazing upon You, O True King, the filth of countless past lives is washed away.

967.g: ਸਚੁ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ਕਿਉ ਏਦੂ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਹਟੀਐ ॥
967.t: sach j gur furamaiaa kiau edhoo bolahu haTeeaai ||
967.e: The Guru gave the True Command; why should we hesitate to proclaim this?

967.g: ਪੁਤ੍ਰੀ ਕਉਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਲਿਓ ਕਰਿ ਪੀਰਹੁ ਕੰਨੑ ਮੁਰਟੀਐ ॥
967.t: putree kaul na paalio kar peerahu ka(n)n(h) muraTeeaai ||
967.e: His sons did not obey His Word; they turned their backs on Him as Guru.

967.g: ਦਿਲਿ ਖੋਟੈ ਆਕੀ ਫਿਰਨਿੑ ਬੰਨਿੑ ਭਾਰੁ ਉਚਾਇਨਿੑ ਛਟੀਐ ॥
967.t: dhil khoTai aakee firani(h) ba(n)ni(h) bhaar uchaini(h) chhaTeeaai ||
967.e: These evil-hearted ones became rebellious; they carry loads of sin on their backs.

967.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਆਖੀ ਸੋਈ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤੀ ਤਿਨੈ ਥਟੀਐ ॥
967.t: jin aakhee soiee kare jin keetee tinai thaTeeaai ||
967.e: Whatever the Guru said, Lehna did, and so he was installed on the throne.

967.g: ਕਉਣੁ ਹਾਰੇ ਕਿਨਿ ਉਵਟੀਐ ॥੨॥
967.t: kaun haare kin uvaTeeaai ||2||
967.e: Who has lost, and who has won? ||2||

967.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤੀ ਸੋ ਮੰਨਣਾ ਕੋ ਸਾਲੁ ਜਿਵਾਹੇ ਸਾਲੀ ॥
967.t: jin keetee so ma(n)nanaa ko saal jivaahe saalee ||
967.e: He who did the work, is accepted as Guru; so which is better - the thistle or the rice?

967.g: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਹੈ ਦੇਵਤਾ ਲੈ ਗਲਾ ਕਰੇ ਦਲਾਲੀ ॥
967.t: dharam rai hai dhevataa lai galaa kare dhalaalee ||
967.e: The Righteous Judge of Dharma considered the arguments and made the decision.

967.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਖੈ ਸਚਾ ਕਰੇ ਸਾ ਬਾਤ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਰਹਾਲੀ ॥
967.t: satigur aakhai sachaa kare saa baat hovai dharahaalee ||
967.e: Whatever the True Guru says, the True Lord does; it comes to pass instantaneously.

967.g: ਗੁਰ ਅੰਗਦ ਦੀ ਦੋਹੀ ਫਿਰੀ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਤੈ ਬੰਧਿ ਬਹਾਲੀ ॥
967.t: gur a(n)gadh dhee dhohee firee sach karatai ba(n)dh bahaalee ||
967.e: Guru Angad was proclaimed, and the True Creator confirmed it.

967.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਪਲਟੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਲਿ ਤਖਤੁ ਬੈਠਾ ਸੈ ਡਾਲੀ ॥
967.t: naanak kaiaa palaT kar mal takhat baiThaa sai ddaalee ||
967.e: Nanak merely changed his body; He still sits on the throne, with hundreds of branches reaching out.

967.g: ਦਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਉਮਤਿ ਖੜੀ ਮਸਕਲੈ ਹੋਇ ਜੰਗਾਲੀ ॥
967.t: dhar seve umat khaRee masakalai hoi ja(n)gaalee ||
967.e: Standing at His door, His followers serve Him; by this service, their rust is scraped off.

967.g: ਦਰਿ ਦਰਵੇਸੁ ਖਸੰਮ ਦੈ ਨਾਇ ਸਚੈ ਬਾਣੀ ਲਾਲੀ ॥
967.t: dhar dharaves khasa(n)m dhai nai sachai baanee laalee ||
967.e: He is the Dervish - the Saint, at the door of His Lord and Master; He loves the True Name, and the Bani of the Guru's Word.

967.g: ਬਲਵੰਡ ਖੀਵੀ ਨੇਕ ਜਨ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਛਾਉ ਪਤ੍ਰਾਲੀ ॥
967.t: balava(n)dd kheevee nek jan jis bahutee chhaau patraalee ||
967.e: Balwand says that Khivi, the Guru's wife, is a noble woman, who gives soothing, leafy shade to all.

967.g: ਲੰਗਰਿ ਦਉਲਤਿ ਵੰਡੀਐ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਖੀਰਿ ਘਿਆਲੀ ॥
967.t: la(n)gar dhaulat va(n)ddeeaai ras a(n)mrit kheer ghiaalee ||
967.e: She distributes the bounty of the Guru's Langar; the kheer - the rice pudding and ghee, is like sweet ambrosia.

967.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਥੀਏ ਪਰਾਲੀ ॥
967.t: gursikhaa ke mukh ujale manmukh the'ee paraalee ||
967.e: The faces of the Guru's Sikhs are radiant and bright; the self-willed manmukhs are pale, like straw.

967.g: ਪਏ ਕਬੂਲੁ ਖਸੰਮ ਨਾਲਿ ਜਾਂ ਘਾਲ ਮਰਦੀ ਘਾਲੀ ॥
967.t: pe kabool khasa(n)m naal jaa(n) ghaal maradhee ghaalee ||
967.e: The Master gave His approval, when Angad exerted Himself heroically.

967.g: ਮਾਤਾ ਖੀਵੀ ਸਹੁ ਸੋਇ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੋਇ ਉਠਾਲੀ ॥੩॥
967.t: maataa kheevee sahu soi jin goi uThaalee ||3||
967.e: Such is the Husband of mother Khivi; He sustains the world. ||3||

967.g: ਹੋਰਿਂਓ ਗੰਗ ਵਹਾਈਐ ਦੁਨਿਆਈ ਆਖੈ ਕਿ ਕਿਓਨੁ ॥
967.t: hori(n)o ga(n)g vahaieeaai dhuniaaiee aakhai k kion ||
967.e: It is as if the Guru made the Ganges flow in the opposite direction, and the world wonders: what has he done?

967.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਈਸਰਿ ਜਗਨਾਥਿ ਉਚਹਦੀ ਵੈਣੁ ਵਿਰਿਕਿਓਨੁ ॥
967.t: naanak ieesar jaganaath uchahadhee vain virikion ||
967.e: Nanak, the Lord, the Lord of the World, spoke the words out loud.

967.g: ਮਾਧਾਣਾ ਪਰਬਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਨੇਤ੍ਰਿ ਬਾਸਕੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਿੜਕਿਓਨੁ ॥
967.t: maadhaanaa parabat kar netr baasak sabadh riRakion ||
967.e: Making the mountain his churning stick, and the snake-king his churning string, He has churned the Word of the Shabad.

967.g: ਚਉਦਹ ਰਤਨ ਨਿਕਾਲਿਅਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਚਿਲਕਿਓਨੁ ॥
967.t: chaudheh ratan nikaalian kar aavaa gaun chilakion ||
967.e: From it, He extracted the fourteen jewels, and illuminated the world.

967.g: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਅਹਿ ਵੇਖਾਲੀਅਨੁ ਜਿਣਿ ਐਵਡ ਪਿਡ ਠਿਣਕਿਓਨੁ ॥
967.t: kudharat eh vekhaaleean jin aaivadd pidd Thinakion ||
967.e: He revealed such creative power, and touched such greatness.

967.g: ਲਹਣੇ ਧਰਿਓਨੁ ਛਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਅਸਮਾਨਿ ਕਿਆੜਾ ਛਿਕਿਓਨੁ ॥
967.t: lahane dharion chhatr sir asamaan kiaaRaa chhikion ||
967.e: He raised the royal canopy to wave over the head of Lehna, and raised His glory to the skies.

967.g: ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਾਹਿ ਆਪੁ ਆਪੈ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਿਕਿਓਨੁ ॥
967.t: jot samaanee jot maeh aap aapai setee mikion ||
967.e: His Light merged into the Light, and He blended Him into Himself.

967.g: ਸਿਖਾਂ ਪੁਤ੍ਰਾਂ ਘੋਖਿ ਕੈ ਸਭ ਉਮਤਿ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਜਿ ਕਿਓਨੁ ॥
967.t: sikhaa(n) putraa(n) ghokh kai sabh umat vekhahu j kion ||
967.e: Guru Nanak tested His Sikhs and His sons, and everyone saw what happened.

967.g: ਜਾਂ ਸੁਧੋਸੁ ਤਾਂ ਲਹਣਾ ਟਿਕਿਓਨੁ ॥੪॥
967.t: jaa(n) sudhos taa(n) lahanaa Tikion ||4||
967.e: When Lehna alone was found to be pure, then He was set on the throne. ||4||

967.g: ਫੇਰਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ਫੇਰੁਆਣਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਖਾਡੂਰੁ ॥
967.t: fer vasaiaa feruaan satigur khaaddoor ||
967.e: Then, the True Guru, the son of Pheru, came to dwell at Khadoor.

967.g: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਮੁਚੁ ਗਰੂਰੁ ॥
967.t: jap tap sa(n)jam naal tudh hor much garoor ||
967.e: Meditation, austerities and self-discipline rest with You, while the others are filled with excessive pride.

967.g: ਲਬੁ ਵਿਣਾਹੇ ਮਾਣਸਾ ਜਿਉ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੂਰੁ ॥
967.t: lab vinaahe maanasaa jiau paanee boor ||
967.e: Greed ruins mankind, like the green algae in the water.

967.g: ਵਰ੍ਹਿਐ ਦਰਗਹ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ ਕੁਦਰਤੀ ਨੂਰੁ ॥
967.t: varihaai dharageh guroo kee kudharatee noor ||
967.e: In the Guru's Court, the Divine Light shines in its creative power.

967.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਸੁ ਹਾਥ ਨ ਲਭਈ ਤੂੰ ਓਹੁ ਠਰੂਰੁ ॥
967.t: jitu su haath na labhiee too(n) oh Tharoor ||
967.e: You are the cooling peace, whose depth cannot be found.

967.g: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਭਰਪੂਰੁ ॥
967.t: nau nidh naam nidhaan hai tudh vich bharapoor ||
967.e: You are overflowing with the nine treasures, and the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

967.g: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਵੰਞੈ ਚੂਰੁ ॥
967.t: ni(n)dhaa teree jo kare so va(n)n(j)ai choor ||
967.e: Whoever slanders You will be totally ruined and destroyed.

967.g: ਨੇੜੈ ਦਿਸੈ ਮਾਤ ਲੋਕ ਤੁਧੁ ਸੁਝੈ ਦੂਰੁ ॥
967.t: neRai dhisai maat lok tudh sujhai dhoor ||
967.e: People of the world can see only what is near at hand, but You can see far beyond.

967.g: ਫੇਰਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ਫੇਰੁਆਣਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਖਾਡੂਰੁ ॥੫॥
967.t: fer vasaiaa feruaan satigur khaaddoor ||5||
967.e: Then the True Guru, the son of Pheru, came to dwell at Khadoor. ||5||

968.g: ਸੋ ਟਿਕਾ ਸੋ ਬੈਹਣਾ ਸੋਈ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
968.t: so Tikaa so baihanaa soiee dheebaan ||
968.e: The same mark on the forehead, the same throne, and the same Royal Court.

968.g: ਪਿਯੂ ਦਾਦੇ ਜੇਵਿਹਾ ਪੋਤਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
968.t: piyoo dhaadhe jevihaa potaa paravaan ||
968.e: Just like the father and grandfather, the son is approved.

968.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਬਾਸਕੁ ਨੇਤ੍ਰੈ ਘਤਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਨੇਹੀ ਤਾਣੁ ॥ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਵਿਰੋਲਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਮੇਰੁ ਮਧਾਣੁ ॥
968.t: jin baasak netrai ghatiaa kar nehee taan || jin samu(n)dh viroliaa kar mer madhaan ||
968.e: He took the thousand-headed serpent as his churning string, and with the force of devotional love, he churned the ocean of the world with his churning stick, the Sumayr mountain.

968.g: ਚਉਦਹ ਰਤਨ ਨਿਕਾਲਿਅਨੁ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਚਾਨਾਣੁ ॥
968.t: chaudheh ratan nikaalian keeton chaanaan ||
968.e: He extracted the fourteen jewels, and brought forth the Divine Light.

968.g: ਘੋੜਾ ਕੀਤੋ ਸਹਜ ਦਾ ਜਤੁ ਕੀਓ ਪਲਾਣੁ ॥
968.t: ghoRaa keeto sahaj dhaa jat keeo palaan ||
968.e: He made intuition his horse, and chastity his saddle.

968.g: ਧਣਖੁ ਚੜਾਇਓ ਸਤ ਦਾ ਜਸ ਹੰਦਾ ਬਾਣੁ ॥
968.t: dhanakh chaRaio sat dhaa jas ha(n)dhaa baan ||
968.e: He placed the arrow of the Lord's Praise in the bow of Truth.

968.g: ਕਲਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਧੂ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ਸਾ ਚੜਿਆ ਰੈ ਭਾਣੁ ॥
968.t: kal vich dhoo a(n)dhaar saa chaRiaa rai bhaan ||
968.e: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, there was only pitch darkness. Then, He rose like the sun to illuminate the darkness.

968.g: ਸਤਹੁ ਖੇਤੁ ਜਮਾਇਓ ਸਤਹੁ ਛਾਵਾਣੁ ॥
968.t: satahu khet jamaio satahu chhaavaan ||
968.e: He farms the field of Truth, and spreads out the canopy of Truth.

968.g: ਨਿਤ ਰਸੋਈ ਤੇਰੀਐ ਘਿਉ ਮੈਦਾ ਖਾਣੁ ॥
968.t: nit rasoiee tereeaai ghiau maidhaa khaan ||
968.e: Your kitchen always has ghee and flour to eat.

968.g: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾਂ ਸੁਝੀਓਸੁ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
968.t: chaare ku(n)ddaa(n) sujheeos man meh sabadh paravaan ||
968.e: You understand the four corners of the universe; in your mind, the Word of the Shabad is approved and supreme.

968.g: ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿਓ ਕਰਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
968.t: aavaa gaun nivaario kar nadhar neesaan ||
968.e: You eliminate the comings and goings of reincarnation, and bestow the insignia of Your Glance of Grace.

968.g: ਅਉਤਰਿਆ ਅਉਤਾਰੁ ਲੈ ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥
968.t: aautariaa aautaar lai so purakh sujaan ||
968.e: You are the Avataar, the Incarnation of the all-knowing Primal Lord.

968.g: ਝਖੜਿ ਵਾਉ ਨ ਡੋਲਈ ਪਰਬਤੁ ਮੇਰਾਣੁ ॥
968.t: jhakhaR vaau na ddoliee parabat meraan ||
968.e: You are not pushed or shaken by the storm and the wind; you are like the Sumayr Mountain.

968.g: ਜਾਣੈ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਜਾਣੀ ਹੂ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
968.t: jaanai birathaa jeea kee jaanee hoo jaan ||
968.e: You know the inner state of the soul; You are the Knower of knowers.

968.g: ਕਿਆ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਚੇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਜਾਂ ਤੂ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥
968.t: kiaa saalaahee sache paatisaeh jaa(n) too sughaR sujaan ||
968.e: How can I praise You, O True Supreme King, when You are so wise and all-knowing?

968.g: ਦਾਨੁ ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਵਸੀ ਸੋ ਸਤੇ ਦਾਣੁ ॥
968.t: dhaan j satigur bhaavasee so sate dhaan ||
968.e: Those blessings granted by the Pleasure of the True Guru - please bless Satta with those gifts.

968.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੰਦਾ ਛਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਉਮਤਿ ਹੈਰਾਣੁ ॥
968.t: naanak ha(n)dhaa chhatr sir umat hairaan ||
968.e: Seeing Nanak's canopy waving over Your head, everyone was astonished.

968.g: ਸੋ ਟਿਕਾ ਸੋ ਬੈਹਣਾ ਸੋਈ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
968.t: so Tikaa so baihanaa soiee dheebaan ||
968.e: The same mark on the forehead, the same throne, and the same Royal Court.

968.g: ਪਿਯੂ ਦਾਦੇ ਜੇਵਿਹਾ ਪੋਤ੍ਰਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੬॥
968.t: piyoo dhaadhe jevihaa potraa paravaan ||6||
968.e: Just like the father and grandfather, the son is approved. ||6||

968.g: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਰਿਆ ਤਿਨੈ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
968.t: dha(n)n dha(n)n raamadhaas gur jin siriaa tinai savaariaa ||
968.e: Blessed, blessed is Guru Raam Daas; He who created You, has also exalted You.

968.g: ਪੂਰੀ ਹੋਈ ਕਰਾਮਾਤਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੈ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
968.t: pooree hoiee karaamaat aap sirajanahaarai dhaariaa ||
968.e: Perfect is Your miracle; the Creator Lord Himself has installed You on the throne.

968.g: ਸਿਖੀ ਅਤੈ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਿਆ ॥
968.t: sikhee atai sa(n)gatee paarabraham kar namasakaariaa ||
968.e: The Sikhs and all the Congregation recognize You as the Supreme Lord God, and bow down to You.

968.g: ਅਟਲੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਅਤੋਲੁ ਤੂ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
968.t: aTal athaahu atol too teraa a(n)t na paaraavaariaa ||
968.e: You are unchanging, unfathomable and immeasurable; You have no end or limitation.

968.g: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਤੂੰ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਸੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਿਆ ॥
968.t: jin(h)ee too(n) seviaa bhaau kar se tudh paar utaariaa ||
968.e: Those who serve You with love - You carry them across.

968.g: ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਢੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਪਰਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
968.t: lab lobh kaam karodh moh maar kadde tudh saparavaariaa ||
968.e: Greed, envy, sexual desire, anger and emotional attachment - You have beaten them and driven them out.

968.g: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਪੈਸਕਾਰਿਆ ॥
968.t: dha(n)nu su teraa thaan hai sach teraa paisakaariaa ||
968.e: Blessed is Your place, and True is Your magnificent glory.

968.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੂ ਲਹਣਾ ਤੂਹੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰੁ ਤੂ ਵੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
968.t: naanak too lahanaa toohai gur amar too veechaariaa ||
968.e: You are Nanak, You are Angad, and You are Amar Daas; so do I recognize You.

968.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਡਿਠਾ ਤਾਂ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਧਾਰਿਆ ॥੭॥
968.t: gur ddiThaa taa(n) man saadhaariaa ||7||
968.e: When I saw the Guru, then my mind was comforted and consoled. ||7||

968.g: ਚਾਰੇ ਜਾਗੇ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗੀ ਪੰਚਾਇਣੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੋਆ ॥
968.t: chaare jaage chahu jugee pa(n)chain aape hoaa ||
968.e: The four Gurus enlightened the four ages; the Lord Himself assumed the fifth form.

968.g: ਆਪੀਨੑੈ ਆਪੁ ਸਾਜਿਓਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਥੰਮਿੑ ਖਲੋਆ ॥
968.t: aapeen(h)ai aap saajion aape hee tha(n)mi(h) khaloaa ||
968.e: He created Himself, and He Himself is the supporting pillar.

968.g: ਆਪੇ ਪਟੀ ਕਲਮ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਲਿਖਣਹਾਰਾ ਹੋਆ ॥
968.t: aape paTee kalam aap aap likhanahaaraa hoaa ||
968.e: He Himself is the paper, He Himself is the pen, and He Himself is the writer.

968.g: ਸਭ ਉਮਤਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਵਣੀ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਨਵਾ ਨਿਰੋਆ ॥
968.t: sabh umat aavan jaavanee aape hee navaa niroaa ||
968.e: All His followers come and go; He alone is fresh and new.

968.g: ਤਖਤਿ ਬੈਠਾ ਅਰਜਨ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਖਿਵੈ ਚੰਦੋਆ ॥
968.t: takhat baiThaa arajan guroo satigur kaa khivai cha(n)dhoaa ||
968.e: Guru Arjun sits on the throne; the royal canopy waves over the True Guru.

968.g: ਉਗਵਣਹੁ ਤੈ ਆਥਵਣਹੁ ਚਹੁ ਚਕੀ ਕੀਅਨੁ ਲੋਆ ॥
968.t: augavanahu tai aathavanahu chahu chakee keean loaa ||
968.e: From east to west, He illuminates the four directions.

968.g: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਪਇਆ ਮੋਆ ॥
968.t: jin(h)ee guroo na sevio manmukhaa piaa moaa ||
968.e: Those self-willed manmukhs who do not serve the Guru die in shame.

968.g: ਦੂਣੀ ਚਉਣੀ ਕਰਾਮਾਤਿ ਸਚੇ ਕਾ ਸਚਾ ਢੋਆ ॥
968.t: dhoonee chaunee karaamaat sache kaa sachaa ddoaa ||
968.e: Your miracles increase two-fold, even four-fold; this is the True Lord's true blessing.

968.g: ਚਾਰੇ ਜਾਗੇ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗੀ ਪੰਚਾਇਣੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੋਆ ॥੮॥੧॥
968.t: chaare jaage chahu jugee pa(n)chain aape hoaa ||8||1||
968.e: The four Gurus enlightened the four ages; the Lord Himself assumed the fifth form. ||8||1||

968.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ॥
968.t: raamakalee baanee bhagataa kee ||
968.e: Raamkalee, The Word Of The Devotees.

968.g: ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ
968.t: kabeer jeeau
968.e: Kabeer Jee:

968.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
968.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
968.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

968.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਲਾਲਨਿ ਲਾਹਨਿ ਮੇਲਉ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁੜੁ ਕੀਨੁ ਰੇ ॥
968.t: kaiaa kalaalan laahan melau gur kaa sabadh guR keen re ||
968.e: Make your body the vat, and mix in the yeast. Let the Word of the Guru's Shabad be the molasses.

969.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਮਦ ਮਤਸਰ ਕਾਟਿ ਕਾਟਿ ਕਸੁ ਦੀਨੁ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
969.t: tirasanaa kaam karodh madh matasar kaaT kaaT kas dheen re ||1||
969.e: Cut up desire, sexuality, anger, pride and envy, and let them be the fermenting bark. ||1||

969.g: ਕੋਈ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਸੰਤੁ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਦੇਉ ਦਲਾਲੀ ਰੇ ॥
969.t: koiee hai re sa(n)t sahaj sukh a(n)tar jaa kau jap tap dheau dhalaalee re ||
969.e: Is there any Saint, with intuitive peace and poise deep within, unto whom I might offer my meditation and austerities as payment?

969.g: ਏਕ ਬੂੰਦ ਭਰਿ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਵਉ ਜੋ ਮਦੁ ਦੇਇ ਕਲਾਲੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
969.t: ek boo(n)dh bhar tan man dhevau jo madh dhei kalaalee re ||1|| rahaau ||
969.e: I dedicate my body and mind to whoever gives me even a drop of this wine from such a vat. ||1||Pause||

969.g: ਭਵਨ ਚਤੁਰ ਦਸ ਭਾਠੀ ਕੀਨੑੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਗਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਜਾਰੀ ਰੇ ॥
969.t: bhavan chatur dhas bhaaThee keen(h)ee braham agan tan jaaree re ||
969.e: I have made the fourteen worlds the furnace, and I have burnt my body with the fire of God.

969.g: ਮੁਦ੍ਰਾ ਮਦਕ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਸੁਖਮਨ ਪੋਚਨਹਾਰੀ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
969.t: mudhraa madhak sahaj dhun laagee sukhaman pochanahaaree re ||2||
969.e: My mudra - my hand-gesture, is the pipe; tuning into the celestial sound current within, the Shushmanaa - the central spinal channel, is my cooling pad. ||2||

969.g: ਤੀਰਥ ਬਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਸੁਚਿ ਸੰਜਮ ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਗਹਨੈ ਦੇਉ ਰੇ ॥
969.t: teerath barat nem such sa(n)jam rav sas gahanai dheau re ||
969.e: Pilgrimages, fasting, vows, purifications, self-discipline, austerities and breath control through the sun and moon channels - all these I pledge.

969.g: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਪਿਆਲ ਸੁਧਾ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਏਹੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਪੇਉ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
969.t: surat piaal sudhaa ras a(n)mrit eh mahaa ras peau re ||3||
969.e: My focused consciousness is the cup, and the Ambrosial Nectar is the pure juice. I drink in the supreme, sublime essence of this juice. ||3||

969.g: ਨਿਝਰ ਧਾਰ ਚੁਐ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਇਹ ਰਸ ਮਨੂਆ ਰਾਤੋ ਰੇ ॥
969.t: nijhar dhaar chuaai at niramal ieh ras manooaa raato re ||
969.e: The pure stream constantly trickles forth, and my mind is intoxicated by this sublime essence.

969.g: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਸਗਲੇ ਮਦ ਛੂਛੇ ਇਹੈ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਸਾਚੋ ਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
969.t: keh kabeer sagale madh chhoochhe ihai mahaa ras saacho re ||4||1||
969.e: Says Kabeer, all other wines are trivial and tasteless; this is the only true, sublime essence. ||4||1||

969.g: ਗੁੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਹੂਆ ਭਉ ਭਾਠੀ ਮਨ ਧਾਰਾ ॥
969.t: guR kar giaan dhiaan kar mahooaa bhau bhaaThee man dhaaraa ||
969.e: Make spiritual wisdom the molasses, meditation the flowers, and the Fear of God the fire enshrined in your mind.

969.g: ਸੁਖਮਨ ਨਾਰੀ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਨੀ ਪੀਵੈ ਪੀਵਨਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
969.t: sukhaman naaree sahaj samaanee peevai peevanahaaraa ||1||
969.e: The Shushmanaa, the central spinal channel, is intuitively balanced, and the drinker drinks in this wine. ||1||

969.g: ਅਉਧੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਤਵਾਰਾ ॥
969.t: aaudhoo meraa man matavaaraa ||
969.e: O hermit Yogi, my mind is intoxicated.

969.g: ਉਨਮਦ ਚਢਾ ਮਦਨ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਨ ਭਇਆ ਉਜਿਆਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
969.t: aunamadh chaddaa madhan ras chaakhiaa tirabhavan bhiaa ujiaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
969.e: When that wine rises up, one tastes the sublime essence of this juice, and sees across the three worlds. ||1||Pause||

969.g: ਦੁਇ ਪੁਰ ਜੋਰਿ ਰਸਾਈ ਭਾਠੀ ਪੀਉ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
969.t: dhui pur jor rasaiee bhaaThee peeau mahaa ras bhaaree ||
969.e: Joining the two channels of the breath, I have lit the furnace, and I drink in the supreme, sublime essence.

969.g: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਦੁਇ ਕੀਏ ਜਲੇਤਾ ਛੂਟਿ ਗਈ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
969.t: kaam karodh dhui ke'ee jaletaa chhooT giee sa(n)saaree ||2||
969.e: I have burnt both sexual desire and anger, and I have been emancipated from the world. ||2||

969.g: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਗੰਮਿਤ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੁਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
969.t: pragaT pragaas giaan gur ga(n)mit satigur te sudh paiee ||
969.e: The light of spiritual wisdom enlightens me; meeting with the Guru, the True Guru, I have obtained this understanding.

969.g: ਦਾਸੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਤਾਸੁ ਮਦ ਮਾਤਾ ਉਚਕਿ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥੨॥
969.t: dhaas kabeer taas madh maataa uchak na kabahoo jaiee ||3||2||
969.e: Slave Kabeer is intoxicated with that wine, which never wears off. ||3||2||

969.g: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੋ ਮੇਰੁ ਪਰਬਤੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਮੈ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
969.t: too(n) mero mer parabat suaamee oT gahee mai teree ||
969.e: You are my Sumayr Mountain, O my Lord and Master; I have grasped Your Support.

969.g: ਨਾ ਤੁਮ ਡੋਲਹੁ ਨਾ ਹਮ ਗਿਰਤੇ ਰਖਿ ਲੀਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੀ ॥੧॥
969.t: naa tum ddolahu naa ham girate rakh leenee har meree ||1||
969.e: You do not shake, and I do not fall. You have preserved my honor. ||1||

969.g: ਅਬ ਤਬ ਜਬ ਕਬ ਤੁਹੀ ਤੁਹੀ ॥
969.t: ab tab jab kab tuhee tuhee ||
969.e: Now and then, here and there, You, only You.

969.g: ਹਮ ਤੁਅ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਸੁਖੀ ਸਦ ਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
969.t: ham tua parasaadh sukhee sadh hee ||1|| rahaau ||
969.e: By Your Grace, I am forever in peace. ||1||Pause||

969.g: ਤੋਰੇ ਭਰੋਸੇ ਮਗਹਰ ਬਸਿਓ ਮੇਰੇ ਤਨ ਕੀ ਤਪਤਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
969.t: tore bharose magahar basio mere tan kee tapat bujhaiee ||
969.e: Relying upon You, I can live even in the cursed place of Magahar; You have put out the fire of my body.

969.g: ਪਹਿਲੇ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਮਗਹਰ ਪਾਇਓ ਫੁਨਿ ਕਾਸੀ ਬਸੇ ਆਈ ॥੨॥
969.t: pahile dharasan magahar paio fun kaasee base aaiee ||2||
969.e: First, I obtained the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan in Magahar; then, I came to dwell at Benares. ||2||

969.g: ਜੈਸਾ ਮਗਹਰੁ ਤੈਸੀ ਕਾਸੀ ਹਮ ਏਕੈ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
969.t: jaisaa magahar taisee kaasee ham ekai kar jaanee ||
969.e: As is Magahar, so is Benares; I see them as one and the same.

969.g: ਹਮ ਨਿਰਧਨ ਜਿਉ ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਰਤੇ ਫੂਟਿ ਗੁਮਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
969.t: ham niradhan jiau ih dhan paiaa marate fooT gumaanee ||3||
969.e: I am poor, but I have obtained this wealth of the Lord; the proud are bursting with pride, and die. ||3||

969.g: ਕਰੈ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ਚੁਭਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੂਲਾ ਕੋ ਕਾਢਨ ਕਉ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
969.t: karai gumaan chubheh tis soolaa ko kaaddan kau naahee ||
969.e: One who takes pride in himself is stuck with thorns; no one can pull them out.

969.g: ਅਜੈ ਸੁ ਚੋਭ ਕਉ ਬਿਲਲ ਬਿਲਾਤੇ ਨਰਕੇ ਘੋਰ ਪਚਾਹੀ ॥੪॥
969.t: ajai su chobh kau bilal bilaate narake ghor pachaahee ||4||
