969.e: Here, he cries bitterly, and hereafter, he burns in the most hideous hell. ||4||

969.g: ਕਵਨੁ ਨਰਕੁ ਕਿਆ ਸੁਰਗੁ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ਸੰਤਨ ਦੋਊ ਰਾਦੇ ॥
969.t: kavan narak kiaa surag bichaaraa sa(n)tan dhouoo raadhe ||
969.e: What is hell, and what is heaven? The Saints reject them both.

969.g: ਹਮ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ਨ ਕਢਤੇ ਅਪਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੇ ॥੫॥
969.t: ham kaahoo kee kaan na kaddate apane gur parasaadhe ||5||
969.e: I have no obligation to either of them, by the Grace of my Guru. ||5||

969.g: ਅਬ ਤਉ ਜਾਇ ਚਢੇ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਨਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਹੈ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਪਾਨੀ ॥
969.t: ab tau jai chadde si(n)ghaasan mile hai saari(n)gapaanee ||
969.e: Now, I have mounted to the throne of the Lord; I have met the Lord, the Sustainer of the World.

969.g: ਰਾਮ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਏਕ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਪਛਾਨੀ ॥੬॥੩॥
969.t: raam kabeeraa ek bhe hai koi na sakai pachhaanee ||6||3||
969.e: The Lord and Kabeer have become one. No one can tell them apart. ||6||3||

969.g: ਸੰਤਾ ਮਾਨਉ ਦੂਤਾ ਡਾਨਉ ਇਹ ਕੁਟਵਾਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
969.t: sa(n)taa maanau dhootaa ddaanau ieh kuTavaaree meree ||
969.e: I honor and obey the Saints, and punish the wicked; this is my duty as God's police officer.

969.g: ਦਿਵਸ ਰੈਨਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਪਾਉ ਪਲੋਸਉ ਕੇਸ ਚਵਰ ਕਰਿ ਫੇਰੀ ॥੧॥
969.t: dhivas rain tere paau palosau kes chavar kar feree ||1||
969.e: Day and night, I wash Your feet, Lord; I wave my hair as the chauree, to brush away the flies. ||1||

969.g: ਹਮ ਕੂਕਰ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥
969.t: ham kookar tere dharabaar ||
969.e: I am a dog at Your Court, Lord.

969.g: ਭਉਕਹਿ ਆਗੈ ਬਦਨੁ ਪਸਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
969.t: bhaukeh aagai badhan pasaar ||1|| rahaau ||
969.e: I open my snout and bark before it. ||1||Pause||

970.g: ਪੂਰਬ ਜਨਮ ਹਮ ਤੁਮੑਰੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਅਬ ਤਉ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
970.t: poorab janam ham tum(h)re sevak ab tau miTiaa na jaiee ||
970.e: In my past life, I was Your servant; now, I cannot leave You.

970.g: ਤੇਰੇ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਧੁਨਿ ਸਹਜ ਕੀ ਮਾਥੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਦਗਾਈ ॥੨॥
970.t: tere dhuaarai dhun sahaj kee maathai mere dhagaiee ||2||
970.e: The celestial sound current resounds at Your Door. Your insignia is stamped upon my forehead. ||2||

970.g: ਦਾਗੇ ਹੋਹਿ ਸੁ ਰਨ ਮਹਿ ਜੂਝਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਦਾਗੇ ਭਗਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
970.t: dhaage hoh su ran meh joojheh bin dhaage bhag jaiee ||
970.e: Those who are branded with Your brand fight bravely in battle; those without Your brand run away.

970.g: ਸਾਧੂ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਛਾਨੈ ਹਰਿ ਲਏ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
970.t: saadhoo hoi su bhagat pachhaanai har le khajaanai paiee ||3||
970.e: One who becomes a Holy person, appreciates the value of devotional worship to the Lord. The Lord places him in His treasury. ||3||

970.g: ਕੋਠਰੇ ਮਹਿ ਕੋਠਰੀ ਪਰਮ ਕੋਠੀ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
970.t: koThare meh koTharee param koThee beechaar ||
970.e: In the fortress is the chamber; by contemplative meditation it becomes the supreme chamber.

970.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਬਸਤੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਕਉ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਬਸਤੁ ਸਮੑਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
970.t: gur dheenee basat kabeer kau levahu basat sam(h)aar ||4||
970.e: The Guru has blessed Kabeer with the commodity, saying, ""Take this commodity; cherish it and keep it secure.""||4||

970.g: ਕਬੀਰਿ ਦੀਈ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕਉ ਲੀਨੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
970.t: kabeer dheeiee sa(n)saar kau leenee jis masatak bhaag ||
970.e: Kabeer gives it to the world, but he alone receives it, upon whose forehead such destiny is recorded.

970.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਥਿਰੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ॥੫॥੪॥
970.t: a(n)mirat ras jin paiaa thir taa kaa sohaag ||5||4||
970.e: Permanent is the marriage, of one who receives this ambrosial essence. ||5||4||

970.g: ਜਿਹ ਮੁਖ ਬੇਦੁ ਗਾਇਤ੍ਰੀ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਨੁ ਬਿਸਰੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
970.t: jeh mukh bedh gaitree nikasai so kiau brahaman bisar karai ||
970.e: O Brahmin, how can you forget the One, from whose mouth the Vedas and the Gayitri prayer issured forth?

970.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਪਾਇ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਨ ਕਹੈ ॥੧॥
970.t: jaa kai pai jagat sabh laagai so kiau pa(n)ddit har na kahai ||1||
970.e: The whole world falls at His feet; why don't you chant the Name of that Lord, O Pandit? ||1||

970.g: ਕਾਹੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਮੑਨ ਹਰਿ ਨ ਕਹਹਿ ॥
970.t: kaahe mere baam(h)n har na kaheh ||
970.e: Why, O my Brahmin, do you not chant the Lord's Name?

970.g: ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਪਾਡੇ ਦੋਜਕੁ ਭਰਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
970.t: raam na boleh paadde dhojak bhareh ||1|| rahaau ||
970.e: If you don't chant the Lord's Name, O Pandit, you will only suffer in hell. ||1||Pause||

970.g: ਆਪਨ ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਘਰਿ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਹਠੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਉਦਰੁ ਭਰਹਿ ॥
970.t: aapan uooch neech ghar bhojan haThe karam kar udhar bhareh ||
970.e: You think that you are high, but you take food from the houses of the lowly; you fill up your belly by forcibly practicing your rituals.

970.g: ਚਉਦਸ ਅਮਾਵਸ ਰਚਿ ਰਚਿ ਮਾਂਗਹਿ ਕਰ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਲੈ ਕੂਪਿ ਪਰਹਿ ॥੨॥
970.t: chaudhas amaavas rach rach maa(n)geh kar dheepak lai koop pareh ||2||
970.e: On the fourteenth day, and the night of the new moon, you go out begging; even though you hold the lamp in your hands, still, you fall into the pit. ||2||

970.g: ਤੂੰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਨੁ ਮੈ ਕਾਸੀਕ ਜੁਲਹਾ ਮੁਹਿ ਤੋਹਿ ਬਰਾਬਰੀ ਕੈਸੇ ਕੈ ਬਨਹਿ ॥
970.t: too(n) brahaman mai kaaseek julahaa muh toh baraabaree kaise kai baneh ||
970.e: You are a Brahmin, and I am only a weaver from Benares. How can I compare to you?

970.g: ਹਮਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕਹਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਬੇਦ ਭਰੋਸੇ ਪਾਂਡੇ ਡੂਬਿ ਮਰਹਿ ॥੩॥੫॥
970.t: hamare raam naam keh ubare bedh bharose paa(n)dde ddoob mareh ||3||5||
970.e: Chanting the Lord's Name, I have been saved; relying on the Vedas, O Brahmin, you shall drown and die. ||3||5||

970.g: ਤਰਵਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਅਨੰਤ ਡਾਰ ਸਾਖਾ ਪੁਹਪ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਰਸ ਭਰੀਆ ॥
970.t: taravar ek ana(n)t ddaar saakhaa puhap patr ras bhareeaa ||
970.e: There is a single tree, with countless branches and twigs; its flowers and leaves are filled with its juice.

970.g: ਇਹ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕੀ ਬਾੜੀ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਤਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰੀਆ ॥੧॥
970.t: eeh a(n)mirat kee baaRee hai re tin har poorai kareeaa ||1||
970.e: This world is a garden of Ambrosial Nectar. The Perfect Lord created it. ||1||

970.g: ਜਾਨੀ ਜਾਨੀ ਰੇ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਕਹਾਨੀ ॥
970.t: jaanee jaanee re raajaa raam kee kahaanee ||
970.e: I have come to know the story of my Sovereign Lord.

970.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਿਰਲੈ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
970.t: a(n)tar jot raam paragaasaa gurmukh biralai jaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
970.e: How rare is that Gurmukh who knows, and whose inner being is illumined by the Lord's Light. ||1||Pause||

970.g: ਭਵਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਪੁਹਪ ਰਸ ਬੀਧਾ ਬਾਰਹ ਲੇ ਉਰ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
970.t: bhavar ek puhap ras beedhaa baareh le ur dhariaa ||
970.e: The bumble bee, addicted to the nectar of the twelve-petalled flowers, enshrines it in the heart.

970.g: ਸੋਰਹ ਮਧੇ ਪਵਨੁ ਝਕੋਰਿਆ ਆਕਾਸੇ ਫਰੁ ਫਰਿਆ ॥੨॥
970.t: soreh madhe pavan jhakoriaa aakaase far fariaa ||2||
970.e: He holds his breath suspended in the sixteen-petalled sky of the Akaashic Ethers, and beats his wings in esctasy. ||2||

970.g: ਸਹਜ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਇਕੁ ਬਿਰਵਾ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਧਰਤੀ ਜਲਹਰੁ ਸੋਖਿਆ ॥
970.t: sahaj su(n)n ik biravaa upajiaa dharatee jalahar sokhiaa ||
970.e: In the profound void of intuitive Samaadhi, the one tree rises up; it soaks up the water of desire from the ground.

970.g: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਹਉ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਬਿਰਵਾ ਦੇਖਿਆ ॥੩॥੬॥
970.t: keh kabeer hau taa kaa sevak jin ih biravaa dhekhiaa ||3||6||
970.e: Says Kabeer, I am the servant of those who have seen this celestial tree. ||3||6||

970.g: ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਮੋਨਿ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਝੋਲੀ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਕਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਰੇ ॥
970.t: mu(n)dhraa mon dhiaa kar jholee patr kaa karahu beechaar re ||
970.e: Make silence your ear-rings, and compassion your wallet; let meditation be your begging bowl.

970.g: ਖਿੰਥਾ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਅਉ ਅਪਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਉ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
970.t: khi(n)thaa ih tan seeaau apanaa naam karau aadhaar re ||1||
970.e: Sew this body as your patched coat, and take the Lord's Name as your support. ||1||

970.g: ਐਸਾ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਮਾਵਹੁ ਜੋਗੀ ॥
970.t: aaisaa jog kamaavahu jogee ||
970.e: Practice such Yoga, O Yogi.

970.g: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭੋਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
970.t: jap tap sa(n)jam gurmukh bhogee ||1|| rahaau ||
970.e: As Gurmukh, enjoy meditation, austerities and self-discipline. ||1||Pause||

970.g: ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਭੂਤਿ ਚਢਾਵਉ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਸਿੰਗੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
970.t: budh bibhoot chaddaavau apunee si(n)gee surat milaiee ||
970.e: Apply the ashes of wisdom to your body; let your horn be your focused consciousness.

970.g: ਕਰਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਫਿਰਉ ਤਨਿ ਨਗਰੀ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਬਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
970.t: kar bairaag firau tan nagaree man kee ki(n)guree bajaiee ||2||
970.e: Become detached, and wander through the city of your body; play the harp of your mind. ||2||

970.g: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਲੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਲਮ ਤਾੜੀ ॥
970.t: pa(n)ch tat lai hiradhai raakhahu rahai niraalam taaRee ||
970.e: Enshrine the five tatvas - the five elements, within your heart; let your deep meditative trance be undisturbed.

970.g: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਬਾੜੀ ॥੩॥੭॥
970.t: kahat kabeer sunahu re sa(n)tahu dharam dhiaa kar baaRee ||3||7||
970.e: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints: make righteousness and compassion your garden. ||3||7||

970.g: ਕਵਨ ਕਾਜ ਸਿਰਜੇ ਜਗ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਕਵਨ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
970.t: kavan kaaj siraje jag bheetar janam kavan fal paiaa ||
970.e: For what purpose were you created and brought into the world? What rewards have you received in this life?

970.g: ਭਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਤਰਨ ਤਾਰਨ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਨਿ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
970.t: bhav nidh taran taaran chi(n)taaman ik nimakh na ih man laiaa ||1||
970.e: God is the boat to carry you across the terrifying world-ocean; He is the Fulfiller of the mind's desires. You have not centered your mind on Him, even for an instant. ||1||

971.e: O Lord of the Universe, I am such a sinner!

971.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਥਾ ਦੀਆ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਸਾਧੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
971.t: jin prabh jeeau pi(n)dd thaa dheeaa tis kee bhaau bhagat nahee saadhee ||1|| rahaau ||
971.e: God gave me body and soul, but I have not practiced loving devotional worship to Him. ||1||Pause||

971.g: ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰ ਤਨ ਪਰ ਤੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਪਰ ਅਪਬਾਦੁ ਨ ਛੂਟੈ ॥
971.t: par dhan par tan par tee ni(n)dhaa par apabaadh na chhooTai ||
971.e: Others' wealth, others' bodies, others' wives, others' slander and others' fights - I have not given them up.

971.g: ਆਵਾ ਗਵਨੁ ਹੋਤੁ ਹੈ ਫੁਨਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਪਰਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਤੂਟੈ ॥੨॥
971.t: aavaa gavan hot hai fun fun ih parasa(n)g na tooTai ||2||
971.e: For the sake of these, coming and going in reincarnation happens over and over again, and this story never ends. ||2||

971.g: ਜਿਹ ਘਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਹੋਤ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਕੀਨੑੋ ਮੈ ਫੇਰਾ ॥
971.t: jeh ghar kathaa hot har sa(n)tan ik nimakh na keen(h)o mai feraa ||
971.e: That house, in which the Saints speak of the Lord - I have not visited it, even for an instant.

971.g: ਲੰਪਟ ਚੋਰ ਦੂਤ ਮਤਵਾਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਦਾ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
971.t: la(n)paT chor dhoot matavaare tin sa(n)g sadhaa baseraa ||3||
971.e: Drunkards, thieves, and evil-doers - I constantly dwell with them. ||3||

971.g: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦ ਮਤਸਰ ਏ ਸੰਪੈ ਮੋ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
971.t: kaam karodh maiaa madh matasar e sa(n)pai mo maahee ||
971.e: Sexual desire, anger, the wine of Maya, and envy - these are what I collect within myself.

971.g: ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ ਅਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਏ ਸੁਪਨੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੪॥
971.t: dhiaa dharam ar gur kee sevaa e supana(n)tar naahee ||4||
971.e: Compassion, righteousness, and service to the Guru - these do not visit me, even in my dreams. ||4||

971.g: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਮੋਦਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਛਲ ਭੈ ਹਾਰੀ ॥
971.t: dheen dhiaal kirapaal dhamodhar bhagat bachhal bhai haaree ||
971.e: He is merciful to the meek, compassionate and benevolent, the Lover of His devotees, the Destroyer of fear.

971.g: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਭੀਰ ਜਨ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਉ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥੫॥੮॥
971.t: kahat kabeer bheer jan raakhahu har sevaa karau tum(h)aaree ||5||8||
971.e: Says Kabeer, please protect Your humble servant from disaster; O Lord, I serve only You. ||5||8||
Remembering Him in meditation, the door of liberation is found.
You shall go to heaven, and not return to this earth.
In the home of the Fearless Lord, the celestial trumpets resound.
The unstruck sound current will vibrate and resonate forever. ||1||
Practice such meditative remembrance in your mind.

971.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਤ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
971.t: bin simaran mukat kat naeh ||1|| rahaau ||
971.e: Without this meditative remembrance, liberation will never be found. ||1||Pause||
Remembering Him in meditation, you will meet with no obstruction.
You will be liberated, and the great load will be taken away.
Bow in humility within your heart,
and you will not have to be reincarnated over and over again. ||2||
Remember Him in meditation, celebrate and be happy.
God has placed His lamp deep within you, which burns without any oil.
That lamp makes the world immortal;
it conquers and drives out the poisons of sexual desire and anger. ||3||
Remembering Him in meditation, you shall obtain salvation.
Wear that meditative remembrance as your necklace.

971.g: ਸੋ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਰਾਖੁ ਉਤਾਰਿ ॥
971.t: so simaran kar nahee raakh utaar ||
971.e: Practice that meditative remembrance, and never let it go.
By Guru's Grace, you shall cross over. ||4||
Remembering Him in meditation, you shall not be obligated to others.
You shall sleep in your mansion, in blankets of silk.
Your soul shall blossom forth in happiness, on this comfortable bed.
So drink in this meditative remembrance, night and day. ||5||
Remembering Him in meditation, your troubles will depart.

971.g: ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਤੁਝੁ ਪੋਹੈ ਨ ਮਾਇ ॥
971.t: jeh simaran tujh pohai na mai ||
971.e: Remembering Him in meditation, Maya will not bother you.

971.g: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
971.t: simar simar har har man gaieeaai ||
971.e: Meditate, meditate in remembrance on the Lord, Har, Har, and sing His Praises in your mind.
This meditative remembrance is obtained from the True Guru. ||6||
Forever and ever, remember Him, day and night,
while standing up and sitting down, with every breath and morsel of food.
While awake and asleep, enjoy the essence of this meditative remembrance.
The Lord's meditative remembrance is obtained by good destiny. ||7||
Remembering Him in meditation, you shall not be loaded down.
Make this meditative remembrance of the Lord's Name your Support.

971.g: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਹੀ ਅੰਤੁ ॥
971.t: keh kabeer jaa kaa nahee a(n)t ||
971.e: Says Kabeer, He has no limits;

971.g: ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਆਗੇ ਤੰਤੁ ਨ ਮੰਤੁ ॥੮॥੯॥
971.t: tis ke aage ta(n)t na ma(n)t ||8||9||
971.e: no tantras or mantras can be used against Him. ||8||9||

971.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਬਾਣੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਕੀ
971.t: raamakalee ghar doojaa baanee kabeer jee kee
971.e: Raamkalee, Second House, The Word Of Kabeer Jee:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Maya, the Trapper, has sprung her trap.
The Guru, the Liberated One, has put out the fire.

972.g: ਜਬ ਨਖ ਸਿਖ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਚੀਨੑਾ ॥
972.t: jab nakh sikh ih man cheen(h)aa ||
972.e: When I came to understand this mind, from the tips of my toes to the crown of my head,
then I took my cleansing bath, deep within my self. ||1||
The mind, the master of the breath, abides in the state of supreme bliss.

972.g: ਨਹੀ ਮਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
972.t: nahee mrit na janam jaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
972.e: There is no death, no re-birth, and no aging for me now. ||1||Pause||
Turning away from materialism, I have found intuitive support.
I have entered into the sky of the mind, and opened the Tenth Gate.
The chakras of the coiled Kundalini energy have been opened,
and I have met my Sovereign Lord King without fear. ||2||
My attachment to Maya has been eradicated;
the moon energy has devoured the sun energy.
When I was focused and merged into the all-pervading Lord,
then the unstruck sound current began to vibrate. ||3||
The Speaker has spoken, and proclaimed the Word of the Shabad.
The hearer has heard, and enshrined it in the mind.
Chanting to the Creator, one crosses over.
Says Kabeer, this is the essence. ||4||1||10||
The moon and the sun are both the embodiment of light.
Within their light, is God, the incomparable. ||1||
O spiritual teacher, contemplate God.
In this light is contained the expanse of the created universe. ||1||Pause||
Gazing upon the diamond, I humbly salute this diamond.
Says Kabeer, the Immaculate Lord is indescribable. ||2||2||11||

972.g: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਹੁਸੀਆਰ ਬੇਦਾਰ ਜਾਗਤ ਮੁਸੀਅਤ ਹਉ ਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
972.t: dhuneeaa huseeaar bedhaar jaagat museeat hau re bhaiee ||
972.e: People of the world, remain awake and aware. Even though you are awake, you are being robbed, O Brother.

972.g: ਨਿਗਮ ਹੁਸੀਆਰ ਪਹਰੂਆ ਦੇਖਤ ਜਮੁ ਲੇ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
972.t: nigam huseeaar paharooaa dhekhat jam le jaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
972.e: While the Vedas stand guard watching, the Messenger of Death carries you away. ||1||Pause||

972.g: ਨੰੀਬੁ ਭਇਓ ਆਂਬੁ ਆਂਬੁ ਭਇਓ ਨੰੀਬਾ ਕੇਲਾ ਪਾਕਾ ਝਾਰਿ ॥
972.t: na(n)eeb bhio aa(n)b aa(n)b bhio na(n)eebaa kelaa paakaa jhaar ||
972.e: He thinks that the bitter nimm fruit is a mango, and the mango is a bitter nimm. He imagines the ripe banana on the thorny bush.

972.g: ਨਾਲੀਏਰ ਫਲੁ ਸੇਬਰਿ ਪਾਕਾ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
972.t: naale'eer fal sebar paakaa moorakh mugadh gavaar ||1||
972.e: He thinks that the ripe coconut hangs on the barren simmal tree; what a stupid, idiotic fool he is! ||1||

972.g: ਹਰਿ ਭਇਓ ਖਾਂਡੁ ਰੇਤੁ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਖਰਿਓ ਹਸਤੰੀ ਚੁਨਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
972.t: har bhio khaa(n)dd ret meh bikhario hasata(n)ee chunio na jaiee ||
972.e: The Lord is like sugar, spilled onto the sand; the elephant cannot pick it up.

972.g: ਕਹਿ ਕਮੀਰ ਕੁਲ ਜਾਤਿ ਪਾਂਤਿ ਤਜਿ ਚੀਟੀ ਹੋਇ ਚੁਨਿ ਖਾਈ ॥੨॥੩॥੧੨॥
972.t: keh kameer kul jaat paa(n)t taj cheeTee hoi chun khaiee ||2||3||12||
972.e: Says Kabeer, give up your ancestry, social status and honor; be like the tiny ant - pick up and eat the sugar. ||2||3||12||

972.g: ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਘਰੁ ੧
972.t: baanee naamadheau jeeau kee raamakalee ghar pehilaa
972.e: The Word Of Naam Dayv Jee, Raamkalee, First House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

972.g: ਆਨੀਲੇ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਕਾਟੀਲੇ ਗੂਡੀ ਆਕਾਸ ਮਧੇ ਭਰਮੀਅਲੇ ॥
972.t: aaneele kaagadh kaaTeele gooddee aakaas madhe bharameeale ||
972.e: The boy takes paper, cuts it and makes a kite, and flies it in the sky.

972.g: ਪੰਚ ਜਨਾ ਸਿਉ ਬਾਤ ਬਤਊਆ ਚੀਤੁ ਸੁ ਡੋਰੀ ਰਾਖੀਅਲੇ ॥੧॥
972.t: pa(n)ch janaa siau baat batuooaa cheetu su ddoree raakheeale ||1||
972.e: Talking with his friends, he still keeps his attention on the kite string. ||1||
My mind has been pierced by the Name of the Lord,

972.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਕਨਿਕ ਕਲਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਮਾਂਡੀਅਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
972.t: jaise kanik kalaa chit maa(n)ddeeale ||1|| rahaau ||
972.e: like the goldsmith, whose attention is held by his work. ||1||Pause||

972.g: ਆਨੀਲੇ ਕੁੰਭੁ ਭਰਾਈਲੇ ਊਦਕ ਰਾਜ ਕੁਆਰਿ ਪੁਰੰਦਰੀਏ ॥
972.t: aaneele ku(n)bh bharaieele uoodhak raaj kuaar pura(n)dhare'e ||
972.e: The young girl in the city takes a pitcher, and fills it with water.

972.g: ਹਸਤ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਬੀਚਾਰ ਕਰਤੀ ਹੈ ਚੀਤੁ ਸੁ ਗਾਗਰਿ ਰਾਖੀਅਲੇ ॥੨॥
972.t: hasat binodh beechaar karatee hai cheetu su gaagar raakheeale ||2||
972.e: She laughs, and plays, and talks with her friends, but she keeps her attention focused on the pitcher of water. ||2||

972.g: ਮੰਦਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਦੁਆਰ ਦਸ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਗਊ ਚਰਾਵਨ ਛਾਡੀਅਲੇ ॥
972.t: ma(n)dhar ek dhuaar dhas jaa ke guoo charaavan chhaaddeeale ||
972.e: The cow is let loose, out of the mansion of the ten gates, to graze in the field.

972.g: ਪਾਂਚ ਕੋਸ ਪਰ ਗਊ ਚਰਾਵਤ ਚੀਤੁ ਸੁ ਬਛਰਾ ਰਾਖੀਅਲੇ ॥੩॥
972.t: paa(n)ch kos par guoo charaavat cheetu su bachharaa raakheeale ||3||
972.e: It grazes up to five miles away, but keeps its attention focused on its calf. ||3||

972.g: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਤਿਲੋਚਨ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਪਾਲਨ ਪਉਢੀਅਲੇ ॥
972.t: kahat naamadheau sunahu tilochan baalak paalan pauddeeale ||
972.e: Says Naam Dayv, listen, O Trilochan: the child is laid down in the cradle.

972.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਾਜ ਬਿਰੂਧੀ ਚੀਤੁ ਸੁ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਰਾਖੀਅਲੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
972.t: a(n)tar baahar kaaj biroodhee cheetu su baarik raakheeale ||4||1||
972.e: Its mother is at work, inside and outside, but she holds her child in her thoughts. ||4||1||

972.g: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਆਨੰਤਾ ਗੀਤ ਕਬਿਤ ਨ ਗਾਵਉਗੋ ॥
972.t: bedh puraan saasatr aana(n)taa geet kabit na gaavaugo ||
972.e: There are countless Vedas, Puraanas and Shaastras; I do not sing their songs and hymns.

973.g: ਅਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਮਹਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਬੇਨੁ ਬਜਾਵਉਗੋ ॥੧॥
973.t: akha(n)dd ma(n)ddal nira(n)kaar meh anahadh ben bajaavaugo ||1||
973.e: In the imperishable realm of the Formless Lord, I play the flute of the unstruck sound current. ||1||

973.g: ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਰਾਮਹਿ ਗਾਵਉਗੋ ॥
973.t: bairaagee raameh gaavaugo ||
973.e: Becoming detached, I sing the Lord's Praises.

973.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਅਤੀਤ ਅਨਾਹਦਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਆਕੁਲ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਉਗੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
973.t: sabadh ateet anaahadh raataa aakul kai ghar jaaugo ||1|| rahaau ||
973.e: Imbued with the unattached, unstruck Word of the Shabad, I shall go to the home of the Lord, who has no ancestors. ||1||Pause||

973.g: ਇੜਾ ਪਿੰਗੁਲਾ ਅਉਰੁ ਸੁਖਮਨਾ ਪਉਨੈ ਬੰਧਿ ਰਹਾਉਗੋ ॥
973.t: eiRaa pi(n)gulaa aaur sukhamanaa paunai ba(n)dh rahaaugo ||
973.e: Then, I shall no longer control the breath through the energy channels of the Ida, Pingala and Shushmanaa.

973.g: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਉ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਾਉਗੋ ॥੨॥
973.t: cha(n)dh sooraj dhui sam kar raakhau braham jot mil jaaugo ||2||
973.e: I look upon both the moon and the sun as the same, and I shall merge in the Light of God. ||2||

973.g: ਤੀਰਥ ਦੇਖਿ ਨ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਪੈਸਉ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਨ ਸਤਾਵਉਗੋ ॥
973.t: teerath dhekh na jal meh paisau jeea ja(n)t na sataavaugo ||
973.e: I do not go to see sacred shrines of pilgrimage, or bathe in their waters; I do not bother any beings or creatures.

973.g: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਘਟ ਹੀ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਨੑਾਉਗੋ ॥੩॥
973.t: aThasaTh teerath guroo dhikhaae ghaT hee bheetar n(h)aaugo ||3||
973.e: The Guru has shown me the sixty-eight places of pilgrimage within my own heart, where I now take my cleansing bath. ||3||

973.g: ਪੰਚ ਸਹਾਈ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਭਲੋ ਭਲੋ ਨ ਕਹਾਵਉਗੋ ॥
973.t: pa(n)ch sahaiee jan kee sobhaa bhalo bhalo na kahaavaugo ||
973.e: I do not pay attention to anyone praising me, or calling me good and nice.

973.g: ਨਾਮਾ ਕਹੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਤਾ ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਮਾਉਗੋ ॥੪॥੨॥
973.t: naamaa kahai chit har siau raataa su(n)n samaadh samaaugo ||4||2||
973.e: Says Naam Dayv, my consciousness is imbued with the Lord; I am absorbed in the profound state of Samaadhi. ||4||2||

973.g: ਮਾਇ ਨ ਹੋਤੀ ਬਾਪੁ ਨ ਹੋਤਾ ਕਰਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਤੀ ਕਾਇਆ ॥
973.t: mai na hotee baap na hotaa karam na hotee kaiaa ||
973.e: When there was no mother and no father, no karma and no human body,

973.g: ਹਮ ਨਹੀ ਹੋਤੇ ਤੁਮ ਨਹੀ ਹੋਤੇ ਕਵਨੁ ਕਹਾਂ ਤੇ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
973.t: ham nahee hote tum nahee hote kavan kahaa(n) te aaiaa ||1||
973.e: when I was not and you were not, then who came from where? ||1||

973.g: ਰਾਮ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੇਰਾ ॥
973.t: raam koi na kis hee keraa ||
973.e: O Lord, no one belongs to anyone else.

973.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਰਵਰਿ ਪੰਖਿ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
973.t: jaise taravar pa(n)kh baseraa ||1|| rahaau ||
973.e: We are like birds perched on a tree. ||1||Pause||

973.g: ਚੰਦੁ ਨ ਹੋਤਾ ਸੂਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਤਾ ਪਾਨੀ ਪਵਨੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
973.t: cha(n)dh na hotaa soor na hotaa paanee pavan milaiaa ||
973.e: When there was no moon and no sun, then water and air were blended together.

973.g: ਸਾਸਤੁ ਨ ਹੋਤਾ ਬੇਦੁ ਨ ਹੋਤਾ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਹਾਂ ਤੇ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
973.t: saasat na hotaa bedh na hotaa karam kahaa(n) te aaiaa ||2||
973.e: When there were no Shaastras and no Vedas, then where did karma come from? ||2||

973.g: ਖੇਚਰ ਭੂਚਰ ਤੁਲਸੀ ਮਾਲਾ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
973.t: khechar bhoochar tulasee maalaa gur parasaadhee paiaa ||
973.e: Control of the breath and positioning of the tongue, focusing at the third eye and wearing malas of tulsi beads, are all obtained through Guru's Grace.

973.g: ਨਾਮਾ ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਪਰਮ ਤਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹੋਇ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥੩॥੩॥
973.t: naamaa pranavai param tat hai satigur hoi lakhaiaa ||3||3||
973.e: Naam Dayv prays, this is the supreme essence of reality; the True Guru has inspired this realization. ||3||3||

973.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
973.t: raamakalee ghar doojaa ||
973.e: Raamkalee, Second House:

973.g: ਬਾਨਾਰਸੀ ਤਪੁ ਕਰੈ ਉਲਟਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਮਰੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਦਹੈ ਕਾਇਆ ਕਲਪੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
973.t: baanaarasee tap karai ulaT teerath marai agan dhahai kaiaa kalap keejai ||
973.e: Someone may practice austerities at Benares, or die upside-down at a sacred shrine of pilgrimage, or burn his body in fire, or rejuvenate his body to live almost forever;

973.g: ਅਸੁਮੇਧ ਜਗੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਸੋਨਾ ਗਰਭ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਰਿ ਤਊ ਨ ਪੂਜੈ ॥੧॥
973.t: asumedh jag keejai sonaa garabh dhaan dheejai raam naam sar tuoo na poojai ||1||
973.e: he may perform the horse-sacrifice ceremony, or give donations of gold covered over, but none of these is equal to the worship of the Lord's Name. ||1||

973.g: ਛੋਡਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਰੇ ਪਾਖੰਡੀ ਮਨ ਕਪਟੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
973.t: chhodd chhodd re paakha(n)ddee man kapaT na keejai ||
973.e: O hypocrite, renounce and abandon your hypocrisy; do not practice deception.

973.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤਹਿ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
973.t: har kaa naam nit niteh leejai ||1|| rahaau ||
973.e: Constantly, continually, chant the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

973.g: ਗੰਗਾ ਜਉ ਗੋਦਾਵਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਕੁੰਭਿ ਜਉ ਕੇਦਾਰ ਨੑਾਈਐ ਗੋਮਤੀ ਸਹਸ ਗਊ ਦਾਨੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
973.t: ga(n)gaa jau godhaavar jaieeaai ku(n)bh jau kedhaar n(h)aieeaai gomatee sahas guoo dhaan keejai ||
973.e: Someone may go to the Ganges or the Godaavari, or to the Kumbha festival, or bathe at Kaydaar Naat'h, or make donations of thousands of cows at Gomti;

973.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਉ ਤੀਰਥ ਕਰੈ ਤਨੁ ਜਉ ਹਿਵਾਲੇ ਗਾਰੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਰਿ ਤਊ ਨ ਪੂਜੈ ॥੨॥
973.t: koT jau teerath karai tan jau hivaale gaarai raam naam sar tuoo na poojai ||2||
973.e: he may make millions of pilgrimages to sacred shrines, or freeze his body in the Himalayas; still, none of these is equal to the worship of the Lord's Name. ||2||

973.g: ਅਸੁ ਦਾਨ ਗਜ ਦਾਨ ਸਿਹਜਾ ਨਾਰੀ ਭੂਮਿ ਦਾਨ ਐਸੋ ਦਾਨੁ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤਹਿ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
973.t: as dhaan gaj dhaan sihajaa naaree bhoom dhaan aaiso dhaan nit niteh keejai ||
973.e: Someone may give away horses and elephants, or women on their beds, or land; he may give such gifts over and over again.

973.g: ਆਤਮ ਜਉ ਨਿਰਮਾਇਲੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਆਪ ਬਰਾਬਰਿ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਰਿ ਤਊ ਨ ਪੂਜੈ ॥੩॥
973.t: aatam jau niramail keejai aap baraabar ka(n)chan dheejai raam naam sar tuoo na poojai ||3||
973.e: He may purify his soul, and give away in charity his body weight in gold; none of these is equal to the worship of the Lord's Name. ||3||

973.g: ਮਨਹਿ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਰੋਸੁ ਜਮਹਿ ਨ ਦੀਜੈ ਦੋਸੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਬਾਣ ਪਦੁ ਚੀਨਿੑ ਲੀਜੈ ॥
973.t: maneh na keejai ros jameh na dheejai dhos niramal nirabaan padh cheeni(h) leejai ||
973.e: Do not harbor anger in your mind, or blame the Messenger of Death; instead, realize the immaculate state of Nirvaanaa.

973.g: ਜਸਰਥ ਰਾਇ ਨੰਦੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਚੰਦੁ ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਨਾਮਾ ਤਤੁ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੪॥੪॥
973.t: jasarath rai na(n)dh raajaa meraa raam cha(n)dh pranavai naamaa tat ras a(n)mrit peejai ||4||4||
973.e: My Sovereign Lord King is Raam Chandra, the Son of the King Dasrat'h; prays Naam Dayv, I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||4||4||

973.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਕੀ
973.t: raamakalee baanee ravidhaas jee kee
973.e: Raamkalee, The Word Of Ravi Daas Jee:

973.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
973.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
973.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

973.g: ਪੜੀਐ ਗੁਨੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਅਨਭਉ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਦਰਸੈ ॥
973.t: paReeaai guneeaai naam sabh suneeaai anabhau bhaau na dharasai ||
973.e: They read and reflect upon all the Names of God; they listen, but they do not see the Lord, the embodiment of love and intuition.

973.g: ਲੋਹਾ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਹਿਰਨ ਹੋਇ ਕੈਸੇ ਜਉ ਪਾਰਸਹਿ ਨ ਪਰਸੈ ॥੧॥
973.t: lohaa ka(n)chan hiran hoi kaise jau paaraseh na parasai ||1||
973.e: How can iron be transformed into gold, unless it touches the Philosopher's Stone? ||1||

974.e: O Divine Lord, the knot of skepticism cannot be untied.

974.g: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦ ਮਤਸਰ ਇਨ ਪੰਚਹੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਲੂਟੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
974.t: kaam karodh maiaa madh matasar in pa(n)chahu mil looTe ||1|| rahaau ||
974.e: Sexual desire, anger, Maya, intoxication and jealousy - these five have combined to plunder the world. ||1||Pause||

974.g: ਹਮ ਬਡ ਕਬਿ ਕੁਲੀਨ ਹਮ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਹਮ ਜੋਗੀ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ॥
974.t: ham badd kab kuleen ham pa(n)ddit ham jogee sa(n)niaasee ||
974.e: I am a great poet, of noble heritage; I am a Pandit, a religious scholar, a Yogi and a Sannyaasi;

974.g: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਗੁਨੀ ਸੂਰ ਹਮ ਦਾਤੇ ਇਹ ਬੁਧਿ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਨਾਸੀ ॥੨॥
974.t: giaanee gunee soor ham dhaate ieh budh kabeh na naasee ||2||
974.e: I am a spiritual teacher, a warrior and a giver - such thinking never ends. ||2||

974.g: ਕਹੁ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਸਭੈ ਨਹੀ ਸਮਝਸਿ ਭੂਲਿ ਪਰੇ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਉਰੇ ॥
974.t: kahu ravidhaas sabhai nahee samajhas bhool pare jaise baure ||
974.e: Says Ravi Daas, no one understands; they all run around, deluded like madmen.

974.g: ਮੋਹਿ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਜੀਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਧਨ ਮੋਰੇ ॥੩॥੧॥
974.t: moh adhaar naam naarain jeevan praan dhan more ||3||1||
974.e: The Lord's Name is my only Support; He is my life, my breath of life, my wealth. ||3||1||
Raamkalee, The Word Of Baynee Jee:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

974.g: ਇੜਾ ਪਿੰਗੁਲਾ ਅਉਰ ਸੁਖਮਨਾ ਤੀਨਿ ਬਸਹਿ ਇਕ ਠਾਈ ॥
974.t: eiRaa pi(n)gulaa aaur sukhamanaa teen baseh ik Thaiee ||
974.e: The energy channels of the Ida, Pingala and Shushmanaa: these three dwell in one place.

974.g: ਬੇਣੀ ਸੰਗਮੁ ਤਹ ਪਿਰਾਗੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਜਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਥਾਈ ॥੧॥
974.t: benee sa(n)gam teh piraag man majan kare tithaiee ||1||
974.e: This is the true place of confluence of the three sacred rivers: this is where my mind takes its cleansing bath. ||1||
O Saints, the Immaculate Lord dwells there;
how rare are those who go to the Guru, and understand this.
The all-pervading immaculate Lord is there. ||1||Pause||
What is the insignia of the Divine Lord's dwelling?
The unstruck sound current of the Shabad vibrates there.

974.g: ਤਹ ਚੰਦੁ ਨ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਪਉਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
974.t: teh cha(n)dh na sooraj paun na paanee ||
974.e: There is no moon or sun, no air or water there.
The Gurmukh becomes aware, and knows the Teachings. ||2||
Spiritual wisdom wells up, and evil-mindedness departs;
the nucleus of the mind sky is drenched with Ambrosial Nectar.
One who knows the secret of this device,
meets the Supreme Divine Guru. ||3||

974.g: ਦਸਮ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਪਰਮ ਪੁਰਖ ਕੀ ਘਾਟੀ ॥
974.t: dhasam dhuaaraa agam apaaraa param purakh kee ghaaTee ||
974.e: The Tenth Gate is the home of the inaccessible, infinite Supreme Lord.

974.g: ਊਪਰਿ ਹਾਟੁ ਹਾਟ ਪਰਿ ਆਲਾ ਆਲੇ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਥਾਤੀ ॥੪॥
974.t: uoopar haaT haaT par aalaa aale bheetar thaatee ||4||
974.e: Above the store is a niche, and within this niche is the commodity. ||4||

974.g: ਜਾਗਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਸੁ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਸੋਵੈ ॥
974.t: jaagat rahai su kabahu na sovai ||
974.e: One who remains awake, never sleeps.
The three qualities and the three worlds vanish, in the state of Samaadhi.
He takes the Beej Mantra, the Seed Mantra, and keeps it in his heart.
Turning his mind away from the world, he focuses on the cosmic void of the absolute Lord. ||5||
He remains awake, and he does not lie.
He keeps the five sensory organs under his control.
He cherishes in his consciousness the Guru's Teachings.
He dedicates his mind and body to the Lord's Love. ||6||
He considers his hands to be the leaves and branches of the tree.
He does not lose his life in the gamble.
He plugs up the source of the river of evil tendencies.
Turning away from the west, he makes the sun rise in the east.
He bears the unbearable, and the drops trickle down within;
then, he speaks with the Lord of the world. ||7||
The four-sided lamp illuminates the Tenth Gate.
The Primal Lord is at the center of the countless leaves.
He Himself abides there with all His powers.
He weaves the jewels into the pearl of the mind. ||8||
The lotus is at the forehead, and the jewels surround it.
Within it is the Immaculate Lord, the Master of the three worlds.
The Panch Shabad, the five primal sounds, in their purity, resound and vibrate there.
The chauris - the fly brushes wave, and the conch shells blare like thunder.
The Gurmukh tramples the demons underfoot with his spiritual wisdom.
Baynee longs for Your Name, Lord. ||9||1||

975.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਨਟ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪
975.t: raag naT naarain mahalaa chauthhaa
975.e: Raag Nat Naaraayan, Fourth Mehla:

975.g: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
975.t: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
975.e: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

975.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੇ ॥
975.t: mere man jap ahinis naam hare ||
975.e: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, day and night.

975.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਦੋਖ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਨੇ ਸਭ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਪਾਸਿ ਧਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
975.t: koT koT dhokh bahu keene sabh parahar paas dhare ||1|| rahaau ||
975.e: Millions and millions of sins and mistakes, committed through countless lifetimes, shall all be put aside and sent away. ||1||Pause||

975.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹਿ ਆਰਾਧਹਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਭਾਇ ਖਰੇ ॥
975.t: har har naam japeh aaraadheh sevak bhai khare ||
975.e: Those who chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and worship Him in adoration, and serve Him with love, are genuine.

975.g: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਦੋਖ ਗਏ ਸਭ ਨੀਕਰਿ ਜਿਉ ਪਾਨੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥
975.t: kilabikh dhokh ge sabh neekar jiau paanee mail hare ||1||
975.e: All their sins are erased, just as water washes off the dirt. ||1||

975.g: ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਨਰੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਨੁ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਨਰ ਨਰਹਰੇ ॥
975.t: khin khin nar naarain gaaveh mukh boleh nar narahare ||
975.e: That being, who sings the Lord's Praises each and every instant, chants with his mouth the Name of the Lord.

975.g: ਪੰਚ ਦੋਖ ਅਸਾਧ ਨਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੨॥
975.t: pa(n)ch dhokh asaadh nagar meh ik khin pal dhoor kare ||2||
975.e: In a moment, in an instant, the Lord rids him of the five incurable diseases of the body-village. ||2||

975.g: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਭਗਤ ਹਰੇ ॥
975.t: vaddabhaagee har naam dhiaaveh har ke bhagat hare ||
975.e: Very fortunate are those who meditate on the Lord's Name; they alone are the Lord's devotees.

975.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਚਉ ਮੈ ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ ਨਿਸਤਰੇ ॥੩॥
975.t: tin kee sa(n)gat dheh prabh jaachau mai mooR mugadh nisatare ||3||
975.e: I beg for the Sangat, the Congregation; O God, please bless me with them. I am a fool, and an idiot - please save me! ||3||

975.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੇ ॥
975.t: kirapaa kirapaa dhaar jagajeevan rakh levahu saran pare ||
975.e: Shower me with Your Mercy and Grace, O Life of the World; save me, I seek Your Sanctuary.

975.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਨੁ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਸਰਨਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਲਾਜ ਹਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
975.t: naanak jan tumaree saranaiee har raakhahu laaj hare ||4||1||
975.e: Servant Nanak has entered Your Sanctuary; O Lord, please preserve my honor! ||4||1||

975.g: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
975.t: naT mahalaa chauthhaa ||
975.e: Nat, Fourth Mehla:

975.g: ਰਾਮ ਜਪਿ ਜਨ ਰਾਮੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਲੇ ॥
975.t: raam jap jan raamai naam rale ||
975.e: Meditating on the Lord, His humble servants are blended with the Lord's Name.

975.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
975.t: raam naam japio gur bachanee har dhaaree har kirapale ||1|| rahaau ||
975.e: Chanting the Lord's Name, following the Guru's Teachings, the Lord showers His Mercy upon them. ||1||Pause||

975.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਨ ਜਪਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਲਲ ਸਲਲੇ ॥
975.t: har har agam agochar suaamee jan jap mil salal salale ||
975.e: Our Lord and Master, Har, Har, is inaccessible and unfathomable. Meditating on Him, His humble servant merges with Him, like water with water.

975.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਮ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਲੇ ॥੧॥
975.t: har ke sa(n)t mil raam ras paiaa ham jan kai bal balale ||1||
975.e: Meeting with the Lord's Saints, I have obtained the sublime essence of the Lord. I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to His humble servants. ||1||

975.g: ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨਿ ਗਾਇਓ ਸਭਿ ਦਾਲਦ ਦੁਖ ਦਲਲੇ ॥
975.t: purakhotam har naam jan gaio sabh dhaaladh dhukh dhalale ||
975.e: The Lord's humble servant sings the Praises of the Name of the Supreme, Primal Soul, and all poverty and pain are destroyed.

975.g: ਵਿਚਿ ਦੇਹੀ ਦੋਖ ਅਸਾਧ ਪੰਚ ਧਾਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਖਿਨ ਪਰਲੇ ॥੨॥
975.t: vich dhehee dhokh asaadh pa(n)ch dhaatoo har ke'ee khin parale ||2||
975.e: Within the body are the five evil and uncontrollable passions. The Lord destroys them in an instant. ||2||

975.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਈ ਜਿਉ ਦੇਖੈ ਸਸਿ ਕਮਲੇ ॥
975.t: har ke sa(n)t man preet lagaiee jiau dhekhai sas kamale ||
975.e: The Lord's Saint loves the Lord in his mind, like the lotus flower gazing at the moon.

975.g: ਉਨਵੈ ਘਨੁ ਘਨ ਘਨਿਹਰੁ ਗਰਜੈ ਮਨਿ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਮੋਰ ਮੁਰਲੇ ॥੩॥
975.t: aunavai ghan ghan ghanihar garajai man bigasai mor murale ||3||
975.e: The clouds hang low, the clouds tremble with thunder, and the mind dances joyfully like the peacock. ||3||

975.g: ਹਮਰੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਲੋਚ ਹਮ ਲਾਈ ਹਮ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ॥
975.t: hamarai suaamee loch ham laiee ham jeeveh dhekh har mile ||
975.e: My Lord and Master has placed this yearning within me; I live by seeing and meeting my Lord.

975.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਅਮਲ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਅਨਦ ਭਲੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
975.t: jan naanak har amal har laae har melahu anadh bhale ||4||2||
975.e: Servant Nanak is addicted to the intoxication of the Lord; meeting with the Lord, he finds sublime bliss. ||4||2||

975.g: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
975.t: naT mahalaa chauthhaa ||
975.e: Nat, Fourth Mehla:

975.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖੇ ॥
975.t: mere man jap har har naam sakhe ||
975.e: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, your only Friend.

976.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਹਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਪਖੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
976.t: gur parasaadhee har naam dhiaaio ham satigur charan pakhe ||1|| rahaau ||
976.e: By Guru's Grace, I meditate on the Name of the Lord; I wash the Feet of the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

976.g: ਊਤਮ ਜਗੰਨਾਥ ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰ ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਰਖੇ ॥
976.t: uootam jaga(n)naath jagadheesur ham paapee saran rakhe ||
976.e: The Exalted Lord of the World, the Master of the Universe, keeps a sinner like me in His Sanctuary

976.g: ਤੁਮ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਓ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਖੇ ॥੧॥
976.t: tum vadd purakh dheen dhukh bha(n)jan har dheeo naam mukhe ||1||
976.e: You are the Greatest Being, Lord, Destroyer of the pains of the meek; You have placed Your Name in my mouth, Lord. ||1||

976.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਹਮ ਗਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਖੇ ॥
976.t: har gun uooch neech ham gaae gur satigur sa(n)g sakhe ||
976.e: I am lowly, but I sing the Lofty Praises of the Lord, meeting with the Guru, the True Guru, my Friend.

976.g: ਜਿਉ ਚੰਦਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸੈ ਨਿੰਮੁ ਬਿਰਖਾ ਗੁਨ ਚੰਦਨ ਕੇ ਬਸਖੇ ॥੨॥
976.t: jiau cha(n)dhan sa(n)g basai ni(n)m birakhaa gun cha(n)dhan ke basakhe ||2||
976.e: Like the bitter nimm tree, growing near the sandalwood tree, I am permeated with the fragrance of sandalwood. ||2||

976.g: ਹਮਰੇ ਅਵਗਨ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਖੈ ਕੇ ਬਹੁ ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ਨਿਮਖੇ ॥
976.t: hamare avagan bikhiaa bikhai ke bahu baar baar nimakhe ||
976.e: My faults and sins of corruption are countless; over and over again, I commit them.

976.g: ਅਵਗਨਿਆਰੇ ਪਾਥਰ ਭਾਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਤਾਰੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਨਖੇ ॥੩॥
976.t: avaganiaare paathar bhaare har taare sa(n)g janakhe ||3||
976.e: I am unworthy, I am a heavy stone sinking down; but the Lord has carried me across, in association with His humble servants. ||3||

976.g: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਭ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਕ੍ਰਿਖੇ ॥
976.t: jin kau tum har raakhahu suaamee sabh tin ke paap kirakhe ||
976.e: Those whom You save, Lord - all their sins are destroyed.

976.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੁਮ ਦੁਸਟ ਤਾਰੇ ਹਰਣਖੇ ॥੪॥੩॥
976.t: jan naanak ke dhiaal prabh suaamee tum dhusaT taare haranakhe ||4||3||
976.e: O Merciful God, Lord and Master of servant Nanak, You have carried across even evil villains like Harnaakhash. ||4||3||

976.g: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
976.t: naT mahalaa chauthhaa ||
976.e: Nat, Fourth Mehla:

976.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗੇ ॥
976.t: mere man jap har har raam ra(n)ge ||
976.e: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, with love.

976.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਜਨ ਪਗਿ ਲਗੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
976.t: har har kirapaa karee jagadheesur har dhiaaio jan pag lage ||1|| rahaau ||
976.e: When the Lord of the Universe, Har, Har, granted His Grace, then I fell at the feet of the humble, and I meditate on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

976.g: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਭੂਲ ਚੂਕ ਹਮ ਅਬ ਆਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਨਗੇ ॥
976.t: janam janam ke bhool chook ham ab aae prabh saranage ||
976.e: Mistaken and confused for so many past lives, I have now come and entered the Sanctuary of God.

976.g: ਤੁਮ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਵਡ ਪਾਪਗੇ ॥੧॥
976.t: tum saranaagat pratipaalak suaamee ham raakhahu vadd paapage ||1||
976.e: O my Lord and Master, You are the Cherisher of those who come to Your Sanctuary. I am such a great sinner - please save me! ||1||

976.g: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਕੋ ਨ ਉਧਰਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਏ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵਗੇ ॥
976.t: tumaree sa(n)gat har ko ko na udhario prabh ke'ee patit pavage ||
976.e: Associating with You, Lord, who would not be saved? Only God sanctifies the sinners.

976.g: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਛੀਪਾ ਦੁਸਟਾਰਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਪੈਜ ਜਨਗੇ ॥੨॥
976.t: gun gaavat chheepaa dhusaTaario prabh raakhee paij janage ||2||
976.e: Naam Dayv, the calico printer, was driven out by the evil villains, as he sang Your Glorious Praises; O God, You protected the honor of Your humble servant. ||2||

976.g: ਜੋ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਤਿਨਗੇ ॥
976.t: jo tumare gun gaaveh suaamee hau bal bal bal tinage ||
976.e: Those who sing Your Glorious Praises, O my Lord and Master - I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice to them.

976.g: ਭਵਨ ਭਵਨ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਭਿ ਕੀਏ ਜਹ ਧੂਰਿ ਪਰੀ ਜਨ ਪਗੇ ॥੩॥
976.t: bhavan bhavan pavitr sabh ke'ee jeh dhoor paree jan page ||3||
976.e: Those houses and homes are sanctified, upon which the dust of the feet of the humble settles. ||3||

976.g: ਤੁਮਰੇ ਗੁਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਹਿ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਵਡ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ ਵਡਗੇ ॥
976.t: tumare gun prabh keh na sakeh ham tum vadd vadd purakh vaddage ||
976.e: I cannot describe Your Glorious Virtues, God; You are the greatest of the great, O Great Primal Lord God.

976.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਹਮ ਸੇਵਹ ਤੁਮ ਜਨ ਪਗੇ ॥੪॥੪॥
976.t: jan naanak kau dhiaa prabh dhaarahu ham seveh tum jan page ||4||4||
976.e: Please shower Your Mercy upon servant Nanak, God; I serve at the feet of Yor humble servants. ||4||4||

976.g: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
976.t: naT mahalaa chauthhaa ||
976.e: Nat, Fourth Mehla:

976.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨੇ ॥
976.t: mere man jap har har naam mane ||
976.e: O my mind, believe in and chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

976.g: ਜਗੰਨਾਥਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮ ਬਨੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
976.t: jaga(n)naath kirapaa prabh dhaaree mat gurmat naam bane ||1|| rahaau ||
976.e: God, the Master of the Universe, has showered His Mercy upon me, and through the Guru's Teachings, my intellect has been molded by the Naam. ||1||Pause||

976.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਇਓ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰ ਸੁਨੇ ॥
976.t: har jan har jas har har gaio upadhes guroo gur sune ||
976.e: The Lord's humble servant sings the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, listening to the Guru's Teachings.

976.g: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਟੇ ਜਿਵ ਖੇਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਾਨਿ ਲੁਨੇ ॥੧॥
976.t: kilabikh paap naam har kaaTe jiv khet kirasaan lune ||1||
976.e: The Lord's Name cuts down all sins, like the farmer cutting down his crops. ||1||

976.g: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਹਮ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨੇ ॥
976.t: tumaree upamaa tum hee prabh jaanahu ham keh na sakeh har gune ||
976.e: You alone know Your Praises, God; I cannot even describe Your Glorious Virtues, Lord.

976.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਤੁਮ ਤੈਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਗੁਨ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ॥੨॥
976.t: jaise tum taise prabh tum hee gun jaanahu prabh apune ||2||
976.e: You are what You are, God; You alone know Your Glorious Virtues, God. ||2||

976.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਫਾਸ ਬੰਧ ਬਹੁ ਬੰਧੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਖੁਲ ਖੁਲਨੇ ॥
976.t: maiaa faas ba(n)dh bahu ba(n)dhe har japio khul khulane ||
976.e: The mortals are bound by the many bonds of Maya's noose. Meditating on the Lord, the knot is untied,

976.g: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਕੁੰਚਰੁ ਤਦੂਐ ਬਾਂਧਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਮੋਖ ਮੁਖਨੇ ॥੩॥
976.t: jiau jal ku(n)char tadhooaai baa(n)dhio har chetio mokh mukhane ||3||
976.e: like the elephant, which was caught in the water by the crococile; it remembered the Lord, and chanted the Lord's Name, and was released. ||3||

976.g: ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਤੁਮ ਖੋਜਹੁ ਜੁਗ ਜੁਗਨੇ ॥
976.t: suaamee paarabraham paramesar tum khojahu jug jugane ||
976.e: O my Lord and Master, Supreme Lord God, Transcendent Lord, throughout the ages, mortals search for You.

976.g: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਥਾਹ ਪਾਈ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਵਡਨੇ ॥੪॥੫॥
976.t: tumaree thaeh paiee nahee paavai jan naanak ke prabh vaddane ||4||5||
976.e: Your extent cannot be estimated or known, O Great God of servant Nanak. ||4||5||

976.g: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
976.t: naT mahalaa chauthhaa ||
976.e: Nat, Fourth Mehla:

976.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕਲਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਵਣੇ ॥
976.t: mere man kal keerat har pravane ||
976.e: O my mind, in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises is worthy and commendable.

976.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆਲਿ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਾਰੀ ਲਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਣੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
976.t: har har dhiaal dhiaa prabh dhaaree lag satigur har japane ||1|| rahaau ||
976.e: When the Merciful Lord God shows kindness and compassion, then one falls at the feet of the True Guru, and meditates on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

977.g: ਹਰਿ ਤੁਮ ਵਡ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਭਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੁੜਣੇ ॥
977.t: har tum vadd agam agochar suaamee sabh dhiaaveh har ruRane ||
977.e: O my Lord and Master, You are great, inaccessible and unfathomable; all meditate on You, O Beautiful Lord.

977.g: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਤੁਮੑਰੇ ਵਡ ਕਟਾਖ ਹੈ ਤੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਣੇ ॥੧॥
977.t: jin kau tum(h)re vadd kaTaakh hai te gurmukh har simarane ||1||
977.e: Those whom You view with Your Great Eye of Grace, meditate on You, Lord, and become Gurmukh. ||1||

977.g: ਇਹੁ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਕੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਜੁਗਣੇ ॥
977.t: eih parapa(n)ch keeaa prabh suaamee sabh jagajeevan jugane ||
977.e: The expanse of this creation is Your work, O God, my Lord and Master, Life of the entire universe, united with all.

977.g: ਜਿਉ ਸਲਲੈ ਸਲਲ ਉਠਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਲਹਰੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਲਲੈ ਸਲਲ ਸਮਣੇ ॥੨॥
977.t: jiau salalai salal uTheh bahu laharee mil salalai salal samane ||2||
977.e: Countless waves rise up from the water, and then they merge into the water again. ||2||

977.g: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਆ ਸੁ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਹਮ ਨਹ ਜਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਗਹਣੇ ॥
977.t: jo prabh keeaa su tum hee jaanahu ham neh jaanee har gahane ||
977.e: You alone, God, know whatever You do. O Lord, I do not know.

977.g: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਕਉ ਰਿਦ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਹਮ ਕਰਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸਿਮਰਣੇ ॥੩॥
977.t: ham baarik kau ridh usatat dhaarahu ham kareh prabhoo simarane ||3||
977.e: I am Your child; please enshrine Your Praises within my heart, God, so that I may remember You in meditation. ||3||

977.g: ਤੁਮ ਜਲ ਨਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਨ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਜੋ ਸੇਵੈ ਸਭ ਫਲਣੇ ॥
977.t: tum jal nidh har maan sarovar jo sevai sabh falane ||
977.e: You are the treasure of water, O Lord, the Maansarovar Lake. Whoever serves You receives all fruitful rewards.

977.g: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਂਛੈ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਣੇ ॥੪॥੬॥
977.t: jan naanak har har har har baa(n)chhai har dhevahu kar kirapane ||4||6||
977.e: Servant Nanak longs for the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har; bless him, Lord, with Your Mercy. ||4||6||

977.g: ਨਟ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਪੜਤਾਲ
977.t: naT naarain mahalaa chauthhaa paRataal
977.e: Nat Naaraayan, Fourth Mehla, Partaal:

977.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
977.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
977.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

977.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸੇਵ ਸਫਲ ਹਰਿ ਘਾਲ ॥
977.t: mere man sev safal har ghaal ||
977.e: O my mind, serve the Lord, and receive the fruits of your rewards.

977.g: ਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਗ ਰੇਨ ਰਵਾਲ ॥
977.t: le gur pag ren ravaal ||
977.e: Receive the dust of the Guru's feet.

977.g: ਸਭਿ ਦਾਲਿਦ ਭੰਜਿ ਦੁਖ ਦਾਲ ॥
977.t: sabh dhaalidh bha(n)j dhukh dhaal ||
977.e: All poverty will be eliminated, and your pains will disappear.

977.g: ਹਰਿ ਹੋ ਹੋ ਹੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
977.t: har ho ho ho nadhar nihaal ||1|| rahaau ||
977.e: The Lord shall bless you with His Glance of Grace, and you shall be enraptured. ||1||Pause||

977.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਰੰਗ ਮਹਲ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਲਾਲ ਲਾਲ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਲ ॥
977.t: har kaa girahu har aap savaario har ra(n)g ra(n)g mahal bea(n)t laal laal har laal ||
977.e: The Lord Himself embellishes His household. The Lord's Mansion of Love is studded with countless jewels, the jewels of the Beloved Lord.

977.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਨੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਆਪਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਆਇਓ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੀਈ ਹੈ ਬਸੀਠੀ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਖੇ ਭਈ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੧॥
977.t: har aapanee kirapaa karee aap gireh aaio ham har kee gur keeiee hai baseeThee ham har dhekhe bhiee nihaal nihaal nihaal nihaal ||1||
977.e: The Lord Himself has granted His Grace, and He has come into my home.The Guru is my advocate before the Lord. Gazing upon the Lord, I have become blissful, blissful, blissful. ||1||

977.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਵਤੇ ਕੀ ਖਬਰਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਾਈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਆਨਦੋ ਆਨੰਦ ਭਏ ਹਰਿ ਆਵਤੇ ਸੁਨੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਲ ॥
977.t: har aavate kee khabar gur paiee man tan aanadho aana(n)dh bhe har aavate sune mere laal har laal ||
977.e: From the Guru, I received news of the Lord's arrival. My mind and body became ecstatic and blissful, hearing of the arrival of the Lord, my Beloved Love, my Lord.

977.g: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਭਏ ਗਲਤਾਨ ਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੨॥੧॥੭॥
977.t: jan naanak har har mile bhe galataan haal nihaal nihaal ||2||1||7||
977.e: Servant Nanak has met with the Lord, Har, Har; he is intoxicated, enraptured, enraptured. ||2||1||7||

977.g: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
977.t: naT mahalaa chauthhaa ||
977.e: Nat, Fourth Mehla:

977.g: ਮਨ ਮਿਲੁ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੁਭਵੰਤੀ ॥
977.t: man mil sa(n)tasa(n)gat subhava(n)tee ||
977.e: O mind, join the Society of the Saints, and become noble and exalted.

977.g: ਸੁਨਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਖਵੰਤੀ ॥
977.t: sun akath kathaa sukhava(n)tee ||
977.e: Listen to the Unspoken Speech of the peace-giving Lord.

977.g: ਸਭ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਲਹੰਤੀ ॥
977.t: sabh kilavikh paap laha(n)tee ||
977.e: All sins will be washed away.

977.g: ਹਰਿ ਹੋ ਹੋ ਹੋ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਲਿਖੰਤੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
977.t: har ho ho ho likhat likha(n)tee ||1|| rahaau ||
977.e: Meet with the Lord, according to your pre-ordained destiny. ||1||Pause||

977.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਲਜੁਗ ਵਿਚਿ ਊਤਮ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਥਾ ਭਜੰਤੀ ॥
977.t: har keerat kalajug vich uootam mat gurmat kathaa bhaja(n)tee ||
977.e: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise is lofty and exalted. Following the Guru's Teachings, the intellect dwells on the sermon of the Lord.

977.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਮਨੀ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੰਤੀ ॥੧॥
977.t: jin jan sunee manee hai jin jan tis jan kai hau kurabaana(n)tee ||1||
977.e: I am a sacrifice to that person who listens and believes. ||1||

977.g: ਹਰਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਕਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਸਭ ਭੂਖ ਲਹੰਤੀ ॥
977.t: har akath kathaa kaa jin ras chaakhiaa tis jan sabh bhookh laha(n)tee ||
977.e: One who tastes the sublime essence of the Unspoken Speech of the Lord - all his hunger is satisfied.

977.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੇ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਵੰਤੀ ॥੨॥੨॥੮॥
977.t: naanak jan har kathaa sun tirapate jap har har har hova(n)tee ||2||2||8||
977.e: Servant Nanak listens to the sermon of the Lord, and is satisfied; chanting the Lord's Name, Har, Har, Har, he has become like the Lord. ||2||2||8||

977.g: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
977.t: naT mahalaa chauthhaa ||
977.e: Nat, Fourth Mehla:

977.g: ਕੋਈ ਆਨਿ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਲ ॥
977.t: koiee aan sunaavai har kee har gaal ||
977.e: If only someone would come and tell me the Lord's sermon.

977.g: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਾਲ ॥
977.t: tis kau hau bal bal baal ||
977.e: I would be a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice to him.

977.g: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਹੈ ਭਲ ਭਾਲ ॥
977.t: so har jan hai bhal bhaal ||
977.e: That humble servant of the Lord is the best of the best.

978.g: ਹਰਿ ਹੋ ਹੋ ਹੋ ਮੇਲਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
978.t: har ho ho ho mel nihaal ||1|| rahaau ||
978.e: Meeting with the Lord, you be enraptured. ||1||Pause||

978.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਤਿ ਬਤਾਇਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਚਾਲ ਦਿਖਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਚਾਲ ॥
978.t: har kaa maarag gur sa(n)t bataio gur chaal dhikhaiee har chaal ||
978.e: The Guru, the Saint, has shown me the Lord's Path. The Guru has shown me the way to walk on the Lord's Path.

978.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਹੁ ਨਿਹਕਪਟ ਕਮਾਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਘਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੧॥
978.t: a(n)tar kapaT chukaavahu mere gursikhahu nihakapaT kamaavahu har kee har ghaal nihaal nihaal nihaal ||1||
978.e: Cast out deception from within yourself, O my Gursikhs, and without deception, serve the Lord. You shall be enraptured, enraptured, enraptured. ||1||

978.g: ਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਸਿਖ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਭਾਏ ਜਿਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਮੇਰਾ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
978.t: te gur ke sikh mere har prabh bhaae jinaa har prabh jaanio meraa naal ||
978.e: Those Sikhs of the Guru, who realize that my Lord God is with them, are pleasing to my Lord God.

978.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੨॥੩॥੯॥
978.t: jan naanak kau mat har prabh dheenee har dhekh nikaT hadhoor nihaal nihaal nihaal nihaal ||2||3||9||
978.e: The Lord God has blessed servant Nanak with understanding; seeing his Lord near at hand, he is enraptured, enraptured, enraptured, enraptured. ||2||3||9||

978.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਨਟ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੫
978.t: raag naT naarain mahalaa panjavaa
978.e: Raag Nat Naaraayan, Fifth Mehla:

978.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
978.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
978.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

978.g: ਰਾਮ ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਨਾ ਕਿਆ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
978.t: raam hau kiaa jaanaa kiaa bhaavai ||
978.e: O Lord, how can I know what pleases You?

978.g: ਮਨਿ ਪਿਆਸ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦਰਸਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
978.t: man piaas bahut dharasaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
978.e: Within my mind is such a great thirst for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||1||Pause||

978.g: ਸੋਈ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਊਪਰਿ ਰੁਚ ਆਵੈ ॥
978.t: soiee giaanee soiee jan teraa jis uoopar ruch aavai ||
978.e: He alone is a spiritual teacher, and he alone is Your humble servant, to whom You have given Your approval.

978.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਸੋ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥੧॥
978.t: kirapaa karahu jis purakh bidhaate so sadhaa sadhaa tudh dhiaavai ||1||
978.e: He alone meditates on You forever and ever, O Primal Lord, O Architect of Destiny, unto whom You grant Your Grace. ||1||

978.g: ਕਵਨ ਜੋਗ ਕਵਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨਾ ਕਵਨ ਗੁਨੀ ਰੀਝਾਵੈ ॥
978.t: kavan jog kavan giaan dhiaanaa kavan gunee reejhaavai ||
978.e: What sort of Yoga, what spiritual wisdom and meditation, and what virtues please You?

978.g: ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ਨਿਜ ਭਗਤਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਊਪਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
978.t: soiee jan soiee nij bhagataa jis uoopar ra(n)g laavai ||2||
978.e: He alone is a humble servant, and he alone is God's own devotee, with whom You are in love. ||2||

978.g: ਸਾਈ ਮਤਿ ਸਾਈ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਜਿਤੁ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਿਸਰਾਵੈ ॥
978.t: saiee mat saiee budh siaanap jit nimakh na prabh bisaraavai ||
978.e: That alone is intelligence, that alone is wisdom and cleverness, which inspires one to never forget God, even for an instant.

978.g: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਲਗਿ ਏਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
978.t: sa(n)tasa(n)g lag eh sukh paio har gun sadh hee gaavai ||3||
978.e: Joining the Society of the Saints, I have found this peace, singing forever the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

978.g: ਦੇਖਿਓ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਮਹਾ ਮੰਗਲ ਰੂਪ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਨ ਨਹੀ ਦਿਸਟਾਵੈ ॥
978.t: dhekhio acharaj mahaa ma(n)gal roop kichh aan nahee dhisaTaavai ||
978.e: I have seen the Wondrous Lord, the embodiment of supreme bliss, and now, I see nothing else at all.

978.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੋਰਚਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਲਾਹਿਓ ਤਹ ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਕਹ ਆਵੈ ॥੪॥੧॥
978.t: kahu naanak morachaa gur laahio teh garabh jon keh aavai ||4||1||
978.e: Says Nanak, the Guru has rubbed sway the rust; now how could I ever enter the womb of reincarnation again? ||4||1||

978.g: ਨਟ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ
978.t: naT naarain mahalaa panjavaa dhupadhe
978.e: Raag Nat Naaraayan, Fifth Mehla, Dho-Padhay:

978.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
978.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
978.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

978.g: ਉਲਾਹਨੋ ਮੈ ਕਾਹੂ ਨ ਦੀਓ ॥
978.t: aulaahano mai kaahoo na dheeo ||
978.e: I don't blame anyone else.

978.g: ਮਨ ਮੀਠ ਤੁਹਾਰੋ ਕੀਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
978.t: man meeTh tuhaaro keeo ||1|| rahaau ||
978.e: Whatever You do is sweet to my mind. ||1||Pause||

978.g: ਆਗਿਆ ਮਾਨਿ ਜਾਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਹਾਰੋ ਜੀਓ ॥
978.t: aagiaa maan jaan sukh paiaa sun sun naam tuhaaro jeeo ||
978.e: Understanding and obeying Your Order, I have found peace; hearing, listening to Your Name, I live.

978.g: ਈਹਾਂ ਊਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਇਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੀਓ ॥੧॥
978.t: e'eehaa(n) uoohaa har tum hee tum hee ih gur te ma(n)tr dhiraReeo ||1||
978.e: Here and hereafter, O Lord, You, only You. The Guru has implanted this Mantra within me. ||1||

978.g: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਜਾਨਿ ਪਾਈ ਏਹ ਬਾਤਾ ਤਬ ਕੁਸਲ ਖੇਮ ਸਭ ਥੀਓ ॥
978.t: jab te jaan paiee eh baataa tab kusal khem sabh theeo ||
978.e: Since I came to realize this, I have been blessed with total peace and pleasure.

978.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਓ ਆਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਰੇ ਬੀਓ ॥੨॥੧॥੨॥
978.t: saadhasa(n)g naanak paragaasio aan naahee re beeo ||2||1||2||
978.e: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, this has been revealed to Nanak, and now, there is no other for him at all. ||2||1||2||

978.g: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
978.t: naT mahalaa panjavaa ||
978.e: Nat, Fifth Mehla:

978.g: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਈ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਧੀਰ ॥
978.t: jaa kau bhiee tumaaree dheer ||
978.e: Whoever has You for support,

978.g: ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਮਿਟੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਿਕਸੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਪੀਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
978.t: jam kee traas miTee sukh paiaa nikasee haumai peer ||1|| rahaau ||
978.e: has the fear of death removed; peace is found, and the disease of egotism is taken away. ||1||Pause||

978.g: ਤਪਤਿ ਬੁਝਾਨੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਨੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੇ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਖੀਰ ॥
978.t: tapat bujhaanee a(n)mirat baanee tirapate jiau baarik kheer ||
978.e: The fire within is quenched, and one is satisfied through the Ambrosial Word of the Guru's Bani, as the baby is satisfied by milk.

978.g: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸਾਜਨ ਸੰਤ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ਬੀਰ ॥੧॥
978.t: maat pitaa saajan sa(n)t mere sa(n)t sahaiee beer ||1||
978.e: The Saints are my mother, father and friends. The Saints are my help and support, and my brothers. ||1||

979.g: ਖੁਲੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੀਤਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ਹੀਰੈ ਬੇਧੇ ਹੀਰ ॥
979.t: khule bhram bheet mile gopaalaa heerai bedhe heer ||
979.e: The doors of doubt are thrown open, and I have met the Lord of the World; God's diamond has pierced the diamond of my mind.

979.g: ਬਿਸਮ ਭਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਤ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਗੁਨੀ ਗਹੀਰ ॥੨॥੨॥੩॥
979.t: bisam bhe naanak jas gaavat Thaakur gunee gaheer ||2||2||3||
979.e: Nanak blossoms forth in ecstasy, singing the Lord's Praises; my Lord and Master is the ocean of virtue. ||2||2||3||

979.g: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
979.t: naT mahalaa panjavaa ||
979.e: Nat, Fifth Mehla:

979.g: ਅਪਨਾ ਜਨੁ ਆਪਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਉਧਾਰਿਓ ॥
979.t: apanaa jan aapeh aap udhaario ||
979.e: He Himself saves His humble servant.

979.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸਿਓ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਨਾਹਿ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
979.t: aaTh pahar jan kai sa(n)g basio man te naeh bisaario ||1|| rahaau ||
979.e: Twenty-four hours a day, He dwells with His humble servant; He never forgets him from His Mind. ||1||Pause||

979.g: ਬਰਨੁ ਚਿਹਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਦਾਸ ਕਾ ਕੁਲੁ ਨ ਬਿਚਾਰਿਓ ॥
979.t: baran chihan naahee kichh pekhio dhaas kaa kul na bichaario ||
979.e: The Lord does not look at his color or form; He does not consider the ancestry of His slave.

979.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਓ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਸਵਾਰਿਓ ॥੧॥
979.t: kar kirapaa naam har dheeo sahaj subhai savaario ||1||
979.e: Granting His Grace, the Lord blesses him with His Name, and embellishes him with intuitive ease. ||1||

979.g: ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਕਾ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਿਓ ॥
979.t: mahaa bikham agan kaa saagar tis te paar utaario ||
979.e: The ocean of fire is treacherous and difficult, but he is carried across.

979.g: ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਗਸਾਨੋ ਪੁਨਹ ਪੁਨਹ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿਓ ॥੨॥੩॥੪॥
979.t: pekh pekh naanak bigasaano puneh puneh balihaario ||2||3||4||
979.e: Seeing, seeing Him, Nanak blossoms forth, over and over again, a sacrifice to Him. ||2||3||4||

979.g: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
979.t: naT mahalaa panjavaa ||
979.e: Nat, Fifth Mehla:

979.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਹਿਓ ॥
979.t: har har man meh naam kahio ||
979.e: One who chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, within his mind

979.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਅਪ੍ਰਾਧ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਰਹਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
979.t: koT apraadh miTeh khin bheetar taa kaa dhukh na rahio ||1|| rahaau ||
979.e: - millions of sins are erased in an instant, and pain is relieved. ||1||Pause||

979.g: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਭਇਓ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਹਿਓ ॥
979.t: khojat khojat bhio bairaagee saadhoo sa(n)g lahio ||
979.e: Seeking and searching, I have become detached; I have found the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

979.g: ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਗਹਿਓ ॥੧॥
979.t: sagal tiaag ek liv laagee har har charan gahio ||1||
979.e: Renouncing everything, I am lovingly focused on the One Lord. I grab hold of the feet of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

979.g: ਕਹਤ ਮੁਕਤ ਸੁਨਤੇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਇਓ ॥
979.t: kahat mukat sunate nisataare jo jo saran pio ||
979.e: Whoever chants His Name is liberated; whoever listens to it is saved, as is anyone who seeks His Sanctuary.

979.g: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਓ ॥੨॥੪॥੫॥
979.t: simar simar suaamee prabh apunaa kahu naanak anadh bhio ||2||4||5||
979.e: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on God the Lord and Master, says Nanak, I am in ecstasy! ||2||4||5||

979.g: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
979.t: naT mahalaa panjavaa ||
979.e: Nat, Fifth Mehla:

979.g: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਡੋਰੀ ॥
979.t: charan kamal sa(n)g laagee ddoree ||
979.e: The string of my love is tied to Your Lotus Feet.

979.g: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਕਰਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਮੋਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
979.t: sukh saagar kar param gat moree ||1|| rahaau ||
979.e: O Lord, ocean of peace, please bless me with the supreme status. ||1||Pause||

979.g: ਅੰਚਲਾ ਗਹਾਇਓ ਜਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਉ ਮਨੁ ਬੀਧੋ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੀ ਖੋਰੀ ॥
979.t: a(n)chalaa gahaio jan apune kau man beedho prem kee khoree ||
979.e: He has inspired His humble servant to grasp the hem of His robe; his mind is pierced through with the intoxication of divine love.

979.g: ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਤ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਸੁ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੀ ਜਾਲੀ ਤੋਰੀ ॥੧॥
979.t: jas gaavat bhagat ras upajio maiaa kee jaalee toree ||1||
979.e: Singing His Praises, love wells up within the devotee, and the trap of Maya is broken. ||1||

979.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਆਨ ਨ ਪੇਖਉ ਹੋਰੀ ॥
979.t: pooran poor rahe kirapaa nidh aan na pekhau horee ||
979.e: The Lord, the ocean of mercy, is all-pervading, permeating everywhere; I do not see any other at all.

979.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੀਓ ਦਾਸੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਥੋਰੀ ॥੨॥੫॥੬॥
979.t: naanak mel leeo dhaas apunaa preet na kabahoo thoree ||2||5||6||
979.e: He has united slave Nanak with Himself; His Love never diminishes. ||2||5||6||

979.g: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
979.t: naT mahalaa panjavaa ||
979.e: Nat, Fifth Mehla:

979.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ॥
979.t: mere man jap jap har naarain ||
979.e: O my mind, chant, and meditate on the Lord.

979.g: ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਬਿਸਰਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੇ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇਣ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
979.t: kabahoo na bisarahu man mere te aaTh pahar gun gain ||1|| rahaau ||
979.e: I shall never forget Him from my mind; twenty-four hours a day, I sing His Glorious Praises. ||1||Pause||

979.g: ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰਿ ਕਰਉ ਨਿਤ ਮਜਨੁ ਸਭ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਗਵਾਇਣ ॥
979.t: saadhoo dhoor karau nit majan sabh kilabikh paap gavain ||
979.e: I take my daily cleansing bath in the dust of the feet of the Holy, and I am rid of all my sins.

979.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਸਮਾਇਣੁ ॥੧॥
979.t: pooran poor rahe kirapaa nidh ghaT ghaT dhisaT samain ||1||
979.e: The Lord, the ocean of mercy, is all-pervading, permeating everywhere; He is seen to be contained in each and every heart. ||1||

979.g: ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਕੋਟਿ ਲਖ ਪੂਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਲਾਇਣ ॥
979.t: jaap taap koT lakh poojaa har simaran tul na lain ||
979.e: Hundreds of thousands and millions of meditations, austerities and worships are not equal to remembering the Lord in meditation.

979.g: ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਇਣੁ ॥੨॥੬॥੭॥
979.t: dhui kar joR naanak dhaan maa(n)gai tere dhaasan dhaas dhasain ||2||6||7||
979.e: With his palms pressed together, Nanak begs for this blessing, that he may become the slave of the slaves of Your slaves. ||2||6||7||

979.g: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
979.t: naT mahalaa panjavaa ||
979.e: Nat, Fifth Mehla:

979.g: ਮੇਰੈ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
979.t: merai sarabas naam nidhaan ||
979.e: The treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is everything for me.

979.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
979.t: kar kirapaa saadhoo sa(n)g milio satigur dheeno dhaan ||1|| rahaau ||
979.e: Granting His Grace, He has led me to join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; the True Guru has granted this gift. ||1||Pause||

979.g: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨਹਾਰਾ ਗਾਉ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
979.t: sukhadhaataa dhukh bha(n)janahaaraa gaau keeratan pooran giaan ||
979.e: Sing the Kirtan, the Praises of the Lord, the Giver of peace, the Destroyer of pain; He shall bless you with perfect spiritual wisdom.

979.g: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਖੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਕੀਨੑੇ ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਮੂੜ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
979.t: kaam karodh lobh kha(n)dd kha(n)dd keen(h)e binasio mooR abhimaan ||1||
979.e: Sexual desire, anger and greed shall be shattered and destroyed, and your foolish ego will be dispelled. ||1||

979.g: ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
979.t: kiaa gun tere aakh vakhaanaa prabh a(n)tarajaamee jaan ||
979.e: What Glorious Virtues of Yours should I chant? O God, You are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

979.g: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਨਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥੨॥੭॥੮॥
979.t: charan kamal saran sukh saagar naanak sadh kurabaan ||2||7||8||
979.e: I seek the Sanctuary of Your Lotus Feet, O Lord, ocean of peace; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You. ||2||7||8||

980.g: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
980.t: naT mahalaa panjavaa ||
980.e: Nat, Fifth Mehla:

980.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿ ਵਾਰਿ ਜਾਉ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
980.t: hau vaar vaar jaau gur gopaal ||1|| rahaau ||
980.e: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Guru, the Lord of the World. ||1||Pause||

980.g: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਤੁਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਦਾਤੇ ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੧॥
980.t: moh niragun tum pooran dhaate dheenaa naath dhiaal ||1||
980.e: I am unworthy; You are the Perfect Giver. You are the Merciful Master of the meek. ||1||

980.g: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗਤ ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਧਨ ਮਾਲ ॥੨॥
980.t: uooThat baiThat sovat jaagat jeea praan dhan maal ||2||
980.e: While standing up and sitting down, while sleeping and awake, You are my soul, my breath of life, my wealth and property. ||2||

980.g: ਦਰਸਨ ਪਿਆਸ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮਨਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੩॥੮॥੯॥
980.t: dharasan piaas bahut man merai naanak dharas nihaal ||3||8||9||
980.e: Within my mind there is such a great thirst for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. Nanak is enraptured with Your Glance of Grace. ||3||8||9||

980.g: ਨਟ ਪੜਤਾਲ ਮਹਲਾ ੫
980.t: naT paRataal mahalaa panjavaa
980.e: Nat Partaal, Fifth Mehla:

980.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
980.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
980.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

980.g: ਕੋਊ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੋ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
980.t: kouoo hai mero saajan meet ||
980.e: Is there any friend or companion of mine,

980.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ਨੀਤ ॥
980.t: har naam sunaavai neet ||
980.e: who will constantly share the Lord's Name with me?

980.g: ਬਿਨਸੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਬਿਪਰੀਤਿ ॥
980.t: binasai dhukh bipareet ||
980.e: Will he rid me of my pains and evil tendencies?

980.g: ਸਭੁ ਅਰਪਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਚੀਤੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
980.t: sabh arapau man tan cheet ||1|| rahaau ||
980.e: I would surrender my mind, body, consciousness and everything. ||1||Pause||

980.g: ਕੋਈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਆਪਨ ਕੀਤ ॥
980.t: koiee viralaa aapan keet ||
980.e: How rare is that one whom the Lord makes His own,

980.g: ਸੰਗਿ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤ ॥
980.t: sa(n)g charan kamal man seet ||
980.e: and whose mind is sewn into the Lord's Lotus Feet.

980.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਦੀਤ ॥੧॥
980.t: kar kirapaa har jas dheet ||1||
980.e: Granting His Grace, the Lord blesses him with His Praise. ||1||

980.g: ਹਰਿ ਭਜਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜੀਤ ॥
980.t: har bhaj janam padhaarath jeet ||
980.e: Vibrating, meditating on the Lord, he is victorious in this precious human life,

980.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਹੋਹਿ ਪੁਨੀਤ ॥
980.t: koT patit hoh puneet ||
980.e: and millions of sinners are sanctified.

980.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਕੀਤ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੦॥੧੯॥
980.t: naanak dhaas bal bal keet ||2||1||10||19||
980.e: Slave Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to Him. ||2||1||10||19||

980.g: ਨਟ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੪
980.t: naT asaTapadheeaa mahalaa chauthhaa
980.e: Nat Ashtpadheeyaa, Fourth Mehla:

980.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
980.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
980.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

980.g: ਰਾਮ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੇ ॥
980.t: raam mere man tan naam adhaare ||
980.e: O Lord, Your Name is the support of my mind and body.

980.g: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਮੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
980.t: khin pal reh na sakau bin sevaa mai gurmat naam sam(h)aare ||1|| rahaau ||
980.e: I cannot survive for a moment, even for an instant, without serving You. Following the Guru's Teachings, I dwell upon the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

980.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
980.t: har har har har har man dhiaavahu mai har har naam piaare ||
980.e: Within my mind, I meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har, Har. The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is so dear to me.

980.g: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਭਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
980.t: dheen dhiaal bhe prabh Thaakur gur kai sabadh savaare ||1||
980.e: When God, my Lord and Master, became merciful to me the meek one, I was exalted by the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

980.g: ਮਧਸੂਦਨ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਮਾਧੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥
980.t: madhasoodhan jagajeevan maadho mere Thaakur agam apaare ||
980.e: Almighty Lord, Slayer of demons, Life of the World, my Lord and Master, inaccessible and infinite:

980.g: ਇਕ ਬਿਨਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕਰਉ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਮੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
980.t: eik binau benatee karau gur aagai mai saadhoo charan pakhaare ||2||
980.e: I offer this one prayer to the Guru, to bless me, that I may wash the feet of the Holy. ||2||

980.g: ਸਹਸ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਾਰੇ ॥
980.t: sahas netr netr hai prabh kau prabh eko purakh niraare ||
980.e: The thousands of eyes are the eyes of God; the One God, the Primal Being, remains unattached.

980.g: ਸਹਸ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਏਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
980.t: sahas moorat eko prabh Thaakur prabh eko gurmat taare ||3||
980.e: The One God, our Lord and Master, has thousands of forms; God alone, through the Guru's Teachings, saves us. ||3||

980.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਮੋਦਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
980.t: gurmat naam dhamodhar paiaa har har naam ur dhaare ||
980.e: Following the Guru's Teachings, I have been blessed with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. I have enshrined within my heart the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

980.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਬਨੀ ਅਤਿ ਮੀਠੀ ਜਿਉ ਗੂੰਗਾ ਗਟਕ ਸਮੑਾਰੇ ॥੪॥
980.t: har har kathaa banee at meeThee jiau goo(n)gaa gaTak sam(h)aare ||4||
980.e: The sermon of the Lord, Har, Har, is so very sweet; like the mute, I taste its sweetness, but I cannot describe it at all. ||4||

980.g: ਰਸਨਾ ਸਾਦ ਚਖੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੂਜੈ ਅਤਿ ਫੀਕੇ ਲੋਭ ਬਿਕਾਰੇ ॥
980.t: rasanaa saadh chakhai bhai dhoojai at feeke lobh bikaare ||
980.e: The tongue savors the bland, insipid taste of the love of duality, greed and corruption.

980.g: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਦ ਚਖਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਸਭ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਸਾਦ ਬਿਸਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
980.t: jo gurmukh saadh chakheh raam naamaa sabh an ras saadh bisaare ||5||
980.e: The Gurmukh tastes the flavor of the Lord's Name, and all other tastes and flavors are forgotten. ||5||

980.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁਣਿ ਕਹਤਿਆ ਪਾਪ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
980.t: gurmat raam naam dhan paiaa sun kahatiaa paap nivaare ||
980.e: Following the Guru's Teachings, I have obtained the wealth of the Lord's Name; hearing it, and chanting it, sins are eradicated.

980.g: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੬॥
980.t: dharam rai jam neR na aavai mere Thaakur ke jan piaare ||6||
980.e: The Messenger of Death and the Righteous Judge of Dharma do not even approach the beloved servant of my Lord and Master. ||6||

980.g: ਸਾਸ ਸਾਸ ਸਾਸ ਹੈ ਜੇਤੇ ਮੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰੇ ॥
980.t: saas saas saas hai jete mai gurmat naam sam(h)aare ||
980.e: With as many breaths as I have, I chant the Naam, under Guru's Instructions.

980.g: ਸਾਸੁ ਸਾਸੁ ਜਾਇ ਨਾਮੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੋ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਸਾਸੁ ਬਿਕਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
980.t: saas saas jai naamai bin so birathaa saas bikaare ||7||
980.e: Each and every breath which escapes me without the Naam - that breath is useless and corrupt. ||7||

980.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਨੀ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮੇਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
980.t: kirapaa kirapaa kar dheen prabh saranee mo kau har jan mel piaare ||
980.e: Please grant Your Grace; I am meek; I seek Your Sanctuary, God. Unite me with Your beloved, humble servants.

981.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹਤੁ ਹੈ ਹਮ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੇ ਪਨਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੮॥੧॥
981.t: naanak dhaasan dhaas kahat hai ham dhaasan ke panihaare ||8||1||
981.e: Nanak, the slave of Your slaves, says, I am the water-carrier of Your slaves. ||8||1||

981.g: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
981.t: naT mahalaa chauthhaa ||
981.e: Nat, Fourth Mehla:

981.g: ਰਾਮ ਹਮ ਪਾਥਰ ਨਿਰਗੁਨੀਆਰੇ ॥
981.t: raam ham paathar niraguneeaare ||
981.e: O Lord, I am an unworthy stone.

981.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਹਮ ਪਾਹਨ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
981.t: kirapaa kirapaa kar guroo milaae ham paahan sabadh gur taare ||1|| rahaau ||
981.e: The Merciful Lord, in His Mercy, has led me to meet the Guru; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, this stone is carried across. ||1||Pause||

981.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਅਤਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਮੈਲਾਗਰੁ ਮਲਗਾਰੇ ॥
981.t: satigur naam dhiraRaae at meeThaa mailaagar malagaare ||
981.e: The True Guru has implanted within me the exceedingly sweet Naam, the Name of the Lord; it is like the most fragrant sandalwood.

981.g: ਨਾਮੈ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਵਜੀ ਹੈ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਸਕੀ ਮੁਸਕ ਗੰਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
981.t: naamai surat vajee hai dheh dhis har musakee musak ga(n)dhaare ||1||
981.e: Through the Name, my awareness extends in the ten directions; the fragrance of the fragrant Lord permeates the air. ||1||

981.g: ਤੇਰੀ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਕਥਾ ਕਥਾ ਹੈ ਮੀਠੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਨੀਕੇ ਬਚਨ ਸਮਾਰੇ ॥
981.t: teree niragun kathaa kathaa hai meeThee gur neeke bachan samaare ||
981.e: Your unlimited sermon is the most sweet sermon; I contemplate the most Sublime Word of the Guru.

981.g: ਗਾਵਤ ਗਾਵਤ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
981.t: gaavat gaavat har gun gaae gun gaavat gur nisataare ||2||
981.e: Singing, singing, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; singing His Glorious Praises, the Guru saves me. ||2||

981.g: ਬਿਬੇਕੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਸੰਕ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥
981.t: bibek guroo guroo samadharasee tis mileeaai sa(n)k utaare ||
981.e: The Guru is wise and clear; the Guru looks upon all alike. Meeting with Him, doubt and skepticism are removed.

981.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
981.t: satigur miliaai param padh paiaa hau satigur kai balihaare ||3||
981.e: Meeting with the True Guru, I have obtained the supreme status. I am a sacrifice to the True Guru. ||3||

981.g: ਪਾਖੰਡ ਪਾਖੰਡ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਭਰਮੇ ਲੋਭੁ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਜਗਿ ਬੁਰਿਆਰੇ ॥
981.t: paakha(n)dd paakha(n)dd kar kar bharame lobh paakha(n)dd jag buriaare ||
981.e: Practicing hypocrisy and deception, people wander around in confusion. Greed and hypocrisy are evils in this world.

981.g: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਦੁਖਦਾਈ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਖੜਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰੇ ॥੪॥
981.t: halat palat dhukhadhaiee hoveh jamakaal khaRaa sir maare ||4||
981.e: In this world and the next, they are miserable; the Messenger of Death hovers over their heads, and strikes them down. ||4||

981.g: ਉਗਵੈ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਆਲੁ ਜਾਲੁ ਸਮੑਾਲੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੇ ॥
981.t: augavai dhinas aal jaal sam(h)aalai bikh maiaa ke bisathaare ||
981.e: At the break of day, they take care of their affairs, and the poisonous entanglements of Maya.

981.g: ਆਈ ਰੈਨਿ ਭਇਆ ਸੁਪਨੰਤਰੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਭੀ ਦੁਖ ਸਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
981.t: aaiee rain bhiaa supana(n)tar bikh supanai bhee dhukh saare ||5||
981.e: When night falls, they enter the land of dreams, and even in dreams, they take care of their corruptions and pains. ||5||

981.g: ਕਲਰੁ ਖੇਤੁ ਲੈ ਕੂੜੁ ਜਮਾਇਆ ਸਭ ਕੂੜੈ ਕੇ ਖਲਵਾਰੇ ॥
981.t: kalar khet lai kooR jamaiaa sabh kooRai ke khalavaare ||
981.e: Taking a barren field, they plant falsehood; they shall harvest only falsehood.

981.g: ਸਾਕਤ ਨਰ ਸਭਿ ਭੂਖ ਭੁਖਾਨੇ ਦਰਿ ਠਾਢੇ ਜਮ ਜੰਦਾਰੇ ॥੬॥
981.t: saakat nar sabh bhookh bhukhaane dhar Thaadde jam ja(n)dhaare ||6||
981.e: The materialistic people shall all remain hungry; the brutal Messenger of Death stands waiting at their door. ||6||

981.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਰਜੁ ਚੜਿਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ ਉਤਰੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
981.t: manmukh karaj chaRiaa bikh bhaaree utarai sabadh veechaare ||
981.e: The self-willed manmukh has accumulated a tremendous load of debt in sin; only by contemplating the Word of the Shabad, can this debt be paid off.

981.g: ਜਿਤਨੇ ਕਰਜ ਕਰਜ ਕੇ ਮੰਗੀਏ ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਪਗਿ ਲਗਿ ਵਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
981.t: jitane karaj karaj ke ma(n)ge'ee kar sevak pag lag vaare ||7||
981.e: As much debt and as many creditors as there are, the Lord makes them into servants, who fall at his feet. ||7||

981.g: ਜਗੰਨਾਥ ਸਭਿ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਉਪਾਏ ਨਕਿ ਖੀਨੀ ਸਭ ਨਥਹਾਰੇ ॥
981.t: jaga(n)naath sabh ja(n)tr upaae nak kheenee sabh nathahaare ||
981.e: All the beings which the Lord of the Universe created - He puts the rings through their noses, and leads them all along.

981.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਖਿੰਚੈ ਤਿਵ ਚਲੀਐ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੮॥੨॥
981.t: naanak prabh khi(n)chai tiv chaleeaai jiau bhaavai raam piaare ||8||2||
981.e: O Nanak, as God drives us on, so do we follow; it is all the Will of the Beloved Lord. ||8||2||

981.g: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
981.t: naT mahalaa chauthhaa ||
981.e: Nat, Fourth Mehla:

981.g: ਰਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਵਾਰੇ ॥
981.t: raam har a(n)mirat sar naavaare ||
981.e: The Lord has bathed me in the pool of Ambrosial Nectar.

981.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਮਜਨੁ ਹੈ ਨੀਕੋ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਲਮਲ ਪਾਪ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
981.t: satigur giaan majan hai neeko mil kalamal paap utaare ||1|| rahaau ||
981.e: The spiritual wisdom of the True Guru is the most excellent cleansing bath; bathing in it, all the filthy sins are washed away. ||1||Pause||

981.g: ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਾ ਗੁਨੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ਪੜਿ ਸੂਆ ਗਨਕ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥
981.t: sa(n)gat kaa gun bahut adhikaiee paR sooaa ganak udhaare ||
981.e: The virtues of the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, are so very great. Even the prostitute was saved, by teaching the parrot to speak the Lord's Name.

981.g: ਪਰਸ ਨਪਰਸ ਭਏ ਕੁਬਿਜਾ ਕਉ ਲੈ ਬੈਕੁੰਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
981.t: paras naparas bhe kubijaa kau lai baiku(n)Th sidhaare ||1||
981.e: Krishna was pleased, and so he touched the hunch-back Kubija, and she was transported to the heavens. ||1||

981.g: ਅਜਾਮਲ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਬੋਲਾਰੇ ॥
981.t: ajaamal preet putr prat keenee kar naarain bolaare ||
981.e: Ajaamal loved his son Naaraayan, and called out his name.

981.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਜਮਕੰਕਰ ਮਾਰਿ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
981.t: mere Thaakur kai man bhai bhaavanee jamaka(n)kar maar bidhaare ||2||
981.e: His loving devotion pleased my Lord and Master, who struck down and drove off the Messengers of Death. ||2||

981.g: ਮਾਨੁਖੁ ਕਥੈ ਕਥਿ ਲੋਕ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ਜੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਸੋ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
981.t: maanukh kathai kath lok sunaavai jo bolai so na beechaare ||
981.e: The mortal speaks and by speaking, makes the people listen; but he does not reflect upon what he himself says.

981.g: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਦਿੜਤਾ ਆਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
981.t: satasa(n)gat milai ta dhiRataa aavai har raam naam nisataare ||3||
981.e: But when he joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, he is confirmed in his faith, and he is saved by the Name of the Lord. ||3||

981.g: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਬਤੁ ਤਬ ਲਗਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਸਮਾਰੇ ॥
981.t: jab lag jeeau pi(n)dd hai saabat tab lag kichh na samaare ||
981.e: As long as his soul and body are healthy and strong, he does not remember the Lord at all.

981.g: ਜਬ ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਆਗਿ ਲਗਾਨੀ ਕਢਿ ਕੂਪੁ ਕਢੈ ਪਨਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੪॥
981.t: jab ghar ma(n)dhar aag lagaanee kadd koop kaddai panihaare ||4||
981.e: But when his home and mansion catch fire, then, he wants to dig the well to draw water. ||4||

981.g: ਸਾਕਤ ਸਿਉ ਮਨ ਮੇਲੁ ਨ ਕਰੀਅਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰੇ ॥
981.t: saakat siau man mel na kareeahu jin har har naam bisaare ||
981.e: O mind, do not join with the faithless cynic, who has forgotten the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

981.g: ਸਾਕਤ ਬਚਨ ਬਿਛੂਆ ਜਿਉ ਡਸੀਐ ਤਜਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਪਰੈ ਪਰਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
981.t: saakat bachan bichhooaa jiau ddaseeaai taj saakat parai paraare ||5||
981.e: The word of the faithless cynic stings like a scorpion; leave the faithless cynic far, far behind. ||5||

982.g: ਲਗਿ ਲਗਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਈ ਲਗਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
982.t: lag lag preet bahu preet lagaiee lag saadhoo sa(n)g savaare ||
982.e: Fall in love, fall deeply in love with the Lord; clinging to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you will be exalted and embellished.

982.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਬਚਨ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੬॥
982.t: gur ke bachan sat sat kar maane mere Thaakur bahut piaare ||6||
982.e: Those who accept the Word of the Guru as True, totally True, are very dear to my Lord and Master. ||6||

982.g: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਪਰਚੂਨ ਕਮਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
982.t: poorab janam parachoon kamaae har har har naam piaare ||
982.e: Because of actions committed in past lives, one comes to love the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har.

982.g: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਰਸੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
982.t: gur prasaadh a(n)mirat ras paiaa ras gaavai ras veechaare ||7||
982.e: By Guru's Grace, you shall obtain the ambrosial essence; sing of this essence, and reflect upon this essence. ||7||

982.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗਿ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲਨ ਲਾਲ ਗੁਲਾਰੇ ॥
982.t: har har roop ra(n)g sabh tere mere laalan laal gulaare ||
982.e: O Lord, Har, Har, all forms and colors are Yours; O my Beloved, my deep crimson ruby.

982.g: ਜੈਸਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ॥੮॥੩॥
982.t: jaisaa ra(n)g dheh so hovai kiaa naanak ja(n)t vichaare ||8||3||
982.e: Only that color which You impart, Lord, exists; O Nanak, what can the poor wretched being do? ||8||3||

982.g: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
982.t: naT mahalaa chauthhaa ||
