982.e: Nat, Fourth Mehla:

982.g: ਰਾਮ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਰਖਵਾਰੇ ॥
982.t: raam gur saran prabhoo rakhavaare ||
982.e: In the Sanctuary of the Guru, the Lord God saves and protects us,

982.g: ਜਿਉ ਕੁੰਚਰੁ ਤਦੂਐ ਪਕਰਿ ਚਲਾਇਓ ਕਰਿ ਊਪਰੁ ਕਢਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
982.t: jiau ku(n)char tadhooaai pakar chalaio kar uoopar kadd nisataare ||1|| rahaau ||
982.e: as He protected the elephant, when the crocodile seized it and pulled it into the water; He lifted him up and pulled him out. ||1||Pause||

982.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਤਿ ਨੀਕੇ ਮਨਿ ਸਰਧਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
982.t: prabh ke sevak bahut at neeke man saradhaa kar har dhaare ||
982.e: God's servants are sublime and exalted; they enshrine faith for Him in their minds.

982.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸਰਧਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
982.t: mere prabh saradhaa bhagat man bhaavai jan kee paij savaare ||1||
982.e: Faith and devotion are pleasing to my God's Mind; He saves the honor of His humble servants. ||1||

982.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਭੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਸਾਰੇ ॥
982.t: har har sevak sevaa laagai sabh dhekhai braham pasaare ||
982.e: The servant of the Lord, Har, Har, is committed to His service; He sees God pervading the entire expanse of the universe.

982.g: ਏਕੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਇਕੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵੈ ਸਭ ਏਕਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
982.t: ek purakh ik nadharee aavai sabh ekaa nadhar nihaare ||2||
982.e: He sees the One and only Primal Lord God, who blesses all with His Glance of Grace. ||2||

982.g: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ਸਭੁ ਚੇਰੀ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਮਾਰੇ ॥
982.t: har prabh Thaakur raviaa sabh Thaiee sabh cheree jagat samaare ||
982.e: God, our Lord and Master, is permeating and pervading all places; He takes care of the whole world as His slave.

982.g: ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦਇਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਥਰ ਕੀਰੇ ਕਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
982.t: aap dhiaal dhiaa dhaan dhevai vich paathar keere kaare ||3||
982.e: The Merciful Lord Himself mercifully gives His gifts, even to worms in stones. ||3||

982.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮੁਸਕਾਈ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਮਿਰਗੁ ਸਿੰਙ੍ਹਾਰੇ ॥
982.t: a(n)tar vaas bahut musakaiee bhram bhoolaa mirag si(n)n(g)haare ||
982.e: Within the deer is the heavy fragrance of musk, but he is confused and deluded, and he shakes his horns looking for it.

982.g: ਬਨੁ ਬਨੁ ਢੂਢਿ ਢੂਢਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਥਾਕੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਘਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੪॥
982.t: ban ban ddoodd ddoodd fir thaakee gur poorai ghar nisataare ||4||
982.e: Wandering, rambling and roaming through the forests and woods, I exhausted myself, and then in my own home, the Perfect Guru saved me. ||4||

982.g: ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਬਾਣੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਾਰੇ ॥
982.t: baanee guroo guroo hai baanee vich baanee a(n)mrit saare ||
982.e: The Word, the Bani is Guru, and Guru is the Bani. Within the Bani, the Ambrosial Nectar is contained.

982.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਕਹੈ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਪਰਤਖਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
982.t: gur baanee kahai sevak jan maanai paratakh guroo nisataare ||5||
982.e: If His humble servant believes, and acts according to the Words of the Guru's Bani, then the Guru, in person, emancipates him. ||5||

982.g: ਸਭੁ ਹੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹੈ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਬੀਜਿਆ ਖਾਵਾਰੇ ॥
982.t: sabh hai braham braham hai pasariaa man beejiaa khaavaare ||
982.e: All is God, and God is the whole expanse; man eats what he has planted.

982.g: ਜਿਉ ਜਨ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਹਾਂਸੁ ਦੁਖਿਆ ਧ੍ਰਿਸਟਬੁਧੀ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਘਰੁ ਲੂਕੀ ਜਾਰੇ ॥੬॥
982.t: jiau jan cha(n)dhrahaa(n)s dhukhiaa dhirasaTabudhee apunaa ghar lookee jaare ||6||
982.e: When Dhrishtabudhi tormented the humble devotee Chandrahaans, he only set his own house on fire. ||6||

982.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਜਨੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਿਦ ਲੋਚੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਸਾਸ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ ॥
982.t: prabh kau jan a(n)tar ridh lochai prabh jan ke saas nihaare ||
982.e: God's humble servant longs for Him within his heart; God watches over each breath of His humble servant.

982.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਜਨ ਪੀਛੈ ਜਗੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
982.t: kirapaa kirapaa kar bhagat dhiraRaae jan peechhai jag nisataare ||7||
982.e: Mercifully, mercifully, He implants devotion within his humble servant; for his sake, God saves the whole world. ||7||

982.g: ਆਪਨ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
982.t: aapan aap aap prabh Thaakur prabh aape sirasaT savaare ||
982.e: God, our Lord and Master, is Himself by Himself; God Himself embellishes the universe.

982.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਸਭੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਕਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੮॥੪॥
982.t: jan naanak aape aap sabh varatai kar kirapaa aap nisataare ||8||4||
982.e: O servant Nanak, He Himself is all-pervading; in His Mercy, He Himself emancipates all. ||8||4||

982.g: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
982.t: naT mahalaa chauthhaa ||
982.e: Nat, Fourth Mehla:

982.g: ਰਾਮ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੇ ॥
982.t: raam kar kirapaa leh ubaare ||
982.e: Grant Your Grace, Lord, and save me,

982.g: ਜਿਉ ਪਕਰਿ ਦ੍ਰੋਪਤੀ ਦੁਸਟਾਂ ਆਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਜ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
982.t: jiau pakar dhropatee dhusaTaa(n) aanee har har laaj nivaare ||1|| rahaau ||
982.e: as You saved Dropadi from shame when she was seized and brought before the court by the evil villians. ||1||Pause||

982.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਇਕੁ ਮਾਗਉ ਦਾਨੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
982.t: kar kirapaa jaachik jan tere ik maagau dhaan piaare ||
982.e: Bless me with Your Grace - I am just a humble beggar of Yours; I beg for a single blessing, O my Beloved.

982.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਨਿਤ ਸਰਧਾ ਲਾਗੀ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
982.t: satigur kee nit saradhaa laagee mo kau har gur mel savaare ||1||
982.e: I long constantly for the True Guru. Lead me to meet the Guru, O Lord, that I may be exalted and embellished. ||1||

982.g: ਸਾਕਤ ਕਰਮ ਪਾਣੀ ਜਿਉ ਮਥੀਐ ਨਿਤ ਪਾਣੀ ਝੋਲ ਝੁਲਾਰੇ ॥
982.t: saakat karam paanee jiau matheeaai nit paanee jhol jhulaare ||
982.e: The actions of the faithless cynic are like the churning of water; he churns, constantly churning only water.

982.g: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਢਿ ਮਾਖਨ ਕੇ ਗਟਕਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
982.t: mil satasa(n)gat param padh paiaa kadd maakhan ke gaTakaare ||2||
982.e: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, the supreme status is obtained; the butter is produced, and eaten with delight. ||2||

982.g: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਕਾਇਆ ਮਜਨੁ ਕੀਆ ਨਿਤ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਦੇਹ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
982.t: nit nit kaiaa majan keeaa nit mal mal dheh savaare ||
982.e: He may constantly and continually wash his body; he may constantly rub, clean and polish his body.

983.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਮਨਿ ਬਚਨ ਨ ਭਾਏ ਸਭ ਫੋਕਟ ਚਾਰ ਸੀਗਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
983.t: mere satigur ke man bachan na bhaae sabh fokaT chaar seegaare ||3||
983.e: But if the Word of my True Guru is not pleasing to his mind, then all his preparations and beautiful decorations are useless. ||3||

983.g: ਮਟਕਿ ਮਟਕਿ ਚਲੁ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਸਾਰੇ ॥
983.t: maTak maTak chal sakhee sahelee mere Thaakur ke gun saare ||
983.e: Walk playfully and carefree, O my friends and companions; cherish the Glorious Virtues of my Lord and Master.

983.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਈ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਰੇ ॥੪॥
983.t: gurmukh sevaa mere prabh bhaiee mai satigur alakh lakhaare ||4||
983.e: To serve, as Gurmukh, is pleasing to my God. Through the True Guru, the unknown is known. ||4||

983.g: ਨਾਰੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਭ ਨਾਰੀ ਸਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
983.t: naaree purakh purakh sabh naaree sabh eko purakh muraare ||
983.e: Women and men, all the men and women, all came from the One Primal Lord God.

983.g: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਰੇਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
983.t: sa(n)t janaa kee ren man bhaiee mil har jan har nisataare ||5||
983.e: My mind loves the dust of the feet of the humble; the Lord emancipates those who meet with the Lord's humble servants. ||5||

983.g: ਗ੍ਰਾਮ ਗ੍ਰਾਮ ਨਗਰ ਸਭ ਫਿਰਿਆ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਭਾਰੇ ॥
983.t: graam graam nagar sabh firiaa ridh a(n)tar har jan bhaare ||
983.e: From village to village, throughout all the cities I wandered; and then, inspired by the Lord's humble servants, I found Him deep within the nucleus of my heart.

983.g: ਸਰਧਾ ਸਰਧਾ ਉਪਾਇ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੬॥
983.t: saradhaa saradhaa upai milaae mo kau har gur gur nisataare ||6||
983.e: Faith and longing have welled up within me, and I have been blended with the Lord; the Guru, the Guru, has saved me. ||6||

983.g: ਪਵਨ ਸੂਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਨੀਕਾ ਕਰਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
983.t: pavan soot sabh neekaa kariaa satigur sabadh veechaare ||
983.e: The thread of my breath has been made totally sublime and pure; I contemplate the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru.

983.g: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਨੈਨਾ ਜਗਤੁ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
983.t: nij ghar jai a(n)mirat ras peeaa bin nainaa jagat nihaare ||7||
983.e: I came back to the home of my own inner self; drinking in the ambrosial essence, I see the world, without my eyes. ||7||

983.g: ਤਉ ਗੁਨ ਈਸ ਬਰਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਸਾਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਮੰਦਰ ਹਮ ਨਿਕ ਕੀਰੇ ॥
983.t: tau gun iees baran nahee saakau tum ma(n)dhar ham nik keere ||
983.e: I cannot describe Your Glorious Virtues, Lord; You are the temple, and I am just a tiny worm.

983.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਮੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰੇ ॥੮॥੫॥
983.t: naanak kirapaa karahu gur melahu mai raam japat man dheere ||8||5||
983.e: Bless Nanak with Your Mercy, and unite him with the Guru; meditating on my Lord, my mind is comforted and consoled. ||8||5||

983.g: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
983.t: naT mahalaa chauthhaa ||
983.e: Nat, Fourth Mehla:

983.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਭਜੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥
983.t: mere man bhaj Thaakur agam apaare ||
983.e: O my mind, vibrate, meditate on the inaccessible and infinite Lord and Master.

983.g: ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਬਹੁ ਨਿਰਗੁਣੀਆਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
983.t: ham paapee bahu niraguneeaare kar kirapaa gur nisataare ||1|| rahaau ||
983.e: I am such a great sinner; I am so unworthy. And yet the Guru, in His Mercy, has saved me. ||1||Pause||

983.g: ਸਾਧੂ ਪੁਰਖ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਪਾਏ ਇਕ ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰਉ ਗੁਰ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
983.t: saadhoo purakh saadh jan paae ik binau karau gur piaare ||
983.e: I have found the Holy Person, the Holy and humble servant of the Lord; I offer a prayer to Him, my Beloved Guru.

983.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਪੂਜੀ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਭੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
983.t: raam naam dhan poojee dhevahu sabh tisanaa bhookh nivaare ||1||
983.e: Please, bless me with the wealth, the capital of the Lord's Name, and take away all my hunger and thirst. ||1||

983.g: ਪਚੈ ਪਤੰਗੁ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਭ੍ਰਿੰਗ ਕੁੰਚਰ ਮੀਨ ਇਕ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਪਕਰਿ ਸਘਾਰੇ ॥
983.t: pachai pata(n)g mirag bhira(n)g ku(n)char meen ik i(n)dhree pakar saghaare ||
983.e: The moth, the deer, the bumble bee, the elephant and the fish are ruined, each by the one passion that controls them.

983.g: ਪੰਚ ਭੂਤ ਸਬਲ ਹੈ ਦੇਹੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਪ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
983.t: pa(n)ch bhoot sabal hai dhehee gur satigur paap nivaare ||2||
983.e: The five powerful demons are in the body; the Guru, the True Guru turns out these sins. ||2||

983.g: ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਦ ਸੋਧਿ ਸੋਧਿ ਦੇਖੇ ਮੁਨਿ ਨਾਰਦ ਬਚਨ ਪੁਕਾਰੇ ॥
983.t: saasatr bedh sodh sodh dhekhe mun naaradh bachan pukaare ||
983.e: I searched and searched through the Shaastras and the Vedas; Naarad the silent sage proclaimed these words as well.

983.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੜਹੁ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
983.t: raam naam paRahu gat paavahu satasa(n)gat gur nisataare ||3||
983.e: Chanting the Lord's Name, salvation is attained; the Guru saves those in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. ||3||

983.g: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰੀ ਜਿਵ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਕਮਲੁ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ ॥
983.t: preetam preet lagee prabh keree jiv sooraj kamal nihaare ||
983.e: In love with the Beloved Lord God, one looks at Him as the lotus looks at the sun.

983.g: ਮੇਰ ਸੁਮੇਰ ਮੋਰੁ ਬਹੁ ਨਾਚੈ ਜਬ ਉਨਵੈ ਘਨ ਘਨਹਾਰੇ ॥੪॥
983.t: mer sumer mor bahu naachai jab unavai ghan ghanahaare ||4||
983.e: The peacock dances on the mountain, when the clouds hang low and heavy. ||4||

983.g: ਸਾਕਤ ਕਉ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਹੁ ਸਿੰਚਹੁ ਸਭ ਡਾਲ ਫੂਲ ਬਿਸੁਕਾਰੇ ॥
983.t: saakat kau a(n)mirat bahu si(n)chahu sabh ddaal fool bisukaare ||
983.e: The faithless cyinc may be totally drenched with ambrosial nectar, but even so, all his branches and flowers are filled with venom.

983.g: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਨਿਵਹਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਨਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਛੇੜਿ ਛੇੜਿ ਕਢੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
983.t: jiau jiau niveh saakat nar setee chheR chheR kaddai bikh khaare ||5||
983.e: The more one bows down in humility before the faithless cyinc, the more he provokes, and stabs, and spits out his poison. ||5||

983.g: ਸੰਤਨ ਸੰਤ ਸਾਧ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਗੁਣ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੇ ॥
983.t: sa(n)tan sa(n)t saadh mil raheeaai gun boleh paraupakaare ||
983.e: Remain with the Holy man, the Saint of the Saints, who chants the Lord's Praises for the benefit of all.

983.g: ਸੰਤੈ ਸੰਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਮਲ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੬॥
983.t: sa(n)tai sa(n)t milai man bigasai jiau jal mil kamal savaare ||6||
983.e: Meeting the Saint of Saints, the mind blossoms forth, like the lotus, exalted by obtaining the water. ||6||

983.g: ਲੋਭ ਲਹਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਸੁਆਨੁ ਹਲਕੁ ਹੈ ਹਲਕਿਓ ਸਭਹਿ ਬਿਗਾਰੇ ॥
983.t: lobh lahar sabh suaan halak hai halakio sabheh bigaare ||
983.e: The waves of greed are like mad dogs with rabies. Their madness ruins everything.

983.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੈ ਦੀਬਾਨਿ ਖਬਰਿ ਹੋੁਈ ਗੁਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਖੜਗੁ ਲੈ ਮਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
983.t: mere Thaakur kai dheebaan khabar huoiee gur giaan khaRag lai maare ||7||
983.e: When the news reached the Court of my Lord and Master, the Guru took up the sword of spiritual wisdom, and killed them. ||7||

983.g: ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੈ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
983.t: raakh raakh raakh prabh mere mai raakhahu kirapaa dhaare ||
983.e: Save me, save me, save me, O my God; shower me with Your Mercy, and save me!

983.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈ ਧਰ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੮॥੬॥
983.t: naanak mai dhar avar na kaiee mai satigur gur nisataare ||8||6||
983.e: O Nanak, I have no other support; the Guru, the True Guru, has saved me. ||8||6||

983.g: ਛਕਾ ੧ ॥
983.t: chhakaa 1 ||
983.e: First Set of Six Hymns||

984.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪
984.t: raag maalee gauRaa mahalaa chauthhaa
984.e: Raag Maalee Gauraa, Fourth Mehla:

984.g: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
984.t: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
984.e: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

984.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
984.t: anik jatan kar rahe har a(n)t naahee paiaa ||
984.e: Countless have tried, but none have found the Lord's limit.

984.g: ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
984.t: har agam agam agaadh bodh aadhes har prabh raiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
984.e: The Lord is inaccessible, unapproachable and unfathomable; I humbly bow to the Lord God, my King. ||1||Pause||

984.g: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਝਗਰਤੇ ਝਗਰਾਇਆ ॥
984.t: kaam karodh lobh moh nit jhagarate jhagaraiaa ||
984.e: Sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment bring continual conflict and strife.

984.g: ਹਮ ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਦੀਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
984.t: ham raakh raakh dheen tere har saran har prabh aaiaa ||1||
984.e: Save me, save me, I am your humble creature, O Lord; I have come to Your Sanctuary, O my Lord God. ||1||

984.g: ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਲਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਨਾਇਆ ॥
984.t: saranaagatee prabh paalate har bhagat vachhal naiaa ||
984.e: You protect and preserve those who take to Your Sanctuary, God; You are called the Lover of Your devotees.

984.g: ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੁ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਨਾਖਿ ਪਕਰਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਓ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
984.t: prahilaadh jan haranaakh pakariaa har raakh leeo taraiaa ||2||
984.e: Prahlaad, Your humble servant, was caught by Harnaakhash; but You saved Him and carried him across, Lord. ||2||

984.g: ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਵਣ ਸਭ ਦੂਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
984.t: har chet re man mahal paavan sabh dhookh bha(n)jan raiaa ||
984.e: Remember the Lord, O mind, and rise up to the Mansion of His Presence; the Sovereign Lord is the Destroyer of pain.

984.g: ਭਉ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
984.t: bhau janam maran nivaar Thaakur har gurmatee prabh paiaa ||3||
984.e: Our Lord and Master takes away the fear of birth and death; following the Guru's Teachings, the Lord God is found. ||3||

984.g: ਹਰਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਭਉ ਭਗਤ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
984.t: har patit paavan naam suaamee bhau bhagat bha(n)jan gaiaa ||
984.e: The Name of the Lord, our Lord and Master, is the Purifier of sinners; I sing of the Lord, the Destroyer of the fears of His devotees.

984.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਾਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
984.t: har haar har ur dhaario jan naanak naam samaiaa ||4||1||
984.e: One who wears the necklace of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in his heart, O servant Nanak, merges in the Naam. ||4||1||

984.g: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
984.t: maalee gauRaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
984.e: Maalee Gauraa, Fourth Mehla:

984.g: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
984.t: jap man raam naam sukhadhaataa ||
984.e: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, the Giver of peace.

984.g: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
984.t: satasa(n)gat mil har saadh aaiaa gurmukh braham pachhaataa ||1|| rahaau ||
984.e: One who joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and enjoys the sublime taste of the Lord, as Gurmukh, comes to realize God. ||1||Pause||

984.g: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
984.t: vaddabhaagee gur dharasan paiaa gur miliaai har prabh jaataa ||
984.e: By great good fortune, one obtains the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan; meeting with the Guru, the Lord God is known.

984.g: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਈ ਸਭ ਨੀਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
984.t: dhuramat mail giee sabh neekar har a(n)mirat har sar naataa ||1||
984.e: The filth of evil-mindedness is totally washed away, bathing in the Lord's ambrosial pool of nectar. ||1||

984.g: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਧੁ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਪੂਛਉ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਬਾਤਾ ॥
984.t: dhan dhan saadh jin(h)ee har prabh paiaa tin(h) poochhau har kee baataa ||
984.e: Blessed, blessed are the Holy, who have found their Lord God; I ask them to tell me the stories of the Lord.

984.g: ਪਾਇ ਲਗਉ ਨਿਤ ਕਰਉ ਜੁਦਰੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਕਰਮਿ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥੨॥
984.t: pai lagau nit karau judhareeaa har melahu karam bidhaataa ||2||
984.e: I fall at their feet, and always pray to them, to mercifully unite me with my Lord, the Architect of Destiny. ||2||

984.g: ਲਿਲਾਟ ਲਿਖੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
984.t: lilaaT likhe paiaa gur saadhoo gur bachanee man tan raataa ||
984.e: Through the destiny written on my forehead, I have found the Holy Guru; my mind and body are imbued with the Guru's Word.

984.g: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਭ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਗਵਾਤਾ ॥੩॥
984.t: har prabh aai mile sukh paiaa sabh kilavikh paap gavaataa ||3||
984.e: The Lord God has come to meet me; I have found peace, and I am rid of all the sins. ||3||

984.g: ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਜਿਨੑ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਊਤਮ ਬਾਤਾ ॥
984.t: raam rasain jin(h) gurmat paiaa tin(h) kee uootam baataa ||
984.e: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings find the Lord, the source of nectar; their words are sublime and exalted.

984.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਪੰਕ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਚਰਨਿ ਪਰਾਤਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
984.t: tin kee pa(n)k paieeaai vaddabhaagee jan naanak charan paraataa ||4||2||
984.e: By great good fortune, one is blessed with the dust of their feet; servant Nanak falls at their feet. ||4||2||

985.g: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
985.t: maalee gauRaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
985.e: Maalee Gauraa, Fourth Mehla:

985.g: ਸਭਿ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਓ ॥
985.t: sabh sidh saadhik mun janaa man bhaavanee har dhiaaio ||
985.e: All the Siddhas, seekers and silent sages, with their minds full of love, meditate on the Lord.

985.g: ਅਪਰੰਪਰੋ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਲਖਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
985.t: apara(n)paro paarabraham suaamee har alakh guroo lakhaio ||1|| rahaau ||
985.e: The Supreme Lord God, my Lord and Master, is limitless; the Guru has inspired me to know the unknowable Lord. ||1||Pause||

985.g: ਹਮ ਨੀਚ ਮਧਿਮ ਕਰਮ ਕੀਏ ਨਹੀ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਓ ॥
985.t: ham neech madhim karam ke'ee nahee chetio har raio ||
985.e: I am low, and I commit evil actions; I have not remembered my Sovereign Lord.

985.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਨਿ ਮੇਲਿਓ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਖਿਨੁ ਬੰਧ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
985.t: har aan melio satiguroo khin ba(n)dh mukat karaio ||1||
985.e: The Lord has led me to meet the True Guru; in an instant, He liberated me from bondage. ||1||

985.g: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮਸਤਕੇ ਧੁਰਿ ਲੀਖਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇਓ ॥
985.t: prabh masatake dhur leekhiaa gurmatee har liv laio ||
985.e: Such is the destiny God wrote on my forehead; following the Guru's Teachings, I enshrine love for the Lord.

985.g: ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦ ਦਰਗਹ ਬਾਜਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
985.t: pa(n)ch sabadh dharageh baajiaa har milio ma(n)gal gaio ||2||
985.e: The Panch Shabad, the five primal sounds, vibrate and resound in the Court of the Lord; meeting the Lord, I sing the songs of joy. ||2||

985.g: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਰਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਭਾਗੀਆਂ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਇਓ ॥
985.t: patit paavan naam narahar ma(n)dhabhaageeaa(n) nahee bhaio ||
985.e: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Purifier of sinners; the unfortunate wretches do not like this.

985.g: ਤੇ ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨੀ ਗਾਲੀਅਹਿ ਜਿਉ ਲੋਨੁ ਜਲਹਿ ਗਲਾਇਓ ॥੩॥
985.t: te garabh jonee gaale'eeh jiau lon jaleh galaio ||3||
985.e: They rot away in the womb of reincarnation; they fall apart like salt in water. ||3||

985.g: ਮਤਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਗਮ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਮਨੁ ਮੈ ਲਾਇਓ ॥
985.t: mat dheh har prabh agam Thaakur gur charan man mai laio ||
985.e: Please bless me with such understanding, O Inaccessible Lord God, my Lord and Master, that my mind may remain attached to the Guru's feet.

985.g: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੈ ਰਹਉ ਲਾਗੋ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਓ ॥੪॥੩॥
985.t: har raam naamai rahau laago jan naanak naam samaio ||4||3||
985.e: Servant Nanak remains attached to the Name of the Lord; he is merged in the Naam. ||4||3||

985.g: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
985.t: maalee gauRaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
985.e: Maalee Gauraa, Fourth Mehla:

985.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਸਿ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
985.t: meraa man raam naam ras laagaa ||
985.e: My mind is addicted to the juice of the Lord's Name.

985.g: ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਭਇਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
985.t: kamal pragaas bhiaa gur paiaa har japio bhram bhau bhaagaa ||1|| rahaau ||
985.e: My heart-lotus has blossomed forth, and I have found the Guru. Meditating on the Lord, my doubts and fears have run away. ||1||Pause||

985.g: ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਲਾਗੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਹੀਅਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਸੋਇਓ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਗਾ ॥
985.t: bhai bhai bhagat laago meraa heearaa man soio gurmat jaagaa ||
985.e: In the Fear of God, my heart is committed in loving devotion to Him; following the Guru's Teachings, my sleeping mind has awakened.

985.g: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਖੀਨ ਭਏ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਵਡਭਾਗਾ ॥੧॥
985.t: kilabikh kheen bhe saa(n)t aaiee har ur dhaario vaddabhaagaa ||1||
985.e: All my sins have been erased, and I have found peace and tranquility; I have enshrined the Lord within my heart, by great good fortune. ||1||

985.g: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭੁ ਹੈ ਕਚੂਆ ਜਿਉ ਕੁਸਮ ਚਾਰਿ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਗਾ ॥
985.t: manmukh ra(n)g kasu(n)bh hai kachooaa jiau kusam chaar dhin chaagaa ||
985.e: The self-willed manmukh is like the false color of the safflower, which fades away; its color lasts for only a few days.

985.g: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਪਰਤਾਪੈ ਡੰਡੁ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕਾ ਲਾਗਾ ॥੨॥
985.t: khin meh binas jai parataapai dda(n)dd dharam rai kaa laagaa ||2||
985.e: He perishes in an instant; he is tormented, and punished by the Righteous Judge of Dharma. ||2||

985.g: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਅਤਿ ਗੂੜੀ ਜਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਜੀਠ ਬਹੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
985.t: satasa(n)gat preet saadh at gooRee jiau ra(n)g majeeTh bahu laagaa ||
985.e: The Lord's Love, found in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, is absolutely permanent, and colorfast.

985.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਾਪਰੁ ਚੀਰ ਬਹੁ ਫਾਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਲਹੈ ਸਭਾਗਾ ॥੩॥
985.t: kaiaa kaapar cheer bahu faare har ra(n)g na lahai sabhaagaa ||3||
985.e: The cloth of the body may be torn to shreds, but still, this beautiful color of the Lord's Love does not fade away. ||3||

985.g: ਹਰਿ ਚਾਰ੍ਹਿਓ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੈ ਰਾਂਗਾ ॥
985.t: har chaariho ra(n)g milai gur sobhaa har ra(n)g chaloolai raa(n)gaa ||
985.e: Meeting with the Blessed Guru, one is dyed in the color of the Lord's Love, imbued with this deep crimson color.

985.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਰੈ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨੀ ਜਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥੪॥੪॥
985.t: jan naanak tin ke charan pakhaarai jo har charanee jan laagaa ||4||4||
985.e: Servant Nanak washes the feet of that humble being, who is attached to the feet of the Lord. ||4||4||

985.g: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
985.t: maalee gauRaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
985.e: Maalee Gauraa, Fourth Mehla:

985.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਭਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਪਾਲਾ ॥
985.t: mere man bhaj har har naam gupaalaa ||
985.e: O my mind, meditate, vibrate upon the Name of the Lord, the Lord of the World, Har, Har.

985.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਲੀਨੁ ਭਇਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੈ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
985.t: meraa man tan leen bhiaa raam naamai mat gurmat raam rasaalaa ||1|| rahaau ||
985.e: My mind and body are merged in the Lord's Name, and through the Guru's Teachings, my intellect is imbued with the Lord, the source of nectar. ||1||Pause||

985.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਮਾਲਾ ॥
985.t: gurmat naam dhiaaieeaai har har man japeeaai har japamaalaa ||
985.e: Follow the Guru's Teachings, and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. Chant, and meditate, on the beads of the mala of the Lord.

985.g: ਜਿਨੑ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੀਖਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਬਨਮਾਲਾ ॥੧॥
985.t: jin(h) kai masatak leekhiaa har miliaa har banamaalaa ||1||
985.e: Those who have such destiny inscribed upon their foreheads, meet with the Lord, adorned with garlands of flowers. ||1||

985.g: ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਚੂਕੇ ਸਰਬ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ ॥
985.t: jin(h) har naam dhiaaiaa tin(h) chooke sarab ja(n)jaalaa ||
985.e: Those who meditate on the Name of the Lord - all their entanglements are ended.

985.g: ਤਿਨੑ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥੨॥
985.t: tin(h) jam neR na aaviee gur raakhe har rakhavaalaa ||2||
985.e: The Messenger of Death does not even approach them; the Guru, the Savior Lord, saves them. ||2||

985.g: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੂ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
985.t: ham baarik kichhoo na jaanahoo har maat pitaa pratipaalaa ||
985.e: I am a child; I know nothing at all. The Lord cherishes me, as my mother and father.

985.g: ਕਰੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਅਗਨਿ ਨਿਤ ਮੇਲਤੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥੩॥
985.t: kar maiaa agan nit melate gur raakhe dheen dhiaalaa ||3||
985.e: I continually put my hands into the fire of Maya, but the Guru saves me; He is merciful to the meek. ||3||

985.g: ਬਹੁ ਮੈਲੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਇਆ ਸਭ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਹਰਿ ਜਸਿ ਜਾਲਾ ॥
985.t: bahu maile niramal hoiaa sabh kilabikh har jas jaalaa ||
985.e: I was filthy, but I have become immaculate. Singing the Lord's Praises, all sins have been burnt to ashes.

985.g: ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥੪॥੫॥
985.t: man anadh bhiaa gur paiaa jan naanak sabadh nihaalaa ||4||5||
985.e: My mind is in esctasy, having found the Guru; servant Nanak is enraptured through the Word of the Shabad. ||4||5||

985.g: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
985.t: maalee gauRaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
985.e: Maalee Gauraa, Fourth Mehla:

986.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਸਭ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟ ॥
986.t: mere man har bhaj sabh kilabikh kaaT ||
986.e: O my mind, meditate, vibrate on the Lord, and all sins will be eradicated.

986.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੀਸੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਗੁਰ ਵਾਟ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
986.t: har har ur dhaario gur poorai meraa sees keejai gur vaaT ||1|| rahaau ||
986.e: The Guru has enshried the Lord, Har, Har, within my heart; I place my head on the Guru's Path. ||1||Pause||

986.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਮੈ ਬਾਤ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਵਉ ਕਟਿ ਕਾਟ ॥
986.t: mere har prabh kee mai baat sunaavai tis man dhevau kaT kaaT ||
986.e: Whoever tells me the stories of my Lord God, I would cut my mind into slices, and dedicate it to him.

986.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੇਲਿਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਬਿਕਾਨੋ ਹਟਿ ਹਾਟ ॥੧॥
986.t: har saajan melio gur poorai gur bachan bikaano haT haaT ||1||
986.e: The Perfect Guru has united me with the Lord, my Friend; I have sold myself at each and every store for the Guru's Word. ||1||

986.g: ਮਕਰ ਪ੍ਰਾਗਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਆ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਦੀਓ ਅਧ ਕਾਟਿ ॥
986.t: makar praag dhaan bahu keeaa sareer dheeo adh kaaT ||
986.e: One may give donations in charity at Prayaag, and cut the body in two at Benares,

986.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕੋ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਬਹੁ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਕਟਿ ਕਾਟ ॥੨॥
986.t: bin har naam ko mukat na paavai bahu ka(n)chan dheejai kaT kaaT ||2||
986.e: but without the Lord's Name, no one attains liberation, even though one may give away huge amounts of gold. ||2||

986.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਓ ਮਨਿ ਉਘਰੇ ਕਪਟ ਕਪਾਟ ॥
986.t: har keerat gurmat jas gaio man ughare kapaT kapaaT ||
986.e: When one follows the Guru's Teachings, and sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, the doors of the mind, held shut by deception, are thrown open again.

986.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਫੋਰਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ਲਜ ਭਾਨੀ ਮਟੁਕੀ ਮਾਟ ॥੩॥
986.t: tirakuTee for bharam bhau bhaagaa laj bhaanee maTukee maaT ||3||
986.e: The three qualities are shattered, doubt and fear run away, and the clay pot of public opinion is broken. ||3||

986.g: ਕਲਜੁਗਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖੇ ਲਿਲਾਟ ॥
986.t: kalajug gur pooraa tin paiaa jin dhur masatak likhe lilaaT ||
986.e: They alone find the Perfect Guru in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, upon whose foreheads such pre-ordained destiny is inscribed.

986.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ਸਭ ਲਾਥੀ ਭੂਖ ਤਿਖਾਟ ॥੪॥੬॥
986.t: jan naanak ras a(n)mrit peeaa sabh laathee bhookh tikhaaT ||4||6||
986.e: Servant Nanak drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar; all his hunger and thirst are quenched. ||4||6||
Set of Six Hymns 1||
Maalee Gauraa, Fifth Mehla:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

986.g: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਟਹਲ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰ ॥
986.t: re man Tahal har sukh saar ||
986.e: O mind, true peace comes from serving the Lord.

986.g: ਅਵਰ ਟਹਲਾ ਝੂਠੀਆ ਨਿਤ ਕਰੈ ਜਮੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
986.t: avar Tahalaa jhooTheeaa nit karai jam sir maar ||1|| rahaau ||
986.e: Other services are false, and as punishment for them, the Messenger of Death bashes in one's head. ||1||Pause||

986.g: ਜਿਨਾ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੀਖਿਆ ਤੇ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੰਗਾਰ ॥
986.t: jinaa masatak leekhiaa te mile sa(n)gaar ||
986.e: They alone join the Sangat, the Congregation, upon whose forehead such destiny is inscribed.

986.g: ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਾਰਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੧॥
986.t: sa(n)saar bhaujal taariaa har sa(n)t purakh apaar ||1||
986.e: They are carried across the terrifying world-ocean by the Saints of the Infinite, Primal Lord God. ||1||

986.g: ਨਿਤ ਚਰਨ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸਾਧ ਕੇ ਤਜਿ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
986.t: nit charan sevahu saadh ke taj lobh moh bikaar ||
986.e: Serve forever at the feet of the Holy; renounce greed, emotional attachment and corruption.

986.g: ਸਭ ਤਜਹੁ ਦੂਜੀ ਆਸੜੀ ਰਖੁ ਆਸ ਇਕ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥੨॥
986.t: sabh tajahu dhoojee aasaRee rakh aas ik nira(n)kaar ||2||
986.e: Abandon all other hopes, and rest your hopes in the One Formless Lord. ||2||

986.g: ਇਕਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਸਾਕਤਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਧ ਅੰਧਾਰ ॥
986.t: eik bharam bhoole saakataa bin gur a(n)dh a(n)dhaar ||
986.e: Some are faithless cynics, deluded by doubt; without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness.

986.g: ਧੁਰਿ ਹੋਵਨਾ ਸੁ ਹੋਇਆ ਕੋ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰ ॥੩॥
986.t: dhur hovanaa su hoiaa ko na meTanahaar ||3||
986.e: Whatever is pre-ordained, comes to pass; no one can erase it. ||3||

986.g: ਅਗਮ ਰੂਪੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕਾ ਅਨਿਕ ਨਾਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
986.t: agam roop gobi(n)dh kaa anik naam apaar ||
986.e: The beauty of the Lord of the Universe is profound and unfathomable; the Names of the Infinite Lord are immunerable.

986.g: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰ ॥੪॥੧॥
986.t: dhan dha(n)n te jan naanakaa jin har naamaa ur dhaar ||4||1||
986.e: Blessed, blessed are those humble beings, O Nanak, who enshrine the Lord's Name in their hearts. ||4||1||
Maalee Gauraa, Fifth Mehla:
I humbly bow to the Name of the Lord.
Chanting it, one is saved. ||1||Pause||
Meditating on Him in remembrance, conflicts are ended.
Meditating on Him, one's bonds are untied.
Meditating on Him, the fool becomes wise.
Meditating on Him, one's ancestors are saved. ||1||

986.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਭਉ ਦੁਖ ਹਰੈ ॥
986.t: jaa kai simaran bhau dhukh harai ||
986.e: Meditating on Him, fear and pain are taken away.
Meditating on Him, misfortune is avoided.
Meditating on Him, sins are erased.
Meditating on Him, agony is ended. ||2||
Meditating on Him, the heart blossoms forth.
Meditating on Him, Maya becomes one's slave.
Meditating on Him, one is blessed with the treasures of wealth.
Meditating on Him, one crosses over in the end. ||3||
The Name of the Lord is the Purifier of sinners.
It saves millions of devotees.
I am meek; I seek the Sanctuary of the slaves of the Lord's slaves.
Nanak lays his forehead on the feet of the Saints. ||4||2||
Maalee Gauraa, Fifth Mehla:
This is the sort of helper the Name of the Lord is.
Meditating in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one's affairs are perfectly resolved. ||1||Pause||
It is like a boat to a drowning man.

987.e: It is like oil to the lamp whose flame is dying out.
It is like water poured on the burning fire.
It is like milk poured into the baby's mouth. ||1||
As one's brother becomes a helper on the field of battle;
as one's hunger is satisfied by food;
as the cloudburst saves the crops;
as one is protected in the tiger's lair;||2||
As with the magic spell of Garuda the eagle upon one's lips, one does not fear the snake;
as the cat cannot eat the parrot in its cage;
as the bird cherishes her eggs in her heart;
as the grains are spared, by sticking to the central post of the mill;||3||
Your Glory is so great; I can describe only a tiny bit of it.
O Lord, You are inaccessible, unapproachable and unfathomable.
You are lofty and high, utterly great and infinite.
Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, O Nanak, one is carried across. ||4||3||
Maalee Gauraa, Fifth Mehla:
Please let my works be rewarding and fruitful.

987.g: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਲੇਹੁ ਨਿਵਾਜਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
987.t: apune dhaas kau leh nivaaj ||1|| rahaau ||
987.e: Please cherish and exalt Your slave. ||1||Pause||
I lay my forehead on the feet of the Saints,
and with my eyes, I gaze upon the Blessed Vision of their Darshan, day and night.
With my hands, I work for the Saints.
I dedicate my breath of life, my mind and wealth to the Saints. ||1||
My mind loves the Society of the Saints.
The Virtues of the Saints abide within my consciousness.
The Will of the Saints is sweet to my mind.
Seeing the Saints, my heart-lotus blossoms forth. ||2||
I dwell in the Society of the Saints.
I have such a great thirst for the Saints.
The Words of the Saints are the Mantras of my mind.
By the Grace of the Saints, my corruption is taken away. ||3||
This way of liberation is my treasure.
O Merciful God, please bless me with this gift.
O God, shower Your Mercy upon Nanak.

987.g: ਚਰਨ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਿਦੇ ਮਝਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੪॥
987.t: charan sa(n)tan ke mere ridhe majhaar ||4||4||
987.e: I have enshrined the feet of the Saints within my heart. ||4||4||
Maalee Gauraa, Fifth Mehla:
He is with all; He is not far away.
He is the Cause of causes, ever-present here and now. ||1||Pause||
Hearing His Name, one comes to life.
Pain is dispelled; peace and tranquility come to dwell within.
The Lord, Har, Har, is all treasure.

987.g: ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੇ ॥੧॥
987.t: mun jan taa kee sev kare ||1||
987.e: The silent sages serve Him. ||1||
Everything is contained in His home.
No one is turned away empty-handed.
He cherishes all beings and creatures.
Forever and ever, serve the Merciful Lord. ||2||
Righteous justice is dispensed in His Court forever.
He is carefree, and owes allegiance to no one.
He Himself, by Himself, does everything.

987.g: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੩॥
987.t: re man mere too taa kau jaap ||3||
987.e: O my mind, meditate on Him. ||3||
I am a sacrifice to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
Joining them, I am saved.
My mind and body are attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
God has blessed Nanak with this gift. ||4||5||
Maalee Gauraa, Fifth Mehla, Dho-Padhay:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
I seek the Sanctuary of the all-powerful Lord.

987.g: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕ ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
987.t: jeeau pi(n)dd dhan raas meree prabh ek kaaran karanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
987.e: My soul, body, wealth and capital belong to the One God, the Cause of causes. ||1||Pause||

987.g: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੀਵਣੈ ਕਾ ਮੂਲੁ ॥
987.t: simar simar sadhaa sukh paieeaai jeevanai kaa mool ||
987.e: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on Him, I have found everlasting peace. He is the source of life.

987.g: ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬਤ ਠਾਈ ਸੂਖਮੋ ਅਸਥੂਲ ॥੧॥
987.t: rav rahiaa sarabat Thaiee sookhamo asathool ||1||
987.e: He is all-pervading, permeating all places; He is in subtle essence and manifest form. ||1||

988.g: ਆਲ ਜਾਲ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਤਜਿ ਸਭਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨਾ ਨਿਤਿ ਗਾਉ ॥
988.t: aal jaal bikaar taj sabh har gunaa nit gaau ||
988.e: Abandon all your entanglements and corruption; sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord forever.

988.g: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਦੇਹੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥੧॥੬॥
988.t: kar joR naanak dhaan maa(n)gai dheh apanaa naau ||2||1||6||
988.e: With palms pressed together, Nanak begs for this blessing; please bless me with Your Name. ||2||1||6||

988.g: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
988.t: maalee gauRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
988.e: Maalee Gauraa, Fifth Mehla:

988.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਮਰਥ ਦੇਵ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
988.t: prabh samarath dhev apaar ||
988.e: God is all-powerful, divine and infinite.

988.g: ਕਉਨੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਚਲਿਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
988.t: kaun jaanai chalit tere kichh a(n)t naahee paar ||1|| rahaau ||
988.e: Who knows Your wondrous plays? You have no end or limitation. ||1||Pause||

988.g: ਇਕ ਖਿਨਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਦਾ ਘੜਿ ਭੰਨਿ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੁ ॥
988.t: eik khineh thaap uthaapadhaa ghaR bha(n)n karanaihaar ||
988.e: In an instant, You establish and disestablish; You create and destroy, O Creator Lord.

988.g: ਜੇਤ ਕੀਨ ਉਪਾਰਜਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਦਾਤਾਰ ॥੧॥
988.t: jet keen upaarajanaa prabh dhaan dhei dhaataar ||1||
988.e: As many beings as You created, God, so many You bless with Your blessings. ||1||

988.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਆਇਓ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਊਚ ਅਗਮ ਮੁਰਾਰ ॥
988.t: har saran aaio dhaas teraa prabh uooch agam muraar ||
988.e: I have come to Your Sanctuary, Lord; I am Your slave, O Inaccessible Lord God.

988.g: ਕਢਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਭਉਜਲ ਬਿਖਮ ਤੇ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥੨॥੨॥੭॥
988.t: kadd leh bhaujal bikham te jan naanak sadh balihaar ||2||2||7||
988.e: Lift me up and pull me out of the terrifying, treacherous world-ocean; servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You. ||2||2||7||

988.g: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
988.t: maalee gauRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
988.e: Maalee Gauraa, Fifth Mehla:

988.g: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਸਿ ਰਹੇ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
988.t: man tan bas rahe gopaal ||
988.e: The Lord of the World abides in my mind and body.

988.g: ਦੀਨ ਬਾਂਧਵ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
988.t: dheen baa(n)dhav bhagat vachhal sadhaa sadhaa kirapaal ||1|| rahaau ||
988.e: Friend of the meek, Lover of His devotees, forever and ever merciful. ||1||Pause||

988.g: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤੇ ਮਧਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
988.t: aadh a(n)te madh toohai prabh binaa naahee koi ||
988.e: In the beginning, in the end and in the middle, You alone exist, God; there is none other than You.

988.g: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਮੰਡਲ ਏਕੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
988.t: poor rahiaa sagal ma(n)ddal ek suaamee soi ||1||
988.e: He is totally permeating and pervading all worlds; He is the One and only Lord and Master. ||1||

988.g: ਕਰਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਰਸਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥
988.t: karan har jas netr dharasan rasan har gun gaau ||
988.e: With my ears I hear God's Praises, and with my eyes I behold the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; with my tongue I sing the Lord's Glorious Praises.

988.g: ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿ ਜਾਏ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥੩॥੮॥੬॥੧੪॥
988.t: balihaar jaae sadhaa naanak dheh apanaa naau ||2||3||8||6||14||
988.e: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You; please, bless me with Your Name. ||2||3||8||6||14||

988.g: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਜੀ ਕੀ
988.t: maalee gauRaa baanee bhagat naamadhev jee kee
988.e: Maalee Gauraa, The Word Of Devotee Naam Dayv Jee:

988.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
988.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
988.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

988.g: ਧਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਓ ਰਾਮ ਬੇਨੁ ਬਾਜੈ ॥
988.t: dhan dha(n)n o raam ben baajai ||
988.e: Blessed, blessed is that flute which the Lord plays.

988.g: ਮਧੁਰ ਮਧੁਰ ਧੁਨਿ ਅਨਹਤ ਗਾਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
988.t: madhur madhur dhun anahat gaajai ||1|| rahaau ||
988.e: The sweet, sweet unstruck sound current sings forth. ||1||Pause||

988.g: ਧਨਿ ਧਨਿ ਮੇਘਾ ਰੋਮਾਵਲੀ ॥
988.t: dhan dhan meghaa romaavalee ||
988.e: Blessed, blessed is the wool of the sheep;

988.g: ਧਨਿ ਧਨਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਓਢੈ ਕਾਂਬਲੀ ॥੧॥
988.t: dhan dhan kirasan oddai kaa(n)balee ||1||
988.e: blessed, blessed is the blanket worn by Krishna. ||1||

988.g: ਧਨਿ ਧਨਿ ਤੂ ਮਾਤਾ ਦੇਵਕੀ ॥
988.t: dhan dhan too maataa dhevakee ||
988.e: Blessed, blessed are you, O mother Dayvakee;

988.g: ਜਿਹ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਰਮਈਆ ਕਵਲਾਪਤੀ ॥੨॥
988.t: jeh gireh ramieeaa kavalaapatee ||2||
988.e: into your home the Lord was born. ||2||

988.g: ਧਨਿ ਧਨਿ ਬਨ ਖੰਡ ਬਿੰਦ੍ਰਾਬਨਾ ॥
988.t: dhan dhan ban kha(n)dd bi(n)dhraabanaa ||
988.e: Blessed, blessed are the forests of Brindaaban;

988.g: ਜਹ ਖੇਲੈ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਨਾਰਾਇਨਾ ॥੩॥
988.t: jeh khelai sree naarainaa ||3||
988.e: the Supreme Lord plays there. ||3||

988.g: ਬੇਨੁ ਬਜਾਵੈ ਗੋਧਨੁ ਚਰੈ ॥
988.t: ben bajaavai godhan charai ||
988.e: He plays the flute, and herds the cows;

988.g: ਨਾਮੇ ਕਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਨਦ ਕਰੈ ॥੪॥੧॥
988.t: naame kaa suaamee aanadh karai ||4||1||
988.e: Naam Dayv's Lord and Master plays happily. ||4||1||

988.g: ਮੇਰੋ ਬਾਪੁ ਮਾਧਉ ਤੂ ਧਨੁ ਕੇਸੌ ਸਾਂਵਲੀਓ ਬੀਠੁਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
988.t: mero baap maadhau too dhan kesau saa(n)valeeo beeThulai ||1|| rahaau ||
988.e: O my Father, Lord of wealth, blessed are You, long-haired, dark-skinned, my darling. ||1||Pause||

988.g: ਕਰ ਧਰੇ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਤੇ ਆਏ ਗਜ ਹਸਤੀ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਉਧਾਰੀਅਲੇ ॥
988.t: kar dhare chakar baiku(n)Th te aae gaj hasatee ke praan udhaareeale ||
988.e: You hold the steel chakra in Your hand; You came down from Heaven, and saved the life of the elephant.

988.g: ਦੁਹਸਾਸਨ ਕੀ ਸਭਾ ਦ੍ਰੋਪਤੀ ਅੰਬਰ ਲੇਤ ਉਬਾਰੀਅਲੇ ॥੧॥
988.t: dhuhasaasan kee sabhaa dhropatee a(n)bar let ubaareeale ||1||
988.e: In the court of Duhsaasan, You saved the honor of Dropati, when her clothes were being removed. ||1||

988.g: ਗੋਤਮ ਨਾਰਿ ਅਹਲਿਆ ਤਾਰੀ ਪਾਵਨ ਕੇਤਕ ਤਾਰੀਅਲੇ ॥
988.t: gotam naar ahaliaa taaree paavan ketak taareeale ||
988.e: You saved Ahliyaa, the wife of Gautam; how many have You purified and carried across?

988.g: ਐਸਾ ਅਧਮੁ ਅਜਾਤਿ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਤਉ ਸਰਨਾਗਤਿ ਆਈਅਲੇ ॥੨॥੨॥
988.t: aaisaa adham ajaat naamadheau tau saranaagat aaieeale ||2||2||
988.e: Such a lowly outcaste as Naam Dayv has come seeking Your Sanctuary. ||2||2||

988.g: ਸਭੈ ਘਟ ਰਾਮੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਰਾਮਾ ਬੋਲੈ ॥
988.t: sabhai ghaT raam bolai raamaa bolai ||
988.e: Within all hearts, the Lord speaks, the Lord speaks.

988.g: ਰਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
988.t: raam binaa ko bolai re ||1|| rahaau ||
988.e: Who else speaks, other than the Lord? ||1||Pause||

988.g: ਏਕਲ ਮਾਟੀ ਕੁੰਜਰ ਚੀਟੀ ਭਾਜਨ ਹੈਂ ਬਹੁ ਨਾਨਾ ਰੇ ॥
988.t: ekal maaTee ku(n)jar cheeTee bhaajan hai(n) bahu naanaa re ||
988.e: Out of the same clay, the elephant, the ant, and the many sorts of species are formed.

988.g: ਅਸਥਾਵਰ ਜੰਗਮ ਕੀਟ ਪਤੰਗਮ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਨਾ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
988.t: asathaavar ja(n)gam keeT pata(n)gam ghaT ghaT raam samaanaa re ||1||
988.e: In stationary life forms, moving beings, worms, moths and within each and every heart, the Lord is contained. ||1||

988.g: ਏਕਲ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਰਾਖੁ ਅਨੰਤਾ ਅਉਰ ਤਜਹੁ ਸਭ ਆਸਾ ਰੇ ॥
988.t: ekal chi(n)taa raakh ana(n)taa aaur tajahu sabh aasaa re ||
988.e: Remember the One, Infinite Lord; abandon all other hopes.

988.g: ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਨਾਮਾ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਕਾਮਾ ਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕੋ ਦਾਸਾ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੩॥
988.t: pranavai naamaa bhe nihakaamaa ko Thaakur ko dhaasaa re ||2||3||
988.e: Naam Dayv prays, I have become dispassionate and detached; who is the Lord and Master, and who is the slave? ||2||3||

989.t: raag maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ghar pehilaa chaupadhe
989.e: Raag Maaroo, First Mehla, First House, Chau-Padhay:

989.g: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
989.t: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
989.e: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:
Shalok:

989.g: ਸਾਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਚਰਨ ਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਰਹਾ ਸਦ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
989.t: saajan tere charan kee hoi rahaa sadh dhoor ||
989.e: O my Friend, I shall forever remain the dust of Your feet.

989.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੀਆ ਪੇਖਉ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
989.t: naanak saran tuhaareeaa pekhau sadhaa hajoor ||1||
989.e: Nanak seeks Your protection, and beholds You ever-present, here and now. ||1||
Shabad:

989.g: ਪਿਛਹੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਦੜਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਲੇਹਿ ॥
989.t: pichhahu raatee sadhaRaa naam khasam kaa leh ||
989.e: Those who receive the call in the last hours of the night, chant the Name of their Lord and Master.

989.g: ਖੇਮੇ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਸਰਾਇਚੇ ਦਿਸਨਿ ਰਥ ਪੀੜੇ ॥
989.t: kheme chhatr saraiche dhisan rath peeRe ||
989.e: Tents, canopies, pavilions and carriages are prepared and made ready for them.

989.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਸਦਿ ਮਿਲੇ ॥੧॥
989.t: jinee teraa naam dhiaaiaa tin kau sadh mile ||1||
989.e: You send out the call, Lord, to those who meditate on Your Name. ||1||
Father, I am unfortunate, a fraud.

989.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਧਾ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
989.t: naam na paiaa teraa a(n)dhaa bharam bhoolaa man meraa ||1|| rahaau ||
989.e: I have not found Your Name; my mind is blind and deluded by doubt. ||1||Pause||

989.g: ਸਾਦ ਕੀਤੇ ਦੁਖ ਪਰਫੁੜੇ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖੇ ਮਾਇ ॥
989.t: saadh keete dhukh parafuRe poorab likhe mai ||
989.e: I have enjoyed the tastes, and now my pains have come to fruition; such is my pre-ordained destiny, O my mother.

989.g: ਸੁਖ ਥੋੜੇ ਦੁਖ ਅਗਲੇ ਦੂਖੇ ਦੂਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥੨॥
989.t: sukh thoRe dhukh agale dhookhe dhookh vihai ||2||
989.e: Now my joys are few, and my pains are many. In utter agony, I pass my life. ||2||

989.g: ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਵੀਛੁੜੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਮੇਲੁ ॥
989.t: vichhuRiaa kaa kiaa veechhuRai miliaa kaa kiaa mel ||
989.e: What separation could be worse than separation from the Lord? For those who are united with Him, what other union can there be?

989.g: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਖੇਲੁ ॥੩॥
989.t: saahib so saalaaheeaai jin kar dhekhiaa khel ||3||
989.e: Praise the Lord and Master, who, having created this play, beholds it. ||3||

989.g: ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਮੇਲਾਵੜਾ ਇਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਕੀਤੇ ਭੋਗ ॥
989.t: sa(n)jogee melaavaRaa in tan keete bhog ||
989.e: By good destiny, this union comes about; this body enjoys its pleasures.

989.g: ਵਿਜੋਗੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੀ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥੪॥੧॥
989.t: vijogee mil vichhuRe naanak bhee sa(n)jog ||4||1||
989.e: Those who have lost their destiny, suffer separation from this union. O Nanak, they may still be united once again! ||4||1||
Maaroo, First Mehla:
The union of the mother and father brings the body into being.
The Creator inscribes upon it the inscription of its destiny.
According to this inscription, gifts, light and glorious greatness are received.
Joining with Maya, the spiritual consciousness is lost. ||1||
O foolish mind, why are you so proud?
You shall have to arise and depart when it pleases your Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||
Abandon the tastes of the world, and find intuitive peace.
All must abandon their worldly homes; no one remains here forever.
Eat some, and save the rest,
if you are destined to return to the world again. ||2||
He adorns his body and ress in silk robes.
He issues all sorts of commands.
Preparing his comfortable bed, he sleeps.
When he falls into the hands of the Messenger of Death, what good does it do to cry out? ||3||
Household affairs are whirlpools of entanglements, O Siblings of Destiny.

990.g: ਪਾਪ ਪਥਰ ਤਰਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
990.t: paap pathar taran na jaiee ||
990.e: Sin is a stone which does not float.

990.g: ਭਉ ਬੇੜਾ ਜੀਉ ਚੜਾਊ ॥
990.t: bhau beRaa jeeau chaRaauoo ||
990.e: So let the Fear of God be the boat to carry your soul across.

990.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਵੈ ਕਾਹੂ ॥੪॥੨॥
990.t: kahu naanak dhevai kaahoo ||4||2||
990.e: Says Nanak, rare are those who are blessed with this Boat. ||4||2||

990.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
990.t: maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ghar pehilaa ||
990.e: Maaroo, First Mehla, First House:

990.g: ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਸਵਾਣੀ ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਦੁਇ ਲੇਖ ਪਏ ॥
990.t: karanee kaagadh man masavaanee buraa bhalaa dhui lekh pe ||
990.e: Actions are the paper, and the mind is the ink; good and bad are both recorded upon it.

990.g: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਚਲਾਏ ਤਿਉ ਚਲੀਐ ਤਉ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਹੀ ਅੰਤੁ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥
990.t: jiau jiau kirat chalaae tiau chaleeaai tau gun naahee a(n)t hare ||1||
990.e: As their past actions drive them, so are mortals driven. There is no end to Your Glorious Virtues, Lord. ||1||

990.g: ਚਿਤ ਚੇਤਸਿ ਕੀ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਵਰਿਆ ॥
990.t: chit chetas kee nahee baavariaa ||
990.e: Why do you not keep Him in your consciousness, you mad man?

990.g: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਲਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
990.t: har bisarat tere gun galiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
990.e: Forgetting the Lord, your own virtues shall rot away. ||1||Pause||

990.g: ਜਾਲੀ ਰੈਨਿ ਜਾਲੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਹੂਆ ਜੇਤੀ ਘੜੀ ਫਾਹੀ ਤੇਤੀ ॥
990.t: jaalee rain jaal dhin hooaa jetee ghaRee faahee tetee ||
990.e: The night is a net, and the day is a net; there are as many traps as there are moments.

990.g: ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਚੋਗ ਚੁਗਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਫਾਸਹਿ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਮੂੜੇ ਕਵਨ ਗੁਣੀ ॥੨॥
990.t: ras ras chog chugeh nit faaseh chhooTas mooRe kavan gunee ||2||
990.e: With relish and delight, you continually bite at the bait; you are trapped, you fool - how will you ever escape? ||2||

990.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਆਰਣੁ ਮਨੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਲੋਹਾ ਪੰਚ ਅਗਨਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੀ ॥
990.t: kaiaa aaran man vich lohaa pa(n)ch agan tit laag rahee ||
990.e: The body is a furnace, and the mind is the iron within it; the five fires are heating it.

990.g: ਕੋਇਲੇ ਪਾਪ ਪੜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਊਪਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਜਲਿਆ ਸੰਨੑੀ ਚਿੰਤ ਭਈ ॥੩॥
990.t: koile paap paRe tis uoopar man jaliaa sa(n)n(h)ee chi(n)t bhiee ||3||
990.e: Sin is the charcoal placed upon it, which burns the mind; the tongs are anxiety and worry. ||3||

990.g: ਭਇਆ ਮਨੂਰੁ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਨੇਹਾ ॥
990.t: bhiaa manoor ka(n)chan fir hovai je gur milai tinehaa ||
990.e: What was turned to slag is again transformed into gold, if one meets with the Guru.

990.g: ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਓਹੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਟਸਿ ਦੇਹਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
990.t: ek naam a(n)mrit oh dhevai tau naanak tirasaTas dhehaa ||4||3||
990.e: He blesses the mortal with the Ambrosial Name of the One Lord, and then, O Nanak, the body is held steady. ||4||3||

990.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
990.t: maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ||
990.e: Maaroo, First Mehla:

990.g: ਬਿਮਲ ਮਝਾਰਿ ਬਸਸਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਲ ਪਦਮਨਿ ਜਾਵਲ ਰੇ ॥
990.t: bimal majhaar basas niramal jal padhaman jaaval re ||
990.e: In the pure, immaculate waters, both the lotus and the slimy scum are found.

990.g: ਪਦਮਨਿ ਜਾਵਲ ਜਲ ਰਸ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਦੋਖ ਨਹੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
990.t: padhaman jaaval jal ras sa(n)gat sa(n)g dhokh nahee re ||1||
990.e: The lotus flower is with the scum and the water, but it remains untouched by any pollution. ||1||

990.g: ਦਾਦਰ ਤੂ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਨਸਿ ਰੇ ॥
990.t: dhaadhar too kabeh na jaanas re ||
990.e: You frog, you will never understand.

990.g: ਭਖਸਿ ਸਿਬਾਲੁ ਬਸਸਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਲ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨ ਲਖਸਿ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
990.t: bhakhas sibaal basas niramal jal a(n)mrit na lakhas re ||1|| rahaau ||
990.e: You eat the dirt, while you dwell in the immaculate waters. You know nothing of the ambrosial nectar there. ||1||Pause||

990.g: ਬਸੁ ਜਲ ਨਿਤ ਨ ਵਸਤ ਅਲੀਅਲ ਮੇਰ ਚਚਾ ਗੁਨ ਰੇ ॥
990.t: bas jal nit na vasat aleeal mer chachaa gun re ||
990.e: You dwell continually in the water; the bumble bee does not dwell there, but it is intoxicated with its fragrance from afar.

990.g: ਚੰਦ ਕੁਮੁਦਨੀ ਦੂਰਹੁ ਨਿਵਸਸਿ ਅਨਭਉ ਕਾਰਨਿ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
990.t: cha(n)dh kumudhanee dhoorahu nivasas anabhau kaaran re ||2||
990.e: Intuitively sensing the moon in the distance, the lotus bows its head. ||2||

990.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਖੰਡੁ ਦੂਧਿ ਮਧੁ ਸੰਚਸਿ ਤੂ ਬਨ ਚਾਤੁਰ ਰੇ ॥
990.t: a(n)mirat kha(n)dd dhoodh madh sa(n)chas too ban chaatur re ||
990.e: The realms of nectar are irrigated with milk and honey; you think you are clever to live in the water.

990.g: ਅਪਨਾ ਆਪੁ ਤੂ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਸਿ ਪਿਸਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਜਿਉ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
990.t: apanaa aap too kabahu na chhoddas pisan preet jiau re ||3||
990.e: You can never escape your own inner tendencies, like the love of the flea for blood. ||3||

990.g: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਜਨ ਮੂਰਖ ਆਗਮ ਸਾਸ ਸੁਨੇ ॥
990.t: pa(n)ddit sa(n)g vaseh jan moorakh aagam saas sune ||
990.e: The fool may live with the Pandit, the religious scholar, and listen to the Vedas and the Shaastras.

990.g: ਅਪਨਾ ਆਪੁ ਤੂ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਸਿ ਸੁਆਨ ਪੂਛਿ ਜਿਉ ਰੇ ॥੪॥
990.t: apanaa aap too kabahu na chhoddas suaan poochh jiau re ||4||
990.e: You can never escape your own inner tendencies, like the crooked tail of the dog. ||4||

990.g: ਇਕਿ ਪਾਖੰਡੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਰਾਚਹਿ ਇਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਰੇ ॥
990.t: eik paakha(n)ddee naam na raacheh ik har har charanee re ||
990.e: Some are hypocrites; they do not merge with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Some are absorbed in the Feet of the Lord, Har, Har.

990.g: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਵਸਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਰੇ ॥੫॥੪॥
990.t: poorab likhiaa paavas naanak rasanaa naam jap re ||5||4||
990.e: The mortals obtain what they are predestined to receive; O Nanak, with your tongue, chant the Naam. ||5||4||

990.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
990.t: maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ||
990.e: Maaroo, First Mehla,

990.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
990.t: salok ||
990.e: Shalok:

990.g: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਅਸੰਖ ਹੋਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗ ॥
990.t: patit puneet asa(n)kh hoh har charanee man laag ||
990.e: Countless sinners are sanctified, attaching their minds to the Feet of the Lord.

990.g: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗ ॥੧॥
990.t: aThasaTh teerath naam prabh naanak jis masatak bhaag ||1||
990.e: The merits of the sixty-eight places of pilgrimage are found in God's Name, O Nanak, when such destiny is inscribed upon one's forehead. ||1||

990.g: ਸਬਦੁ ॥
990.t: sabadh ||
990.e: Shabad:

990.g: ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਗਰਬਿ ਗਹੇਲੀ ॥
990.t: sakhee sahelee garab gahelee ||
990.e: O friends and companions, so puffed up with pride,

990.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਹ ਕੀ ਇਕ ਬਾਤ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ॥੧॥
990.t: sun seh kee ik baat suhelee ||1||
990.e: listen to this one joyous story of your Husband Lord. ||1||

990.g: ਜੋ ਮੈ ਬੇਦਨ ਸਾ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖਾ ਮਾਈ ॥
990.t: jo mai bedhan saa kis aakhaa maiee ||
990.e: Who can I tell about my pain, O my mother?

990.g: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਉ ਨ ਰਹੈ ਕੈਸੇ ਰਾਖਾ ਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
990.t: har bin jeeau na rahai kaise raakhaa maiee ||1|| rahaau ||
990.e: Without the Lord, my soul cannot survive; how can I comfort it, O my mother? ||1||Pause||

990.g: ਹਉ ਦੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਖਰੀ ਰੰਞਾਣੀ ॥
990.t: hau dhohaagan kharee ra(n)n(j)aanee ||
990.e: I am a dejected, discarded bride, totally miserable.

990.g: ਗਇਆ ਸੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਧਨ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੀ ॥੨॥
990.t: giaa su joban dhan pachhutaanee ||2||
990.e: I have lost my youth; I regret and repent. ||2||

990.g: ਤੂ ਦਾਨਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
990.t: too dhaanaa saahib sir meraa ||
990.e: You are my wise Lord and Master, above my head.

990.g: ਖਿਜਮਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਜਨੁ ਬੰਦਾ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
990.t: khijamat karee jan ba(n)dhaa teraa ||3||
990.e: I serve You as Your humble slave. ||3||

990.g: ਭਣਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਏਹੀ ॥
990.t: bhanat naanak a(n)dhesaa ehee ||
990.e: Nanak humbly prays, this is my only concern:

990.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੈਸੇ ਰਵਉ ਸਨੇਹੀ ॥੪॥੫॥
990.t: bin dharasan kaise ravau sanehee ||4||5||
990.e: without the Blessed Vision of my Beloved, how can I enjoy Him? ||4||5||

991.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
991.t: maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ||
991.e: Maaroo, First Mehla:

991.g: ਮੁਲ ਖਰੀਦੀ ਲਾਲਾ ਗੋਲਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ਸਭਾਗਾ ॥
991.t: mul khareedhee laalaa golaa meraa naau sabhaagaa ||
991.e: I am Your slave, Your bonded servant, and so I am called fortunate.

991.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਚਨੀ ਹਾਟਿ ਬਿਕਾਨਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥੧॥
991.t: gur kee bachanee haaT bikaanaa jit laiaa tit laagaa ||1||
991.e: I sold myself at Your store in exchange for the Guru's Word; whatever You link me to, to that I am linked. ||1||

991.g: ਤੇਰੇ ਲਾਲੇ ਕਿਆ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
991.t: tere laale kiaa chaturaiee ||
991.e: What cleverness can Your servant try with You?

991.g: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
991.t: saahib kaa hukam na karanaa jaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
991.e: O my Lord and Master, I cannot carry out the Hukam of Your Command. ||1||Pause||

991.g: ਮਾ ਲਾਲੀ ਪਿਉ ਲਾਲਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਉ ਲਾਲੇ ਕਾ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
991.t: maa laalee piau laalaa meraa hau laale kaa jaiaa ||
991.e: My mother is Your slave, and my father is Your slave; I am the child of Your slaves.

991.g: ਲਾਲੀ ਨਾਚੈ ਲਾਲਾ ਗਾਵੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਉ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
991.t: laalee naachai laalaa gaavai bhagat karau teree raiaa ||2||
991.e: My slave mother dances, and my slave father sings; I practice devotional worship to You, O my Sovereign Lord. ||2||

991.g: ਪੀਅਹਿ ਤ ਪਾਣੀ ਆਣੀ ਮੀਰਾ ਖਾਹਿ ਤ ਪੀਸਣ ਜਾਉ ॥
991.t: pe'eeh ta paanee aanee meeraa khaeh ta peesan jaau ||
991.e: If You wish to drink, then I shall get water for You; if You wish to eat, I shall grind the corn for You.

991.g: ਪਖਾ ਫੇਰੀ ਪੈਰ ਮਲੋਵਾ ਜਪਤ ਰਹਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੩॥
991.t: pakhaa feree pair malovaa japat rahaa teraa naau ||3||
991.e: I wave the fan over You, and wash Your feet, and continue to chant Your Name. ||3||

991.g: ਲੂਣ ਹਰਾਮੀ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਲਾਲਾ ਬਖਸਿਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
991.t: loon haraamee naanak laalaa bakhaseh tudh vaddiaaiee ||
991.e: I have been untrue to myself, but Nanak is Your slave; please forgive him, by Your glorious greatness.

991.g: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਦਇਆਪਤਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੬॥
991.t: aadh jugaadh dhiaapat dhaataa tudh vin mukat na paiee ||4||6||
991.e: Since the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages, You have been the merciful and generous Lord. Without You, liberation cannot be attained. ||4||6||

991.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
991.t: maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ||
991.e: Maaroo, First Mehla:

991.g: ਕੋਈ ਆਖੈ ਭੂਤਨਾ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਤਾਲਾ ॥
991.t: koiee aakhai bhootanaa ko kahai betaalaa ||
991.e: Some call him a ghost; some say that he is a demon.

991.g: ਕੋਈ ਆਖੈ ਆਦਮੀ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
991.t: koiee aakhai aadhamee naanak vechaaraa ||1||
991.e: Some call him a mere mortal; O, poor Nanak! ||1||

991.g: ਭਇਆ ਦਿਵਾਨਾ ਸਾਹ ਕਾ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬਉਰਾਨਾ ॥
991.t: bhiaa dhivaanaa saeh kaa naanak bauraanaa ||
991.e: Crazy Nanak has gone insane, after his Lord, the King.

991.g: ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
991.t: hau har bin avar na jaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
991.e: I know of none other than the Lord. ||1||Pause||

991.g: ਤਉ ਦੇਵਾਨਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਭੈ ਦੇਵਾਨਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
991.t: tau dhevaanaa jaaneeaai jaa bhai dhevaanaa hoi ||
991.e: He alone is known to be insane, when he goes insane with the Fear of God.

991.g: ਏਕੀ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
991.t: ekee saahib baaharaa dhoojaa avar na jaanai koi ||2||
991.e: He recognizes none other than the One Lord and Master. ||2||

991.g: ਤਉ ਦੇਵਾਨਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਏਕਾ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
991.t: tau dhevaanaa jaaneeaai jaa ekaa kaar kamai ||
991.e: He alone is known to be insane, if he works for the One Lord.

991.g: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਦੂਜੀ ਅਵਰ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਕਾਇ ॥੩॥
991.t: hukam pachhaanai khasam kaa dhoojee avar siaanap kai ||3||
991.e: Recognizing the Hukam, the Command of his Lord and Master, what other cleverness is there? ||3||

991.g: ਤਉ ਦੇਵਾਨਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
991.t: tau dhevaanaa jaaneeaai jaa saahib dhare piaar ||
991.e: He alone is known to be insane, when he falls in love with his Lord and Master.

991.g: ਮੰਦਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪ ਕਉ ਅਵਰੁ ਭਲਾ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੭॥
991.t: ma(n)dhaa jaanai aap kau avar bhalaa sa(n)saar ||4||7||
991.e: He sees himself as bad, and all the rest of the world as good. ||4||7||

991.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
991.t: maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ||
991.e: Maaroo, First Mehla:

991.g: ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਰਬ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
991.t: eih dhan sarab rahiaa bharapoor ||
991.e: This wealth is all-pervading, permeating all.

991.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਸਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਦੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
991.t: manmukh fireh s jaaneh dhoor ||1||
991.e: The self-willed manmukh wanders around, thinking that it is far away. ||1||

991.g: ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਮਾਰੈ ॥
991.t: so dhan vakhar naam ridhai hamaarai ||
991.e: That commodity, the wealth of the Naam, is within my heart.

991.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
991.t: jis too dheh tisai nisataarai ||1|| rahaau ||
991.e: Whoever You bless with it, is emancipated. ||1||Pause||

991.g: ਨ ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਜਲੈ ਨ ਤਸਕਰੁ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
991.t: n ih dhan jalai na tasakar lai jai ||
991.e: This wealth does not burn; it cannot be stolen by a thief.

991.g: ਨ ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਡੂਬੈ ਨ ਇਸੁ ਧਨ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
991.t: n ih dhan ddoobai na is dhan kau milai sajai ||2||
991.e: This wealth does not drown, and its owner is never punished. ||2||

991.g: ਇਸੁ ਧਨ ਕੀ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
991.t: eis dhan kee dhekhahu vaddiaaiee ||
991.e: Gaze upon the glorious greatness of this wealth,

991.g: ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
991.t: sahaje maate anadhin jaiee ||3||
991.e: and your nights and days will pass, imbued with celestial peace. ||3||

991.g: ਇਕ ਬਾਤ ਅਨੂਪ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਨਰ ਭਾਈ ॥
991.t: eik baat anoop sunahu nar bhaiee ||
991.e: Listen to this incomparably beautiful story, O my brothers, O Siblings of Destiny.

991.g: ਇਸੁ ਧਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥
991.t: eis dhan bin kahahu kinai param gat paiee ||4||
991.e: Tell me, without this wealth, who has ever obtained the supreme status? ||4||

991.g: ਭਣਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਅਕਥ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
991.t: bhanat naanak akath kee kathaa sunaae ||
991.e: Nanak humbly prays, I proclaim the Unspoken Speech of the Lord.

991.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੫॥੮॥
991.t: satigur milai ta ih dhan paae ||5||8||
991.e: If one meets the True Guru, then this wealth is obtained. ||5||8||

991.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
991.t: maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ||
991.e: Maaroo, First Mehla:

991.g: ਸੂਰ ਸਰੁ ਸੋਸਿ ਲੈ ਸੋਮ ਸਰੁ ਪੋਖਿ ਲੈ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਰਤੁ ਸੁ ਸਨਬੰਧੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
991.t: soor sar sos lai som sar pokh lai jugat kar maratu su sanaba(n)dh keejai ||
991.e: Heat up the sun energy of the right nostril, and cool down the moon energy of the left nostril; practicing this breath-control, bring them into perfect balance.

991.g: ਮੀਨ ਕੀ ਚਪਲ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖੀਐ ਉਡੈ ਨਹ ਹੰਸੁ ਨਹ ਕੰਧੁ ਛੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
991.t: meen kee chapal siau jugat man raakheeaai uddai neh ha(n)s neh ka(n)dh chheejai ||1||
991.e: In this way, the fickle fish of the mind will be held steady; the swan-soul shall not fly away, and the body-wall will not crumble. ||1||

991.g: ਮੂੜੇ ਕਾਇਚੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾ ॥
991.t: mooRe kaiche bharam bhulaa ||
991.e: You fool, why are you deluded by doubt?

991.g: ਨਹ ਚੀਨਿਆ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
991.t: neh cheeniaa paramaana(n)dh bairaagee ||1|| rahaau ||
991.e: You do not remember the detached Lord of supreme bliss. ||1||Pause||

991.g: ਅਜਰ ਗਹੁ ਜਾਰਿ ਲੈ ਅਮਰ ਗਹੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਲੈ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਿ ਤਜਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਤਉ ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
991.t: ajar gahu jaar lai amar gahu maar lai bhraat taj chhodd tau apiau peejai ||
991.e: Seize and burn the unbearable; seize and kill the imperishable; leave behind your doubts, and then, you shall drink in the Nectar.

991.g: ਮੀਨ ਕੀ ਚਪਲ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖੀਐ ਉਡੈ ਨਹ ਹੰਸੁ ਨਹ ਕੰਧੁ ਛੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
991.t: meen kee chapal siau jugat man raakheeaai uddai neh ha(n)s neh ka(n)dh chheejai ||2||
991.e: In this way, the fickle fish of the mind will be held steady; the swan-soul shall not fly away, and the body-wall shall not crumble. ||2||

992.g: ਭਣਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਨੋ ਰਵੈ ਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਮਨੋ ਮਨ ਪਵਨ ਸਿਉ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
992.t: bhanat naanak jano ravai je har mano man pavan siau a(n)mrit peejai ||
992.e: Nanak humbly prays, if the Lord's humble servant dwells upon Him, in his mind of minds, with his every breath, then he drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar.

992.g: ਮੀਨ ਕੀ ਚਪਲ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖੀਐ ਉਡੈ ਨਹ ਹੰਸੁ ਨਹ ਕੰਧੁ ਛੀਜੈ ॥੩॥੯॥
992.t: meen kee chapal siau jugat man raakheeaai uddai neh ha(n)s neh ka(n)dh chheejai ||3||9||
992.e: In this way, the fickle fish of the mind will be held steady; the swan-soul shall not fly away, and the body-wall shall not crumble. ||3||9||

992.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
992.t: maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ||
992.e: Maaroo, First Mehla:

992.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੁਈ ਨ ਮਨੁ ਮੁਆ ਸਰੁ ਲਹਰੀ ਮੈ ਮਤੁ ॥
992.t: maiaa muiee na man muaa sar laharee mai mat ||
992.e: Maya is not conquered, and the mind is not subdued; the waves of desire in the world-ocean are intoxicating wine.

992.g: ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਜਲ ਸਿਰਿ ਤਰਿ ਟਿਕੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਵਖਰੁ ਜਿਤੁ ॥
992.t: bohith jal sir tar Tikai saachaa vakhar jit ||
992.e: The boat crosses over the water, carrying the true merchandise.

992.g: ਮਾਣਕੁ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਸੀ ਸਚਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕਤੁ ॥
992.t: maanak man meh man maarasee sach na laagai kat ||
992.e: The jewel within the mind subdues the mind; attached to the Truth, it is not broken.

992.g: ਰਾਜਾ ਤਖਤਿ ਟਿਕੈ ਗੁਣੀ ਭੈ ਪੰਚਾਇਣ ਰਤੁ ॥੧॥
992.t: raajaa takhat Tikai gunee bhai pa(n)chain rat ||1||
992.e: The king is seated upon the throne, imbued with the Fear of God and the five qualities. ||1||

992.g: ਬਾਬਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਦੇਖੁ ॥
992.t: baabaa saachaa saahib dhoor na dhekh ||
992.e: O Baba, do not see your True Lord and Master as being far away.

992.g: ਸਰਬ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਜੀਵਨਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਲੇਖੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
992.t: sarab jot jagajeevanaa sir sir saachaa lekh ||1|| rahaau ||
992.e: He is the Light of all, the Life of the world; The True Lord writes His Inscription on each and every head. ||1||Pause||

992.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਰਿਖੀ ਮੁਨੀ ਸੰਕਰੁ ਇੰਦੁ ਤਪੈ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ॥
992.t: brahamaa bisan rikhee munee sa(n)kar i(n)dh tapai bhekhaaree ||
992.e: Brahma and Vishnu, the Rishis and the silent sages, Shiva and Indra, penitents and beggars

992.g: ਮਾਨੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸੋਹੈ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਆਕੀ ਮਰਹਿ ਅਫਾਰੀ ॥
992.t: maanai hukam sohai dhar saachai aakee mareh afaaree ||
992.e: - whoever obeys the Hukam of the Lord's Command, looks beautiful in the Court of the True Lord, while the stubborn rebels die.

992.g: ਜੰਗਮ ਜੋਧ ਜਤੀ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
992.t: ja(n)gam jodh jatee sa(n)niaasee gur poorai veechaaree ||
992.e: The wandering beggars, warriors, celibates and Sannyaasee hermits - through the Perfect Guru, consider this:

992.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਫਲੁ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਸਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
992.t: bin sevaa fal kabahu na paavas sevaa karanee saaree ||2||
992.e: without selfless service, no one ever receives the fruits of their rewards. Serving the Lord is the most excellent action. ||2||

992.g: ਨਿਧਨਿਆ ਧਨੁ ਨਿਗੁਰਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਿੰਮਾਣਿਆ ਤੂ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
992.t: nidhaniaa dhan niguriaa gur ni(n)maaniaa too maan ||
992.e: You are the wealth of the poor, the Guru of the guru-less, the honor of the dishonored.

992.g: ਅੰਧੁਲੈ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਕੜਿਆ ਨਿਤਾਣਿਆ ਤੂ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
992.t: a(n)dhulai maanak gur pakaRiaa nitaaniaa too taan ||
992.e: I am blind; I have grasped hold of the jewel, the Guru. You are the strength of the weak.

992.g: ਹੋਮ ਜਪਾ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥
992.t: hom japaa nahee jaaniaa gurmatee saach pachhaan ||
992.e: He is not known through burnt offerings and ritual chanting; the True Lord is known through the Guru's Teachings.

992.g: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਦਰਿ ਢੋਈ ਝੂਠਾ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੩॥
992.t: naam binaa naahee dhar ddoiee jhooThaa aavan jaan ||3||
992.e: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, no one finds shelter in the Court of the Lord; the false come and go in reincarnation. ||3||

992.g: ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਸਾਚੇ ਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
992.t: saachaa naam salaaheeaai saache te tirapat hoi ||
992.e: So praise the True Name, and through the True Name, you will find satisfaction.

992.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਜੀਐ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਮੈਲਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
992.t: giaan ratan man maajeeaai bahuR na mailaa hoi ||
992.e: When the mind is cleaned with the jewel of spiritual wisdom, it does not become dirty again.

992.g: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
992.t: jab lag saahib man vasai tab lag bighan na hoi ||
992.e: As long as the Lord and Master dwells in the mind, no obstacles are encountered.

992.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਰੁ ਦੇ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
992.t: naanak sir dhe chhuTeeaai man tan saachaa soi ||4||10||
992.e: O Nanak, giving one's head, one is emancipated, and the mind and body become true. ||4||10||

992.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
992.t: maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ||
992.e: Maaroo, First Mehla:

992.g: ਜੋਗੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰਮਾਇਲੁ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
992.t: jogee jugat naam niramail taa kai mail na raatee ||
992.e: The Yogi who is joined to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is pure; he is not stained by even a particle of dirt.

992.g: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਨਾਥੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਗੇ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਗਤਿ ਬੀਤੀ ॥੧॥
992.t: preetam naath sadhaa sach sa(n)ge janam maran gat beetee ||1||
992.e: The True Lord, his Beloved, is always with him; the rounds of birth and death are ended for him. ||1||

992.g: ਗੁਸਾਈ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
992.t: gusaiee teraa kahaa naam kaise jaatee ||
992.e: O Lord of the Universe, what is Your Name, and what is it like?

992.g: ਜਾ ਤਉ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਵਹਿ ਪੂਛਉ ਬਾਤ ਨਿਰੰਤੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
992.t: jaa tau bheetar mahal bulaaveh poochhau baat nira(n)tee ||1|| rahaau ||
992.e: If You summon me into the Mansion of Your Presence, I will ask You, how I can become one with You. ||1||Pause||

992.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਇਸਨਾਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਪੂਜੇ ਪਾਤੀ ॥
992.t: brahaman braham giaan isanaanee har gun pooje paatee ||
992.e: He alone is a Brahmin, who takes his cleansing bath in the spiritual wisdom of God, and whose leaf-offerings in worship are the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

992.g: ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਏਕਾ ਜੋਤੀ ॥੨॥
992.t: eko naam ek naarain tirabhavan ekaa jotee ||2||
992.e: The One Name, the One Lord, and His One Light pervade the three worlds. ||2||

992.g: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਡੰਡੀ ਇਹੁ ਘਟੁ ਛਾਬਾ ਤੋਲਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਜਾਚੀ ॥
992.t: jihavaa dda(n)ddee ih ghaT chhaabaa tolau naam ajaachee ||
992.e: My tongue is the balance of the scale, and this heart of mine is the pan of the scale; I weigh the immeasurable Naam.

992.g: ਏਕੋ ਹਾਟੁ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ਇਕ ਭਾਤੀ ॥੩॥
992.t: eko haaT saahu sabhanaa sir vanajaare ik bhaatee ||3||
992.e: There is one store, and one banker above all; the merchants deal in the one commodity. ||3||

992.g: ਦੋਵੈ ਸਿਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਨਿਬੇੜੇ ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਜੀਅਹੁ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਭਰਾਤੀ ॥
992.t: dhovai sire satiguroo nibeRe so boojhai jis ek liv laagee jeeahu rahai nibharaatee ||
992.e: The True Guru saves us at both ends; he alone understands, who is lovingly focused on the One Lord; his inner being remains free of doubt.

992.g: ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸਾਏ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ਸਦਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ॥੪॥
992.t: sabadh vasaae bharam chukaae sadhaa sevak dhin raatee ||4||
992.e: The Word of the Shabad abides within, and doubt is ended, for those who constantly serve, day and night. ||4||

992.g: ਊਪਰਿ ਗਗਨੁ ਗਗਨ ਪਰਿ ਗੋਰਖੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅਗਮੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਪੁਨਿ ਵਾਸੀ ॥
992.t: uoopar gagan gagan par gorakh taa kaa agam guroo pun vaasee ||
992.e: Above is the sky of the mind, and beyond this sky is the Lord, the Protector of the World; the Inaccessible Lord God; the Guru abides there as well.

992.g: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਭਇਆ ਉਦਾਸੀ ॥੫॥੧੧॥
992.t: gur bachanee baahar ghar eko naanak bhiaa udhaasee ||5||11||
992.e: According to the Word of the Guru's Teachings, what is outside is the same as what is inside the home of the self. Nanak has become a detached renunciate. ||5||11||

993.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੫
993.t: raag maaroo mahalaa pehilaa ghar panjavaa
993.e: Raag Maaroo, First Mehla, Fifth House:

993.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
993.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
993.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

993.g: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਜਾਗੈ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਸੋਵੈ ॥
993.t: ahinis jaagai needh na sovai ||
993.e: Day and night, he remains awake and aware; he never sleeps or dreams.

993.g: ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਵੇਦਨ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
993.t: so jaanai jis vedhan hovai ||
993.e: He alone knows this, who feels the pain of separation from God.

993.g: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੇ ਕਾਨ ਲਗੇ ਤਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਵੈਦੁ ਕਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
993.t: prem ke kaan lage tan bheetar vaidh k jaanai kaaree jeeau ||1||
993.e: My body is pierced through with the arrow of love. How can any physician know the cure? ||1||

993.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਲਾਏ ॥ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕਿਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
993.t: jis no saachaa sifatee laae || gurmukh virale kisai bujhaae ||
993.e: Rare is that one, who as Gurmukh, understands, and whom the True Lord links to His Praise.

993.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
993.t: a(n)mirat kee saar soiee jaanai j a(n)mirat kaa vaapaaree jeeau ||1|| rahaau ||
993.e: He alone appreciates the value of the Ambsosial Nectar, who deals in this Ambrosia. ||1||Pause||

993.g: ਪਿਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਧਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਰਚਾਏ ॥
993.t: pir setee dhan prem rachaae ||
993.e: The soul-bride is in love with her Husband Lord;

993.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਥਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
993.t: gur kai sabadh tathaa chit laae ||
993.e: she focuses her consciousness on the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

993.g: ਸਹਜ ਸੇਤੀ ਧਨ ਖਰੀ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਤਿਖਾ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
993.t: sahaj setee dhan kharee suhelee tirasanaa tikhaa nivaaree jeeau ||2||
993.e: The soul-bride is joyously embellished with intuitive ease; her hunger and thirst are taken away. ||2||

993.g: ਸਹਸਾ ਤੋੜੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥
993.t: sahasaa toRe bharam chukaae ||
993.e: Tear down skepticism and dispel your doubt;

993.g: ਸਹਜੇ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਧਣਖੁ ਚੜਾਏ ॥
993.t: sahaje sifatee dhanakh chaRaae ||
993.e: with your intuition, draw the bow of the Praise of the Lord.

993.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਜੋਗਾਧਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
993.t: gur kai sabadh marai man maare su(n)dhar jogaadhaaree jeeau ||3||
993.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, conquer and subdue your mind; take the support of Yoga - Union with the beautiful Lord. ||3||

993.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਜਲਿਆ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੇ ॥
993.t: haumai jaliaa manahu visaare ||
993.e: Burnt by egotism, one forgets the Lord from his mind.

993.g: ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਵਜਹਿ ਖੜਗ ਕਰਾਰੇ ॥
993.t: jam pur vajeh khaRag karaare ||
993.e: In the City of Death, he is attacked with massive swords.

993.g: ਅਬ ਕੈ ਕਹਿਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਮਿਲਈ ਤੂ ਸਹੁ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਭਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
993.t: ab kai kahiaai naam na miliee too sahu jeeaRe bhaaree jeeau ||4||
993.e: Then, even if he asks for it, he will not receive the Lord's Name; O soul, you shall suffer terrible punishment. ||4||

993.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਮਤਾ ਪਵਹਿ ਖਿਆਲੀ ॥
993.t: maiaa mamataa paveh khiaalee ||
993.e: You are distracted by thoughts of Maya and worldly attachment.

993.g: ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਫਾਸਹਿਗਾ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੀ ॥
993.t: jam pur faasahigaa jam jaalee ||
993.e: In the City of Death, you will be caught by the noose of the Messenger of Death.

993.g: ਹੇਤ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋੜਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਹਿ ਤਾ ਜਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਆਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
993.t: het ke ba(n)dhan toR na saakeh taa jam kare khuaaree jeeau ||5||
993.e: You cannot break free from the bondage of loving attachment, and so the Messenger of Death will torture you. ||5||

993.g: ਨਾ ਹਉ ਕਰਤਾ ਨਾ ਮੈ ਕੀਆ ॥
993.t: naa hau karataa naa mai keeaa ||
993.e: I have done nothing; I am doing nothing now.

993.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ॥
993.t: a(n)mrit naam satigur dheeaa ||
993.e: The True Guru has blessed me with the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam.

993.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਿਆ ਚਾਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥੧॥੧੨॥
993.t: jis too dheh tisai kiaa chaaraa naanak saran tumaaree jeeau ||6||1||12||
993.e: What other efforts can anyone make, when You bestow Your blessing? Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary. ||6||1||12||

993.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧
993.t: maaroo mahalaa teejaa ghar pehilaa
993.e: Maaroo, Third Mehla, First House:

993.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
993.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
993.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

993.g: ਜਹ ਬੈਸਾਲਹਿ ਤਹ ਬੈਸਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਹ ਭੇਜਹਿ ਤਹ ਜਾਵਾ ॥
993.t: jeh baisaaleh teh baisaa suaamee jeh bhejeh teh jaavaa ||
993.e: Wherever You seat me, there I sit, O my Lord and Master; wherever You send me, there I go.

993.g: ਸਭ ਨਗਰੀ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੋ ਰਾਜਾ ਸਭੇ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹਹਿ ਥਾਵਾ ॥੧॥
993.t: sabh nagaree meh eko raajaa sabhe pavit heh thaavaa ||1||
993.e: In the entire village, there is only One King; all places are sacred. ||1||

993.g: ਬਾਬਾ ਦੇਹਿ ਵਸਾ ਸਚ ਗਾਵਾ ॥
993.t: baabaa dheh vasaa sach gaavaa ||
993.e: O Baba, while I dwell in this body, let me sing Your True Praises,

993.g: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
993.t: jaa te sahaje sahaj samaavaa ||1|| rahaau ||
993.e: that I may intuitively merge with You. ||1||Pause||

993.g: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪਸ ਤੇ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਏਈ ਸਗਲ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ॥
993.t: buraa bhalaa kichh aapas te jaaniaa eiee sagal vikaaraa ||
993.e: He thinks that good and bad deeds come from himself; this is the source of all evil.

993.g: ਇਹੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਹੋਆ ਵਰਤੈ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
993.t: eih furamaiaa khasam kaa hoaa varatai ih sa(n)saaraa ||2||
993.e: Whatever happens in this world is only by the Order of our Lord and Master. ||2||

993.g: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਧਾਤੁ ਸਬਲ ਕਹੀਅਤ ਹੈ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਕਿਸ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ॥
993.t: ei(n)dhree dhaat sabal kaheeat hai i(n)dhree kis te hoiee ||
993.e: Sexual desires are so strong and compelling; where has this sexual desire come from?

993.g: ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲ ਕਰੈ ਸਭਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਐਸਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥
993.t: aape khel karai sabh karataa aaisaa boojhai koiee ||3||
993.e: The Creator Himself stages all the plays; how rare are those who realize this. ||3||

993.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਤਦੇ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
993.t: gur parasaadhee ek liv laagee dhubidhaa tadhe binaasee ||
993.e: By Guru's Grace, one is lovingly focused on the One Lord, and then, duality is ended.

993.g: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਸੋ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਕਾਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ॥੪॥
993.t: jo tis bhaanaa so sat kar maaniaa kaaTee jam kee faasee ||4||
993.e: Whatever is in harmony with His Will, he accepts as True; the noose of Death is loosened from around his neck. ||4||

993.g: ਭਣਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਲੇਖਾ ਮਾਗੈ ਕਵਨਾ ਜਾ ਚੂਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ॥
993.t: bhanat naanak lekhaa maagai kavanaa jaa chookaa man abhimaanaa ||
993.e: Prays Nanak, who can call him to account, when the egotistical pride of his mind has been silenced?

993.g: ਤਾਸੁ ਤਾਸੁ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਜਪਤੁ ਹੈ ਪਏ ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾ ॥੫॥੧॥
993.t: taas taas dharam rai japat hai pe sache kee saranaa ||5||1||
993.e: Even the Righteous Judge of Dharma is intimidated and afraid of him; he has entered the Sanctuary of the True Lord. ||5||1||

993.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
993.t: maaroo mahalaa teejaa ||
993.e: Maaroo, Third Mehla:

993.g: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
993.t: aavan jaanaa naa theeaai nij ghar vaasaa hoi ||
993.e: Coming and going in reincarnation no longer happens, when one dwells in the home of the self within.

993.g: ਸਚੁ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਬਖਸਿਆ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
993.t: sach khajaanaa bakhasiaa aape jaanai soi ||1||
993.e: He bestowed the Blessing of His treasure of truth; only He Himself knows. ||1||

994.g: ਏ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਚੇਤਿ ਤੂ ਮਨਹੁ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
994.t: e man har jeeau chet too manahu taj vikaar ||
994.e: O my mind, remember the Dear Lord, and abandon the corruption of your mind.

994.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਸਚਿ ਲਗੀ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
994.t: gur kai sabadh dhiaai too sach lagee piaar ||1|| rahaau ||
994.e: Meditate on the Word of the Guru's Shabad; focus lovingly on the Truth. ||1||Pause||

994.g: ਐਥੈ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਭੁਲਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਹਥੁ ਕਿਥਾਊ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
994.t: aaithai naavahu bhuliaa fir hath kithaauoo na pai ||
994.e: One who forgets the Name in this world, shall not find any place of rest anywhere else.

994.g: ਜੋਨੀ ਸਭਿ ਭਵਾਈਅਨਿ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
994.t: jonee sabh bhavaieean bisaTaa maeh samai ||2||
994.e: He shall wander in all sorts of reincarnations, and rot away in manure. ||2||

994.g: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਮਾਇ ॥
994.t: vaddabhaagee gur paiaa poorab likhiaa mai ||
994.e: By great good fortune, I have found the Guru, according to my pre-ordained destiny, O my mother.

994.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
994.t: anadhin sachee bhagat kar sachaa le milai ||3||
994.e: Night and day, I practice true devotional worship; I am united with the True Lord. ||3||

994.g: ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
994.t: aape sirasaT sabh saajeean aape nadhar karei ||
994.e: He Himself fashioned the entire universe; He Himself bestows His Glance of Grace.

994.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥੪॥੨॥
994.t: naanak naam vaddiaaieeaa jai bhaavai tai dhei ||4||2||
994.e: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is glorious and great; as He pleases, He bestows His Blessings. ||4||2||

994.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
994.t: maaroo mahalaa teejaa ||
994.e: Maaroo, Third Mehla:

994.g: ਪਿਛਲੇ ਗੁਨਹ ਬਖਸਾਇ ਜੀਉ ਅਬ ਤੂ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
994.t: pichhale guneh bakhasai jeeau ab too maarag pai ||
994.e: Please forgive my past mistakes, O my Dear Lord; now, please place me on the Path.

994.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹਾ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੧॥
994.t: har kee charanee laag rahaa vichahu aap gavai ||1||
994.e: I remain attached to the Lord's Feet, and eradicate self-conceit from within. ||1||

994.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
994.t: mere man gurmukh naam har dhiaai ||
994.e: O my mind, as Gurmukh, meditate on the Name of the Lord.

994.g: ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹਾ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਏਕੈ ਭਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
994.t: sadhaa har charanee laag rahaa ik man ekai bhai ||1|| rahaau ||
994.e: Remain attached forever to the Lord's Feet, single-mindedly, with love for the One Lord. ||1||Pause||

994.g: ਨਾ ਮੈ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਪਤਿ ਹੈ ਨਾ ਮੈ ਥੇਹੁ ਨ ਥਾਉ ॥
994.t: naa mai jaat na pat hai naa mai theh na thaau ||
994.e: I have no social status or honor; I have no place or home.

994.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਭੇਦਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਟਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥੨॥
994.t: sabadh bhedh bhram kaTiaa gur naam dheeaa samajhai ||2||
994.e: Pierced through by the Word of the Shabad, my doubts have been cut away. The Guru has inspired me to understand the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

994.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਲਚ ਕਰਦਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
994.t: eih man laalach karadhaa firai laalach laagaa jai ||
994.e: This mind wanders around, driven by greed, totally attached to greed.

994.g: ਧੰਧੈ ਕੂੜਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਇ ॥੩॥
994.t: dha(n)dhai kooR viaapiaa jam pur choTaa khai ||3||
994.e: He is engrossed in false pursuits; he shall endure beatings in the City of Death. ||3||

994.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
994.t: naanak sabh kichh aape aap hai dhoojaa naahee koi ||
994.e: O Nanak, God Himself Himself is all-in-all. There is no other at all.

994.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਬਖਸਿਓਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੩॥
994.t: bhagat khajaanaa bakhasion gurmukhaa sukh hoi ||4||3||
